# GitHub Control-Plane Artifact and Workflow Implementation Plan

> **Current execution boundary:** This document is a dormant future specification. Do not execute, implement, stage, commit, push, open a main implementation PR, or report GREEN for any part of Tasks 1–14. Checkbox steps and command blocks preserve reviewed future contract detail only; they are not current instructions.

**Future goal:** Build the source-only GitHub artifact, immutable Production Gate, deployment-plan, permission, and manual workflow contracts for Japan control-plane deployment without dispatching a workflow, changing GitHub settings, reading production secrets, or touching production.

**Future architecture:** Pure Node.js contracts first create canonical Production Gate, deployment-plan, release-declaration, artifact-assembly, GitHub-evidence, and immutable-publication boundaries while consuming the Host/DB-owned canonical writer registry. Three manual-only workflows then compose those contracts into separated source preparation, tokenless build, no-write verification, protected publication, no-secret preflight, protected approval, and isolated Deploy Note jobs. This would be one serial slice of a later single main source-only Draft PR, after separately approved predecessors; no such Artifact implementation PR is authorized now. Host execution, database transaction, bootstrap, terminal receipt, recovery, settings mutation, workflow dispatch, and production use remain owned by their adjacent plans and Risk A Gates.

**Tech Stack:** Node.js 22 ESM, `node:test`, GitHub Actions, GitHub REST, GitHub artifact attestations, Git Release assets, SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-256, canonical UTF-8 JSON, `git archive`, npm lockfile integrity, and a digest-pinned Debian builder image.

That receipt, tag, predicate domain, and asset namespace are disjoint from `pg1`, `control-plane-app-*`, and `production-gate-*` and never satisfy production preflight.
- Inventory Gate ID grammar is exactly `^ig1\.[0-9a-f]{40}\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?\.[0-9a-f]{64}$`; its fields are version, source commit, runtime-contract ID, and receipt SHA-256.
- Inventory receipt Release is `control-plane-inventory-{sourceCommit}-{runtimeContractId}`; asset is `inventory-receipt-{receiptSha256}.json`; the receipt excludes its external ID and expires exactly two hours after `createdAt`.
- Production Gate and deployment plan expire when `now >= expiresAt`; effective plan expiry is exactly `min(inventoryExpiresAt, productionGateExpiresAt, createdAt + 2h)`.
- Portable `artifact.json` remains Artifact Manifest v1; deployment-only fields live in companions and never enter that manifest.
- Artifact bundle maximum compressed size is 268435456 bytes; canonical source ZIP maximum is 67108864 bytes; maximum entries are 50000; maximum per-entry expanded size is 67108864 bytes; maximum aggregate expanded size is 805306368 bytes; maximum compression ratio is 100.
- Builder authority is exactly the immutable published Foundation v2 lock. Its image is `docker.io/library/node:22.23.1-bookworm@sha256:175215a1f306ed5df592434b99cc2019f70624373fe49cb659240a618a846aed` for `linux/amd64`. The committed Artifact builder contract binds only its own schema/type, the package-lock digest, native-registry digest, and exact package-custody policy; it does not restate or independently expect the Foundation lock-asset SHA-256, image, Node-header tree, toolchain tree, role path/digest, or complete closure. - New high-authority workflows pin `actions/checkout` to `df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10`, `actions/setup-node` to `249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38`, `actions/upload-artifact` to `043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a`, `actions/download-artifact` to `3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c`, `actions/github-script` to `60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea`, and the official generic `actions/attest` v4.2.2 to `1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6`; the reviewed action metadata exists at that commit and uses the Node 24 action runtime. Protected deployment adds only `id-token: write`; both no-secret preflight and protected postapproval use `pull-requests: read` solely for the fixed main-source PR/ancestry resolver.
- Publisher receives only `actions: read`, `contents: write`, `pull-requests: read`, `id-token: write`, and `attestations: write`, is bound to `artifact-publication`, and has no production Environment or production secret. It performs no checkout, setup-node, archive extraction, candidate import, or repository-script execution: pinned official actions plus one inline, fixed, bounded publisher control re-hash opaque verified assets, re-read the exact main-source PR/ancestry plus approval/policy, and perform only the closed Release/attestation operations.
- Environment authority is content-addressed, not count-addressed: its canonical policy includes sorted exact user reviewer identities (`type:"user"`, stable decimal `id`, normalized lower-case `login`, `slug:null`) and the explicit `can_admins_bypass` bit. A Team or unknown reviewer, missing/unknown bypass evidence, same-count reviewer replacement, or an approver outside the current exact user set fails before any secret or write; no organization-membership API, PAT, or App token is required.
- Deploy Note receives only `actions: read`, `contents: read`, and `pull-requests: write`, and never shares a job with production credentials, OIDC, or SSH.
- Existing `.github/workflows/release-artifact.yml` remains short-lived source-build evidence; existing `.github/workflows/production-deploy-dry-run.yml` remains dry-run-only.
- Reserved Environment secrets are exactly `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_HOST`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PORT`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_BINDING_KEY`, and `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`.
- Reserved Environment variables are exactly `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_BOOTSTRAP_GENERATION`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_BOOTSTRAP_RECEIPT_SHA256`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_AUTHORIZATION_BINDING_HMAC_SHA256`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_AUTHORIZATION_STATE_SHA256`, `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_ID`, and `JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_INSTALLATION_ID`.
- No output may contain a secret value, endpoint, host path, database path, environment value, raw config, response body, log, process identifier, OIDC token, private key, customer data, or subscription material.
- Never hard-code a guessed GitHub check App ID or synthesize workflow identity from context/App. Artifact and deployment admission consume fresh inventory-owned `requiredCheckContracts`, re-read exact-SHA checks plus the complete Actions workflow-run snapshot, join workflow checks by observed check-suite ID, require producer tuple byte equality and success, and reject missing, extra, duplicate, ruleset-drifted, or producer-drifted contexts.
- Every cross-job artifact is data-only. `source-prepare` checks out the immutable workflow-dispatch SHA read-only and emits a canonical source archive plus manifest/tree digest and canonical inputs. A separate trusted read-only `toolchain-prepare` job checks out the same exact `${{ github.sha }}`, uses Foundation's fixed no-selector exporter to verify the immutable v2 publication live, and uploads exactly `foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json` plus `immutable-publication-evidence.json`. The tokenless builder has `permissions: {}`, no checkout, no repository or GitHub API token in any candidate process, validates both data artifacts before extraction/execution, and obtains no Foundation bytes from a PR head, caller URL, Release request, or fallback. Verify checks out the exact source SHA read-only, downloads the same two toolchain data files, grants exactly `attestations: read`, `contents: read`, and `pull-requests: read`, and maps its read-only `GITHUB_TOKEN` only into the trusted exact-SHA main-source resolver plus Integration's typed immutable inventory Release/attestation resolver; the token never enters builder code, publisher code, a child environment, or output. Publisher downloads only the verified publication envelope/assets and never receives or executes the source archive, a candidate script, checksum program, package, native binary, or shell fragment.
- Every dependency/native build child runs under the closed `env -i` scrubber, receives no GitHub/OIDC/Actions token, uses only Foundation's private-branded published-lock resolver return, and the offline phase runs in a disabled network namespace. The pinned download/upload actions may use the runner's internal Actions-artifact transport before or after candidate execution, and the fetch phase may use only its closed HTTPS package-custody origins; neither capability nor any token is inherited by candidate code. No independent custody digest/root/manifest tuple crosses into a child.
- `workflow_dispatch` values enter shell steps only through a closed `env:` mapping and are validated as data. No `${{ inputs.* }}` expression may appear inside a `run:` block.
- All 19 jobs across the normal, compatibility, and production workflows fix `runs-on: ubuntu-24.04` and an exact ordered direct-key/value skeleton. The tests compare every job's ordered keys, visible scalar values, and a SHA-256 over the complete raw job block, so nested outputs, permissions, and steps are covered as bytes. Duplicate/case/anchor/alias/merge drift, `defaults`, `container`, `services`, self-hosted/`ubuntu-latest`, unlisted keys, or any `needs`, `if`, `continue-on-error`, `timeout-minutes`, `environment`, `outputs`, `permissions`, or `steps` mutation fails before the test-only external-write-eligibility callback and leaves that callback at zero.
- This plan currently accepts no attestation for eligibility. A future accepted attestation must carry a private full-Sigstore owner brand covering GitHub issuer, repository, workflow path/ref/SHA, source commit, predicate type, exact subject name/digest, SCT/CT-log authority, Fulcio/Rekor key-time policy, and official vectors; matching an API row, payload, diagnostic result, or subject digest is insufficient.
- These are direct workflows, not reusable workflows. Production OIDC verification binds the signed `workflow_ref` and `workflow_sha` claims; `job_workflow_ref` and `job_workflow_sha` are rejected. Bootstrap alone owns time validation and accepts the normal relation `nbf <= iat`, checks `nbf`, `iat`, and `exp` independently against bounded skew, and limits `exp - iat`.
- Preapproval never reads or requires a future Environment approval. The first protected custom step re-reads current policy, current exhaustive ruleset requirements, exact successful check tuples, and the current run's approval history, then creates the one canonical production authorization record.
- Production credential material is lazy-only. Controller and scope-attestor code receive materializers, never raw host, port, user, private-key, known-hosts, binding-key, or metadata-App private-key values. The deploy materializer obtains the branded four-field host-key binding only through `deriveKnownHostsBinding({ host, port, knownHostsBytes })`, emits Bootstrap's exact 11-field `FIXED_CREDENTIAL_MATERIAL_FIELDS` record, creates Bootstrap's sole branded eight-field expectation through `createFixedCredentialExpectation(...)`, calls `assertKnownHostsRecordExpectation({ binding, material })`, calls `validateFixedCredentialMaterial(material, expectation)`, and returns the exact frozen `{ material, expectation }` capture; it never constructs an expectation-shaped object itself. Bootstrap seals the one capture, gives every operation a fresh non-aliased clone, zeroizes each clone in its operation `finally`, and zeroizes/closes retained originals in the transport's outer `finally`/idempotent `close()`.

## File Structure

### Shared dependencies consumed from adjacent plans

- `server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs`: duplicate-key-rejecting canonical byte contract.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-inventory-receipt.mjs`: owns the inventory receipt schema and exports `resolveInventoryReceipt({ repository, inventoryGateId, token, fetchFn })`, returning `{ bytes, sha256, receipt }` without accepting a URL or path. Its canonical receipt carries the complete inventory-owned `requiredCheckContracts` value; all live ruleset-required contexts are exhaustive, and semantic roles include at least `validate` and `codeql`.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-required-check-contract.mjs`: Integration Task 2's sole required-check schema/canonical-byte provider. Artifact imports its exact Foundation-shape `REQUIRED_CHECK_CONTRACT`, `REQUIRED_CHECK_ARRAY_CONTRACT`, `validateRequiredCheckContracts`, and `canonicalizeRequiredCheckContracts(value) -> { requiredCheckContracts, bytes, sha256 }`; every entry is exact `{ semanticRole, context, appSlug, integrationId, sourceKind, workflowPath, workflowRef, workflowSha }`, non-workflow fields are canonical `null`, and Artifact declares no local check-contract constant, field list, or serializer.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-required-check-registry.mjs`: Integration Task 2's sole private semantic/context policy and producer resolver. Its only export is `resolveControlPlaneRequiredCheckContracts({ sourceCommit, rulesetRequirements, checkRuns, workflowRuns }) -> { requiredCheckContracts, bytes, sha256 }`; Artifact supplies the complete live check-run and workflow-run observations, consumes that exact wrapper byte-for-byte, and defines no second registry, mapping, identity array, canonicalizer, or workflow-identity fallback.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-inventory-attestation-predicate.mjs`: Integration's dependency-leaf owner of `INVENTORY_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT`. Artifact imports that exact contract for generic attestation verification and never copies its field order or validator.
- `server/services/deployment/writer-registry.mjs`: Host/DB-owned registry implementation exporting `WRITER_REGISTRY_CONTRACT`, `discoverProductionWriters`, `canonicalizeWriterRegistry`, and `verifyWriterRegistry`; its CLI is `scripts/control-plane-writer-registry.mjs`, test is `server/tests/control-plane-writer-registry.test.mjs`, and source contract is `ops/control-plane-deploy/writer-registry.sources.json`.
- `ops/control-plane-deploy/contracts/host-execution-contract.json`: exact host, bootstrap, database, writer, validation, rollback, and recovery contract digests.
- `ops/control-plane-deploy/contracts/receipt-contract.json`: exact terminal aggregate receipt contract consumed by workflow validation.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-transport-contract.mjs`: Bootstrap-owned `DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID`, exact eleven-field `FIXED_CREDENTIAL_MATERIAL_FIELDS`, exact eight-field `FIXED_CREDENTIAL_EXPECTATION_FIELDS`, executable `FIXED_CREDENTIAL_EXPECTATION_CONTRACT`, `createFixedCredentialExpectation({ credentialId, authorizationGeneration, bootstrapReceiptSha256, knownHostsFingerprint, knownHostsTupleSha256, expiresAt, observedAt })`, `deriveKnownHostsBinding({ host, port, knownHostsBytes })`, `assertKnownHostsRecordExpectation({ binding, material })`, `validateFixedCredentialMaterial(material, expectation)`, `TRANSPORT_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES`, `validateTransportEnvelope(envelope)`, and `createSecureSshTransport({ native, clock, secretMaterializer })`. The owner factory fixes `principal` from `credentialId` and returns the only accepted branded expectation; Artifact never supplies a raw principal or any caller-built expectation alias. The transport's exact public surface is `execute`, `request`, `requestStatusBundle`, `requestBootstrap`, and `close`; the three one-response operations return the exact validated `{ exitCode, responseBytes, diagnosticCode }` envelope, while only Bootstrap's terminal reader can drive the private-frame `requestStatusBundle` stream. Only fixed credential ID `japan-control-plane-github-deploy-v1` is accepted by this workflow.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-host-protocol.mjs`: Bootstrap-owned exact request/response codecs and bounded terminal-bundle reader. Artifact imports only `encodeExecuteAuthFrame`, `validateArtifactAcceptedFrame`, `encodeStatusRequestFrame`, `validateStatusResponseFrame`, and `readTerminalBundleBytes({ transport, validatedStatus, timeoutMs })`; there is no generic decoder, chunk loop, bundle parser, or Artifact-local codec alias. `execute_auth` carries the exact bounded canonical `deploymentPlanBytes`, `productionGateReceiptBytes`, `authorizationRecordBytes`, and OIDC token bytes so the host can validate and durably publish/read back the Bootstrap-owned accepted-plan before artifact acceptance. Artifact passes a six-field expected ready value, not encoded ready bytes, to transport. Ordinary status requests carry exactly `{ requestId, gateId, deploymentPlanSha256, transactionId }`; Bootstrap's terminal reader alone consumes fixed 768-byte chunks, maximum 262,144 bytes and 342 chunks, and Artifact does not duplicate those constants.
- `server/services/deployment/database-contract.mjs`: Host/DB-owned `canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(value) -> { databaseContracts, bytes, sha256 }` plus the sole frozen `DATABASE_CONTRACT_ENTRY_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT`. Artifact invokes the helper and mounts that unchanged opaque owner object only as `nested["database-contract-entry-v1"]`, with `arrays.databaseContracts` equal to the same fixed selector. It compares three independently canonicalized sources and propagates the owner digest. Artifact never reads or copies the descriptor's field order, exports or imports Host's private set/root contract or normalizer, sorts, repairs, duplicates the 14-field schema, generates, or recomputes physical identity HMACs.
- `server/services/deployment/control-plane-controller-closeout.mjs`, `server/services/deployment/control-plane-controller-closeout-adapter.mjs`, and `scripts/control-plane-controller-closeout.mjs`: Receipt-owned immutable closeout state algebra, transition-specific one-use OIDC request builder, Actions-artifact publisher/readback, `CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT`, `buildControllerFinalStatus(...)`, `inspectControllerFinalStatus(bytes, expectedRun)`, `validateControllerFinalStatus(bytes, expected)`, observation validators, and fixed CLI commands; this plan only composes them. Only the isolated Deploy Note path uses `inspectControllerFinalStatus` for its no-read no-claim decision; the normal controller uses full validation.
- `package.json`, `schemas/README.md`, `docs/GITHUB_DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md`, `RELEASE_MANIFEST.md`, `docs/VALIDATION_BASELINE.md`, and `docs/README.md`: owned by the rollout/integration/documentation slice; this plan supplies exact commands and source-workflow semantics but does not edit those files.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the exact Production Gate field contract and ID parser**

```javascript
import { readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import { assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity } from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";

export const PRODUCTION_GATE_ID_PATTERN = /^pg1\.[0-9a-f]{40}\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?\.[0-9a-f]{64}$/;

export const PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-production-gate-receipt-v1",
  maxBytes: 32_768,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schemaVersion", "receiptType", "repository", "sourceCommit",
    "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha",
    "mainSourceMergeCommitSha",
    "runtimeContractId", "target", "releaseUnit", "expectedCurrentRelease",
    "inventoryGateId", "inventoryReceiptSha256", "inventoryExpiresAt",
    "artifactReleaseTag", "artifactSha256", "releaseDeclarationSha256",
    "bootstrapReceiptSha256", "deploymentPlanTemplateSha256", "createdAt",
    "expiresAt"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schemaVersion !== "1"
      || value.receiptType !== "japan_control_plane_production_gate"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal") {
      throw new Error("production_gate_receipt_invalid");
    }
  }
});

export function parseProductionGateId(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !PRODUCTION_GATE_ID_PATTERN.test(value)) {
    throw new Error("production_gate_id_invalid");
  }
  const [version, sourceCommit, runtimeContractId, receiptSha256] = value.split(".");
  const canonical = `${version}.${sourceCommit}.${runtimeContractId}.${receiptSha256}`;
  if (canonical !== value) throw new Error("production_gate_id_invalid");
  return {
    version,
    sourceCommit,
    runtimeContractId,
    receiptSha256,
    releaseTag: `control-plane-app-${sourceCommit}-${runtimeContractId}`,
    assetName: `production-gate-${receiptSha256}.json`
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement canonical receipt creation and strict validation**

```js
const SHA256_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SOURCE_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const RELEASE_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,160}$/;
const REPOSITORY = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";

function canonicalTime(value, code) {
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) || parsed.toISOString() !== value) throw new Error(code);
  return parsed.getTime();
}

function validateReceipt(receipt) {
  const expectedTag = `control-plane-app-${receipt.sourceCommit}-${receipt.runtimeContractId}`;
  const createdAt = canonicalTime(receipt.createdAt, "production_gate_receipt_invalid");
  const expiresAt = canonicalTime(receipt.expiresAt, "production_gate_receipt_invalid");
  if (receipt.schemaVersion !== "1"
    || receipt.receiptType !== "japan_control_plane_production_gate"
    || receipt.repository !== REPOSITORY
    || !SOURCE_PATTERN.test(receipt.sourceCommit)
    || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(receipt.mainSourceIdentitySha256)
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(receipt.mainSourcePrNumber)
    || receipt.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
    || !SOURCE_PATTERN.test(receipt.mainSourceHeadSha)
    || !SOURCE_PATTERN.test(receipt.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
    || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?$/.test(receipt.runtimeContractId)
    || receipt.target !== "japan-control-plane"
    || receipt.releaseUnit !== "control-plane-app"
    || !RELEASE_PATTERN.test(receipt.expectedCurrentRelease)
    || !/^ig1\.[0-9a-f]{40}\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?\.[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(receipt.inventoryGateId)
    || receipt.artifactReleaseTag !== expectedTag
    || ![receipt.inventoryReceiptSha256, receipt.artifactSha256,
      receipt.releaseDeclarationSha256, receipt.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
      receipt.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
      receipt.deploymentPlanTemplateSha256].every((value) => SHA256_PATTERN.test(value))
    || expiresAt !== createdAt + 7_200_000
    || expiresAt > canonicalTime(receipt.inventoryExpiresAt, "production_gate_receipt_invalid")) {
    throw new Error("production_gate_receipt_invalid");
  }
  return receipt;
}

export function createProductionGateReceipt(input) {
  const mainSourceIdentity = assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity(input.validatedMainSourceIdentity);
  const { validatedMainSourceIdentity, ...receiptInput } = input;
  const receipt = validateReceipt(Object.freeze({
    ...receiptInput,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: mainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  }));
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(receipt, PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT);
  const receiptSha256 = sha256Hex(bytes);
  const productionGateId = `pg1.${receipt.sourceCommit}.${receipt.runtimeContractId}.${receiptSha256}`;
  return {
    receipt,
    bytes,
    receiptSha256,
    productionGateId,
    releaseTag: receipt.artifactReleaseTag,
    assetName: `production-gate-${receiptSha256}.json`
  };
}

export function validateProductionGateReceipt({
  productionGateId,
  bytes,
  now,
  expectedRepository = REPOSITORY,
  expectedSourceCommit
}) {
  const parsedId = parseProductionGateId(productionGateId);
  const receipt = validateReceipt(parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT));
  if (receipt.repository !== expectedRepository
    || receipt.sourceCommit !== parsedId.sourceCommit
    || receipt.runtimeContractId !== parsedId.runtimeContractId
    || sha256Hex(bytes) !== parsedId.receiptSha256
    || expectedSourceCommit !== undefined && receipt.sourceCommit !== expectedSourceCommit
    || new Date(now).getTime() >= new Date(receipt.expiresAt).getTime()) {
    throw new Error("production_gate_receipt_invalid");
  }
  return { receipt, ...parsedId };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Add exact immutable Release resolution and the bounded verify CLI**

```js
export async function resolveProductionGateReceipt({ repository, productionGateId, token, fetchFn, now }) {
  if (repository !== REPOSITORY) throw new Error("production_gate_repository_invalid");
  const identity = parseProductionGateId(productionGateId);
  const releaseResponse = await fetchFn(`https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${identity.releaseTag}`, {
    method: "GET",
    redirect: "error",
    headers: { accept: "application/vnd.github+json", authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "x-github-api-version": "2022-11-28" }
  });
  if (!releaseResponse.ok) throw new Error(`production_gate_release_http_${releaseResponse.status}`);
  const release = await releaseResponse.json();
  const assets = release.assets?.filter(({ name }) => name === identity.assetName) ?? [];
  if (release.tag_name !== identity.releaseTag
    || release.target_commitish !== identity.sourceCommit
    || assets.length !== 1
    || !/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(String(assets[0].id))) {
    throw new Error("production_gate_release_invalid");
  }
  const assetResponse = await fetchFn(`https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/assets/${assets[0].id}`, {
    method: "GET",
    redirect: "manual",
    headers: { accept: "application/octet-stream", authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "x-github-api-version": "2022-11-28" }
  });
  let bytes;
  if (assetResponse.status === 302) {
    const location = new URL(assetResponse.headers.get("location"));
    if (location.protocol !== "https:" || location.hostname !== "release-assets.githubusercontent.com") {
      throw new Error("production_gate_asset_redirect_invalid");
    }
    const redirected = await fetchFn(location, { method: "GET", redirect: "error", headers: { accept: "application/octet-stream" } });
    if (!redirected.ok) throw new Error(`production_gate_asset_http_${redirected.status}`);
    bytes = Buffer.from(await redirected.arrayBuffer());
  } else {
    if (!assetResponse.ok) throw new Error(`production_gate_asset_http_${assetResponse.status}`);
    bytes = Buffer.from(await assetResponse.arrayBuffer());
  }
  const validated = validateProductionGateReceipt({ productionGateId, bytes, now, expectedRepository: repository });
  return Object.freeze({ bytes, sha256: identity.receiptSha256, receipt: validated.receipt });
}

export function runProductionGateCli({ argv, stdout, stderr } = {}) {
  try {
    const [command, inputFlag, inputPath, idFlag, idValue] = argv;
    if (inputFlag !== "--input" || !inputPath) throw new Error("production_gate_cli_invalid");
    const bytes = readFileSync(inputPath);
    if (command === "verify" && idFlag === "--production-gate-id") {
      const result = validateProductionGateReceipt({
        productionGateId: idValue,
        bytes,
        now: new Date().toISOString()
      });
      stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ ok: true, type: "production_gate", receiptSha256: result.receiptSha256 })}\n`);
      return 0;
    }
    throw new Error("production_gate_cli_invalid");
  } catch {
    stderr.write('{"ok":false,"error":"production_gate_rejected"}\n');
    return 1;
  }
}
```

    databaseContracts: canonicalDatabase.databaseContracts

  const stableBytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(stableBody, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_STABLE_BODY_CONTRACT);
  assert.equal(created.bytes.at(-1), "}".charCodeAt(0));
  assert.equal(stableBytes.at(-1), "}".charCodeAt(0));
  assert.deepEqual(parseCanonicalJsonBytes(created.bytes, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT), created.plan);
  const reorderedArtifact = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(created.plan.artifact).reverse());
  assert.equal(
    serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(
      { ...created.plan, artifact: reorderedArtifact },
      DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT
    ).equals(created.bytes),
    true
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    parseCanonicalJsonBytes(stableBytes, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_STABLE_BODY_CONTRACT),
    stableBody
  );
  assert.strictEqual(DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.nested, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_STABLE_BODY_CONTRACT.nested);
  assert.strictEqual(DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.arrays, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_STABLE_BODY_CONTRACT.arrays);
  assert.equal(
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.arrays.auxiliaryWriterContracts,
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.nested[
      DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.arrays.auxiliaryWriterContracts
    ].schemaId
  );
  assert.equal(
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.arrays.gatedBusinessMutationEntrypoints,
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.nested[
      DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.arrays.gatedBusinessMutationEntrypoints
    ].schemaId
  );
  assert.strictEqual(
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.nested["database-contract-entry-v1"],
    DATABASE_CONTRACT_ENTRY_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT
  );
  assert.equal(
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.arrays.databaseContracts,
    "database-contract-entry-v1"
  );
});

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement exact expiry and domain-separated identities**

```js
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import {
  DATABASE_CONTRACT_ENTRY_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT,
  canonicalizeDatabaseContracts
} from "../server/services/deployment/database-contract.mjs";
import { assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity } from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";

const PLAN_TTL_MS = 7_200_000;

function canonicalTime(value) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString() !== value) {
    throw new Error("deployment_plan_invalid");
  }
  return date;
}

export function computeEffectiveExpiry({ inventoryExpiresAt, productionGateExpiresAt, createdAt }) {
  const values = [
    canonicalTime(inventoryExpiresAt).getTime(),
    canonicalTime(productionGateExpiresAt).getTime(),
    canonicalTime(createdAt).getTime() + PLAN_TTL_MS
  ];
  return new Date(Math.min(...values)).toISOString();
}

function domainDigest(domain, values) {
  const hash = createHash("sha256").update(`${domain}\0`, "utf8");
  for (const value of values) hash.update(`${value}\0`, "utf8");
  return hash.digest("hex");
}

function createRunIdentities({ gateReceipt, runContext }) {
  const transactionDigest = domainDigest("gccgw-control-plane-deployment-transaction-v1", [
    runContext.repository,
    String(runContext.runId),
    String(runContext.runAttempt),
    "japan-control-plane",
    gateReceipt.sourceCommit
  ]);
  const transactionId = `dpt1.${transactionDigest}`;
  const recoveryDigest = domainDigest("gccgw-control-plane-controller-recovery-v1", [
    gateReceipt.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    transactionId,
    "japan-control-plane",
    gateReceipt.sourceCommit
  ]);
  return {
    transactionId,
    controllerRecoveryId: `cr1.${recoveryDigest}`,
    candidateRelease: `control-plane-${transactionDigest.slice(0, 32)}`
  };
}
```

const STRING_ARRAY_DESCRIPTOR = Object.freeze({ elementType: "string" });
const SHA256_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SOURCE_COMMIT_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const SAFE_ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:+-]{0,191}$/;
const SAFE_FILE_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/;

function allUniqueStrings(values, pattern = SAFE_ID_PATTERN) {
  return Array.isArray(values)
    && values.length > 0
    && values.every((value) => typeof value === "string" && pattern.test(value))
    && new Set(values).size === values.length;
}

export const DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-deployment-plan-artifact-v1",
  maxBytes: 4_096,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "releaseTag", "deploymentMode", "automatedDeploymentEligible", "fileName",
    "sha256", "releaseDeclarationSha256", "sizeBytes", "runtimeContract"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (typeof value.releaseTag !== "string"
      || value.deploymentMode !== "normal"
      || value.automatedDeploymentEligible !== true
      || !SAFE_FILE_PATTERN.test(value.fileName ?? "")
      || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.sha256 ?? "")
      || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.releaseDeclarationSha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.sizeBytes) || value.sizeBytes < 1
      || value.sizeBytes > 268_435_456
      || !SAFE_ID_PATTERN.test(value.runtimeContract ?? "")) {
      throw new Error("deployment_plan_artifact_invalid");
    }
  }
});

    const digestFields = [
      "artifactSha256", "releaseTreeManifestSha256", "dataCompatibilityPairSha256",

    ];
    if (!SAFE_ID_PATTERN.test(value.releaseLabel ?? "")
      || typeof value.releaseTag !== "string" || value.releaseTag.length > 255
      || !SOURCE_COMMIT_PATTERN.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
      || digestFields.some((field) => !SHA256_PATTERN.test(value[field] ?? ""))

- [ ] **Step 5: Materialize and validate the exact plan bytes**

```js
export function materializeDeploymentPlan({ gateId, gateReceipt, stableBody, runContext, now }) {
  if (runContext.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
    || runContext.runAttempt !== 1
    || runContext.ref !== "refs/heads/master"
    || runContext.sourceCommit !== gateReceipt.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("deployment_plan_invalid");
  }
  const canonicalDatabaseContracts = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(stableBody.databaseContracts);
  const normalizedStableBody = Object.freeze({
    ...stableBody,
    databaseContracts: canonicalDatabaseContracts.databaseContracts
  });
  if (normalizedStableBody.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== gateReceipt.mainSourceIdentitySha256
    || normalizedStableBody.mainSourcePrNumber !== gateReceipt.mainSourcePrNumber
    || normalizedStableBody.mainSourceHeadSha !== gateReceipt.mainSourceHeadSha
    || normalizedStableBody.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== gateReceipt.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) {
    throw new Error("deployment_plan_main_source_identity_invalid");
  }
  const templateSha256 = computeDeploymentPlanTemplateSha256(normalizedStableBody);
  if (templateSha256 !== gateReceipt.deploymentPlanTemplateSha256) {
    throw new Error("deployment_plan_invalid");
  }
  const createdAt = canonicalTime(now).toISOString();
  const identities = createRunIdentities({ gateReceipt, runContext });
  const expiresAt = computeEffectiveExpiry({
    inventoryExpiresAt: gateReceipt.inventoryExpiresAt,
    productionGateExpiresAt: gateReceipt.expiresAt,
    createdAt
  });
  const plan = {
    ...normalizedStableBody,
    gateId,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: gateReceipt.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    productionGateExpiresAt: gateReceipt.expiresAt,
    ...identities,
    createdAt,
    expiresAt
  };
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(plan, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT);
  return { plan, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) };
}

export function validateDeploymentPlanBytes({ bytes, runContext, now }) {
  const plan = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT);
  const canonicalDatabaseContracts = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(plan.databaseContracts);
  if (plan.schemaVersion !== "1"
    || plan.target !== "japan-control-plane"
    || plan.releaseUnit !== "control-plane-app"
    || plan.identityImpact !== false
    || plan.dataCompatibilityImpact !== false
    || runContext.runAttempt !== 1
    || plan.sourceCommit !== runContext.sourceCommit
    || new Date(now).getTime() >= new Date(plan.expiresAt).getTime()) {
    throw new Error("deployment_plan_invalid");
  }
  return { plan, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) };
}

export function validateDeploymentPlanMainSourceIdentity({ plan, validatedMainSourceIdentity }) {
  const mainSourceIdentity = assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity(validatedMainSourceIdentity);
  if (plan.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== mainSourceIdentity.sha256
    || plan.mainSourcePrNumber !== mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber
    || plan.mainSourceHeadSha !== mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha
    || plan.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) {
    throw new Error("deployment_plan_main_source_identity_invalid");
  }
  return plan;
}
```

test("deployment plan rejects authority expansion and sensitive fields", () => {
  const base = deploymentFixture();

    ...base,

  }), /deployment_plan_invalid/);

  }), /control-plane-deployment-plan-stable-body-v1_fields_invalid/);

  }), /deployment_plan_invalid/);

test("deployment plan rejects unknown nested fields and malformed object arrays", () => {

  assert.throws(

### Task 3: Release declaration consumes the canonical writer registry

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-release-declaration.mjs`
- Create: `ops/control-plane-deploy/release-metadata/release-declaration.template.json`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-release-declaration.test.mjs`
- Modify: `server/tests/artifact-manifest.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes `discoverProductionWriters`, `canonicalizeWriterRegistry`, and `verifyWriterRegistry` from `server/services/deployment/writer-registry.mjs`, whose implementation, CLI `scripts/control-plane-writer-registry.mjs`, tests, and source contract `ops/control-plane-deploy/writer-registry.sources.json` are uniquely owned by the Host/DB plan.
- Consumes exact source commit, foundation Linux feasibility contract, host execution contract, inventory receipt, Artifact Manifest v1, canonical JSON bytes, Task 2's six unique structured projection descriptors, and Host/DB-owned `canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(value)` plus opaque `DATABASE_CONTRACT_ENTRY_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT`. The inventory owner must provide the full Host/DB 14-field `databaseContracts`; Release Declaration mounts the unchanged object only under the owner-fixed `database-contract-entry-v1` selector without reading or copying its fields, and a lossy `databases` projection is rejected.
- The tokenless materializer consumes only Integration's `validateMainSourceIdentityRecordBytes(mainSourceIdentityBytes)` over the fixed record carried in the exact source archive. It has no token, `fetchFn`, PR metadata, ancestry result, or private brand. Trusted Artifact verification separately consumes `assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity(...)` and requires exact record/declaration equality before the first Release write or production-secret access.
- Produces `RELEASE_DECLARATION_CONTRACT`, `materializeNormalReleaseDeclaration(input)`, `materializeCompatibilityReleaseDeclaration(input)`, `validateReleaseDeclarationBytes(input)`, and `validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity({ declaration, validatedMainSourceIdentity })`. Parsing remains a pure canonical/source validator; the trusted Artifact Gate, preflight, and postapproval layers separately require the Integration-owned live brand before any publication or secret access.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement two named declaration materializers with no caller-selected mode**

```js
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { Transform } from "node:stream";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import {
  WRITER_REGISTRY_CONTRACT,
  discoverProductionWriters,
  canonicalizeWriterRegistry,
  verifyWriterRegistry
} from "../server/services/deployment/writer-registry.mjs";
import {
  DATABASE_CONTRACT_ENTRY_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT,
  canonicalizeDatabaseContracts
} from "../server/services/deployment/database-contract.mjs";
import {
  DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_APPLICATION_WRITER_CONTRACT,
  DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_AUXILIARY_WRITER_CONTRACT,
  DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_GATED_MUTATION_CONTRACT,
  DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_HOST_EXECUTION_CONTRACT
} from "./control-plane-deployment-plan.mjs";
import {
  assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity,
  validateMainSourceIdentityRecordBytes
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";

const RELEASE_DECLARATION_STRUCTURED_NESTED = Object.freeze({
  applicationWriterContract: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_APPLICATION_WRITER_CONTRACT,
  [DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_AUXILIARY_WRITER_CONTRACT.schemaId]: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_AUXILIARY_WRITER_CONTRACT,
  [DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_GATED_MUTATION_CONTRACT.schemaId]: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_GATED_MUTATION_CONTRACT,
  "database-contract-entry-v1": DATABASE_CONTRACT_ENTRY_EMBEDDING_CONTRACT,
  hostExecution: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_HOST_EXECUTION_CONTRACT
});

const RELEASE_DECLARATION_STRUCTURED_ARRAYS = Object.freeze({
  auxiliaryWriterContracts: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_AUXILIARY_WRITER_CONTRACT.schemaId,
  gatedBusinessMutationEntrypoints: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_GATED_MUTATION_CONTRACT.schemaId,
  databaseContracts: "database-contract-entry-v1"
});

export const RELEASE_DECLARATION_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-release-declaration-v1",
  maxBytes: 262_144,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schemaVersion", "declarationType", "repository", "sourceCommit",
    "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha",
    "mainSourceMergeCommitSha", "target",
    "releaseUnit", "artifactFileName", "artifactSha256", "artifactSizeBytes",
    "runtimeContractId", "deploymentMode", "automatedDeploymentEligible",
    "identityImpact", "dataCompatibilityImpact", "dataCompatibilityContract",
    "dataCompatibilityPairSha256", "writerRegistrySchema", "writerRegistrySha256",
    "writerRegistryVerificationReceiptSha256", "applicationWriterContract",
    "auxiliaryWriterContracts", "gatedBusinessMutationEntrypoints",
    "databaseContracts", "hostExecution", "validationContract", "featureFlagContract",
    "rollbackContract", "bootstrapReceiptSha256", "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256",
    "builderContractSha256"
  ]),
  nested: RELEASE_DECLARATION_STRUCTURED_NESTED,
  arrays: RELEASE_DECLARATION_STRUCTURED_ARRAYS,
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schemaVersion !== "1"
      || value.declarationType !== "control_plane_release"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.mainSourceIdentitySha256)
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.mainSourcePrNumber)
      || value.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.mainSourceHeadSha)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
      || (value.deploymentMode === "normal"
        ? (value.automatedDeploymentEligible !== true
          || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.bootstrapReceiptSha256)
          || value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 !== null)
        : value.deploymentMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
          ? (value.automatedDeploymentEligible !== false
            || value.bootstrapReceiptSha256 !== null
            || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256))
          : true)) {
      throw new Error("release_declaration_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function materialize(input, bindings) {
  // The tokenless builder reads only the fixed canonical record from the source archive.
  // Fresh PR/ancestry validation and the private owner brand remain in the trusted Gate.
  const mainSourceIdentity = validateMainSourceIdentityRecordBytes(input.mainSourceIdentityBytes);
  const discovered = discoverProductionWriters({ sourceRoot: input.sourceRoot });
  const discoveredBytes = canonicalizeWriterRegistry(discovered);
  const declared = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(input.writerRegistryBytes, WRITER_REGISTRY_CONTRACT);
  if (!discoveredBytes.equals(input.writerRegistryBytes)) {
    throw new Error("release_declaration_writer_registry_bytes_mismatch");
  }
  const writerRegistry = verifyWriterRegistry({ discovered, declared });
  const canonicalDatabaseContracts = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(input.inventoryReceipt.databaseContracts);
  const declaration = {
    schemaVersion: "1",
    declarationType: "control_plane_release",
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    sourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: mainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    target: "japan-control-plane",
    releaseUnit: "control-plane-app",
    artifactFileName: input.artifactManifest.artifact.fileName,
    artifactSha256: input.artifactManifest.artifact.sha256,
    artifactSizeBytes: input.artifactManifest.artifact.sizeBytes,
    runtimeContractId: input.inventoryReceipt.runtimeContractId,
    deploymentMode: bindings.deploymentMode,
    automatedDeploymentEligible: bindings.automatedDeploymentEligible,
    identityImpact: false,
    dataCompatibilityImpact: false,
    dataCompatibilityContract: "control-plane-persisted-data-backward-v1",
    dataCompatibilityPairSha256: input.dataCompatibilityPairSha256,
    writerRegistrySchema: "control-plane-writer-registry-v1",
    writerRegistrySha256: writerRegistry.sha256,
    writerRegistryVerificationReceiptSha256: input.writerRegistryVerificationReceiptSha256,
    applicationWriterContract: input.hostExecution.applicationWriterContract,
    auxiliaryWriterContracts: input.hostExecution.auxiliaryWriterContracts,
    gatedBusinessMutationEntrypoints: input.hostExecution.gatedBusinessMutationEntrypoints,
    databaseContracts: canonicalDatabaseContracts.databaseContracts,
    hostExecution: input.hostExecution,
    validationContract: "control-plane-promotion-health-gate-v1",
    featureFlagContract: input.featureFlagContract,
    rollbackContract: "control-plane-release-pointer-rollback-v1",
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: bindings.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
    hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: bindings.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256,
    builderContractSha256: input.builderContractSha256
  };
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(declaration, RELEASE_DECLARATION_CONTRACT);
  return { declaration, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) };
}

export function materializeNormalReleaseDeclaration(input) {
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.inventoryReceipt.bootstrapReceiptSha256)
    || "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256" in input.inventoryReceipt) {
    throw new Error("release_declaration_normal_inventory_invalid");
  }
  return materialize(input, Object.freeze({
    deploymentMode: "normal",
    automatedDeploymentEligible: true,
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: input.inventoryReceipt.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
    hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: null
  }));
}

export function materializeCompatibilityReleaseDeclaration(input) {
  if ("bootstrapReceiptSha256" in input.inventoryReceipt
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.inventoryReceipt.stagedHostBundleContentReceiptSha256)
    || input.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256
      !== input.inventoryReceipt.stagedHostBundleContentReceiptSha256) {
    throw new Error("release_declaration_compatibility_inventory_invalid");
  }
  return materialize(input, Object.freeze({
    deploymentMode: "compatibility_bootstrap",
    automatedDeploymentEligible: false,
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: null,
    hostBundleContentReceiptSha256:
      input.inventoryReceipt.stagedHostBundleContentReceiptSha256
  }));
}

export function validateReleaseDeclarationBytes({ bytes, expectedSourceCommit }) {
  const declaration = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, RELEASE_DECLARATION_CONTRACT);
  const canonicalDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(declaration.databaseContracts);
  if (declaration.sourceCommit !== expectedSourceCommit
    || !serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(declaration, RELEASE_DECLARATION_CONTRACT).equals(bytes)) {
    throw new Error("release_declaration_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    declaration: Object.freeze({
      ...declaration,
      databaseContracts: canonicalDatabase.databaseContracts
    }),
    databaseContractsSha256: canonicalDatabase.sha256,
    sha256: sha256Hex(bytes)
  });
}

export function validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity({ declaration, validatedMainSourceIdentity }) {
  const mainSourceIdentity = assertValidatedMainSourceIdentity(validatedMainSourceIdentity);
  if (declaration.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== mainSourceIdentity.sha256
    || declaration.mainSourcePrNumber !== mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber
    || declaration.mainSourceHeadSha !== mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha
    || declaration.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) {
    throw new Error("release_declaration_main_source_identity_invalid");
  }
  return declaration;
}
```

**Files:**
- Create: `server/services/deployment/bounded-zip.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/bounded-zip.test.mjs`
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-artifact-assembly.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-artifact-assembly.test.mjs`

- Modify: `server/tests/artifact-git-tree-verifier.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: canonical source ZIP, production dependency layer, Artifact Manifest v1, release declaration, writer registry, bootstrap receipt companion, and the existing trusted Git-tree verifier. This task extends that one verifier owner with `verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes({ artifactBytes, repositoryPath, expectedCommit })`; the path and Buffer entrypoints share the same private ZIP/tree comparison and no second parser, callback verifier, or trust table is introduced.
- Produces: `inspectBoundedZip({ bytes, limits })`, `createArtifactAssembly(input)`, `verifyArtifactAssembly(input)`, `assertVerifiedArtifactAssembly(value)`, `extractVerifiedControllerRuntime({ bundleBytes, expectedBundleSha256, expectedBundleSize })`, and `runArtifactAssemblyCli(options)`. `verifyArtifactAssembly` accepts only the fixed outer bundle plus expected digest/size, the four byte-identical externally published companions (`artifact.json`, writer registry, release declaration, and release assembly), source/runtime identity, and the trusted checkout root; it invokes `verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes` internally and returns one privately branded observation carrying the source/dependency/controller-runtime digests. Bootstrap's receipt is verified only as an internal manifest-bound outer entry and has no external Task 9 companion input. The separately published Task 5 `dependency-build-receipt.json` is a different owner/domain and is never byte-aliased into the Bootstrap slot. No caller supplies `verifySourceZip` or another verifier. `extractVerifiedControllerRuntime` is the sole shared producer/consumer owner for the fixed outer-seven → `source.zip` wrapper plus `dependency-layer.zip` addon projection; it returns only owned `{ wrapperBytes, wrapperSha256, addonBytes, addonSha256 }` and accepts no path, extractor, contract, filename, digest override, or checkout root.

- [ ] **Step 3: Extract and parameterize the existing ZIP reader**

Move the existing central-directory, local-header, UTF-8 path, CRC32, and inflate checks from `scripts/artifact-git-tree-verifier.mjs` into the shared module, keeping the original verifier behavior unchanged. The public entrypoint is:

```js
export function inspectBoundedZip({ bytes, limits }) {
  assertLimits(limits);
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)
    || bytes.length === 0
    || bytes.length > limits.compressedBytes) {
    throw new BoundedZipError();
  }
  const entries = readCentralDirectory(bytes, limits);
  const exactNames = new Set();
  const caseNames = new Set();
  const normalizedNames = new Set();
  let expandedBytes = 0;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const path = decodePortablePath(entry.rawName);
    const caseKey = path.toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
    const unicodeKey = path.normalize("NFC");
    if (exactNames.has(path) || caseNames.has(caseKey) || normalizedNames.has(unicodeKey)) {
      throw new BoundedZipError();
    }
    exactNames.add(path);
    caseNames.add(caseKey);
    normalizedNames.add(unicodeKey);
    assertRegularOrDirectory(entry);
    const data = inflateEntry(bytes, entry, limits.entryBytes);
    expandedBytes += data.length;
    if (expandedBytes > limits.expandedBytes
      || entry.compressedSize > 0 && data.length / entry.compressedSize > limits.compressionRatio) {
      throw new BoundedZipError();
    }
    entry.path = path;
    entry.data = data;
  }
  return {
    entries,
    commentBytes: readExactArchiveComment(bytes),
    compressedBytes: bytes.length,
    expandedBytes
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Rewire the Git-tree verifier to the shared ZIP module**

```js
import { readFileSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { inspectBoundedZip } from "../server/services/deployment/bounded-zip.mjs";

const SOURCE_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  compressedBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
  entries: 10_000,
  entryBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
  expandedBytes: 256 * 1024 * 1024,
  compressionRatio: 100
});

function readZipEntriesBytes(artifactBytes) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(artifactBytes)) throw mismatch();
  const archive = inspectBoundedZip({ bytes: Buffer.from(artifactBytes), limits: SOURCE_LIMITS });
  const sourceCommitComment = decodeExactLowercaseSha40(archive.commentBytes);
  return Object.freeze({ ...archive, sourceCommitComment });
}

function verifyArtifactGitTreeArchive({ archive, repositoryPath, expectedCommit }) {
  const trusted = readTrustedTree(repositoryPath, expectedCommit);
  return compareArchiveToTrustedTree({ archive, trusted, expectedCommit });
}

export function verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes({
  artifactBytes, repositoryPath, expectedCommit
} = {}) {
  return verifyArtifactGitTreeArchive({
    archive: readZipEntriesBytes(artifactBytes),
    repositoryPath,
    expectedCommit
  });
}

export function verifyArtifactGitTree({ artifactPath, repositoryPath, expectedCommit } = {}) {
  const artifactBytes = readFileSync(realpathSync(resolve(artifactPath)));
  return verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes({ artifactBytes, repositoryPath, expectedCommit });
}
```

`compareArchiveToTrustedTree` is the existing verifier body moved without semantic change: it still compares the fixed commit comment, path/mode set, and every Git blob OID. Tests byte-compare the path and Buffer entrypoint results and inject path, mode, commit-comment, duplicate, traversal, and byte drift through both entrypoints.

```js
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import { inspectBoundedZip } from "../server/services/deployment/bounded-zip.mjs";
import {
  WRITER_REGISTRY_CONTRACT,
  discoverProductionWriters,
  canonicalizeWriterRegistry,
  verifyWriterRegistry
} from "../server/services/deployment/writer-registry.mjs";
import { verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes } from "./artifact-git-tree-verifier.mjs";

const SHA256_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SOURCE_COMMIT_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_ID = "linux-amd64-glibc-node-127";
const CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_ABI = "127";
const CONTROLLER_WRAPPER_PATH = "ops/control-plane-deploy/native/index.mjs";
const CONTROLLER_ADDON_PATH = "ops/control-plane-deploy/native/build/Release/control_plane_native.node";
const REGULAR_0644 = 0o100644;
const OUTER_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  compressedBytes: 268_435_456,
  entries: 50_000,
  entryBytes: 67_108_864,
  expandedBytes: 805_306_368,
  compressionRatio: 100
});
const INNER_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  compressedBytes: 67_108_864,
  entries: 50_000,
  entryBytes: 67_108_864,
  expandedBytes: 805_306_368,
  compressionRatio: 100
});

const PAYLOAD_FILES = Object.freeze([
  "artifact.json",
  "bootstrap-receipt.json",
  "dependency-layer.zip",
  "release-declaration.json",
  "source.zip",
  "writer-registry.json"
]);

const BUNDLE_FILES = Object.freeze([...PAYLOAD_FILES, "release-assembly.json"].sort());

const ASSEMBLY_FILE_ENTRY_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-release-assembly-file-v1",
  maxBytes: 512,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["fileName", "sha256", "sizeBytes"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (!PAYLOAD_FILES.includes(value.fileName)
      || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.sha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.sizeBytes) || value.sizeBytes < 1
      || value.sizeBytes > OUTER_LIMITS.entryBytes) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_file_invalid");
    }
  }
});

const CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_PROJECTION_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-controller-runtime-projection-v1",
  maxBytes: 2_048,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "wrapperPath", "wrapperSha256", "wrapperMode",
    "addonPath", "addonSha256", "addonMode", "nodeModuleAbi"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.wrapperPath !== CONTROLLER_WRAPPER_PATH
      || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.wrapperSha256 ?? "")
      || value.wrapperMode !== "0644"
      || value.addonPath !== CONTROLLER_ADDON_PATH
      || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.addonSha256 ?? "")
      || value.addonMode !== "0644"
      || value.nodeModuleAbi !== CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_ABI) {
      throw new Error("artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
    }
  }
});

const ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-release-assembly-v1",
  maxBytes: 32_768,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schemaVersion", "assemblyType", "sourceCommit", "runtimeContractId",
    "files", "controllerRuntime"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({
    [ASSEMBLY_FILE_ENTRY_CONTRACT.schemaId]: ASSEMBLY_FILE_ENTRY_CONTRACT,
    controllerRuntime: CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_PROJECTION_CONTRACT
  }),
  arrays: Object.freeze({ files: ASSEMBLY_FILE_ENTRY_CONTRACT.schemaId }),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schemaVersion !== "1"
      || value.assemblyType !== "control_plane_production_dependency_bundle"
      || !SOURCE_COMMIT_PATTERN.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
      || value.runtimeContractId !== CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_ID) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
    }
  }
});

const VERIFY_ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "bundleBytes", "expectedBundleSha256", "expectedBundleSize",
  "assemblyManifestBytes", "artifactManifestBytes", "writerRegistryBytes",
  "releaseDeclarationBytes", "sourceCommit", "runtimeContractId", "trustedCheckoutRoot"
]);
const VERIFIED_ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "ok", "sourceCommit", "runtimeContractId", "bundleSha256", "bundleSize",
  "assemblyManifestSha256", "artifactManifestSha256", "writerRegistrySha256",
  "releaseDeclarationSha256", "bootstrapReceiptSha256", "sourceZipSha256",
  "dependencyLayerSha256", "dependencyLayerSizeBytes", "controllerRuntime", "fileNames"
]);
const verifiedArtifactAssemblies = new WeakSet();

function assertExactVerifyArtifactAssemblyInput(input) {
  rejectCallerContract(input, "artifact_assembly_input_invalid");
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(input);
  if (keys.length !== VERIFY_ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_FIELDS.length
    || keys.some((key, index) => key !== VERIFY_ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_FIELDS[index])
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.bundleBytes)
    || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(input.expectedBundleSha256 ?? "")
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.expectedBundleSize) || input.expectedBundleSize < 1
    || input.bundleBytes.length !== input.expectedBundleSize
    || sha256Hex(input.bundleBytes) !== input.expectedBundleSha256
    || ![input.assemblyManifestBytes, input.artifactManifestBytes,
      input.writerRegistryBytes, input.releaseDeclarationBytes].every(Buffer.isBuffer)
    || !SOURCE_COMMIT_PATTERN.test(input.sourceCommit ?? "")
    || input.runtimeContractId !== CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_ID
    || typeof input.trustedCheckoutRoot !== "string" || input.trustedCheckoutRoot.length < 1) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_input_invalid");
  }
}

export function assertVerifiedArtifactAssembly(value) {
  const keys = value !== null && typeof value === "object" ? Reflect.ownKeys(value) : [];
  if (!Object.isFrozen(value) || !verifiedArtifactAssemblies.has(value)
    || keys.length !== VERIFIED_ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_FIELDS.length
    || keys.some((key, index) => key !== VERIFIED_ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_FIELDS[index])
    || value.ok !== true || !Object.isFrozen(value.controllerRuntime)
    || !Object.isFrozen(value.fileNames)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_verification_invalid");
  }
  return value;
}

function rejectCallerContract(input, code) {
  if (input === null || typeof input !== "object" || Array.isArray(input)
    || Object.hasOwn(input, "assemblyContract") || Object.hasOwn(input, "bundleLimits")
    || Object.hasOwn(input, "verifySourceZip")) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
}

function requireExactRegularEntry(entries, path, code) {
  const entry = entries.find((candidate) => candidate.path === path);
  if (entry === undefined || entry.directory === true || entry.mode !== REGULAR_0644) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
  return entry;
}

function inspectControllerRuntimeArchives({ sourceZipBytes, dependencyLayerBytes }) {
  const source = inspectBoundedZip({ bytes: sourceZipBytes, limits: INNER_LIMITS });
  const dependency = inspectBoundedZip({ bytes: dependencyLayerBytes, limits: INNER_LIMITS });
  const wrapper = requireExactRegularEntry(source.entries, CONTROLLER_WRAPPER_PATH, "artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
  const addon = requireExactRegularEntry(dependency.entries, CONTROLLER_ADDON_PATH, "artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
  const addonBase = CONTROLLER_ADDON_PATH.split("/").at(-1).normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
  const addonCandidates = dependency.entries.filter((entry) => !entry.directory
    && entry.path.split("/").at(-1).normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase("en-US") === addonBase);
  if (addonCandidates.length !== 1 || addonCandidates[0] !== addon) {
    throw new Error("artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
  }
  const value = Object.freeze({
    wrapperPath: CONTROLLER_WRAPPER_PATH,
    wrapperSha256: sha256Hex(wrapper.data),
    wrapperMode: "0644",
    addonPath: CONTROLLER_ADDON_PATH,
    addonSha256: sha256Hex(addon.data),
    addonMode: "0644",
    nodeModuleAbi: CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_ABI
  });
  CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_PROJECTION_CONTRACT.validate(value);
  return Object.freeze({
    value,
    wrapperBytes: Buffer.from(wrapper.data),
    addonBytes: Buffer.from(addon.data)
  });
}

function readExactOuterAssembly(bundleBytes) {
  const archive = inspectBoundedZip({ bytes: bundleBytes, limits: OUTER_LIMITS });
  if (archive.entries.some((entry) => entry.directory === true || entry.mode !== REGULAR_0644)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
  }
  const files = new Map(archive.entries.map((entry) => [entry.path, entry.data]));
  if (files.size !== BUNDLE_FILES.length || !BUNDLE_FILES.every((name) => files.has(name))) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
  }
  const manifestBytes = files.get("release-assembly.json");
  const manifest = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(manifestBytes, ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT);
  const observedEntries = PAYLOAD_FILES.map((fileName) => Object.freeze({
    fileName,
    sha256: sha256Hex(files.get(fileName)),
    sizeBytes: files.get(fileName).length
  }));
  if (JSON.stringify(manifest.files) !== JSON.stringify(observedEntries)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
  }
  const runtime = inspectControllerRuntimeArchives({
    sourceZipBytes: files.get("source.zip"),
    dependencyLayerBytes: files.get("dependency-layer.zip")
  });
  if (JSON.stringify(manifest.controllerRuntime) !== JSON.stringify(runtime.value)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ files, manifest, manifestBytes, runtime });
}

export function createArtifactAssembly(input) {
  rejectCallerContract(input, "artifact_assembly_input_invalid");
  const fileEntries = Object.entries(input.files)
    .map(([fileName, bytes]) => Object.freeze({ fileName, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes), sizeBytes: bytes.length }))
    .sort((left, right) => left.fileName.localeCompare(right.fileName, "en"));
  if (fileEntries.map(({ fileName }) => fileName).join("\n") !== PAYLOAD_FILES.join("\n")) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
  }
  const runtime = inspectControllerRuntimeArchives({
    sourceZipBytes: input.files["source.zip"],
    dependencyLayerBytes: input.files["dependency-layer.zip"]
  });
  const manifest = Object.freeze({
    schemaVersion: "1",
    assemblyType: "control_plane_production_dependency_bundle",
    sourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
    runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
    files: Object.freeze(fileEntries),
    controllerRuntime: runtime.value
  });
  const assemblyManifestBytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(manifest, ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT);
  const bundleBytes = input.zipWriter({ ...input.files, "release-assembly.json": assemblyManifestBytes });
  const observed = readExactOuterAssembly(bundleBytes);
  if (!observed.manifestBytes.equals(assemblyManifestBytes)) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
  return {
    bundleBytes,
    bundleSha256: sha256Hex(bundleBytes),
    assemblyManifestBytes,
    assemblyManifestSha256: sha256Hex(assemblyManifestBytes)
  };
}

export function verifyArtifactAssembly(input) {
  assertExactVerifyArtifactAssemblyInput(input);
  const observed = readExactOuterAssembly(input.bundleBytes);
  const { files, manifest } = observed;
  if (!observed.manifestBytes.equals(input.assemblyManifestBytes)
    || manifest.sourceCommit !== input.sourceCommit
    || manifest.runtimeContractId !== input.runtimeContractId
    || !files.get("artifact.json").equals(input.artifactManifestBytes)
    || !files.get("writer-registry.json").equals(input.writerRegistryBytes)
    || !files.get("release-declaration.json").equals(input.releaseDeclarationBytes)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_invalid");
  }
  verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes({
    artifactBytes: files.get("source.zip"),
    repositoryPath: input.trustedCheckoutRoot,
    expectedCommit: manifest.sourceCommit
  });
  const discovered = discoverProductionWriters({ sourceRoot: input.trustedCheckoutRoot });
  const discoveredBytes = canonicalizeWriterRegistry(discovered);
  const declared = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(files.get("writer-registry.json"), WRITER_REGISTRY_CONTRACT);
  if (!discoveredBytes.equals(files.get("writer-registry.json"))) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_writer_registry_mismatch");
  verifyWriterRegistry({ discovered, declared });
  const value = Object.freeze({
    ok: true,
    sourceCommit: manifest.sourceCommit,
    runtimeContractId: manifest.runtimeContractId,
    bundleSha256: sha256Hex(input.bundleBytes),
    bundleSize: input.bundleBytes.length,
    assemblyManifestSha256: sha256Hex(observed.manifestBytes),
    artifactManifestSha256: sha256Hex(files.get("artifact.json")),
    writerRegistrySha256: sha256Hex(files.get("writer-registry.json")),
    releaseDeclarationSha256: sha256Hex(files.get("release-declaration.json")),
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: sha256Hex(files.get("bootstrap-receipt.json")),
    sourceZipSha256: sha256Hex(files.get("source.zip")),
    dependencyLayerSha256: sha256Hex(files.get("dependency-layer.zip")),
    dependencyLayerSizeBytes: files.get("dependency-layer.zip").length,
    controllerRuntime: observed.runtime.value,
    fileNames: Object.freeze([...files.keys()].sort())
  });
  verifiedArtifactAssemblies.add(value);
  return value;
}

export function extractVerifiedControllerRuntime(input) {
  try {
    rejectCallerContract(input, "artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
    if (Reflect.ownKeys(input).join("\n") !== [
      "bundleBytes", "expectedBundleSha256", "expectedBundleSize"
    ].join("\n")
      || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.bundleBytes)
      || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(input.expectedBundleSha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.expectedBundleSize) || input.expectedBundleSize < 1
      || input.expectedBundleSize > OUTER_LIMITS.compressedBytes
      || input.bundleBytes.length !== input.expectedBundleSize
      || sha256Hex(input.bundleBytes) !== input.expectedBundleSha256) {
      throw new Error("artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
    }
    const observed = readExactOuterAssembly(input.bundleBytes);
    return Object.freeze({
      wrapperBytes: Buffer.from(observed.runtime.wrapperBytes),
      wrapperSha256: observed.runtime.value.wrapperSha256,
      addonBytes: Buffer.from(observed.runtime.addonBytes),
      addonSha256: observed.runtime.value.addonSha256
    });
  } catch {
    throw new Error("artifact_controller_runtime_invalid");
  }
}
```

`ARTIFACT_ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT`, its file-entry child, and `CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_PROJECTION_CONTRACT` are module-private exact Foundation descriptors. The same object instances and `readExactOuterAssembly` path are used by create, verify, and extract; no caller supplies a contract or selector. `extractVerifiedControllerRuntime` validates the expected outer byte count and digest before parsing, applies `inspectBoundedZip` separately to only the manifest-bound `source.zip` and `dependency-layer.zip` bytes, and selects two literal direct paths without globbing, recursive extraction, or fallback. It requires regular mode `0644`, the owner-computed manifest digest, runtime ID `linux-amd64-glibc-node-127`, ABI `127`, and exactly one control-plane addon basename; it returns only owned copies. Task 5's dependency-layer producer test proves the addon is a direct entry of `dependency-layer.zip`; Task 4's source producer test proves the wrapper is a direct entry of `source.zip`. Neither producer adds either native file to the outer seven-file set, so the published `control-plane-app.zip`, its assembly manifest, attested subject digest, preflight copy, and controller consumer remain one byte-identical contract.

  const fixture = artifactAssemblyFixture(t);
  const created = createArtifactAssembly(fixture);
  for (const override of [
    { artifactManifestBytes: Buffer.from("{}") },

### Task 5: Tokenless two-phase dependency builder

**Files:**
- Create: `ops/control-plane-deploy/artifact-builder-contract.json`
- Create: `ops/control-plane-deploy/runtime-contract.json`
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-artifact-builder.mjs`
- Create: `server/services/deployment/control-plane-artifact-builder-cli-adapter.mjs`
- Create: `server/services/deployment/control-plane-better-sqlite3-build-adapter.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-artifact-builder.test.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-better-sqlite3-build-adapter.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes Foundation's `resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain(...)` and `assertVerifiedFoundationToolchain(...)` as the only image/header/toolchain authority. Every fetch/build entry first exact-validates the five-field Artifact builder contract and its complete nested custody contract, then resolves that owner before reading a caller tool path, constructing a child environment, fetching custody bytes, or spawning a process. It passes the exact private-branded return unchanged to the Foundation-owned `buildControlPlaneNative(...)` and the Artifact-owned direct dependency adapter. The tracked builder contract fixes package-cache HTTPS origins/content/archive contracts, the exact package-lock digest, and the native registry only; Foundation lock digest, image, header-tree, toolchain-tree, executable path/digest, environment, role, and closure fields are unknown-field rejections. The trusted `toolchain-prepare` boundary retrieves and verifies the exact immutable lock asset and single-subject attestation, while the tokenless builder re-hashes those bytes and resolves the materialized closure without credentials, proxies, script execution, an alternate custody download, or ambient `PATH`. Both online package-cache fill and offline install use the full dependency graph with `--ignore-scripts` so package-lock-pinned `node-gyp@11.4.2` remains present until the direct build completes.
- `control-plane-better-sqlite3-build-adapter.mjs` exports only `buildPinnedBetterSqlite3({ sourceDirectory, verifiedFoundationToolchain, packageLockBytes, frozenCacheManifestBytes, spawnFn, readFile, statFile, openDatabase })`. It first asserts Foundation's private brand; Node, Node headers, all six native tools, executable closure, and the seven-field tool environment come only from that brand. Its private `resolvePinnedNodeGypPackagePolicy(...)` then derives the fixed `node_modules/node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js` entry path and digest only from the exact `node-gyp@11.4.2` package-lock entry, its integrity-bound archive in the already frozen cache manifest, and the matching installed tree. The adapter accepts no separate path, environment, tool, header, image, digest, or caller-owned expected-tool map. It reasserts both brands before and after the fixed direct command, opens a real `Database(":memory:")`, performs create/insert/select/close, and returns the exact `.node` path/digest plus the derived node-gyp entry digest without invoking package lifecycle metadata.
- `control-plane-artifact-builder-cli-adapter.mjs` exports only `createArtifactBuilderCliMaterializer()`. Its frozen surface is `materialize({ operation, flags })` plus `serializeSafeResult({ operation, result })`; it owns all fixed filesystem/process/database adapters, rejects symlink/realpath escape and non-regular inputs, opens only the exact flag-derived files with no ambient lookup, and returns the complete exact-key input required by `runTokenlessDependencyFetch` or `runTokenlessDependencyBuild`. The serializer canonicalizes the fetch cache-manifest receipt or the build dependency receipt through their owner contracts and returns bounded bytes. Neither method accepts a token, environment, executable, tool path, network client, contract override, or operations object.
- Produces: `createTokenlessBuilderEnvironment({ operation, verifiedFoundationToolchain })`, `inspectLifecycleInventory(input)`, `runTokenlessDependencyFetch(input)`, `runTokenlessDependencyBuild(input)`, future addendum APIs `validateDependencyBuildReceiptBytes({ bytes, verifiedFoundationToolchain, expectedRuntimeContractId })` plus `assertValidatedDependencyBuildReceipt(value)`, `runArtifactBuilderCli(options)`, and a safe canonical receipt binding package lock, immutable Foundation lock asset/candidate closure, owner-derived image/header/toolchain/every-actual-tool, package-lock-derived node-gyp, lifecycle, first-party-native, better-sqlite3, and output digests plus prune and residue proofs. The future validator stays inside this existing Task 5 owner, canonical-parses the already specified receipt shape without adding fields, reasserts Foundation's private brand, and compares every existing lock/closure/image/header/toolchain/tool/executable-closure field to that same brand. It fixes the expected runtime ID and returns only a privately branded frozen exact `{ receipt, bytes, sha256 }`. A clone or caller-built Foundation object, contract selector, extra input, receipt drift, or tool/closure mismatch rejects.
- `runTokenlessDependencyBuild` also emits the exact `dependency-layer.zip` consumed by Task 4. Its sorted direct-entry manifest contains `ops/control-plane-deploy/native/build/Release/control_plane_native.node` exactly once as regular mode `0644`, with its digest byte-equal to the Foundation native build result and existing receipt `binaryDigests.controlPlaneNative` row. A case/Unicode alias, nested copy, link/device, alternate `.node` at that control-plane path, post-receipt byte change, or receipt/addon substitution rejects. Other explicitly manifest-bound production dependencies, including `better_sqlite3.node`, remain separate entries and cannot satisfy the control-plane addon selector. `source.zip` independently carries `ops/control-plane-deploy/native/index.mjs` as one direct regular mode-`0644` entry whose digest is tied to the trusted Git tree; Task 4 validates both inner producers before writing the unchanged seven-file outer assembly. The external Task 5 receipt remains a separate publication companion and is never substituted for Task 4's Bootstrap-owned outer receipt.
