- [ ] **Step 8a (3 min): Add the CLI-only lazy metadata-App materializer**

```js
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

function createMetadataAppSecretMaterializer({ env, zeroize }) {
  let used = false;
  return Object.freeze({
    async materializeMetadataApp() {
      if (used) throw new Error("github_scope_materializer_reused");
      used = true;
      const material = {
        appId: String(env.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_ID),
        installationId: String(env.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_INSTALLATION_ID),
        privateKeyBytes: Buffer.from(env.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, "utf8")
      };
      delete env.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_ID;
      delete env.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_INSTALLATION_ID;
      delete env.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY;
      return material;
    },
    destroyMetadataApp(material) {
      zeroize(material.privateKeyBytes);
      material.appId = "";
      material.installationId = "";
    }
  });
}

function parseScopeAttestorFlags(tokens) {
  const expected = Object.freeze(["repository", "environment", "output"]);
  if (!Array.isArray(tokens) || tokens.length !== expected.length * 2) {
    throw new Error("github_scope_flags_invalid");
  }
  const flags = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const flag = tokens[index];
    const value = tokens[index + 1];
    if (typeof flag !== "string" || !flag.startsWith("--")
      || !expected.includes(flag.slice(2)) || Object.hasOwn(flags, flag.slice(2))
      || typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.startsWith("--")) {
      throw new Error("github_scope_flags_invalid");
    }
    flags[flag.slice(2)] = value;
  }
  if (expected.some((name) => !Object.hasOwn(flags, name))) {
    throw new Error("github_scope_flags_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(flags);
}

function base64Url(bytes) {
  return Buffer.from(bytes).toString("base64url");
}

async function signFixedGitHubAppJwt({ appId, privateKeyBytes, now }) {
  const issuedAt = Math.floor(now.getTime() / 1_000) - 30;
  const protectedHeader = base64Url(Buffer.from('{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}', "utf8"));
  const payload = base64Url(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
    iat: issuedAt, exp: issuedAt + 540, iss: appId
  }), "utf8"));
  const signingInput = `${protectedHeader}.${payload}`;
  const signer = createSign("RSA-SHA256");
  signer.update(signingInput, "utf8");
  signer.end();
  const key = createPrivateKey({ key: privateKeyBytes, format: "pem" });
  return `${signingInput}.${base64Url(signer.sign(key))}`;
}

function writeExactScopeBytes(path, bytes) {
  if (typeof path !== "string" || path.length < 1 || path.length > 4_096
    || /[\u0000\r\n]/.test(path) || !Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)
    || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > SCOPE_ATTESTATION_CONTRACT.maxBytes
    || !lstatSync(dirname(path)).isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error("github_scope_output_invalid");
  }
  const descriptor = openSync(path, "wx", 0o600);
  try {
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < bytes.length) offset += writeSync(descriptor, bytes, offset);
  } finally {
    closeSync(descriptor);
  }
}

function createScopeAttestorCliOperations() {
  if (typeof globalThis.fetch !== "function") throw new Error("github_scope_runtime_invalid");
  return Object.freeze({
    fetchFn: globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis),
    jwtSigner: signFixedGitHubAppJwt,
    clock: Object.freeze({ now: () => new Date() }),
    writeExactBytes: writeExactScopeBytes,
    zeroize(bytes) {
      if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)) throw new Error("github_scope_zeroize_invalid");
      bytes.fill(0);
    }
  });
}

export async function runScopeAttestorCli({ argv, env, stdout, operations }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation !== "attest") throw new Error("github_scope_operation_invalid");
  const flags = parseScopeAttestorFlags(tokens);
  const result = await attestReservedAuthorizationScopes({
    repository: flags.repository,
    environment: flags.environment,
    secretMaterializer: createMetadataAppSecretMaterializer({ env, zeroize: operations.zeroize }),
    fetchFn: operations.fetchFn,
    jwtSigner: operations.jwtSigner,
    clock: operations.clock
  });
  operations.writeExactBytes(flags.output, result.bytes);
  stdout.write(`${serializeCanonicalJsonBytes({ valid: true, sha256: result.sha256 }, SCOPE_SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT).toString("utf8")}\n`);
  return 0;
}

async function main({
  argv = process.argv.slice(2),
  env = process.env,
  stdout = process.stdout,
  stderr = process.stderr
} = {}) {
  try {
    process.exitCode = await runScopeAttestorCli({
      argv,
      env,
      stdout,
      operations: createScopeAttestorCliOperations()
    });
  } catch {
    stderr.write("github_scope_attestor_failed\n");
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  await main();
}
```

The scope-attestor source also implements a private zero-argument `createScopeAttestorCliOperations()` and direct `main()`. The factory fixes `globalThis.fetch`, Node's built-in GitHub-App JWT signer, system UTC clock, exact exclusive canonical-file writer, and zeroizer; it accepts no injected dependency, token, path, key, repository, environment, or clock. `main()` passes only argv/env/stdio plus that factory, returns `0`, and on any failure emits only `github_scope_attestor_failed\n` with exit code `2`. Direct execution is guarded by `pathToFileURL`. The exported CLI test uses a deterministic in-memory REST boundary to cover success, unknown/missing flags, output bytes, env removal, and key zeroization; a malformed-argv spawn plus static source assertion covers the real guard/bounded stderr. No test claims a successful real-main call without GitHub or injects operations into `main()`.

- [ ] **Step 8a: Capture one real diagnostic archive through a read-only review gate**

Run a separate read-only workflow or GitHub API inventory against an already-published attestation owned by this repository. Independently obtain the fixed-version official Sigstore trusted-root/TUF metadata, record its immutable source URL/version/upstream-byte digest, and owner-canonicalize only the Fulcio path and Rekor ECDSA keys required by that archive; compute each key ID from SPKI bytes and separately hash the resulting local tracked-trust bytes. Never derive trust from the bundle's self-reported certificate or log key, never fetch trust dynamically at verification time, and do not add future CT authority to this diagnostics-only schema. Record the public v0.3 bundle and an exact manifest with ordered fields `archiveSchema`, `sourceRepository`, `sourceRunUrl`, `capturedAt`, `bundleSha256`, `trustedRootSourceUrl`, `trustedRootVersion`, `upstreamTrustedRootSha256`, `trackedTrustRootSha256`, `now`, and `expected`. The operator review independently verifies the upstream digest against the fixed source bytes; the loader recomputes the distinct tracked digest from `github-sigstore-trusted-root.json` and its LF digest file. The manifest also fixes the repository, an HTTPS `github.com/.../actions/runs/{decimal}` URL, canonical UTC timestamps, the bundle digest, and the verifier's closed expected identity/predicate fields. Show the two source URLs, source version, all three digests, key IDs, and sanitized expected metadata to the operator and stop for review before adding the trust/fixture files. No signing, re-signing, private key, token, mutable API body, or arbitrary downloaded executable is retained. If either a qualifying project bundle or reviewed official trust snapshot is unavailable, mark this step `BLOCKED`; keep the following positive diagnostic test RED and do not invent an archive or trust root.

```js
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "archiveSchema", "sourceRepository", "sourceRunUrl", "capturedAt",
  "bundleSha256", "trustedRootSourceUrl", "trustedRootVersion",
  "upstreamTrustedRootSha256", "trackedTrustRootSha256", "now", "expected"
]);
const EXPECTED_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "subjectName", "subjectSha256", "sourceCommit", "workflowPath",
  "workflowRef", "workflowSha", "predicateType", "predicateBindings"
]);
const fixtureUrl = (name) => new URL(`../fixtures/${name}`, import.meta.url);

function cloneAndFreeze(value) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return value;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return Object.freeze(value.map(cloneAndFreeze));
  if (Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Object.prototype) {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_fixture_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(value).map(([key, child]) => [key, cloneAndFreeze(child)])
  ));
}

const archivedBundleBytes = readFileSync(fixtureUrl("github-attestation-v0.3.bundle.json"));
const manifestBytes = readFileSync(fixtureUrl("github-attestation-v0.3.expected.json"));
const trustedRootUrl = new URL("../../../ops/control-plane-deploy/github-sigstore-trusted-root.json", import.meta.url);
const trustedRootBytes = readFileSync(trustedRootUrl);
const trustedRootDigestBytes = readFileSync(new URL("../../../ops/control-plane-deploy/github-sigstore-trusted-root.sha256", import.meta.url));
const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString("utf8"));
if (Reflect.ownKeys(manifest).join("\n") !== ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_FIELDS.join("\n")
  || !Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(manifest), "utf8").equals(manifestBytes)
  || manifest.archiveSchema !== "control_plane_github_attestation_diagnostic_archive_v1"
  || manifest.sourceRepository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
  || !/^https:\/\/github\.com\/gccwebos-com\/proxy-gateway-minimal\/actions\/runs\/[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(manifest.sourceRunUrl)
  || !/^https:\/\/tuf-repo-cdn\.sigstore\.dev\/[A-Za-z0-9._~!$&'()*+,;=:@%/-]+$/.test(manifest.trustedRootSourceUrl)
  || !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(manifest.trustedRootVersion)
  || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(manifest.upstreamTrustedRootSha256)
  || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(manifest.trackedTrustRootSha256)
  || new Date(manifest.capturedAt).toISOString() !== manifest.capturedAt
  || new Date(manifest.now).toISOString() !== manifest.now
  || manifest.expected === null || typeof manifest.expected !== "object"
  || Array.isArray(manifest.expected)
  || Reflect.ownKeys(manifest.expected).join("\n") !== EXPECTED_FIELDS.join("\n")
  || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(manifest.expected.sourceCommit)
  || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(manifest.expected.workflowSha)
  || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(manifest.expected.subjectSha256)
  || manifest.expected.predicateType !== "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1"
  || manifest.expected.predicateBindings?.schema !== "control_plane_publication_attestation_v1"
  || ![
    ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml",
    ".github/workflows/control-plane-compatibility-artifact-gate.yml"
  ].includes(manifest.expected.workflowPath)
  || createHash("sha256").update(archivedBundleBytes).digest("hex") !== manifest.bundleSha256
  || createHash("sha256").update(trustedRootBytes).digest("hex") !== manifest.trackedTrustRootSha256
  || !trustedRootDigestBytes.equals(Buffer.from(`${manifest.trackedTrustRootSha256}\n`, "utf8"))) {
  throw new Error("github_attestation_fixture_invalid");
}
const frozenManifest = cloneAndFreeze(manifest);

export function signedGitHubBundleFixture() {
  return Object.freeze({
    bundleBytes: Buffer.from(archivedBundleBytes),
    now: frozenManifest.now,
    expected: cloneAndFreeze(frozenManifest.expected)
  });
}

export function publicationPredicateFixture() {
  return cloneAndFreeze(frozenManifest.expected.predicateBindings);
}
```

```js
function corruptedBundleFixture(fault) {

  });

  });

  const flip = (value) => `${value[0] === "A" ? "B" : "A"}${value.slice(1)}`;
  if (fault === "payload_byte") bundle.dsseEnvelope.payload = flip(bundle.dsseEnvelope.payload);
  else if (fault === "signature_byte") bundle.dsseEnvelope.signatures[0].sig = flip(bundle.dsseEnvelope.signatures[0].sig);
  else if (fault === "checkpoint_byte") {

  });
```

```js
);

const SIGSTORE_TRUST_ENTRY_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-github-sigstore-trust-entry-v1",
  maxBytes: 32_768,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["kind", "keyId", "pem"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {

      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.keyId)
      || typeof value.pem !== "string" || value.pem.length < 64 || value.pem.length > 24_576
      || !value.pem.endsWith("\n")) {
      throw new Error("github_attestation_trusted_root_invalid");
    }
  }
});

const SIGSTORE_TRUST_ROOT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-github-sigstore-trust-root-v1",
  maxBytes: 262_144,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["schema", "fulcioRoots", "rekorKeys"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({

  }),
  arrays: Object.freeze({
    fulcioRoots: "sigstore-trust-entry-v1",
    rekorKeys: "sigstore-trust-entry-v1"
  }),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_github_sigstore_trust_root_v1"
      || value.fulcioRoots.length < 1 || value.fulcioRoots.length > 8
      || value.rekorKeys.length < 1 || value.rekorKeys.length > 8
      || value.fulcioRoots.some(({ kind }) => kind !== "fulcio_root")
      || value.rekorKeys.some(({ kind }) => kind !== "rekor_key")
      || new Set([...value.fulcioRoots, ...value.rekorKeys].map(({ keyId }) => keyId)).size
        !== value.fulcioRoots.length + value.rekorKeys.length) {
      throw new Error("github_attestation_trusted_root_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function failGithubAttestation() {
  throw new Error("github_attestation_invalid");
}

function decodeStrictBase64(value, minimumBytes = 1, maximumBytes = 262_144) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 4 || value.length > maximumBytes * 2
    || !/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(value)) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const bytes = Buffer.from(value, "base64");
  if (bytes.length < minimumBytes || bytes.length > maximumBytes
    || bytes.toString("base64") !== value) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  return bytes;
}

function parseSafeDecimal(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$/.test(value)) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const number = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(number) || number < 0) failGithubAttestation();
  return number;
}

function sha256Buffer(bytes) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)) failGithubAttestation();
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest();
}

const SIGSTORE_CERTIFICATE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({

  maxBytes: 16_384,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["rawBytes"]),

const SIGSTORE_INCLUSION_PROMISE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({

    envelopeHash: REKOR_HASH_CONTRACT,
    payloadHash: REKOR_HASH_CONTRACT,
    "rekor-dsse-signature-v1": REKOR_DSSE_SIGNATURE_CONTRACT

  arrays: Object.freeze({ signatures: "rekor-dsse-signature-v1" }),
  validate(value) {

});

const REKOR_DSSE_BODY_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-rekor-dsse-body-v1",
  maxBytes: 196_608,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["apiVersion", "kind", "spec"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({ spec: REKOR_DSSE_SPEC_CONTRACT }),

const REKOR_SET_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-rekor-set-payload-v1",
  maxBytes: 262_144,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["body", "integratedTime", "logID", "logIndex"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {

const IN_TOTO_DIGEST_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-in-toto-digest-v1",
  maxBytes: 256,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["sha256"]),

const IN_TOTO_SUBJECT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-in-toto-subject-v1",
  maxBytes: 2_048,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["name", "digest"]),

export const GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY = Object.freeze({
  issuer: "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com",
  repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
  ref: "refs/heads/master",
  predicateTypes: Object.freeze({
    artifactPublication: "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1",
    recoveredCloseout: "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1"
  })
});

export function canonicalizeGitHubAttestationBundleTransport(value) {
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, SIGSTORE_BUNDLE_CONTRACT);
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, SIGSTORE_BUNDLE_CONTRACT);
  return bytes;
}

function decodeDssePayload(envelope) {
  if (envelope === null || typeof envelope !== "object"
    || envelope.payloadType !== "application/vnd.in-toto+json"
    || !Array.isArray(envelope.signatures) || envelope.signatures.length !== 1) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  return decodeStrictBase64(envelope.payload, 32, 196_608);
}

function createDssePae(payloadType, payloadBytes) {
  if (payloadType !== "application/vnd.in-toto+json" || !Buffer.isBuffer(payloadBytes)
    || payloadBytes.length < 1 || payloadBytes.length > 196_608) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const typeBytes = Buffer.from(payloadType, "utf8");
  return Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from(`DSSEv1 ${typeBytes.length} `, "ascii"), typeBytes,
    Buffer.from(` ${payloadBytes.length} `, "ascii"), payloadBytes
  ]);
}

function verifyDsseSignature({ envelope, certificate, paeBytes }) {
  if (!(certificate instanceof X509Certificate) || !Buffer.isBuffer(paeBytes)
    || envelope?.signatures?.length !== 1) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const signature = decodeStrictBase64(envelope.signatures[0].sig, 64, 2_048);
  if (!verify("sha256", paeBytes, certificate.publicKey, signature)) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
}

function parseTrackedPemCertificates(pem) {
  if (typeof pem !== "string" || pem.length < 64 || pem.length > 24_576
    || !pem.endsWith("\n")) failGithubAttestation();
  const expression = /-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n([A-Za-z0-9+/=\n]+)-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n/g;
  const blocks = [];
  let consumed = "";
  for (const match of pem.matchAll(expression)) {
    const lines = match[1].split("\n").filter((line) => line !== "");
    if (lines.length < 1 || lines.some((line, index) => line.length < 1
      || line.length > 64 || (index < lines.length - 1 && line.length !== 64))) {
      failGithubAttestation();
    }
    const encoded = lines.join("");
    const der = decodeStrictBase64(encoded, 256, 12_288);
    const canonicalLines = encoded.match(/.{1,64}/g);
    const block = `-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n${canonicalLines.join("\n")}\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n`;
    if (block !== match[0]) failGithubAttestation();
    blocks.push(block);
    consumed += block;
  }
  if (blocks.length < 1 || blocks.length > 4 || consumed !== pem) failGithubAttestation();
  try { return blocks.map((block) => new X509Certificate(block)); } catch {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
}

function certificateSpkiSha256(certificate) {
  if (!(certificate instanceof X509Certificate)) failGithubAttestation();
  let der;
  try { der = certificate.publicKey.export({ type: "spki", format: "der" }); } catch {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  return sha256Buffer(Buffer.from(der)).toString("hex");
}

function verifyFulcioCertificateChain({ certificate, fulcioRoots, verificationTime }) {
  if (certificate === null || typeof certificate !== "object"
    || !Array.isArray(fulcioRoots) || fulcioRoots.length < 1 || fulcioRoots.length > 8
    || typeof verificationTime !== "string") failGithubAttestation();
  const at = Date.parse(verificationTime);
  if (!Number.isFinite(at) || new Date(at).toISOString() !== verificationTime) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  let leaf;
  try {
    leaf = new X509Certificate(decodeStrictBase64(certificate.rawBytes, 256, 12_288));
  } catch {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const validFrom = Date.parse(leaf.validFrom);
  const validTo = Date.parse(leaf.validTo);
  if (!Number.isFinite(validFrom) || !Number.isFinite(validTo)
    || at < validFrom || at > validTo || leaf.ca !== false
    || !["ec", "rsa"].includes(leaf.publicKey.asymmetricKeyType)) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  if (leaf.publicKey.asymmetricKeyType !== "ec"
    || leaf.publicKey.asymmetricKeyDetails?.namedCurve !== "prime256v1"
    || !Array.isArray(leaf.keyUsage)
    || !leaf.keyUsage.includes("1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.3")) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  let matchingPaths = 0;
  for (const row of fulcioRoots) {
    if (row === null || typeof row !== "object" || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(row.keyId ?? "")) {
      failGithubAttestation();
    }
    const path = [leaf, ...parseTrackedPemCertificates(row.pem)];
    const root = path.at(-1);
    if (certificateSpkiSha256(root) !== row.keyId || root.ca !== true) continue;
    const rootFrom = Date.parse(root.validFrom);
    const rootTo = Date.parse(root.validTo);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rootFrom) || !Number.isFinite(rootTo)
      || at < rootFrom || at > rootTo || !root.checkIssued(root)
      || !root.verify(root.publicKey)) continue;
    let validPath = true;
    for (let index = 0; index < path.length - 1; index += 1) {
      const child = path[index];
      const issuer = path[index + 1];
      const childFrom = Date.parse(child.validFrom);
      const childTo = Date.parse(child.validTo);
      if (!Number.isFinite(childFrom) || !Number.isFinite(childTo)
        || at < childFrom || at > childTo
        || (index > 0 && child.ca !== true)
        || !child.checkIssued(issuer) || !child.verify(issuer.publicKey)) {
        validPath = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (validPath) matchingPaths += 1;
  }
  if (matchingPaths !== 1) failGithubAttestation();
  return leaf;
}

function verifyRekorSignedEntryTimestamp({ bundle, rekorKeys }) {
  const entry = bundle?.verificationMaterial?.tlogEntries?.[0];
  if (!entry || !Array.isArray(rekorKeys) || rekorKeys.length < 1 || rekorKeys.length > 8) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const logIdBytes = decodeStrictBase64(entry.logId.keyId, 32, 32);
  const logId = logIdBytes.toString("hex");
  const keys = rekorKeys.filter((row) => row?.keyId === logId && typeof row.pem === "string");
  if (keys.length !== 1) failGithubAttestation();
  const integratedTime = parseSafeDecimal(entry.integratedTime);
  const logIndex = parseSafeDecimal(entry.logIndex);
  const signed = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes({
    body: entry.canonicalizedBody,
    integratedTime,
    logID: logId,
    logIndex
  }, REKOR_SET_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT);
  const signature = decodeStrictBase64(
    entry.inclusionPromise.signedEntryTimestamp, 64, 2_048
  );
  let key;
  try { key = createPublicKey(keys[0].pem); } catch { failGithubAttestation(); }
  let spki;
  try { spki = key.export({ type: "spki", format: "der" }); } catch {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  if (sha256Buffer(Buffer.from(spki)).toString("hex") !== logId
    || key.asymmetricKeyType !== "ec"
    || key.asymmetricKeyDetails?.namedCurve !== "prime256v1") {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  if (!verify("sha256", signed, key, signature)) failGithubAttestation();
  return Object.freeze({ entry, key, integratedTime, logIndex, logId });
}

function verifyRekorCheckpoint({ checkpointEnvelope, proof, rekor }) {
  if (typeof checkpointEnvelope !== "string" || !checkpointEnvelope.endsWith("\n")
    || rekor === null || typeof rekor !== "object") failGithubAttestation();
  const lines = checkpointEnvelope.split("\n");
  if (lines.length !== 6 || lines[3] !== "" || lines[5] !== ""
    || !/^rekor\.sigstore\.dev - [1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(lines[0])) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const treeSize = parseSafeDecimal(lines[1]);
  const rootHash = decodeStrictBase64(lines[2], 32, 32);
  const signatureMatch = /^— rekor\.sigstore\.dev ([A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2})$/.exec(lines[4]);
  if (!signatureMatch) failGithubAttestation();
  const noteSignature = decodeStrictBase64(signatureMatch[1], 68, 2_052);
  const expectedHint = Buffer.from(rekor.logId, "hex").subarray(0, 4);
  if (treeSize !== parseSafeDecimal(proof.treeSize)
    || !rootHash.equals(decodeStrictBase64(proof.rootHash, 32, 32))
    || !noteSignature.subarray(0, 4).equals(expectedHint)
    || !verify("sha256", Buffer.from(lines.slice(0, 3).join("\n") + "\n", "utf8"),
      rekor.key, noteSignature.subarray(4))) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
}

function verifyRekorInclusionPromiseAndProof({ bundle, statementBytes, rekor }) {
  const entry = bundle?.verificationMaterial?.tlogEntries?.[0];
  const proof = entry?.inclusionProof;
  if (!entry || entry !== rekor?.entry || !proof || !Buffer.isBuffer(statementBytes)
    || parseSafeDecimal(entry.logIndex) !== rekor.logIndex
    || parseSafeDecimal(proof.logIndex) !== rekor.logIndex) failGithubAttestation();
  const bodyBytes = decodeStrictBase64(entry.canonicalizedBody, 32, 196_608);
  let body;
  try {
    body = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bodyBytes, REKOR_DSSE_BODY_CONTRACT);
  } catch {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  if (entry.kindVersion.kind !== body.kind
    || entry.kindVersion.version !== body.apiVersion) failGithubAttestation();
  const envelopeBytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(bundle.dsseEnvelope, DSSE_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT);
  const signature = decodeStrictBase64(bundle.dsseEnvelope.signatures[0].sig, 64, 2_048);
  const loggedSignature = decodeStrictBase64(body.spec.signatures[0].signature, 64, 2_048);
  const loggedVerifier = decodeStrictBase64(body.spec.signatures[0].verifier, 256, 24_576);
  const leafBytes = decodeStrictBase64(
    bundle.verificationMaterial.certificate.rawBytes, 256, 12_288
  );
  let loggedVerifierCertificate;
  let bundleLeafCertificate;
  try {
    loggedVerifierCertificate = new X509Certificate(loggedVerifier);
    bundleLeafCertificate = new X509Certificate(leafBytes);
  } catch {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  if (body.spec.envelopeHash.value !== sha256Hex(envelopeBytes)
    || body.spec.payloadHash.value !== sha256Hex(statementBytes)
    || !loggedSignature.equals(signature)
    || !loggedVerifierCertificate.raw.equals(bundleLeafCertificate.raw)
    || !decodeDssePayload(bundle.dsseEnvelope).equals(statementBytes)) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  verifyRekorCheckpoint({ checkpointEnvelope: proof.checkpoint.envelope, proof, rekor });
  let index = parseSafeDecimal(proof.logIndex);
  let last = parseSafeDecimal(proof.treeSize) - 1;
  let hash = sha256Buffer(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0]), bodyBytes]));
  for (const encoded of proof.hashes) {
    if (last === 0) failGithubAttestation();
    const sibling = decodeStrictBase64(encoded, 32, 32);
    if ((index & 1) === 1 || index === last) {
      hash = sha256Buffer(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([1]), sibling, hash]));
      while ((index & 1) === 0 && index !== 0) {
        index = Math.floor(index / 2);
        last = Math.floor(last / 2);
      }
    } else {
      hash = sha256Buffer(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([1]), hash, sibling]));
    }
    index = Math.floor(index / 2);
    last = Math.floor(last / 2);
  }
  const rootHash = decodeStrictBase64(proof.rootHash, 32, 32);
  if (last !== 0 || hash.length !== rootHash.length
    || !hash.every((byte, offset) => byte === rootHash[offset])) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
}

function readDerTlv(bytes, offset) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || !Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0
    || offset + 2 > bytes.length) failGithubAttestation();
  const tag = bytes[offset];
  const firstLength = bytes[offset + 1];
  let cursor = offset + 2;
  let length;
  if (firstLength < 0x80) {
    length = firstLength;
  } else {
    const octets = firstLength & 0x7f;
    if (octets < 1 || octets > 4 || cursor + octets > bytes.length
      || bytes[cursor] === 0) failGithubAttestation();
    length = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < octets; index += 1) {
      length = length * 256 + bytes[cursor + index];
    }
    if (length < 0x80) failGithubAttestation();
    cursor += octets;
  }
  const end = cursor + length;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(end) || end > bytes.length) failGithubAttestation();
  return Object.freeze({ tag, start: cursor, end, next: end });
}

function decodeDerOid(bytes) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > 64) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const first = Math.min(2, Math.floor(bytes[0] / 40));
  const values = [first, bytes[0] - first * 40];
  let value = 0;
  let open = false;
  for (let index = 1; index < bytes.length; index += 1) {
    value = value * 128 + (bytes[index] & 0x7f);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) failGithubAttestation();
    open = (bytes[index] & 0x80) !== 0;
    if (!open) { values.push(value); value = 0; }
  }
  if (open) failGithubAttestation();
  return values.join(".");
}

function readFulcioExtensionMap(certificate) {
  if (!(certificate instanceof X509Certificate) || !Buffer.isBuffer(certificate.raw)) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const root = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, 0);
  if (root.tag !== 0x30 || root.end !== certificate.raw.length) failGithubAttestation();
  const tbs = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, root.start);
  if (tbs.tag !== 0x30) failGithubAttestation();
  let extensions = null;
  for (let offset = tbs.start; offset < tbs.end;) {
    const child = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, offset);
    if (child.tag === 0xa3) {
      if (extensions !== null) failGithubAttestation();
      extensions = child;
    }
    offset = child.next;
  }
  if (extensions === null) failGithubAttestation();
  const sequence = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, extensions.start);
  if (sequence.tag !== 0x30 || sequence.end !== extensions.end) failGithubAttestation();
  const result = new Map();
  for (let offset = sequence.start; offset < sequence.end;) {
    const extension = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, offset);
    if (extension.tag !== 0x30) failGithubAttestation();
    let cursor = extension.start;
    const oidTlv = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, cursor);
    if (oidTlv.tag !== 0x06) failGithubAttestation();
    const oid = decodeDerOid(certificate.raw.subarray(oidTlv.start, oidTlv.end));
    cursor = oidTlv.next;
    let valueTlv = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, cursor);
    if (valueTlv.tag === 0x01) {
      cursor = valueTlv.next;
      valueTlv = readDerTlv(certificate.raw, cursor);
    }
    if (valueTlv.tag !== 0x04 || valueTlv.end !== extension.end) failGithubAttestation();
    if ([
      "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.8", "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.9",
      "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.10", "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.11",
      "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.12", "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.13",
      "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.14", "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.18",
      "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.19", "1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.20"
    ].includes(oid)) {
      let payload = certificate.raw.subarray(valueTlv.start, valueTlv.end);
      const inner = readDerTlv(payload, 0);
      if (inner.tag !== 0x0c || inner.end !== payload.length) failGithubAttestation();
      payload = payload.subarray(inner.start, inner.end);
      let text;
      try { text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(payload); } catch {
        failGithubAttestation();
      }
      if (text.length < 1 || text.length > 4_096 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(text)
        || result.has(oid)) failGithubAttestation();
      result.set(oid, text);
    }
    offset = extension.next;
  }
  return result;
}

function readGitHubOidcCertificateExtensions(certificate) {
  const extensions = readFulcioExtensionMap(certificate);
  const issuer = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.8");
  const signerUri = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.9");
  const signerSha = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.10");
  const repositoryUri = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.12");
  const sourceSha = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.13");
  const sourceRef = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.14");
  const workflowUri = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.18");
  const workflowSha = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.19");
  const workflowTrigger = extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.20");
  const repositoryMatch = /^https:\/\/github\.com\/([^/]+\/[^/]+)$/.exec(repositoryUri ?? "");
  const workflowMatch = /^https:\/\/github\.com\/([^/]+\/[^/]+)\/(\.github\/workflows\/[^@,]+)@(refs\/heads\/master)$/.exec(workflowUri ?? "");
  if (!repositoryMatch || !workflowMatch || repositoryMatch[1] !== workflowMatch[1]
    || issuer !== "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
    || extensions.get("1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.11") !== "github-hosted"
    || signerUri !== workflowUri
    || signerSha !== workflowSha
    || workflowTrigger !== "workflow_dispatch"
    || sourceRef !== workflowMatch[3]
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(sourceSha ?? "")
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(workflowSha ?? "")
    || certificate.subjectAltName !== `URI:${signerUri}`) {
    failGithubAttestation();
  }
  const repository = repositoryMatch[1];
  const workflowPath = workflowMatch[2];
  return Object.freeze({
    issuer,
    repository,
    workflowPath,
    workflowRef: `${repository}/${workflowPath}@${workflowMatch[3]}`,
    workflowSha,
    sourceRef,
    sourceSha
  });
}

function verifySigstoreBundleCryptography({
  bundleBytes, fulcioRoots, rekorKeys, now, predicateFamily
}) {
  const bundle = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bundleBytes, SIGSTORE_BUNDLE_CONTRACT);
  const statementBytes = decodeDssePayload(bundle.dsseEnvelope);
  const rekor = verifyRekorSignedEntryTimestamp({ bundle, rekorKeys });
  verifyRekorInclusionPromiseAndProof({ bundle, statementBytes, rekor });
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(rekor.integratedTime)
    || rekor.integratedTime * 1000 > Date.parse(now) + 30_000) {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_invalid");
  }
  const certificate = verifyFulcioCertificateChain({
    certificate: bundle.verificationMaterial.certificate,
    fulcioRoots,
    verificationTime: new Date(rekor.integratedTime * 1000).toISOString()
  });
  verifyDsseSignature({
    envelope: bundle.dsseEnvelope,
    certificate,
    paeBytes: createDssePae("application/vnd.in-toto+json", statementBytes)
  });
  return Object.freeze({
    bundle,
    certificateClaims: readGitHubOidcCertificateExtensions(certificate),
    statementBytes,
    statement: parseCanonicalJsonBytes(
      statementBytes, resolveInTotoStatementContract(predicateFamily)
    )
  });
}

const PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-publication-attestation-predicate-v1",
  maxBytes: 16_384,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schema", "repository", "sourceSha", "workflowPath", "workflowRef",
    "workflowSha", "publicationMode", "publicationEnvelopeSha256",
    "inventoryReceiptSha256", "productionGateReceiptSha256",
    "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256", "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_publication_attestation_v1"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || ![
        ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml",
        ".github/workflows/control-plane-compatibility-artifact-gate.yml"
      ].includes(value.workflowPath)
      || value.workflowRef !== `${value.repository}/${value.workflowPath}@refs/heads/master`
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.sourceSha)
      || value.workflowSha !== value.sourceSha
      || !["normal", "compatibility_bootstrap"].includes(value.publicationMode)
      || (value.publicationMode === "normal"
        && value.workflowPath !== ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml")
      || (value.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
        && value.workflowPath !== ".github/workflows/control-plane-compatibility-artifact-gate.yml")
      || ![
        value.publicationEnvelopeSha256,
        value.inventoryReceiptSha256
      ].every((digest) => /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(digest))
      || (value.publicationMode === "normal"
        && (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.productionGateReceiptSha256)
          || value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 !== null
          || value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 !== null))
      || (value.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
        && (value.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== null
          || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256)
          || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256)))) {
      throw new Error("publication_attestation_predicate_invalid");
    }
  }
});

export const RECOVERED_CLOSEOUT_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-recovered-closeout-attestation-predicate-v1",
  maxBytes: 16_384,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schema", "repository", "originalTransactionTargetCommit",
    "attesterWorkflowPath", "attesterWorkflowRef", "attesterWorkflowSha",
    "attesterSourceCommit", "controllerRecoveryId", "terminalReceiptSha256",
    "recoveredCloseoutSha256", "actionsArtifactObservationSha256"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_recovered_closeout_attestation_v1"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || value.attesterWorkflowPath !== ".github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml"
      || value.attesterWorkflowRef !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal/.github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml@refs/heads/master"
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.originalTransactionTargetCommit)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.attesterWorkflowSha)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.attesterSourceCommit)
      || !/^cr1\.[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.controllerRecoveryId)
      || ![value.terminalReceiptSha256, value.recoveredCloseoutSha256,
        value.actionsArtifactObservationSha256].every((digest) => /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(digest))) {
      throw new Error("recovered_closeout_attestation_predicate_invalid");
    }
  }
});

const IN_TOTO_PUBLICATION_STATEMENT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-in-toto-publication-statement-v1",
  maxBytes: 196_608,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["_type", "subject", "predicateType", "predicate"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({
    "in-toto-subject-v1": IN_TOTO_SUBJECT_CONTRACT,
    predicate: PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT
  }),
  arrays: Object.freeze({ subject: "in-toto-subject-v1" }),
  validate(value) {
    if (value._type !== "https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1"
      || value.subject.length !== 1
      || value.predicateType !== "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1") {
      failGithubAttestation();
    }
  }
});

const IN_TOTO_INVENTORY_STATEMENT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-in-toto-inventory-statement-v1",
  maxBytes: 196_608,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["_type", "subject", "predicateType", "predicate"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({
    "in-toto-subject-v1": IN_TOTO_SUBJECT_CONTRACT,
    predicate: INVENTORY_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT
  }),
  arrays: Object.freeze({ subject: "in-toto-subject-v1" }),
  validate(value) {
    if (value._type !== "https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1"
      || value.subject.length !== 1 || value.predicateType !== "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1") {
      failGithubAttestation();
    }
  }
});

const IN_TOTO_RECOVERED_STATEMENT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-in-toto-recovered-statement-v1",
  maxBytes: 196_608,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["_type", "subject", "predicateType", "predicate"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({
    "in-toto-subject-v1": IN_TOTO_SUBJECT_CONTRACT,
    predicate: RECOVERED_CLOSEOUT_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT
  }),
  arrays: Object.freeze({ subject: "in-toto-subject-v1" }),
  validate(value) {
    if (value._type !== "https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1"
      || value.subject.length !== 1 || value.predicateType !== "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1") {
      failGithubAttestation();
    }
  }
});

function resolveInTotoStatementContract(family) {
  if (family === "artifact_publication") return IN_TOTO_PUBLICATION_STATEMENT_CONTRACT;
  if (family === "inventory") return IN_TOTO_INVENTORY_STATEMENT_CONTRACT;
  if (family === "recovered_closeout") return IN_TOTO_RECOVERED_STATEMENT_CONTRACT;
  failGithubAttestation();
}

export function validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings({ predicateType, predicateBindings }) {
  let family;
  let contract;
  if (predicateType === GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.predicateTypes.artifactPublication) {
    family = "artifact_publication";
    contract = PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT;
  } else if (predicateType === "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1"
    && predicateBindings?.schema === "control_plane_inventory_attestation_v1") {
    family = "inventory";
    contract = INVENTORY_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT;
  } else if (predicateType === GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.predicateTypes.recoveredCloseout
    && predicateBindings?.schema === "control_plane_recovered_closeout_attestation_v1") {
    family = "recovered_closeout";
    contract = RECOVERED_CLOSEOUT_ATTESTATION_PREDICATE_CONTRACT;
  } else {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_predicate_family_invalid");
  }
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(predicateBindings, contract);
  const value = Object.freeze(parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, contract));
  return Object.freeze({ family, value, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) });
}

function loadTrackedSigstoreTrust() {
  const trustedRootBundle = readFileSync(TRACKED_TRUST_ROOT_URL);
  const digestFile = readFileSync(TRACKED_TRUST_ROOT_DIGEST_URL, "utf8");
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}\n$/.test(digestFile)
    || sha256Hex(trustedRootBundle) !== digestFile.slice(0, 64)) {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_trusted_root_invalid");
  }
  const value = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(trustedRootBundle, SIGSTORE_TRUST_ROOT_CONTRACT);
  return Object.freeze({
    fulcioRoots: Object.freeze(value.fulcioRoots.map(({ keyId, pem }) => Object.freeze({ keyId, pem }))),
    rekorKeys: Object.freeze(value.rekorKeys.map(({ keyId, pem }) => Object.freeze({ keyId, pem })))
  });
}

function runTrackedGithubAttestationDiagnostics({ bundleBytes, expected, trust, now }) {
  const expectedPredicate = validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings({
    predicateType: expected.predicateType,
    predicateBindings: expected.predicateBindings
  });
  const verified = verifySigstoreBundleCryptography({
    bundleBytes,
    fulcioRoots: trust.fulcioRoots,
    rekorKeys: trust.rekorKeys,
    now,
    predicateFamily: expectedPredicate.family
  });
  const claims = verified.certificateClaims;
  const statement = verified.statement;
  const subjects = statement.subject.filter(({ name, digest }) => name === expected.subjectName && digest.sha256 === expected.subjectSha256);
  const actualPredicate = validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings({
    predicateType: statement.predicateType,
    predicateBindings: statement.predicate
  });
  const bindingWorkflowPath = expectedPredicate.family === "recovered_closeout"
    ? expectedPredicate.value.attesterWorkflowPath
    : expectedPredicate.value.workflowPath;
  const bindingWorkflowRef = expectedPredicate.family === "recovered_closeout"
    ? expectedPredicate.value.attesterWorkflowRef
    : expectedPredicate.value.workflowRef;
  const bindingWorkflowSha = expectedPredicate.family === "recovered_closeout"
    ? expectedPredicate.value.attesterWorkflowSha
    : expectedPredicate.value.workflowSha;
  const bindingSourceCommit = expectedPredicate.family === "artifact_publication"
    ? expectedPredicate.value.sourceSha
    : expectedPredicate.family === "recovered_closeout"
      ? expectedPredicate.value.attesterSourceCommit
      : expectedPredicate.value.sourceCommit;
  if (claims.issuer !== GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.issuer
    || claims.repository !== GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.repository
    || claims.workflowPath !== expected.workflowPath
    || expected.workflowRef !== `${GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.repository}/${expected.workflowPath}@${GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.ref}`
    || claims.workflowRef !== expected.workflowRef
    || claims.workflowSha !== expected.workflowSha
    || claims.sourceRef !== GITHUB_ATTESTATION_POLICY.ref
    || claims.sourceSha !== expected.sourceCommit
    || statement.predicateType !== expected.predicateType
    || statement.subject.length !== 1
    || subjects.length !== 1
    || expectedPredicate.family !== actualPredicate.family
    || !expectedPredicate.bytes.equals(actualPredicate.bytes)
    || bindingWorkflowPath !== expected.workflowPath
    || bindingWorkflowRef !== expected.workflowRef
    || bindingWorkflowSha !== expected.workflowSha
    || bindingSourceCommit !== expected.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    diagnosticOnly: true,
    authoritative: false,
    diagnosticCode: "bounded_dsse_fulcio_rekor_oidc_diagnostics_only",
    bundleSha256: sha256Hex(bundleBytes),
    statementSha256: sha256Hex(verified.statementBytes),
    subjectSha256: expected.subjectSha256
  });
}

function assertTrackedDiagnosticOptions(options) {
  const keys = options !== null && typeof options === "object" ? Reflect.ownKeys(options) : [];
  if (keys.length !== 1 || keys[0] !== "clock"
    || options === null || Object.getPrototypeOf(options) !== Object.prototype
    || options.clock === null || typeof options.clock !== "object"
    || Reflect.ownKeys(options.clock).length !== 1
    || Reflect.ownKeys(options.clock)[0] !== "now"
    || typeof options.clock.now !== "function") {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_diagnostic_options_invalid");
  }
  const trust = loadTrackedSigstoreTrust();
  return Object.freeze({ options, trust });
}

export function createTrackedGithubAttestationDiagnosticRunner(options) {
  const { trust } = assertTrackedDiagnosticOptions(options);
  return Object.freeze({
    diagnose(input) {
      const inputKeys = input !== null && typeof input === "object" ? Reflect.ownKeys(input) : [];
      if (inputKeys.length !== 2 || inputKeys[0] !== "bundleBytes" || inputKeys[1] !== "expected") {
        throw new Error("github_attestation_diagnostic_input_invalid");
      }
      const now = options.clock.now();
      if (!(now instanceof Date) || !Number.isFinite(now.getTime())) {
        throw new Error("github_attestation_diagnostic_clock_invalid");
      }
      try {
        return runTrackedGithubAttestationDiagnostics({
          bundleBytes: input.bundleBytes,
          expected: input.expected,
          trust,
          now: now.toISOString()
        });
      } catch {
        throw new Error("github_attestation_invalid");
      }
    }
  });
}

export function createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier(options) {
  const diagnostic = createTrackedGithubAttestationDiagnosticRunner(options);
  return Object.freeze({
    verify(input) {
      diagnostic.diagnose(input);
      throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
    }
  });
}

function renderFixedTrackedVerifierInlineClosure(input) {
  const expectedKeys = ["canonicalRuntime"];
  if (input === null || typeof input !== "object" || Array.isArray(input)
    || Object.getPrototypeOf(input) !== Object.prototype
    || Reflect.ownKeys(input).join("\n") !== expectedKeys.join("\n")
    || input.canonicalRuntime === null || typeof input.canonicalRuntime !== "object"
    || !Object.isFrozen(input.canonicalRuntime)
    || Reflect.ownKeys(input.canonicalRuntime).join("\n") !== "bytes\nsha256"
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.canonicalRuntime.bytes)
    || input.canonicalRuntime.bytes.length < 1
    || input.canonicalRuntime.bytes.length > 65_536
    || input.canonicalRuntime.bytes.at(-1) !== 0x0a
    || input.canonicalRuntime.sha256 !== CANONICAL_JSON_INLINE_RUNTIME_SHA256
    || sha256Hex(input.canonicalRuntime.bytes) !== input.canonicalRuntime.sha256) {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_inline_verifier_invalid");
  }
  return Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from('"use strict";\n', "utf8"),
    Buffer.from(input.canonicalRuntime.bytes),
    Buffer.from([
    'async function verifyRecoveredCloseoutPair(input){',
    '  if(input===null||typeof input!=="object"||Array.isArray(input)||Reflect.ownKeys(input).join("\\n")!=="bundleBytes\\nexpected")throw new Error("github_attestation_inline_input_invalid");',
    '  throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");',
    '}',
    ''
    ].join("\n"), "utf8")
  ]);
}

export function createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifierInlineBytes() {
  const canonicalRuntime = createCanonicalJsonInlineRuntimeFixture();
  const bytes = renderFixedTrackedVerifierInlineClosure({
    canonicalRuntime
  });
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > 262_144
    || !bytes.toString("utf8").endsWith("\n")
    || (bytes.toString("utf8").match(/require\("node:crypto"\)/g) ?? []).length !== 1
    || /\b(?:import|eval|Function|child_process|process|fetch)\b/.test(bytes.toString("utf8"))) {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_inline_verifier_invalid");
  }
  const context = createContext({
    Buffer,
    TextDecoder,
    require(specifier) {
      if (specifier !== "node:crypto") {
        throw new Error("github_attestation_inline_require_invalid");
      }
      return Object.freeze({ createHash });
    }
  }, { codeGeneration: { strings: false, wasm: false } });
  const compiled = new Script(
    `${bytes.toString("utf8")}\nglobalThis.__artifactVerifier=Object.freeze({verifyRecoveredCloseoutPair});`,
    { filename: "tracked-github-attestation-stop.cjs" }
  );
  compiled.runInContext(context, { timeout: 1_000 });
  if (Reflect.ownKeys(context.__artifactVerifier).join("\n") !== "verifyRecoveredCloseoutPair"
    || typeof context.__artifactVerifier.verifyRecoveredCloseoutPair !== "function") {
    throw new Error("github_attestation_inline_verifier_invalid");
  }
  return Buffer.from(bytes);
}
```

The same module implements the seven bounded diagnostic primitives and their private helpers against the committed official-shape GitHub v0.3 archive: strict Base64/transport contracts, DSSE PAE/signature, tracked Fulcio path at Rekor time, Rekor SET plus signed checkpoint and RFC 6962 inclusion, V2 Fulcio OID parsing, three exact in-toto statement roots, and subject/predicate identity comparison. These checks are deliberately labelled diagnostics, not full Sigstore verification: the tracked root format has no CT-log/SCT/precertificate authority and no Rekor-key validity window, so even a positive diagnostic is never admissible for a last asset or production. `renderFixedTrackedVerifierInlineClosure` no longer serializes functions or validators. It accepts only Foundation's hash-frozen canonical runtime fixture, appends one static `verifyRecoveredCloseoutPair` that always throws `github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable`, and compiles/executes the exact bytes in an isolated CommonJS VM. Tests cover the real archive, transport/DSSE/Fulcio/Rekor/OIDC/predicate fault rows, deterministic non-aliased inline bytes, and zero Release/eligibility/completion outputs; they do not claim parity with a nonexistent full verifier.

```js
import {
  canonicalizeGitHubAttestationBundleTransport,
  createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier,
  validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings
} from "../server/services/deployment/github-attestation-verifier.mjs";
import { sha256Hex } from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";

const REPOSITORY = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
const GITHUB_API_ORIGIN = "https://api.github.com";
const GITHUB_UPLOAD_ORIGIN = "https://uploads.github.com";
const GITHUB_API_VERSION = "2022-11-28";
const GITHUB_JSON_LIMIT_BYTES = 1_048_576;
const GITHUB_RELEASE_ASSET_REDIRECT_HOSTS = new Set([
  "objects.githubusercontent.com",
  "github-releases.githubusercontent.com",
  "release-assets.githubusercontent.com"
]);
const SHA256_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const COMMIT_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const ATTESTATION_IDENTITY_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "workflowPath", "workflowRef", "workflowSha", "sourceCommit", "predicateType"
]);
const SLSA_PREDICATE = "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1";
const PUBLICATION_PREDICATE = "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1";

function tagFamilyPolicies(tag, targetCommit) {
  const runtimeSuffix = "[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?";
  const app = new RegExp(`^control-plane-app-(${COMMIT_PATTERN.source.slice(1, -1)})-(${runtimeSuffix})$`).exec(tag);
  if (app !== null && app[1] === targetCommit) return Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ workflowPath: ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml", predicateType: PUBLICATION_PREDICATE })
  ]);
  const compatibilityApp = new RegExp(`^control-plane-compatibility-(${COMMIT_PATTERN.source.slice(1, -1)})-(${runtimeSuffix})$`).exec(tag);
  if (compatibilityApp !== null && compatibilityApp[1] === targetCommit) return Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ workflowPath: ".github/workflows/control-plane-compatibility-artifact-gate.yml", predicateType: PUBLICATION_PREDICATE })
  ]);
  const inventory = new RegExp(`^control-plane-inventory-(${COMMIT_PATTERN.source.slice(1, -1)})-(${runtimeSuffix})$`).exec(tag);
  if (inventory !== null && inventory[1] === targetCommit) return Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ workflowPath: ".github/workflows/japan-control-plane-readonly-inventory.yml", predicateType: SLSA_PREDICATE })
  ]);
  const compatibility = new RegExp(`^control-plane-compatibility-inventory-(${COMMIT_PATTERN.source.slice(1, -1)})-(${runtimeSuffix})$`).exec(tag);
  if (compatibility !== null && compatibility[1] === targetCommit) return Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ workflowPath: ".github/workflows/japan-control-plane-compatibility-readonly-inventory.yml", predicateType: SLSA_PREDICATE })
  ]);
  if (/^control-plane-recovered-closeout-cr1\.[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(tag)) return Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ workflowPath: ".github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml", predicateType: SLSA_PREDICATE, recovered: true })
  ]);
  throw new Error("immutable_publication_tag_family_invalid");
}

function validateRecoveredPublicationIdentity({ targetCommit, attestationIdentity, predicate }) {
  return predicate.originalTransactionTargetCommit === targetCommit
    && predicate.attesterWorkflowPath === attestationIdentity.workflowPath
    && predicate.attesterWorkflowRef === attestationIdentity.workflowRef
    && predicate.attesterWorkflowSha === attestationIdentity.workflowSha
    && predicate.attesterSourceCommit === attestationIdentity.sourceCommit;
}

function validateExactPredicateBindingsForTagFamily(input) {
  const recovered = /^control-plane-recovered-closeout-cr1\.[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.tag);
  const inventory = /^control-plane-(?:compatibility-)?inventory-/.test(input.tag);
  const expectedFamily = recovered ? "recovered_closeout" : inventory ? "inventory" : "artifact_publication";
  const canonical = validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings({
    predicateType: input.attestationIdentity?.predicateType,
    predicateBindings: input.predicateBindings
  });
  if (canonical.family !== expectedFamily) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_predicate_invalid");
  }
  return canonical;
}

function validateAttestationIdentity({ tag, targetCommit, attestationIdentity, canonicalPredicate }) {
  const keys = attestationIdentity !== null && typeof attestationIdentity === "object"
    ? Reflect.ownKeys(attestationIdentity)
    : [];
  if (attestationIdentity === null || typeof attestationIdentity !== "object"
    || Object.getPrototypeOf(attestationIdentity) !== Object.prototype
    || !Object.isFrozen(attestationIdentity)
    || keys.length !== ATTESTATION_IDENTITY_FIELDS.length
    || !keys.every((key, index) => key === ATTESTATION_IDENTITY_FIELDS[index])
    || keys.some((key) => {
      const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(attestationIdentity, key);
      return descriptor === undefined || descriptor.enumerable !== true
        || !Object.hasOwn(descriptor, "value") || descriptor.get !== undefined || descriptor.set !== undefined;
    })) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_identity_invalid");
  }
  const matches = tagFamilyPolicies(tag, targetCommit).filter(({ workflowPath, predicateType, recovered = false }) =>
    attestationIdentity.workflowPath === workflowPath
    && attestationIdentity.workflowRef === `${REPOSITORY}/${workflowPath}@refs/heads/master`
    && COMMIT_PATTERN.test(attestationIdentity.workflowSha)
    && COMMIT_PATTERN.test(attestationIdentity.sourceCommit)
    && (recovered
      ? validateRecoveredPublicationIdentity({
        targetCommit,
        attestationIdentity,
        predicate: canonicalPredicate.value
      })
      : attestationIdentity.workflowSha === targetCommit && attestationIdentity.sourceCommit === targetCommit)
    && attestationIdentity.predicateType === predicateType);
  if (matches.length !== 1) throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_identity_invalid");
  return attestationIdentity;
}

function validateInput(input) {
  if (input.repository !== REPOSITORY
    || !COMMIT_PATTERN.test(input.targetCommit)
    || !SHA256_PATTERN.test(input.sha256)
    || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,180}$/.test(input.tag)
    || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,180}$/.test(input.assetName)) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_identity_invalid");
  }
  const canonicalPredicate = validateExactPredicateBindingsForTagFamily(input);
  validateAttestationIdentity({ ...input, canonicalPredicate });
}

function fixedGithubHeaders(token, accept = "application/vnd.github+json") {
  if (typeof token !== "string" || token.length < 1 || token.length > 4_096
    || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/u.test(token)
    || typeof accept !== "string" || accept.length < 1 || accept.length > 128) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_request_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    accept,
    authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "x-github-api-version": GITHUB_API_VERSION
  });
}

async function readBoundedGithubJson(response, expectedStatuses) {
  if (response === null || typeof response !== "object"
    || !Array.isArray(expectedStatuses) || !expectedStatuses.includes(response.status)
    || typeof response.body?.getReader !== "function") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_response_invalid");
  }
  const contentType = (response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")
    .split(";", 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  if (contentType !== "application/json" && contentType !== "application/vnd.github+json") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_response_invalid");
  }
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    if (!(value instanceof Uint8Array)) {
      await reader.cancel();
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_response_invalid");
    }
    size += value.byteLength;
    if (size > GITHUB_JSON_LIMIT_BYTES) {
      await reader.cancel();
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_response_invalid");
    }
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(value));
  }
  if (size < 2) throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_response_invalid");
  try {
    return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks, size).toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_github_response_invalid");
  }
}

async function readExactReleaseByTag(input) {
  const releaseResponse = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_API_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${encodeURIComponent(input.tag)}`,
    Object.freeze({ method: "GET", redirect: "error", headers: fixedGithubHeaders(input.token) })
  );
  if (releaseResponse.status === 404) return null;
  const release = await readBoundedGithubJson(releaseResponse, [200]);
  const releaseKeys = release !== null && typeof release === "object" ? Reflect.ownKeys(release) : [];
  if (release === null || typeof release !== "object" || Array.isArray(release)
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(release.id) || release.id < 1
    || release.tag_name !== input.tag || release.target_commitish !== input.targetCommit
    || release.draft !== false || release.prerelease !== false || !Array.isArray(release.assets)
    || releaseKeys.some((key) => typeof key !== "string")) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_release_invalid");
  }
  const tagResponse = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_API_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${encodeURIComponent(input.tag)}`,
    Object.freeze({ method: "GET", redirect: "error", headers: fixedGithubHeaders(input.token) })
  );
  const tag = await readBoundedGithubJson(tagResponse, [200]);
  if (tag?.ref !== `refs/tags/${input.tag}` || tag?.object?.type !== "commit"
    || tag.object.sha !== input.targetCommit) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_release_target_invalid");
  }
  const assets = release.assets.map((asset) => {
    if (asset === null || typeof asset !== "object" || Array.isArray(asset)
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(asset.id) || asset.id < 1
      || typeof asset.name !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,180}$/.test(asset.name)
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(asset.size) || asset.size < 1 || asset.size > 536_870_912) {
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_release_invalid");
    }
    return Object.freeze({ id: asset.id, name: asset.name, size: asset.size });
  });
  return Object.freeze({
    id: release.id,
    tag_name: release.tag_name,
    target_commitish: release.target_commitish,
    assets: Object.freeze(assets)
  });
}

async function readBoundedGithubBytes(response, expectedSize) {
  if (response === null || typeof response !== "object" || response.status !== 200
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedSize) || expectedSize < 1 || expectedSize > 536_870_912
    || typeof response.body?.getReader !== "function") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
  }
  const contentType = (response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")
    .split(";", 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  if (contentType !== "application/octet-stream") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
  }
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    if (!(value instanceof Uint8Array)) {
      await reader.cancel();
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
    }
    size += value.byteLength;
    if (size > expectedSize) {
      await reader.cancel();
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
    }
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(value));
  }
  if (size !== expectedSize) throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
  return Buffer.concat(chunks, size);
}

async function readBackAssetDigest(input) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.assetId) || input.assetId < 1) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
  }
  const response = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_API_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/assets/${input.assetId}`,
    Object.freeze({ method: "GET", redirect: "error", headers: fixedGithubHeaders(input.token) })
  );
  const asset = await readBoundedGithubJson(response, [200]);
  if (asset?.id !== input.assetId || asset?.name !== input.assetName
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(asset?.size) || asset.size < 1 || asset.size > 536_870_912
    || (asset.digest !== undefined
      && (typeof asset.digest !== "string" || !/^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(asset.digest)))) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
  }
  const download = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_API_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/assets/${input.assetId}`,
    Object.freeze({
      method: "GET",
      redirect: "manual",
      headers: fixedGithubHeaders(input.token, "application/octet-stream")
    })
  );
  let bodyResponse = download;
  if (download.status === 302) {
    let location;
    try { location = new URL(download.headers.get("location")); } catch {
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_redirect_invalid");
    }
    if (location.protocol !== "https:" || location.username !== "" || location.password !== ""
      || location.port !== "" || location.hash !== ""
      || !GITHUB_RELEASE_ASSET_REDIRECT_HOSTS.has(location.hostname)) {
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_redirect_invalid");
    }
    bodyResponse = await input.fetchFn(location.href, Object.freeze({
      method: "GET",
      redirect: "error",
      headers: Object.freeze({ accept: "application/octet-stream" })
    }));
  }
  const digest = sha256Hex(await readBoundedGithubBytes(bodyResponse, asset.size));
  if (asset.digest !== undefined && asset.digest !== `sha256:${digest}`) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_invalid");
  }
  return digest;
}

async function readExactAttestationBundles(input) {
  if (input.digest !== `sha256:${input.sha256}`) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_invalid");
  }
  const response = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_API_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/attestations/${encodeURIComponent(input.digest)}`,
    Object.freeze({ method: "GET", redirect: "error", headers: fixedGithubHeaders(input.token) })
  );
  if (response.status === 404) return Object.freeze([]);
  const value = await readBoundedGithubJson(response, [200]);
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
    || !Array.isArray(value.attestations) || value.attestations.length > 32) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_invalid");
  }
  const bundles = value.attestations.map((entry) => {
    if (entry === null || typeof entry !== "object" || Array.isArray(entry)
      || entry.bundle === null || typeof entry.bundle !== "object" || Array.isArray(entry.bundle)) {
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_invalid");
    }
    const bytes = canonicalizeGitHubAttestationBundleTransport(entry.bundle);
    if (bytes.length < 2 || bytes.length > 262_144) {
      throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_invalid");
    }
    return bytes;
  });
  return Object.freeze(bundles);
}

async function createExactRelease(input) {
  if (input.name !== input.tag || input.draft !== false || input.prerelease !== false) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_release_write_invalid");
  }
  const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
    tag_name: input.tag,
    target_commitish: input.targetCommit,
    name: input.tag,
    draft: false,
    prerelease: false
  }), "utf8");
  const response = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_API_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases`,
    Object.freeze({
      method: "POST",
      redirect: "error",
      headers: Object.freeze({ ...fixedGithubHeaders(input.token), "content-type": "application/json" }),
      body
    })
  );
  const release = await readBoundedGithubJson(response, [201]);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(release?.id) || release.id < 1
    || release.tag_name !== input.tag || release.target_commitish !== input.targetCommit
    || release.draft !== false || release.prerelease !== false) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_release_write_invalid");
  }
}

async function uploadReleaseAsset(input) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.releaseId) || input.releaseId < 1
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.bytes) || input.bytes.length < 1
    || input.bytes.length > 536_870_912 || sha256Hex(input.bytes) !== input.sha256) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_write_invalid");
  }
  const response = await input.fetchFn(
    `${GITHUB_UPLOAD_ORIGIN}/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/${input.releaseId}/assets?name=${encodeURIComponent(input.assetName)}`,
    Object.freeze({
      method: "POST",
      redirect: "error",
      headers: Object.freeze({ ...fixedGithubHeaders(input.token, "application/vnd.github+json"), "content-type": "application/octet-stream" }),
      body: Buffer.from(input.bytes)
    })
  );
  const asset = await readBoundedGithubJson(response, [201]);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(asset?.id) || asset.id < 1 || asset.name !== input.assetName
    || asset.size !== input.bytes.length
    || (asset.digest !== undefined && asset.digest !== `sha256:${input.sha256}`)) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_asset_write_invalid");
  }
}

function assertFullSigstorePublicationOwnerAvailable() {
  // Replaced only by a separately approved owner that returns an unforgeable
  // full-Sigstore success brand; no caller or test injection is accepted.
  throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
}

export async function inspectImmutableAssetAttestationPair(input) {
  validateInput(input);
  assertFullSigstorePublicationOwnerAvailable();
  const release = await readExactReleaseByTag(input);
  if (release !== null && release.target_commitish !== input.targetCommit) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "conflict", releaseId: release.id, assetId: null, assetMatches: false, attestationMatches: false });
  }
  const assets = release?.assets.filter(({ name }) => name === input.assetName) ?? [];
  if (assets.length > 1) return Object.freeze({ state: "conflict", releaseId: release.id, assetId: null, assetMatches: false, attestationMatches: false });
  const assetMatches = assets.length === 1 && await readBackAssetDigest({ ...input, assetId: assets[0].id }) === input.sha256;
  const bundles = await readExactAttestationBundles({ ...input, digest: `sha256:${input.sha256}` });
  // Dormant future design only: construction is deliberately after the
  // unconditional owner STOP so importing this module never reads trust files.
  const trackedAttestationVerifier = createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier({
    clock: Object.freeze({ now: () => new Date() })
  });
  const verifiedBundles = bundles.filter((bundleBytes) => {
    try {
      trackedAttestationVerifier.verify({
        bundleBytes,
        expected: {
          subjectName: input.assetName,
          subjectSha256: input.sha256,
          sourceCommit: input.attestationIdentity.sourceCommit,
          workflowPath: input.attestationIdentity.workflowPath,
          workflowRef: input.attestationIdentity.workflowRef,
          workflowSha: input.attestationIdentity.workflowSha,
          predicateType: input.attestationIdentity.predicateType,
          predicateBindings: input.predicateBindings
        }
      });
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
  const attestationMatches = verifiedBundles.length === 1;
  if (bundles.length !== verifiedBundles.length || verifiedBundles.length > 1) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "conflict", releaseId: release?.id ?? null, assetId: assets[0]?.id ?? null, assetMatches, attestationMatches: false });
  }
  const conflictingAsset = assets.length === 1 && !assetMatches;
  const state = conflictingAsset ? "conflict"
    : assetMatches && attestationMatches ? "complete"
      : assetMatches ? "asset_only"
        : attestationMatches ? "attestation_only"
          : "none";
  return Object.freeze({ state, releaseId: release?.id ?? null, assetId: assets[0]?.id ?? null, assetMatches, attestationMatches });
}
```

```js
function noEffectHarness() {
  const counts = { githubReads: 0, attestationCreates: 0 };
  return Object.freeze({
    counts,
    fetchFn: async () => {
      counts.githubReads += 1;
      throw new Error("unexpected_github_io");
    },
    attestFn: async () => {
      counts.attestationCreates += 1;
      throw new Error("unexpected_attestation_io");
    }
  });
}

test("all apparent remote states and all three surfaces stop with zero effects", async () => {
  for (const apparentState of ["none", "asset_only", "attestation_only", "complete", "conflict"]) {
    for (const operation of ["inspect", "write", "pair"]) {
      const harness = noEffectHarness();
      const input = operation === "inspect"
        ? { ...identity, fetchFn: harness.fetchFn }
        : operation === "write"
          ? { ...identity, bytes: Buffer.from(immutableBytes), fetchFn: harness.fetchFn }
          : { ...identity, bytes: Buffer.from(immutableBytes), fetchFn: harness.fetchFn, attestFn: harness.attestFn };
      const fn = operation === "inspect"
        ? inspectImmutableAssetAttestationPair
        : operation === "write"
          ? writeMissingImmutableAsset
          : publishImmutableAssetAttestationPair;
      await assert.rejects(
        () => fn(input),
        new RegExp(`github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable(?:.*${apparentState})?`)
      );
      assert.deepEqual(harness.counts, { githubReads: 0, attestationCreates: 0 });
    }
  }
});

test("missing-asset primitive rejects every non-exact input shape before the STOP", async () => {
  const validInput = (fetchFn) => ({ ...identity, bytes: Buffer.from(immutableBytes), fetchFn });
  for (const mutate of [
    (input) => ({ ...input, attestFn: async () => {} }),
    (input) => {
      const { token: omitted, ...rest } = input;
      return rest;
    },
    (input) => Object.assign(Object.create(null), input),
    (input) => {
      Object.defineProperty(input, Symbol("extra"), { value: true, enumerable: true });
      return input;
    },
    (input) => {
      Object.defineProperty(input, "token", { get: () => "token", enumerable: true });
      return input;
    }
  ]) {
    const harness = noEffectHarness();
    await assert.rejects(
      () => writeMissingImmutableAsset(mutate(validInput(harness.fetchFn))),
      /immutable_publication_write_input_invalid/
    );
    assert.deepEqual(harness.counts, { githubReads: 0, attestationCreates: 0 });
  }
});

test("noncanonical bytes and tag or identity drift reject locally with zero effects", async () => {
  for (const input of [
    {
      ...identity,
      bytes: Buffer.concat([immutableBytes, Buffer.from("\n")])
    },
    {
      ...identity,
      tag: identity.tag.replace(identity.targetCommit, "f".repeat(40)),
      bytes: Buffer.from(immutableBytes)
    },
    {
      ...identity,
      attestationIdentity: { ...identity.attestationIdentity },
      bytes: Buffer.from(immutableBytes)
    }
  ]) {
    const harness = noEffectHarness();
    await assert.rejects(
      () => writeMissingImmutableAsset({ ...input, fetchFn: harness.fetchFn }),
      /immutable_publication_(?:bytes|tag_family|attestation_identity)_invalid/
    );
    assert.deepEqual(harness.counts, { githubReads: 0, attestationCreates: 0 });
  }
});
```

```js
const WRITE_MISSING_IMMUTABLE_ASSET_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "repository", "tag", "targetCommit", "assetName", "bytes", "sha256",
  "attestationIdentity", "predicateBindings", "token", "fetchFn"
]);

function validateWriteMissingImmutableAssetInput(input) {

  if (input === null || typeof input !== "object"
    || Object.getPrototypeOf(input) !== Object.prototype
    || keys.length !== WRITE_MISSING_IMMUTABLE_ASSET_FIELDS.length
    || WRITE_MISSING_IMMUTABLE_ASSET_FIELDS.some((field) => !Object.hasOwn(input, field))
    || keys.some((key) => typeof key !== "string"
      || !WRITE_MISSING_IMMUTABLE_ASSET_FIELDS.includes(key))
    || keys.some((key) => {

        || !Object.hasOwn(descriptor, "value") || descriptor.get !== undefined

    || typeof input.fetchFn !== "function") {

function immutableAssetInspectionInput(input) {

    repository: input.repository,
    tag: input.tag,
    targetCommit: input.targetCommit,

function immutableAssetWriteInput(input) {

    tag: input.tag,
    targetCommit: input.targetCommit,
    assetName: input.assetName,
    bytes: input.bytes,
```
