```js
export async function writeMissingImmutableAsset(input) {
  validateWriteMissingImmutableAssetInput(input);
  const inspectionInput = immutableAssetInspectionInput(input);
  let inspected = await inspectImmutableAssetAttestationPair(inspectionInput);
  if (inspected.state === "conflict") throw new Error("immutable_publication_conflict");

  if (inspected.state === "none" || inspected.state === "attestation_only") {
    if (inspected.releaseId === null) {
      try {
        await createExactRelease({
          ...inspectionInput,
          name: input.tag,
          draft: false,
          prerelease: false
        });
      } catch {
        // A failed response is ambiguous; only tracked inspection may classify the result.
      }
      inspected = await inspectImmutableAssetAttestationPair(inspectionInput);
      if (inspected.state === "conflict") throw new Error("immutable_publication_conflict");
    }
    if (inspected.state === "none" || inspected.state === "attestation_only") {
      if (inspected.releaseId === null) throw new Error("immutable_publication_release_invalid");
      try {
        await uploadReleaseAsset({
          ...inspectionInput,
          bytes: input.bytes,
          releaseId: inspected.releaseId
        });
      } catch {
        // Lost upload responses converge only through the final tracked inspection below.
      }
    }
  }

  const finalInspection = await inspectImmutableAssetAttestationPair(inspectionInput);
  if (finalInspection.state === "conflict") throw new Error("immutable_publication_conflict");
  if (finalInspection.state !== "asset_only" && finalInspection.state !== "complete") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_readback_failed");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    state: finalInspection.state,
    releaseId: finalInspection.releaseId,
    assetId: finalInspection.assetId,
    sha256: input.sha256
  });
}

export async function publishImmutableAssetAttestationPair(input) {
  validateInput(input);
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(input.bytes) || sha256Hex(input.bytes) !== input.sha256) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_bytes_invalid");
  }
  if (typeof input.attestFn !== "function") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_attestation_writer_invalid");
  }
  const asset = await writeMissingImmutableAsset(immutableAssetWriteInput(input));
  if (asset.state === "asset_only") {
    try {
      await input.attestFn({
        subjectName: input.assetName,
        subjectDigest: { sha256: input.sha256 },
        repository: input.repository,
        targetCommit: input.targetCommit,
        attestationIdentity: input.attestationIdentity,
        predicateBindings: input.predicateBindings
      });
    } catch {
      // Lost attestation responses converge only through tracked inspection.
    }
  }
  const inspected = await inspectImmutableAssetAttestationPair(
    immutableAssetInspectionInput(input)
  );
  if (inspected.state !== "complete") throw new Error("immutable_publication_readback_failed");
  return Object.freeze({ state: "complete", releaseId: inspected.releaseId, assetId: inspected.assetId, sha256: input.sha256 });
}

function readFixedRecoveryPublicationInput({ fs, root, token, fetchFn }) {
  if (fs === null || typeof fs !== "object" || typeof root !== "string"
    || typeof token !== "string" || token.length < 1 || token.length > 4_096
    || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/u.test(token) || typeof fetchFn !== "function") {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_input_invalid");
  }
  const canonicalRoot = fs.realpathSync(root);
  if (canonicalRoot !== root || fs.lstatSync(root).isSymbolicLink()
    || !fs.lstatSync(root).isDirectory()
    || JSON.stringify(fs.readdirSync(root).sort())
      !== JSON.stringify(["publication-input.json", "subject.bin"])) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_input_invalid");
  }
  const metadataPath = `${root}/publication-input.json`;
  const subjectPath = `${root}/subject.bin`;
  const metadataStat = fs.lstatSync(metadataPath);
  const subjectStat = fs.lstatSync(subjectPath);
  if (!metadataStat.isFile() || metadataStat.isSymbolicLink()
    || metadataStat.size < 1 || metadataStat.size > 65_536
    || !subjectStat.isFile() || subjectStat.isSymbolicLink()
    || subjectStat.size < 1 || subjectStat.size > 262_144) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_input_invalid");
  }
  const metadataBytes = fs.readFileSync(metadataPath);
  let value;
  try { value = JSON.parse(metadataBytes.toString("utf8")); } catch {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_input_invalid");
  }
  const keys = [
    "repository", "tag", "targetCommit", "assetName", "sha256",
    "attestationIdentity", "predicateBindings", "subjectSize"
  ];
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
    || Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Object.prototype
    || Reflect.ownKeys(value).join("\n") !== keys.join("\n")
    || !Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8").equals(metadataBytes)
    || value.repository !== REPOSITORY || value.subjectSize !== subjectStat.size) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_input_invalid");
  }
  const bytes = fs.readFileSync(subjectPath);
  if (bytes.length !== value.subjectSize || sha256Hex(bytes) !== value.sha256) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_input_invalid");
  }
  const input = Object.freeze({
    repository: value.repository,
    tag: value.tag,
    targetCommit: value.targetCommit,
    assetName: value.assetName,
    bytes: Buffer.from(bytes),
    sha256: value.sha256,
    attestationIdentity: Object.freeze(value.attestationIdentity),
    predicateBindings: Object.freeze(value.predicateBindings),
    token,
    fetchFn
  });
  validateWriteMissingImmutableAssetInput(input);
  return input;
}

function writeFixedRecoveryAttestationInputs({ fs, root, input, result }) {
  if (typeof root !== "string" || root.length < 1
    || !["asset_only", "complete"].includes(result?.state)) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_output_invalid");
  }
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { mode: 0o700 });
  if (fs.realpathSync(root) !== root || fs.readdirSync(root).length !== 0) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_output_invalid");
  }
  const subjectPath = `${root}/subject.bin`;
  const predicatePath = `${root}/predicate.json`;
  const predicateBytes = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(input.predicateBindings), "utf8");
  fs.writeFileSync(subjectPath, input.bytes, { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 });
  fs.writeFileSync(predicatePath, predicateBytes, { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 });
  if (!fs.readFileSync(subjectPath).equals(input.bytes)
    || !fs.readFileSync(predicatePath).equals(predicateBytes)) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_output_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ subjectPath, predicatePath });
}

function renderFixedRecoveryPublisherInlineClosure() {
  const bytes = Buffer.from([
    '"use strict";',
    'async function prepareRecoveredCloseoutPublicationInline(){throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");}',
    'async function readBackRecoveredCloseoutPublicationInline(){throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");}',
    ''
  ].join("\n"), "utf8");
  if (bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > 4_096
    || !bytes.toString("utf8").endsWith("\n")
    || /\b(?:import|require|eval|Function|process|fetch|child_process)\b/.test(bytes.toString("utf8"))) {
    throw new Error("immutable_publication_inline_control_invalid");
  }
  return bytes;
}

export function createRecoveryImmutablePublisherInlineBytes() {
  return Buffer.from(renderFixedRecoveryPublisherInlineClosure());
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6a: Add the Task 7-owned recovery inline authority extension from the now-available generic publisher**

This step extends `control-plane-github-evidence.mjs`. Task 6 remains the sole
owner of the base `RECOVERY_WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_INLINE_CONTROL_CONTRACT` and
`parseValidateAndRefreshArtifactPublicationApprovalProof`; Task 7 Step 6a is
the sole owner of `RECOVERY_WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_INLINE_CONTROL_SHA256`, the
zero-argument `createRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineFixture()`, its exact
11-key return value, and all authority/prepare/postverify body and rendered-step
bytes and hashes. The committed Receipt workflow's YAML inline wrappers embed
the returned Task 7 bytes and never import either source module at runtime.
Receipt repository recovery code uniquely static-imports the Task 6 base
contract for local canonical validation but never imports or calls the Task 6
token/fetch live-refresh parser.

```js
import { createRecoveryImmutablePublisherInlineBytes } from "./github-immutable-release-publisher.mjs";

async function runRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineControl({
  github, context, core, env, crypto, expectedProof = null
}) {
  const fail = () => { throw new Error("recovery_workflow_authority_invalid"); };
  const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
  const environment = env.RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_ENVIRONMENT;
  const workflowPath = ".github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml";
  const workflowRef = `${repository}/${workflowPath}@refs/heads/master`;
  const sha = (bytes) => crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
  const canonical = (value) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8");
  const exact = (value, keys) => {
    if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
      || Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Object.prototype
      || Reflect.ownKeys(value).join("\n") !== keys.join("\n")) fail();
  };
  const decodeProof = (base64, digest) => {
    if (typeof base64 !== "string" || base64.length < 4 || base64.length > 24_576
      || !/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(base64)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(digest)) fail();
    const bytes = Buffer.from(base64, "base64");
    if (bytes.toString("base64") !== base64 || sha(bytes) !== digest
      || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > 16_384) fail();
    let value;
    try { value = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8")); } catch { fail(); }
    const keys = [
      "schema", "repository", "eventName", "environment", "workflowPath",
      "workflowRef", "workflowSha", "sourceRef", "sourceSha", "runId",
      "runAttempt", "runnerEnvironment", "actorIdentitySha256",
      "triggeringActorIdentitySha256", "reviewerIdentitySha256",
      "environmentPolicySha256", "approvalHistorySha256", "preflightSha256",
      "createdAt", "expiresAt"
    ];
    exact(value, keys);
    if (!canonical(value).equals(bytes)) fail();
    return Object.freeze({ value: Object.freeze(value), bytes, sha256: digest });
  };
  const supplied = expectedProof === null ? null
    : decodeProof(expectedProof.base64, expectedProof.sha256);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(context.runAttempt)) || Number(context.runAttempt) < 1
    || context.eventName !== "workflow_dispatch" || context.ref !== "refs/heads/master"
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(context.sha)
    || env.RECOVERY_REPOSITORY !== repository
    || env.RECOVERY_ACTOR !== String(context.actor)
    || env.RECOVERY_TRIGGERING_ACTOR !== String(env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR)
    || env.RECOVERY_RUN_ID !== String(context.runId)
    || env.RECOVERY_RUN_ATTEMPT !== String(context.runAttempt)
    || env.RECOVERY_REF !== context.ref || env.RECOVERY_SHA !== context.sha
    || !["vultr-japan-production", "artifact-publication"].includes(environment)) fail();
  const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
  const api = (route, parameters = {}) => github.request(route, { owner, repo, ...parameters });
  const projectPolicy = (raw) => {
    const required = raw?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
    if (raw?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
      || raw?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
      || raw?.can_admins_bypass !== false || required?.length !== 1
      || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true || !Array.isArray(required[0].reviewers)
      || required[0].reviewers.length < 1) fail();
    const reviewers = required[0].reviewers.map((row) => {
      if (row.type !== "User" || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id)
        || row.reviewer.id < 1 || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer?.login)) fail();
      return Object.freeze({
        type: "user", id: String(row.reviewer.id),
        login: row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase(), slug: null
      });
    }).sort((left, right) => `${left.id}:${left.login}`.localeCompare(`${right.id}:${right.login}`, "en"));
    if (new Set(reviewers.map(({ id, login }) => `${id}:${login}`)).size !== reviewers.length) fail();
    return Object.freeze({
      environment, preventSelfReview: true, protectedBranches: true,
      customBranchPolicies: false, adminBypassAllowed: false,
      reviewers: Object.freeze(reviewers)
    });
  };
  const firstPolicyResponse = await api(
    "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}",
    { environment_name: environment }
  );
  const firstPolicy = projectPolicy(firstPolicyResponse.data);
  const run = (await api(
    "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt_number}",
    { run_id: context.runId, attempt_number: context.runAttempt }
  )).data;
  const master = (await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/master")).data;
  const approvalsResponse = await api(
    "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals",
    { run_id: context.runId }
  );
  const approvals = (Array.isArray(approvalsResponse.data) ? approvalsResponse.data : [])
    .filter((row) => row.state === "approved")
    .map((row) => Object.freeze({
      login: String(row.user?.login ?? "").toLowerCase(),
      id: String(row.user?.id ?? ""),
      environments: Object.freeze((row.environments ?? []).map(({ name }) => name).sort())
    })).sort((left, right) => `${left.id}:${left.login}`.localeCompare(`${right.id}:${right.login}`, "en"));
  const matching = approvals.filter((row) =>
    row.environments.length === 1 && row.environments[0] === environment);
  if (String(run?.id) !== String(context.runId) || run?.run_attempt !== Number(context.runAttempt)
    || run?.event !== "workflow_dispatch" || run?.path !== workflowPath
    || run?.head_sha !== context.sha || run?.head_branch !== "master"
    || master?.object?.type !== "commit" || master.object.sha !== context.sha
    || matching.length !== 1 || !/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(matching[0].id)
    || matching[0].login === String(context.actor).toLowerCase()
    || matching[0].login === String(env.RECOVERY_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
  const user = (await api("GET /users/{username}", { username: matching[0].login })).data;
  if (String(user?.id) !== matching[0].id
    || String(user?.login ?? "").toLowerCase() !== matching[0].login
    || firstPolicy.reviewers.filter((row) =>
      row.id === matching[0].id && row.login === matching[0].login).length !== 1) fail();
  const secondPolicy = projectPolicy((await api(
    "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}",
    { environment_name: environment }
  )).data);
  const policyBytes = canonical(firstPolicy);
  if (!canonical(secondPolicy).equals(policyBytes)) fail();
  const approvalBytes = canonical(Object.freeze({ approvals: Object.freeze(approvals) }));
  const reviewerIdentitySha256 = sha(Buffer.from(
    `control-plane-expected-reviewer-approval-v1\0${matching[0].login}\0${matching[0].id}\0user\0${matching[0].id}\0${matching[0].login}\0`,
    "utf8"
  ));
  const stable = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_recovery_workflow_approval_proof_v1",
    repository, eventName: "workflow_dispatch", environment, workflowPath,
    workflowRef, workflowSha: context.sha, sourceRef: "refs/heads/master",
    sourceSha: context.sha, runId: String(context.runId), runAttempt: Number(context.runAttempt),
    runnerEnvironment: "github-hosted",
    actorIdentitySha256: sha(Buffer.from(String(context.actor).toLowerCase(), "utf8")),
    triggeringActorIdentitySha256: sha(Buffer.from(String(env.RECOVERY_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase(), "utf8")),
    reviewerIdentitySha256, environmentPolicySha256: sha(policyBytes),
    approvalHistorySha256: sha(approvalBytes),
    preflightSha256: environment === "vultr-japan-production" ? env.RECOVERY_PREFLIGHT_SHA256 : null
  });
  if (supplied !== null) {
    const created = Date.parse(supplied.value.createdAt);
    const expires = Date.parse(supplied.value.expiresAt);
    const stableKeys = Reflect.ownKeys(stable);
    if (!Number.isFinite(created) || !Number.isFinite(expires)
      || Date.now() < created || Date.now() >= expires || expires - created > 300_000
      || stableKeys.some((key) => supplied.value[key] !== stable[key])) fail();
    return supplied;
  }
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const value = Object.freeze({
    ...stable,
    createdAt,
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(createdAt) + 300_000).toISOString()
  });
  const bytes = canonical(value);
  const digest = sha(bytes);
  core.setOutput("approval_proof_base64", bytes.toString("base64"));
  core.setOutput("approval_proof_sha256", digest);
  return Object.freeze({ value, bytes, sha256: digest });
}

function renderRecoveryInlineStep({ authorityControlBytes, environment }) {
  const isRecovery = environment === "vultr-japan-production";
  const name = isRecovery
    ? "Authorize production recovery"
    : "Authorize recovered publication";
  const envLines = [
    `          RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_ENVIRONMENT: ${environment}`,
    "          RECOVERY_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}",
    "          RECOVERY_ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}",
    "          RECOVERY_TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}",
    "          RECOVERY_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}",
    "          RECOVERY_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}",
    "          RECOVERY_REF: ${{ github.ref }}",
    "          RECOVERY_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}"
  ];
  if (isRecovery) {
    envLines.push("          RECOVERY_PREFLIGHT_SHA256: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.preflight_sha256 }}");
  }
  const body = [
    `      - name: ${name}`,
    "        id: authority",
    "        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea",
    "        env:",
    ...envLines,
    "        with:",
    "          github-token: ${{ github.token }}",
    "          script: |",
    "            const crypto = require(\"node:crypto\");",
    ...authorityControlBytes.toString("utf8").trimEnd().split("\n").map((line) => `            ${line}`),
    "            await runRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineControl({ github, context, core, env: process.env, crypto });",
    ""
  ].filter((line) => line !== "").join("\n") + "\n";
  return Buffer.from(body, "utf8");
}

function renderRecoveryPrepareControl({ authorityControlBytes, verifierBytes, publisherBytes }) {
  return Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from('const crypto=require("node:crypto");\n', "utf8"),
    authorityControlBytes,
    verifierBytes,
    publisherBytes,
    Buffer.from([
      'const proof=Object.freeze({base64:process.env.RECOVERY_APPROVAL_PROOF_BASE64,sha256:process.env.RECOVERY_APPROVAL_PROOF_SHA256});',
      'await runRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineControl({github,context,core,env:process.env,crypto,expectedProof:proof});',
      'await prepareRecoveredCloseoutPublicationInline();',
      ''
    ].join("\n"), "utf8")
  ]);
}

function renderRecoveryPostverifyControl({ verifierBytes, publisherBytes }) {
  return Buffer.concat([
    verifierBytes,
    publisherBytes,
    Buffer.from([
      'await readBackRecoveredCloseoutPublicationInline();',
      ''
    ].join("\n"), "utf8")
  ]);
}

const RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_CONTROL_TEMPLATE = Buffer.from(
  `${runRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineControl.toString()}\n`,
  "utf8"
);
export const RECOVERY_WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_INLINE_CONTROL_SHA256 =
  sha256Hex(RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_CONTROL_TEMPLATE);

export function createRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineFixture() {
  const authorityControlBytes = Buffer.from(RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_CONTROL_TEMPLATE);
  const verifierBytes = createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifierInlineBytes();
  const publisherBytes = createRecoveryImmutablePublisherInlineBytes();
  const publisherPrepareBytes = renderRecoveryPrepareControl({
    authorityControlBytes, verifierBytes, publisherBytes
  });
  const publisherPostverifyBytes = renderRecoveryPostverifyControl({
    verifierBytes, publisherBytes
  });
  const recoverAuthorityStepBytes = renderRecoveryInlineStep({
    authorityControlBytes, environment: "vultr-japan-production"
  });
  const publishAuthorityStepBytes = renderRecoveryInlineStep({
    authorityControlBytes, environment: "artifact-publication"
  });
  return Object.freeze({
    contract: RECOVERY_WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_INLINE_CONTROL_CONTRACT,
    authorityControlBytes: Buffer.from(authorityControlBytes),
    authorityControlSha256: sha256Hex(authorityControlBytes),
    publisherPrepareBytes: Buffer.from(publisherPrepareBytes),
    publisherPrepareSha256: sha256Hex(publisherPrepareBytes),
    publisherPostverifyBytes: Buffer.from(publisherPostverifyBytes),
    publisherPostverifySha256: sha256Hex(publisherPostverifyBytes),
    recoverAuthorityStepBytes: Buffer.from(recoverAuthorityStepBytes),
    recoverAuthorityStepSha256: sha256Hex(recoverAuthorityStepBytes),
    publishAuthorityStepBytes: Buffer.from(publishAuthorityStepBytes),
    publishAuthorityStepSha256: sha256Hex(publishAuthorityStepBytes)
  });
}
```

The previously reviewed `readFixedRecoveryPublicationInput` and
`writeFixedRecoveryAttestationInputs` algorithms are dormant future-only notes;
`createRecoveryImmutablePublisherInlineBytes` emits only the two one-line
`github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable` entrypoints and does not emit either
helper in this revision. The complete prepare fixture still embeds and executes
the separately owned authority control, so its bounded policy/run/master/
approval/user reads remain expected. After that read-only authority boundary,
the publisher stop occurs before any publication-input directory read,
subject/predicate materialization, publication fetch adapter, Release/redirect
operation, filesystem write, attestation input, or completion output; postverify
stops at the same publication boundary. Tests execute those exact bytes and
require zero publication/input/filesystem read or write and zero completion
output, not zero approval-authority reads. Restoring the dormant helpers, route
allowlist, explicit publication token consumers, or attestation inputs requires
the separately approved full-Sigstore owner supplement and new executable
tests; none is implied by the current hard-stop fixture.

```js
function recoveryAuthorityFixture({ sourceCommit = "a".repeat(40), fault = null } = {}) {

        policyReads += 1;
        return { data: fault === "policy_between_reads" && policyReads === 2
          ? { ...policy, can_admins_bypass: true } : policy };
      }
      if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt_number}") {
        return { data: {
          id: context.runId, run_attempt: context.runAttempt, event: "workflow_dispatch",
          path: ".github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml",
          head_sha: sourceCommit, head_branch: "master"
        } };
      }
      if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/master") {
        return { data: { object: { type: "commit", sha: fault === "master" ? "b".repeat(40) : sourceCommit } } };
      }
      if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals") {
        return { data: approvals };
      }
      if (route === "GET /users/{username}") {
        return { data: {
          id: fault === "reviewer_replacement" ? 99 : 41,
          login: fault === "reviewer_replacement" ? "replacement" : "release-reviewer"
        } };
      }
      throw new Error("recovery_authority_unlisted_route");
    }
  });
  return {
    github,
    context,
    core: Object.freeze({ setOutput(name, value) { outputs.set(name, value); } }),
    env,
    crypto: Object.freeze({ createHash }),
    outputs,
    policy,
    approvals,
    get policyReads() { return policyReads; }
  };
}

async function executeRecoveryAuthorityBody(bytes, fixture) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1) throw new Error("recovery_authority_test_invalid");
  const sandbox = createContext({
    Buffer, Date, Object, Reflect, structuredClone,
    github: fixture.github, context: fixture.context, core: fixture.core,
    env: fixture.env, crypto: fixture.crypto
  }, { codeGeneration: { strings: false, wasm: false } });
  return new Script(`(async()=>{${bytes.toString("utf8")}\nreturn runRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineControl({github,context,core,env,crypto});})()`, {
    filename: "recovery-workflow-authority-inline.cjs"
  }).runInContext(sandbox, { timeout: 2_000 });
}

function recoveryHardStopInputFixture() {
  const requests = [];
  const fetch = async (rawUrl) => {
    requests.push(String(rawUrl));
    throw new Error("recovery_hard_stop_performed_io");
  };
  return {
    fetch,
    requests,
    authority: recoveryAuthorityFixture(),
    outputs: new Map(),
    cleanup() {}
  };
}

async function executeRecoveryPublisherBody(bytes, fixture) {
  const authorityBytes = createRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineFixture().authorityControlBytes;
  await executeRecoveryAuthorityBody(authorityBytes, fixture.authority);
  const env = Object.freeze({
    RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_ENVIRONMENT: "artifact-publication",
    RECOVERY_REPOSITORY: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    RECOVERY_ACTOR: fixture.authority.context.actor,
    RECOVERY_TRIGGERING_ACTOR: "recovery-trigger",
    RECOVERY_RUN_ID: String(fixture.authority.context.runId),
    RECOVERY_RUN_ATTEMPT: String(fixture.authority.context.runAttempt),
    RECOVERY_REF: fixture.authority.context.ref,
    RECOVERY_SHA: fixture.authority.context.sha,
    GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR: "recovery-trigger",
    RECOVERY_APPROVAL_PROOF_BASE64: fixture.authority.outputs.get("approval_proof_base64"),
    RECOVERY_APPROVAL_PROOF_SHA256: fixture.authority.outputs.get("approval_proof_sha256"),
    GITHUB_TOKEN: "test-token"
  });
  const exactRequire = (specifier) => {
    if (specifier === "node:crypto") return nodeCrypto;
    throw new Error("recovery_publisher_unlisted_require");
  };
  const sandbox = createContext({
    Buffer, Date, URL, Uint8Array, require: exactRequire,
    github: fixture.authority.github, context: fixture.authority.context,
    core: Object.freeze({ setOutput(name, value) { fixture.outputs.set(name, value); } }),
    process: Object.freeze({ env }), fetch: fixture.fetch
  }, { codeGeneration: { strings: false, wasm: false } });
  try {
    return await new Script(`(async()=>{${bytes.toString("utf8")}})()`, {
      filename: "recovery-publisher-inline.cjs"
    }).runInContext(sandbox, { timeout: 5_000 });
  } finally {
    fixture.cleanup();
  }
}

async function executeRecoveryPrepareBody(bytes, fixture) {
  return executeRecoveryPublisherBody(bytes, fixture);
}

async function executeRecoveryPostverifyBody(bytes, fixture) {
  return executeRecoveryPublisherBody(bytes, fixture);
}

async function recoveryApprovalProofFixture({ fault }) {
  const authority = recoveryAuthorityFixture();
  await executeRecoveryAuthorityBody(
    createRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineFixture().authorityControlBytes,
    authority
  );
  const proofBase64 = authority.outputs.get("approval_proof_base64");
  const proofBytes = Buffer.from(proofBase64, "base64");
  const proof = JSON.parse(proofBytes.toString("utf8"));
  const structuralFaults = new Set([
    "missing_half", "noncanonical_base64", "oversize", "digest", "duplicate_key", "unknown_key"
  ]);
  const proofFieldFaults = Object.freeze({
    expired: ["createdAt", new Date(Date.now() - 600_000).toISOString()],
    future: ["createdAt", new Date(Date.now() + 600_000).toISOString()],
    repository: ["repository", "other/repository"], event: ["eventName", "push"],
    workflow_path: ["workflowPath", ".github/workflows/other.yml"],
    workflow_ref: ["workflowRef", "other/ref"], workflow_sha: ["workflowSha", "b".repeat(40)],
    source_ref: ["sourceRef", "refs/heads/staging"], source_sha: ["sourceSha", "b".repeat(40)],
    run_id: ["runId", "9002"], run_attempt: ["runAttempt", 2],
    runner: ["runnerEnvironment", "self-hosted"], preflight: ["preflightSha256", "1".repeat(64)]
  });
  if (fault === "expired") proof.expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() - 1_000).toISOString();
  else if (Object.hasOwn(proofFieldFaults, fault)) proof[proofFieldFaults[fault][0]] = proofFieldFaults[fault][1];
  let bytes = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(proof), "utf8");
  if (fault === "duplicate_key") bytes = Buffer.from(`{"schema":"duplicate",${bytes.toString("utf8").slice(1)}`, "utf8");
  if (fault === "unknown_key") bytes = Buffer.from(`${bytes.toString("utf8").slice(0, -1)},"unknown":true}`, "utf8");
  if (fault === "oversize") bytes = Buffer.alloc(17_000, 0x61);
  let approvalProofBase64 = bytes.toString("base64");
  let approvalProofSha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
  if (fault === "noncanonical_base64") approvalProofBase64 = `${approvalProofBase64.slice(0, -2)}==`;
  if (fault === "digest") approvalProofSha256 = "f".repeat(64);
  const bindings = {
    recoveryWorkflowPath: ".github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml",
    recoveryWorkflowRef: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal/.github/workflows/control-plane-receipt-recovery.yml@refs/heads/master",
    recoveryWorkflowSha: authority.context.sha,
    recoverySourceRef: "refs/heads/master",
    recoverySourceCommit: authority.context.sha,
    recoveryRunId: String(authority.context.runId),
    recoveryRunAttempt: authority.context.runAttempt,
    recoveryActor: authority.context.actor,
    recoveryTriggeringActor: authority.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR,
    runnerEnvironment: "github-hosted",
    preflightSha256: null
  };
  let githubReads = 0;
  let policyReads = 0;
  const fetchFn = async (rawUrl) => {
    githubReads += 1;
    if (fault === "redirect") return new Response(null, { status: 302, headers: { location: "https://evil.invalid" } });
    const url = new URL(rawUrl);
    if (url.pathname.includes("/environments/")) {
      policyReads += 1;
      const value = structuredClone(authority.policy);
      if (fault === "policy_between_reads" && policyReads === 2) value.can_admins_bypass = true;
      if (fault === "admin_bypass") value.can_admins_bypass = true;
      if (fault === "team_reviewer") value.protection_rules[0].reviewers[0] = { type: "Team", reviewer: { id: 41, slug: "release-reviewers" } };
      if (fault === "unknown_reviewer") value.protection_rules[0].reviewers[0].type = "Robot";
      return fixedJsonResponse(value);
    }
    if (url.pathname.includes("/actions/runs/9001/attempts/1")) return fixedJsonResponse({
      id: 9001, run_attempt: 1, event: "workflow_dispatch",
      path: bindings.recoveryWorkflowPath, head_sha: bindings.recoverySourceCommit,
      head_branch: "master", actor: { login: bindings.recoveryActor },
      triggering_actor: { login: bindings.recoveryTriggeringActor }
    });
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/git/ref/heads/master")) return fixedJsonResponse({
      object: { type: "commit", sha: fault === "master" ? "b".repeat(40) : bindings.recoverySourceCommit }
    });
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/actions/runs/9001/approvals")) {
      const approvals = fault === "zero_approval" ? [] : structuredClone(authority.approvals);
      if (fault === "two_approvals") approvals.push(structuredClone(approvals[0]));
      if (fault === "self_review" && approvals[0]) approvals[0].user.login = bindings.recoveryActor;
      return fixedJsonResponse(approvals);
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/users/release-reviewer") return fixedJsonResponse({
      id: fault === "user_id" || fault === "reviewer_replacement" ? 99 : 41,
      login: fault === "reviewer_replacement" ? "replacement" : "release-reviewer"
    });
    throw new Error("recovery_approval_unlisted_route");
  };
  const input = {
    approvalProofBase64,
    approvalProofSha256,
    environment: "artifact-publication",
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    bindings,
    token: "test-token",
    fetchFn
  };
  if (fault === "missing_half") delete input.approvalProofSha256;
  return {
    input,
    structuralFault: structuralFaults.has(fault),
    get githubReads() { return githubReads; },
    releaseReads: 0,
    githubWrites: 0,
    subjectWrites: 0
  };
}

test("Task 7 Step 6a recovery fixture is exact, fresh, executable, and non-aliased", async () => {
  const first = createRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineFixture();
  const second = createRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineFixture();
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(first), [
    "contract", "authorityControlBytes", "authorityControlSha256",
    "publisherPrepareBytes", "publisherPrepareSha256",
    "publisherPostverifyBytes", "publisherPostverifySha256",
    "recoverAuthorityStepBytes", "recoverAuthorityStepSha256",
    "publishAuthorityStepBytes", "publishAuthorityStepSha256"
  ]);
  assert.equal(first.contract, RECOVERY_WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_INLINE_CONTROL_CONTRACT);
  assert.equal(first.authorityControlSha256, RECOVERY_WORKFLOW_AUTHORITY_INLINE_CONTROL_SHA256);
  for (const prefix of ["authorityControl", "publisherPrepare", "publisherPostverify",
    "recoverAuthorityStep", "publishAuthorityStep"]) {
    assert.equal(first[`${prefix}Sha256`], sha256Hex(first[`${prefix}Bytes`]));
    assert.notEqual(first[`${prefix}Bytes`], second[`${prefix}Bytes`]);
    assert.deepEqual(first[`${prefix}Bytes`], second[`${prefix}Bytes`]);
  }
  const recoverStep = first.recoverAuthorityStepBytes.toString("utf8");
  const publishStep = first.publishAuthorityStepBytes.toString("utf8");
  assert.match(recoverStep, /- name: Authorize production recovery/);
  assert.match(publishStep, /- name: Authorize recovered publication/);
  for (const source of [recoverStep, publishStep]) {
    for (const expression of [
      "${{ github.repository }}", "${{ github.actor }}", "${{ github.triggering_actor }}",
      "${{ github.run_id }}", "${{ github.run_attempt }}", "${{ github.ref }}", "${{ github.sha }}"
    ]) assert.equal(source.split(expression).length - 1, 1);
    assert.equal(source.split("await runRecoveryWorkflowAuthorityInlineControl(").length - 1, 1);
  }
  assert.equal(recoverStep.split("${{ needs.preflight.outputs.preflight_sha256 }}").length - 1, 1);
  assert.doesNotMatch(publishStep, /^          RECOVERY_PREFLIGHT_SHA256:/m);
  await executeRecoveryAuthorityBody(first.authorityControlBytes, recoveryAuthorityFixture());
  const prepareFixture = recoveryHardStopInputFixture();
  await assert.rejects(
    () => executeRecoveryPrepareBody(first.publisherPrepareBytes, prepareFixture),
    /github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable/
  );
  assert.equal(prepareFixture.requests.length, 0);
  await assert.rejects(
    () => executeRecoveryPostverifyBody(first.publisherPostverifyBytes, recoveryHardStopInputFixture()),
    /github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable/
  );
});
```

Recovery uses a dedicated local `recoveryHardStopInputFixture()` that contains no
production-trust bundle and no synthetic CA.  Both prepare and postverify execute the
reviewed stop bodies and prove zero Release reads, writes, subject materialization, and
completion outputs.  A later full-Sigstore supplement must bring its own independently
approved real archive corpus; this plan does not mutate or re-sign a valid bundle to
pretend that unrelated-entry, certificate-swap, or recovered-publication positives exist.

### Task 8: Closed publication envelope, no-secret preflight, and post-approval replay

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-publication-envelope.mjs`
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-production-preflight.mjs`
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-postapproval-check.mjs`
- Create: `schemas/control-plane-production-authorization-v1.schema.json`
- Create: `server/services/deployment/control-plane-production-authorization.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-publication-envelope.test.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-production-preflight.test.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-postapproval-check.test.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-production-authorization.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- `PUBLICATION_ASSET_ENTRY_CONTRACT` is the sole shared asset child descriptor. Distinct roots `NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT` and `COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT`, selected only through `resolvePublicationEnvelopeContract(publicationMode)`, bind `assetOrder` through a frozen primitive-string descriptor and `assets` through that child descriptor. `createPublicationEnvelope(input)` and `verifyPublicationEnvelope({ bytes, files, publicationMode })` bind the trusted mode, fixed Release tag, target commit, the exact four-field main-source identity, exact file identities, attestation subjects, and owner-derived last receipt name. Normal mode alone carries a non-null Production Gate digest and `production-gate-{digest}.json`; compatibility mode instead carries a non-null typed compatibility-publication digest and `compatibility-publication-{digest}.json`. The two root contracts, fields, tags, predicates, and file orders are mutually exclusive; parsing valid bytes under the other root fails before file comparison.
- `runProductionPreflight(...)` and `runPostApprovalCheck(...)` retain the reviewed future output shapes documented below, but in this revision neither can return `ready` or `valid`: both reach Task 6's fail-closed Release-evidence bridge and raise `github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable` before packet/authorization output, scope materialization, OIDC, production secret, SSH, or GitHub write. Their no-secret master/PR/policy/inventory checks may run read-only before that boundary; tests require no durable output.
- `finalizeProductionAuthorization(...)`, `buildProductionAuthorizationRecord(...)`, the exact schema, validator, and audience derivation remain pure source-contract algebra and may be unit-tested with explicit synthetic canonical inputs. No operational caller can obtain the required postapproval evidence in this plan revision, so these pure helpers confer no deploy authority.
- Both preflight modules explicitly import the fail-closed `createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier` compatibility surface and pass only its `verify` method to `verifyArtifactReleaseEvidence`. Neither imports predicate contracts or accepts a verifier/trust dependency. The compatibility surface always raises the owner-unavailable sentinel and returns no brand.
- Artifact is the sole owner of the final Bootstrap-consumed authorization schema. `PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_FIELDS`, `buildProductionAuthorizationRecord(input) -> { value, bytes, sha256 }`, `validateProductionAuthorizationRecord({ bytes, expected, now })`, and `deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience(authorizationRecordSha256)` are the unique surface. The helper returns exactly `gccgw-control-plane-deploy:<sha256>`; Bootstrap imports this helper and the validator directly and consumes the exact bytes without a mapper or second literal implementation.
- The exact ordered authorization fields are `schema`, `gateId`, `productionGateReceiptSha256`, `deploymentPlanSha256`, `inventoryReceiptSha256`, `inventoryExpiresAt`, `productionGateExpiresAt`, `effectivePlanExpiresAt`, `transactionId`, `repository`, `eventName`, `environment`, `workflowPath`, `workflowRef`, `workflowSha`, `sourceRef`, `sourceSha`, `runId`, `runAttempt`, `runnerEnvironment`, `reviewerIdentitySha256`, `approvalHistorySha256`, `bootstrapGeneration`, `bootstrapReceiptSha256`, `bootstrapStateSha256`, `authorizationBindingHmacSha256`, `authorizationGeneration`, `databaseContractsSha256`, `hostExecutionContractSha256`, `artifactSize`, `artifactSha256`, `createdAt`, `expiresAt`, `nonceSha256`. Unknown, missing, duplicate, renamed, reordered, or compatibility-alias fields are rejected.
- Both functions derive all Release/API routes from closed identities and never accept host, path, endpoint, secret, or arbitrary URL inputs.

```js
    /normal_publication_envelope_invalid/
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(compatibility.value, NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT),
    /normal_publication_envelope_invalid/
  );
  assert.doesNotThrow(() =>
    serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(compatibility.value, COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT));
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the closed publication envelope**

```js
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";

const PUBLICATION_STRING_ARRAY_DESCRIPTOR = Object.freeze({ elementType: "string" });
const PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_FIELD_ORDER = Object.freeze([
  "schemaVersion", "type", "repository", "publicationMode", "tag",
  "targetCommit", "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber",
  "mainSourceHeadSha", "mainSourceMergeCommitSha", "runtimeContractId", "inventoryReceiptSha256",
  "productionGateReceiptSha256", "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256",
  "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256", "assetOrder", "assets"
]);
const PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const PUBLICATION_SOURCE_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const PUBLICATION_RUNTIME_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:+-]{0,191}$/;
const PUBLICATION_ASSET_NAME_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,191}$/;

export const PUBLICATION_ASSET_ENTRY_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-publication-asset-entry-v1",
  maxBytes: 1_024,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["name", "sha256", "size"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (!PUBLICATION_ASSET_NAME_PATTERN.test(value.name ?? "")
      || !PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.sha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.size) || value.size < 1 || value.size > 268_435_456) {
      throw new Error("publication_asset_entry_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function createPublicationEnvelopeStructure() {
  return Object.freeze({
    nested: Object.freeze({
      [PUBLICATION_ASSET_ENTRY_CONTRACT.schemaId]: PUBLICATION_ASSET_ENTRY_CONTRACT
    }),
    arrays: Object.freeze({
      assetOrder: PUBLICATION_STRING_ARRAY_DESCRIPTOR,
      assets: PUBLICATION_ASSET_ENTRY_CONTRACT.schemaId
    })
  });
}

const NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE = createPublicationEnvelopeStructure();
const COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE = createPublicationEnvelopeStructure();

function validatePublicationEnvelopeRoot(value, expectedMode) {
  const expectedTag = expectedMode === "normal"
    ? `control-plane-app-${value.targetCommit}-${value.runtimeContractId}`
    : `control-plane-compatibility-${value.targetCommit}-${value.runtimeContractId}`;
  const commonValid = value.schemaVersion === "1"
    && value.type === "control_plane_publication_envelope"
    && value.repository === "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
    && value.publicationMode === expectedMode
    && PUBLICATION_SOURCE_PATTERN.test(value.targetCommit ?? "")
    && PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.mainSourceIdentitySha256 ?? "")
    && Number.isSafeInteger(value.mainSourcePrNumber) && value.mainSourcePrNumber > 0
    && PUBLICATION_SOURCE_PATTERN.test(value.mainSourceHeadSha ?? "")
    && PUBLICATION_SOURCE_PATTERN.test(value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha ?? "")
    && PUBLICATION_RUNTIME_PATTERN.test(value.runtimeContractId ?? "")
    && value.tag === expectedTag
    && PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.inventoryReceiptSha256 ?? "")
    && Array.isArray(value.assetOrder) && value.assetOrder.length === 7
    && Array.isArray(value.assets) && value.assets.length === 7;
  const receiptValid = expectedMode === "normal"
    ? PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.productionGateReceiptSha256 ?? "")
      && value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 === null
      && value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 === null
    : value.productionGateReceiptSha256 === null
      && PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 ?? "")
      && PUBLICATION_SHA256_PATTERN.test(value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 ?? "");
  if (!commonValid || !receiptValid) {
    throw new Error(`${expectedMode === "normal" ? "normal" : "compatibility"}_publication_envelope_invalid`);
  }
}

export const NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-normal-publication-envelope-v1",
  maxBytes: 65_536,
  fieldOrder: PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_FIELD_ORDER,
  nested: NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE.nested,
  arrays: NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE.arrays,
  validate(value) {
    validatePublicationEnvelopeRoot(value, "normal");
  }
});

export const COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-compatibility-publication-envelope-v1",
  maxBytes: 65_536,
  fieldOrder: PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_FIELD_ORDER,
  nested: COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE.nested,
  arrays: COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE.arrays,
  validate(value) {
    validatePublicationEnvelopeRoot(value, "compatibility_bootstrap");
  }
});

export function resolvePublicationEnvelopeContract(publicationMode) {
  if (publicationMode === "normal") return NORMAL_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT;
  if (publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap") {
    return COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT;
  }
  throw new Error("publication_envelope_mode_invalid");
}

export const PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER = Object.freeze([
  "control-plane-app.zip",
  "artifact.json",
  "writer-registry.json",
  "release-declaration.json",
  "release-assembly.json",
  "dependency-build-receipt.json"
]);

export function publicationFileOrder({
  publicationMode,
  productionGateReceiptSha256,
  compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
}) {
  const normal = publicationMode === "normal"
    && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(productionGateReceiptSha256 ?? "")
    && compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 === null;
  const compatibility = publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
    && productionGateReceiptSha256 === null
    && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 ?? "");
  if (!normal && !compatibility) throw new Error("publication_envelope_receipt_domain_invalid");
  const last = normal
    ? `production-gate-${productionGateReceiptSha256}.json`
    : `compatibility-publication-${compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256}.json`;
  return Object.freeze([...PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER, last]);
}

export function createPublicationEnvelope(input) {
  const contract = resolvePublicationEnvelopeContract(input.publicationMode);
  const expectedTag = input.publicationMode === "normal"
    ? `control-plane-app-${input.targetCommit}-${input.runtimeContractId}`
    : `control-plane-compatibility-${input.targetCommit}-${input.runtimeContractId}`;
  if (input.tag !== expectedTag) {
    throw new Error("publication_envelope_tag_invalid");
  }
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.inventoryReceiptSha256)
    || (input.publicationMode === "normal" && input.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 !== null)
    || (input.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
      && !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256))) {
    throw new Error("publication_envelope_receipt_binding_invalid");
  }
  const fileOrder = publicationFileOrder(input);
  const entries = fileOrder.map((name) => {
    const bytes = input.files.get(name);
    if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)) throw new Error("publication_envelope_file_missing");
    return Object.freeze({ name, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes), size: bytes.length });
  });
  const value = {
    schemaVersion: "1",
    type: "control_plane_publication_envelope",
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    publicationMode: input.publicationMode,
    tag: input.tag,
    targetCommit: input.targetCommit,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: input.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: input.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: input.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: input.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: input.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: input.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: input.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
    assetOrder: entries.map(({ name }) => name),
    assets: entries
  };
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, contract);
  return Object.freeze({ bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes), value });
}

export function verifyPublicationEnvelope({ bytes, files, publicationMode }) {
  const contract = resolvePublicationEnvelopeContract(publicationMode);
  const value = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, contract);
  const rebuilt = createPublicationEnvelope({
    publicationMode: value.publicationMode,
    tag: value.tag,
    targetCommit: value.targetCommit,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: value.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runtimeContractId: value.runtimeContractId,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: value.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: value.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
    files
  });
  if (!rebuilt.bytes.equals(bytes)) throw new Error("publication_envelope_mismatch");
  return value;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement no-secret preflight composition**

```js
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { resolveInventoryReceipt } from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-inventory-receipt.mjs";
import {
  MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH,
  resolveMainSourceIdentity
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";
import { canonicalizeDatabaseContracts } from "../server/services/deployment/database-contract.mjs";
import { createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier } from "../server/services/deployment/github-attestation-verifier.mjs";
import {
  DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT,
  computeDeploymentPlanTemplateSha256,
  materializeDeploymentPlan,
  validateDeploymentPlanMainSourceIdentity
} from "./control-plane-deployment-plan.mjs";
import {
  PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT,
  resolveProductionGateReceipt
} from "./control-plane-production-gate.mjs";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import {
  collectPreapprovalEvidence,
  readCurrentMaster,
  verifyArtifactReleaseEvidence
} from "./control-plane-github-evidence.mjs";

export async function runProductionPreflight(input) {
  if (input.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
    || input.runIdentity.runAttempt !== 1) {
    throw new Error("production_preflight_identity_invalid");
  }
  const initialMaster = await readCurrentMaster(input);
  if (initialMaster.sourceCommit !== input.runIdentity.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("production_preflight_github_master_drift");
  }
  const mainSourceIdentityBytes = await readFile(resolve(input.trustedCheckout, MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH));
  const mainSourceIdentity = await resolveMainSourceIdentity({
    bytes: mainSourceIdentityBytes,
    expectedSourceCommit: initialMaster.sourceCommit,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn
  });
  const gate = await resolveProductionGateReceipt({
    repository: input.repository,
    productionGateId: input.productionGateId,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn,
    now: input.now
  });
  const inventory = await resolveInventoryReceipt({
    repository: input.repository,
    inventoryGateId: gate.receipt.inventoryGateId,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn
  });
  if (gate.receipt.sourceCommit !== initialMaster.sourceCommit
    || inventory.sha256 !== gate.receipt.inventoryReceiptSha256
    || inventory.receipt.sourceCommit !== gate.receipt.sourceCommit
    || inventory.receipt.runtimeContractId !== gate.receipt.runtimeContractId
    || Date.parse(input.now) >= Date.parse(inventory.receipt.expiresAt)) {
    throw new Error("production_preflight_inventory_invalid");
  }
  for (const [field, expected] of Object.entries({
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: mainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  })) {
    if (gate.receipt[field] !== expected) throw new Error("production_preflight_main_source_identity_invalid");
  }
  const githubEvidence = await collectPreapprovalEvidence({
    ...input,
    expectedSourceCommit: gate.receipt.sourceCommit,
    requiredCheckContracts: inventory.receipt.requiredCheckContracts,
    environment: "vultr-japan-production"
  });
  const attestationVerifier = createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier({
    clock: Object.freeze({ now: () => new Date(input.now) })
  });
  const artifactEvidence = await verifyArtifactReleaseEvidence({
    ...input,
    gateReceipt: gate.receipt,
    validatedMainSourceIdentity: mainSourceIdentity,
    requiredDeploymentMode: "normal",
    requiredAttestationWorkflowPath: ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml",
    verifyAttestationBundle: attestationVerifier.verify
  });
  const confirmedMaster = await readCurrentMaster(input);
  if (confirmedMaster.sourceCommit !== gate.receipt.sourceCommit
    || confirmedMaster.sourceCommit !== input.runIdentity.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("production_preflight_github_master_drift");
  }
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(artifactEvidence.artifactBytes)
    || artifactEvidence.artifactBytes.length !== artifactEvidence.artifactSize
    || sha256Hex(artifactEvidence.artifactBytes) !== artifactEvidence.artifactSha256
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationBytes)
    || sha256Hex(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationBytes)
      !== artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || artifactEvidence.artifactSha256 !== gate.receipt.artifactSha256
    || artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody?.artifact?.sizeBytes
      !== artifactEvidence.artifactSize
    || artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody?.artifact?.sha256
      !== artifactEvidence.artifactSha256
    || artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody?.artifact?.releaseDeclarationSha256
      !== artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256 !== gate.receipt.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || computeDeploymentPlanTemplateSha256(artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody)
      !== gate.receipt.deploymentPlanTemplateSha256) {
    throw new Error("production_preflight_artifact_evidence_invalid");
  }
  const inventoryDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(inventory.receipt.databaseContracts);
  const releaseDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(
    artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationValue.databaseContracts
  );
  const stableBodyDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(
    artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody.databaseContracts
  );
  if (!inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(releaseDatabase.bytes)
    || !inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(stableBodyDatabase.bytes)) {
    throw new Error("production_preflight_database_contract_drift");
  }
  const plan = materializeDeploymentPlan({
    gateId: input.productionGateId,
    gateReceipt: { ...gate.receipt, productionGateReceiptSha256: gate.sha256 },
    stableBody: artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody,
    runContext: input.runIdentity,
    now: input.now
  });
  validateDeploymentPlanMainSourceIdentity({ plan: plan.plan, validatedMainSourceIdentity: mainSourceIdentity });
  return Object.freeze({
    ready: true,
    deploymentPlanBytes: plan.bytes,
    deploymentPlanSha256: plan.sha256,
    preapprovalEvidenceBytes: githubEvidence.bytes,
    preapprovalEvidenceSha256: githubEvidence.sha256,
    productionGateReceiptBytes: gate.bytes,
    transactionId: plan.plan.transactionId,
    controllerRecoveryId: plan.plan.controllerRecoveryId,
    sourceCommit: plan.plan.sourceCommit,
    artifactEvidence
  });
}
```

```json
    "workflowRef": { "const": "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal/.github/workflows/japan-control-plane-production-deploy.yml@refs/heads/master" },
    "workflowSha": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$" },

    "approvalHistorySha256": { "$ref": "#/$defs/sha256" },
    "bootstrapGeneration": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 },
```

```js
export const PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "schema", "gateId", "productionGateReceiptSha256", "deploymentPlanSha256",
  "inventoryReceiptSha256", "inventoryExpiresAt", "productionGateExpiresAt",
  "effectivePlanExpiresAt", "transactionId", "repository", "eventName",
  "environment", "workflowPath", "workflowRef", "workflowSha", "sourceRef",
  "sourceSha", "runId", "runAttempt", "runnerEnvironment",
  "reviewerIdentitySha256", "approvalHistorySha256", "bootstrapGeneration",
  "bootstrapReceiptSha256", "bootstrapStateSha256", "authorizationBindingHmacSha256",
  "authorizationGeneration", "databaseContractsSha256", "hostExecutionContractSha256",
  "artifactSize", "artifactSha256", "createdAt", "expiresAt", "nonceSha256"
]);

export const PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-production-authorization-v1",
  maxBytes: 32_768,
  fieldOrder: PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_FIELDS,
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    validateProductionAuthorizationSchema(value);
  }
});

export function buildProductionAuthorizationRecord(input) {
  const createdAt = canonicalTime(input.createdAt);
  const expiresAt = new Date(Math.min(
    Date.parse(input.inventoryExpiresAt),
    Date.parse(input.productionGateExpiresAt),
    Date.parse(input.effectivePlanExpiresAt),
    createdAt.getTime() + 300_000
  )).toISOString();
  if (Date.parse(expiresAt) <= createdAt.getTime()) throw new Error("production_authorization_invalid");
  const value = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_production_authorization_v1",
    gateId: input.gateId,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: input.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    deploymentPlanSha256: input.deploymentPlanSha256,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    inventoryExpiresAt: input.inventoryExpiresAt,
    productionGateExpiresAt: input.productionGateExpiresAt,
    effectivePlanExpiresAt: input.effectivePlanExpiresAt,
    transactionId: input.transactionId,
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    eventName: "workflow_dispatch",
    environment: "vultr-japan-production",
    workflowPath: ".github/workflows/japan-control-plane-production-deploy.yml",
    workflowRef: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal/.github/workflows/japan-control-plane-production-deploy.yml@refs/heads/master",
    workflowSha: input.workflowSha,
    sourceRef: "refs/heads/master",
    sourceSha: input.sourceSha,
    runId: String(input.runId),
    runAttempt: 1,
    runnerEnvironment: "github-hosted",
    reviewerIdentitySha256: input.reviewerIdentitySha256,
    approvalHistorySha256: input.approvalHistorySha256,
    bootstrapGeneration: input.bootstrapGeneration,
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: input.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
    bootstrapStateSha256: input.bootstrapStateSha256,
    authorizationBindingHmacSha256: input.authorizationBindingHmacSha256,
    authorizationGeneration: input.authorizationGeneration,
    databaseContractsSha256: input.databaseContractsSha256,
    hostExecutionContractSha256: input.hostExecutionContractSha256,
    artifactSize: input.artifactSize,
    artifactSha256: input.artifactSha256,
    createdAt: createdAt.toISOString(),
    expiresAt,
    nonceSha256: sha256Hex(input.nonceBytes)
  });
  validateProductionAuthorizationSchema(value);
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT);
  return Object.freeze({ value, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) });
}

export function validateProductionAuthorizationRecord({ bytes, expected, now }) {
  const value = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT);
  validateProductionAuthorizationSchema(value);
  const rebuilt = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT);
  if (!rebuilt.equals(bytes)
    || Object.keys(value).some((key, index) => key !== PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_FIELDS[index])
    || Date.parse(now) >= Date.parse(value.expiresAt)
    || Date.parse(value.expiresAt) > Date.parse(value.createdAt) + 300_000) {
    throw new Error("production_authorization_invalid");
  }
  for (const [key, expectedValue] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    if (!PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_FIELDS.includes(key) || value[key] !== expectedValue) {
      throw new Error("production_authorization_invalid");
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({ value, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) });
}

export function deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience(authorizationRecordSha256) {
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(authorizationRecordSha256)) {
    throw new Error("production_authorization_digest_invalid");
  }
  return `gccgw-control-plane-deploy:${authorizationRecordSha256}`;
}
```

```js
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { canonicalizeDatabaseContracts } from "../server/services/deployment/database-contract.mjs";
import { createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier } from "../server/services/deployment/github-attestation-verifier.mjs";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import { resolveInventoryReceipt } from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-inventory-receipt.mjs";
import { buildProductionAuthorizationRecord } from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-production-authorization.mjs";
import {
  MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH,
  resolveMainSourceIdentity
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";
import {
  validateDeploymentPlanBytes,
  validateDeploymentPlanMainSourceIdentity
} from "./control-plane-deployment-plan.mjs";
import {
  PREAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT,
  collectPostapprovalEvidence,
  readCurrentMaster,
  verifyArtifactReleaseEvidence
} from "./control-plane-github-evidence.mjs";

import { validateReservedAuthorizationScopeAttestation } from "./control-plane-github-scope-attestor.mjs";

export const POSTAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-postapproval-evidence-v1",
  maxBytes: 32_768,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schema", "gateId", "productionGateReceiptSha256", "deploymentPlanSha256",
    "inventoryReceiptSha256", "inventoryExpiresAt", "productionGateExpiresAt",
    "effectivePlanExpiresAt", "transactionId", "sourceCommit",
    "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha",
    "mainSourceMergeCommitSha", "workflowSha",
    "runId", "runAttempt", "approverIdentitySha256", "approvalHistorySha256",
    "environmentPolicySha256", "requiredCheckContractsSha256",
    "bootstrapGeneration", "bootstrapReceiptSha256", "bootstrapStateSha256",
    "authorizationBindingHmacSha256", "authorizationGeneration",
    "databaseContractsSha256", "hostExecutionContractSha256", "artifactSize",
    "artifactSha256", "releaseDeclarationSha256", "observedAt"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_postapproval_evidence_v1"
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.deploymentPlanSha256)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.mainSourceIdentitySha256)
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.mainSourcePrNumber)
      || value.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.mainSourceHeadSha)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
      || value.runAttempt !== 1
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.databaseContractsSha256)) {
      throw new Error("postapproval_evidence_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function createPostapprovalEvidence({
  plan,
  inventory,
  evidence,
  deploymentPlanSha256,
  databaseContractsSha256,
  releaseDeclarationSha256,
  runIdentity,
  observedAt
}) {
  const value = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_postapproval_evidence_v1",
    gateId: plan.gateId,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: plan.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    deploymentPlanSha256,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: inventory.sha256,
    inventoryExpiresAt: inventory.receipt.expiresAt,
    productionGateExpiresAt: plan.productionGateExpiresAt,
    effectivePlanExpiresAt: plan.expiresAt,
    transactionId: plan.transactionId,
    sourceCommit: plan.sourceCommit,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: plan.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: plan.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: plan.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: plan.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    workflowSha: runIdentity.workflowSha,
    runId: String(runIdentity.runId),
    runAttempt: runIdentity.runAttempt,
    approverIdentitySha256: evidence.reviewerIdentitySha256,
    approvalHistorySha256: evidence.approvalHistorySha256,
    environmentPolicySha256: evidence.environmentPolicySha256,
    requiredCheckContractsSha256: evidence.requiredCheckContractsSha256,
    bootstrapGeneration: inventory.receipt.bootstrapGeneration,
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: inventory.receipt.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
    bootstrapStateSha256: inventory.receipt.bootstrapStateSha256,
    authorizationBindingHmacSha256: inventory.receipt.authorizationBindingHmacSha256,
    authorizationGeneration: inventory.receipt.authorizationGeneration,
    databaseContractsSha256,
    hostExecutionContractSha256: plan.hostExecution.contractDigest,
    artifactSize: plan.artifact.sizeBytes,
    artifactSha256: plan.artifact.sha256,
    releaseDeclarationSha256,
    observedAt
  });
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, POSTAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT);
  return Object.freeze({ value, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) });
}

export async function runPostApprovalCheck(input) {
  if (input.runIdentity.runAttempt !== 1) throw new Error("postapproval_run_attempt_invalid");
  const validated = validateDeploymentPlanBytes({
    bytes: input.deploymentPlanBytes,
    now: input.now,
    runContext: input.runIdentity
  });
  const plan = validated.plan;
  const mainSourceIdentityBytes = await readFile(resolve(input.trustedCheckout, MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH));
  const mainSourceIdentity = await resolveMainSourceIdentity({
    bytes: mainSourceIdentityBytes,
    expectedSourceCommit: plan.sourceCommit,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn
  });
  validateDeploymentPlanMainSourceIdentity({
    plan,
    validatedMainSourceIdentity: mainSourceIdentity
  });
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(input.preapprovalEvidenceBytes)
    || sha256Hex(input.preapprovalEvidenceBytes) !== input.preapprovalEvidenceSha256) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_preapproval_evidence_invalid");
  }
  const preapprovalEvidence = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(
    input.preapprovalEvidenceBytes,
    PREAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT
  );
  if (preapprovalEvidence.sourceCommit !== plan.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_preapproval_evidence_invalid");
  }
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(input.deploymentPlanBytes)
    || validated.sha256 !== input.deploymentPlanSha256
    || sha256Hex(input.deploymentPlanBytes) !== input.deploymentPlanSha256) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_plan_digest_invalid");
  }
  const inventory = await resolveInventoryReceipt({
    repository: input.repository,
    inventoryGateId: plan.inventoryGateId,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn
  });
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(inventory.bytes)
    || sha256Hex(inventory.bytes) !== inventory.sha256
    || inventory.sha256 !== plan.inventoryReceiptSha256
    || inventory.receipt.sourceCommit !== plan.sourceCommit
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(inventory.receipt.authorizationBindingHmacSha256)
    || Date.parse(input.now) >= Date.parse(inventory.receipt.expiresAt)) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_inventory_invalid");
  }
  const evidence = await collectPostapprovalEvidence({
    ...input,
    expectedSourceCommit: plan.sourceCommit,
    requiredCheckContracts: inventory.receipt.requiredCheckContracts,
    expectedEnvironmentPolicySha256: preapprovalEvidence.environmentPolicySha256,
    environment: "vultr-japan-production",
    runAttempt: 1
  });
  const attestationVerifier = createTrackedGithubAttestationVerifier({
    clock: Object.freeze({ now: () => new Date(input.now) })
  });
  const artifactEvidence = await verifyArtifactReleaseEvidence({
    ...input,
    sourceCommit: plan.sourceCommit,
    validatedMainSourceIdentity: mainSourceIdentity,
    artifactSha256: plan.artifact.sha256,
    releaseDeclarationSha256: plan.artifact.releaseDeclarationSha256,
    requiredDeploymentMode: "normal",
    requiredAttestationWorkflowPath: ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml",
    verifyAttestationBundle: attestationVerifier.verify
  });
  const confirmedMaster = await readCurrentMaster(input);
  if (confirmedMaster.sourceCommit !== plan.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_github_master_drift");
  }
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(artifactEvidence.artifactBytes)
    || artifactEvidence.artifactBytes.length !== artifactEvidence.artifactSize
    || sha256Hex(artifactEvidence.artifactBytes) !== artifactEvidence.artifactSha256
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationBytes)
    || sha256Hex(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationBytes)
      !== artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || artifactEvidence.artifactSha256 !== plan.artifact.sha256
    || artifactEvidence.artifactSize !== plan.artifact.sizeBytes
    || artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256
      !== plan.artifact.releaseDeclarationSha256) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_artifact_evidence_drift");
  }
  for (const [field, expected] of Object.entries({
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: mainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  })) {
    if (artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationValue[field] !== expected || plan[field] !== expected) {
      throw new Error("postapproval_main_source_identity_drift");
    }
  }
  const deploymentPlanSha256 = validated.sha256;
  if (evidence.requiredCheckContractsSha256 !== preapprovalEvidence.requiredCheckContractsSha256) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_preapproval_evidence_drift");
  }
  const inventoryDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(inventory.receipt.databaseContracts);
  const planDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(plan.databaseContracts);
  const releaseDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(
    artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationValue.databaseContracts
  );
  const stableBodyDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(
    artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody.databaseContracts
  );
  if (!inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(planDatabase.bytes)
    || !inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(releaseDatabase.bytes)
    || !inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(stableBodyDatabase.bytes)
    || inventoryDatabase.sha256 !== planDatabase.sha256
    || inventoryDatabase.sha256 !== releaseDatabase.sha256
    || inventoryDatabase.sha256 !== stableBodyDatabase.sha256) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_database_contract_drift");
  }
  const databaseContractsSha256 = inventoryDatabase.sha256;
  const postapprovalEvidence = createPostapprovalEvidence({
    plan,
    inventory,
    evidence,
    deploymentPlanSha256,
    databaseContractsSha256,
    releaseDeclarationSha256: artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256,
    runIdentity: input.runIdentity,
    observedAt: input.now
  });
  if (postapprovalEvidence.value.inventoryReceiptSha256 !== inventory.sha256
    || postapprovalEvidence.value.deploymentPlanSha256 !== deploymentPlanSha256
    || postapprovalEvidence.value.authorizationBindingHmacSha256 !== inventory.receipt.authorizationBindingHmacSha256) {
    throw new Error("postapproval_authorization_binding_drift");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    valid: true,
    postapprovalEvidenceBytes: postapprovalEvidence.bytes,
    postapprovalEvidenceSha256: postapprovalEvidence.sha256
  });
}

export function finalizeProductionAuthorization({ postapprovalEvidenceBytes, scopeAttestationBytes, nonceBytes, now }) {
  const evidence = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(postapprovalEvidenceBytes, POSTAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT);
  validateReservedAuthorizationScopeAttestation({
    bytes: scopeAttestationBytes,
    expected: Object.freeze({
      repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
      environment: "vultr-japan-production",
      valid: true
    })
  });
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(nonceBytes) || nonceBytes.length !== 32) {
    throw new Error("production_authorization_nonce_invalid");
  }
  try {
    const authorization = buildProductionAuthorizationRecord({
      gateId: evidence.gateId,
      productionGateReceiptSha256: evidence.productionGateReceiptSha256,
      deploymentPlanSha256: evidence.deploymentPlanSha256,
      inventoryReceiptSha256: evidence.inventoryReceiptSha256,
      inventoryExpiresAt: evidence.inventoryExpiresAt,
      productionGateExpiresAt: evidence.productionGateExpiresAt,
      effectivePlanExpiresAt: evidence.effectivePlanExpiresAt,
      transactionId: evidence.transactionId,
      workflowSha: evidence.workflowSha,
      sourceSha: evidence.sourceCommit,
      runId: evidence.runId,
      reviewerIdentitySha256: evidence.approverIdentitySha256,
      approvalHistorySha256: evidence.approvalHistorySha256,
      bootstrapGeneration: evidence.bootstrapGeneration,
      bootstrapReceiptSha256: evidence.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
      bootstrapStateSha256: evidence.bootstrapStateSha256,
      authorizationBindingHmacSha256: evidence.authorizationBindingHmacSha256,
      authorizationGeneration: evidence.authorizationGeneration,
      databaseContractsSha256: evidence.databaseContractsSha256,
      hostExecutionContractSha256: evidence.hostExecutionContractSha256,
      artifactSize: evidence.artifactSize,
      artifactSha256: evidence.artifactSha256,
      nonceBytes,
      createdAt: now
    });
    return Object.freeze({
      valid: true,
      authorizationRecordBytes: authorization.bytes,
      authorizationRecordSha256: authorization.sha256
    });
  } finally {
    nonceBytes.fill(0);
  }
}
```
