It is workflow-owned reviewed text, never a repository file or cross-job artifact; the two copies must parse, have the same fixed SHA-256, and may statically import only the listed `node:` built-ins:

```js
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { lstat, mkdir, open, readdir, readFile, realpath, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, join, posix, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const INPUT_ROOT = "/workspace/input";
const TOOLCHAIN_ROOT = "/workspace/toolchain";
const SOURCE_ROOT = "/workspace/source";
const IMAGE = "docker.io/library/node:22.23.1-bookworm@sha256:175215a1f306ed5df592434b99cc2019f70624373fe49cb659240a618a846aed";
const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SOURCE = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 67_108_864;
const MAX_TREE_BYTES = 16_777_216;
const TRANSFER_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "schema", "sourceCommit", "sourceArchiveSha256", "sourceArchiveSize",
  "gitTreeManifestSha256", "gitTreeManifestSize", "inventoryGateId",
  "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256"
]);

function sha256(bytes) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function fail() {
  throw new Error("artifact_transfer_invalid");
}

function assertExactObject(value, fields) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
    || Reflect.ownKeys(value).some((name, index) => name !== fields[index])
    || Reflect.ownKeys(value).length !== fields.length) fail();
}

export function serializeFixedSourceTransfer(value) {
  assertExactObject(value, TRANSFER_FIELDS);
  const compatibility = /^cig1\./.test(value.inventoryGateId ?? "");
  if (value.schema !== "control_plane_source_transfer_v1"
    || !SOURCE.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
    || !SHA256.test(value.sourceArchiveSha256 ?? "")
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.sourceArchiveSize) || value.sourceArchiveSize < 1
    || value.sourceArchiveSize > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES
    || !SHA256.test(value.gitTreeManifestSha256 ?? "")
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.gitTreeManifestSize) || value.gitTreeManifestSize < 1
    || value.gitTreeManifestSize > MAX_TREE_BYTES
    || (!/^ig1\./.test(value.inventoryGateId ?? "") && !compatibility)
    || (compatibility
      ? !SHA256.test(value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 ?? "")
      : value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 !== null)) fail();
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(
    TRANSFER_FIELDS.map((name) => [name, value[name]])
  )), "utf8");
}

export function verifyFixedSourceTransferBytes(bytes) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.at(-1) !== 0x7d) fail();
  let value;
  try { value = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8")); } catch { fail(); }
  const canonical = serializeFixedSourceTransfer(value);
  if (!canonical.equals(bytes)) fail();
  return Object.freeze({ value: Object.freeze(value), bytes: Buffer.from(bytes), sha256: sha256(bytes) });
}

function parseOctal(bytes) {
  const text = bytes.toString("ascii").replace(/\0.*$/s, "").trim();
  if (!/^[0-7]+$/.test(text)) fail();
  const value = Number.parseInt(text, 8);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) fail();
  return value;
}

function parseBoundedTar(bytes) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) fail();
  const entries = [];
  const names = new Set();
  let offset = 0;
  while (offset + 512 <= bytes.length) {
    const header = bytes.subarray(offset, offset + 512);
    if (header.every((byte) => byte === 0)) break;
    const storedChecksum = parseOctal(header.subarray(148, 156));
    const checksum = header.reduce((sum, byte, index) => sum + (index >= 148 && index < 156 ? 0x20 : byte), 0);
    if (checksum !== storedChecksum) fail();
    const name = header.subarray(0, 100).toString("utf8").replace(/\0.*$/s, "");
    const prefix = header.subarray(345, 500).toString("utf8").replace(/\0.*$/s, "");
    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}/${name}` : name;
    const type = String.fromCharCode(header[156] || 0x30);
    const size = parseOctal(header.subarray(124, 136));
    const mode = parseOctal(header.subarray(100, 108)) & 0o777;
    const normalized = posix.normalize(path);
    if (!path || path !== normalized || path.startsWith("/") || path.includes("\\")
      || path.split("/").includes("..") || names.has(path)
      || !["0", "\0", "5", "g"].includes(type) || size > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) fail();
    names.add(path);
    const dataOffset = offset + 512;
    const next = dataOffset + Math.ceil(size / 512) * 512;
    if (next > bytes.length) fail();
    if (type === "0" || type === "\0") entries.push(Object.freeze({ path, mode, data: Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(dataOffset, dataOffset + size)) }));
    if (type === "g" && !bytes.subarray(dataOffset, dataOffset + size).toString("utf8").startsWith("52 comment=")) fail();
    offset = next;
  }
  if (entries.length < 1 || bytes.subarray(offset).some((byte) => byte !== 0)) fail();
  return entries;
}

function parseGitTree(bytes) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > MAX_TREE_BYTES || bytes.at(-1) !== 0x0a) fail();
  const rows = bytes.toString("utf8").trimEnd().split("\n").map((line) => {
    const match = /^(100644|100755) blob ([0-9a-f]{40})\t([^\u0000-\u001f\\]+)$/.exec(line);
    if (!match || posix.normalize(match[3]) !== match[3] || match[3].split("/").includes("..")) fail();
    return Object.freeze({ mode: match[1], oid: match[2], path: match[3] });
  });
  if (rows.some((row, index) => index > 0 && rows[index - 1].path.localeCompare(row.path, "en") >= 0)) fail();
  return rows;
}

function gitBlobOid(bytes) {
  return createHash("sha1").update(`blob ${bytes.length}\0`, "utf8").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function compareTarToTree(entries, rows) {
  const files = entries.map(({ path, mode, data }) => Object.freeze({
    path,
    mode: mode & 0o111 ? "100755" : "100644",
    oid: gitBlobOid(data)
  })).sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path, "en"));
  if (JSON.stringify(files) !== JSON.stringify(rows)) fail();
}

async function readExactRegular(path, maxBytes) {
  const before = await lstat(path);
  if (!before.isFile() || before.isSymbolicLink() || before.nlink !== 1 || before.size < 1 || before.size > maxBytes) fail();
  const bytes = await readFile(path);
  const after = await lstat(path);
  if (before.dev !== after.dev || before.ino !== after.ino || before.size !== after.size) fail();
  return bytes;
}

async function assertExactDirectory(root, names) {
  const actual = (await readdir(root)).sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"));
  if (JSON.stringify(actual) !== JSON.stringify([...names].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")))) fail();
}

async function verifyBeforeExtract(expected) {
  if (process.platform !== "linux" || process.arch !== "x64" || process.version !== "v22.23.1"
    || process.env.CONTROL_PLANE_FOUNDATION_IMAGE !== IMAGE) fail();
  await assertExactDirectory(TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, [
    "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json", "immutable-publication-evidence.json"
  ]);
  const lock = await readExactRegular(join(TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json"), 1_048_576);
  const evidence = await readExactRegular(join(TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, "immutable-publication-evidence.json"), 4_194_304);
  if (sha256(lock) !== expected.lockSha256 || sha256(evidence) !== expected.evidenceSha256) fail();
  await assertExactDirectory(INPUT_ROOT, ["git-tree.manifest", "source-transfer.json", "source.tar"]);
  const transfer = verifyFixedSourceTransferBytes(await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "source-transfer.json"), 65_536));
  const archive = await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "source.tar"), MAX_SOURCE_BYTES);
  const tree = await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "git-tree.manifest"), MAX_TREE_BYTES);
  if (transfer.value.sourceCommit !== expected.sourceCommit
    || transfer.value.sourceArchiveSha256 !== expected.sourceArchiveSha256
    || transfer.value.sourceArchiveSize !== archive.length || sha256(archive) !== expected.sourceArchiveSha256
    || transfer.value.gitTreeManifestSha256 !== sha256(tree)
    || transfer.value.gitTreeManifestSize !== tree.length) fail();
  compareTarToTree(parseBoundedTar(archive), parseGitTree(tree));
}

async function walkExtracted(root, prefix = "") {
  const output = [];
  for (const name of (await readdir(join(root, prefix))).sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))) {
    const relative = prefix ? `${prefix}/${name}` : name;
    const path = join(root, relative);
    const info = await lstat(path);
    if (info.isSymbolicLink() || (!info.isDirectory() && !info.isFile())) fail();
    if (info.isDirectory()) output.push(...await walkExtracted(root, relative));
    else output.push(Object.freeze({
      path: relative.replaceAll("\\", "/"),
      mode: info.mode & 0o111 ? "100755" : "100644",
      oid: gitBlobOid(await readFile(path))
    }));
  }
  return output;
}

async function verifyExtracted() {
  if (await realpath(SOURCE_ROOT) !== SOURCE_ROOT) fail();
  const rows = parseGitTree(await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "git-tree.manifest"), MAX_TREE_BYTES));
  const observed = await walkExtracted(SOURCE_ROOT);
  if (JSON.stringify(observed) !== JSON.stringify(rows)) fail();
}

function parseFlags(tokens) {
  const names = [
    "expected-source-commit", "expected-source-archive-sha256",
    "expected-toolchain-lock-sha256", "expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256"
  ];
  if (tokens.length !== names.length * 2) fail();
  const values = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const name = tokens[index]?.replace(/^--/, "");
    if (!names.includes(name) || Object.hasOwn(values, name) || !tokens[index + 1]) fail();
    values[name] = tokens[index + 1];
  }
  if (!SOURCE.test(values["expected-source-commit"] ?? "")
    || !SHA256.test(values["expected-source-archive-sha256"] ?? "")
    || !SHA256.test(values["expected-toolchain-lock-sha256"] ?? "")
    || !SHA256.test(values["expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256"] ?? "")) fail();
  return Object.freeze({
    sourceCommit: values["expected-source-commit"],
    sourceArchiveSha256: values["expected-source-archive-sha256"],
    lockSha256: values["expected-toolchain-lock-sha256"],
    evidenceSha256: values["expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256"]
  });
}

export async function runArtifactTransferVerifierCli({ argv }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation === "verify-before-extract") await verifyBeforeExtract(parseFlags(tokens));
  else if (operation === "verify-extracted" && tokens.length === 0) await verifyExtracted();
  else fail();
  return 0;
}

export async function main({ argv = process.argv.slice(2), stderr = process.stderr } = {}) {
  try { process.exitCode = await runArtifactTransferVerifierCli({ argv }); }
  catch { stderr.write("artifact_transfer_verifier_failed\n"); process.exitCode = 2; }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await main();
```

  const jobsOffset = workflow.indexOf("\njobs:\n");
  if (jobsOffset < 0) throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  const observedNames = [...workflow.slice(jobsOffset + 7).matchAll(/^  ([a-z0-9-]+):\n/gm)]
    .map((match) => match[1]);
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(observedNames, Object.keys(expectedJobs));
    for (const [jobId, expected] of Object.entries(expectedJobs)) {
      assert.deepEqual(observeNormalJobSkeleton(workflow, jobId), expected);
      assert.equal(expected.direct["runs-on"], "ubuntu-24.04");
    }
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  onExternalWriteEligible();
}

function extractLiteralPublisherControlBodies(publisher) {
  return [...publisher.matchAll(
    /^(            async function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl\(input\) \{[\s\S]*?^            \})$/gm
  )].map((match) => Buffer.from(
    match[1].split("\n").map((line) => line.slice(12)).join("\n"), "utf8"
  ));
}

function extractLiteralPublisherScripts(publisher) {
  const lines = publisher.split("\n");
  const scripts = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    if (lines[index] !== "          script: |") continue;
    const body = [];
    while (++index < lines.length && (lines[index] === "" || lines[index].startsWith("            "))) {
      body.push(lines[index] === "" ? "" : lines[index].slice(12));
    }
    index -= 1;
    const source = body.join("\n");
    if (source.includes("function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl")) {
      scripts.push(Buffer.from(source, "utf8"));
    }
  }
  return scripts;
}

function completePublisherControlText(workflow) {
  const lastJob = workflow.includes("  publish-gate-last:\n")
    ? "publish-gate-last"
    : "publish-receipt-last";
  return `${jobBlock(workflow, "publish")}\n${jobBlock(workflow, lastJob)}`;
}

const PUBLISHER_PROCESS_ENV_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "VERIFIED_PUBLICATION", "AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION", "EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT",
  "GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR"
]);

function publisherSha256(bytes) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function createPublisherExecutionFixture({ publicationMode, operation, fault = null }) {
  const normal = publicationMode === "normal";
  const base = realFs.mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "control-plane-publisher-"));
  const physicalVerifiedRoot = join(base, "verified");
  const physicalAuthorizedRoot = join(base, "authorized");
  const verifiedRoot = "/verified-publication";
  const authorizedRoot = "/authorized-publication";
  realFs.mkdirSync(physicalVerifiedRoot, { mode: 0o700 });
  const source = "a".repeat(40);

    mainSourceIdentitySha256: "1".repeat(64), mainSourcePrNumber: 17,

  const declarationIdentity = fault === "declaration_identity_drift_before_write"

  const gateIdentity = fault === "gate_identity_drift_before_write"

    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: declarationIdentity.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  }), "utf8");
  const lastBytes = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(normal ? {

    mainSourcePrNumber: gateIdentity.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: gateIdentity.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: gateIdentity.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  } : { schema: "control_plane_compatibility_publication_receipt_v1" }), "utf8");

  const lastName = normal
    ? `production-gate-${lastDigest}.json`
    : `compatibility-publication-${lastDigest}.json`;
  const fileBytes = new Map([
    ["control-plane-app.zip", Buffer.from("zip")],
    ["artifact.json", Buffer.from("{\"artifact\":true}")],

    ["release-assembly.json", Buffer.from("{\"assembly\":true}")],

  ]);
  const fileOrder = [...fileBytes.keys()];
  const envelope = {

    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal", publicationMode,
    tag: `${normal ? "control-plane-app" : "control-plane-compatibility"}-${source}-linux-amd64-glibc-node-127`,
    targetCommit: source, mainSourceIdentitySha256: identity.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: identity.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: identity.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: identity.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runtimeContractId: "linux-amd64-glibc-node-127",
    inventoryReceiptSha256: "2".repeat(64),
    productionGateReceiptSha256: normal ? lastDigest : null,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: normal ? null : "3".repeat(64),
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: normal ? null : lastDigest,
    assetOrder: fileOrder,
    assets: fileOrder.map((name) => ({
      name, sha256: publisherSha256(fileBytes.get(name)), size: fileBytes.get(name).length
    }))
  };
  const envelopeBytes = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(envelope), "utf8");
  realFs.writeFileSync(join(physicalVerifiedRoot, "publication-envelope.json"), envelopeBytes, { mode: 0o600 });
  for (const [name, bytes] of fileBytes) realFs.writeFileSync(join(physicalVerifiedRoot, name), bytes, { mode: 0o600 });

  const environment = {
    deployment_branch_policy: { protected_branches: true, custom_branch_policies: false },
    can_admins_bypass: false,
    protection_rules: [{
      type: "required_reviewers", prevent_self_review: true,
      reviewers: [{ type: "User", reviewer: { id: 41, login: "release-reviewer" } }]
    }]
  };
  const approvals = [{
    state: "approved", environments: [{ name: "artifact-publication" }],
    user: { id: 41, login: "release-reviewer" }
  }];
  const now = new Date();
  const evidenceIdentity = fault === "approval_identity_drift_before_write"
    ? Object.freeze({ ...identity, mainSourcePrNumber: identity.mainSourcePrNumber + 1 }) : identity;
  const approval = {
    schema: "control_plane_artifact_publication_approval_evidence_v1",
    repository: envelope.repository, environment: "artifact-publication", sourceSha: source,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: evidenceIdentity.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: evidenceIdentity.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: evidenceIdentity.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: evidenceIdentity.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runId: "9001", runAttempt: 1,
    actorIdentitySha256: publisherSha256(Buffer.from("release-actor")),
    triggeringActorIdentitySha256: publisherSha256(Buffer.from("release-trigger")),
    reviewerIdentitySha256: publisherSha256(Buffer.from("41:release-reviewer")),
    environmentPolicySha256: publisherSha256(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(environment))),
    approvalHistorySha256: publisherSha256(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(approvals))),
    createdAt: now.toISOString(), expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 300_000).toISOString()
  };
  const approvalBytes = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(approval), "utf8");
  const authorization = {
    schema: "control_plane_artifact_publication_authorization_v1",
    approvalEvidenceSha256: publisherSha256(approvalBytes),
    publicationEnvelopeSha256: publisherSha256(envelopeBytes),
    inventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
    publicationMode, repository: envelope.repository, sourceSha: source,
    runId: "9001", runAttempt: 1, createdAt: approval.createdAt, expiresAt: approval.expiresAt
  };
  if (!/^authorize/.test(operation)) {
    realFs.mkdirSync(physicalAuthorizedRoot, { mode: 0o700 });
    for (const name of ["attestation-subjects", "predicates"]) {
      realFs.mkdirSync(join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, name), { mode: 0o700 });
    }
    realFs.writeFileSync(join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, "publication-envelope.json"), envelopeBytes, { mode: 0o600 });
    for (const [name, bytes] of fileBytes) realFs.writeFileSync(join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, name), bytes, { mode: 0o600 });
    realFs.writeFileSync(join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, "approval-evidence.json"), approvalBytes, { mode: 0o600 });
    realFs.writeFileSync(join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, "publication-authorization.json"),
      Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(authorization), "utf8"), { mode: 0o600 });
  }

  const githubWrites = [];
  const fsWrites = [];
  const request = async (route) => {
    if (/^(?:POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) /.test(route)) githubWrites.push(route);
    if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master") return {
      data: { commit: { sha: fault === "source_advanced_before_write" ? "d".repeat(40) : source } }
    };
    if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}") return {
      data: fault === "policy_drift_before_write" ? { ...environment, can_admins_bypass: true } : environment
    };
    if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals") return {
      data: fault === "approval_drift_before_write" ? [...approvals, { state: "rejected" }] : approvals
    };
    if (route === "GET /users/{username}") return { data: { id: 41, login: "release-reviewer" } };
    if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}") return { data: {
      merged: true,
      base: { ref: fault === "pr_base_drift_before_write" ? "staging" : "master",
        repo: { full_name: fault === "pr_base_repository_drift_before_write" ? "other/repo" : envelope.repository } },
      head: { sha: fault === "pr_head_drift_before_write" ? "d".repeat(40) : identity.mainSourceHeadSha,
        repo: { full_name: fault === "pr_head_repository_drift_before_write" ? "fork/repo" : envelope.repository } },
      merge_commit_sha: fault === "pr_merge_drift_before_write" ? "d".repeat(40) : identity.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
    } };
    if (route === "GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{basehead}") return {
      data: { status: fault === "ancestry_drift_before_write" ? "behind" : "ahead" }
    };
    throw new Error("publisher_harness_unlisted_github_method");
  };
  const mapPath = (value) => {
    if (value === verifiedRoot) return physicalVerifiedRoot;
    if (value === authorizedRoot) return physicalAuthorizedRoot;
    if (value.startsWith(verifiedRoot + "/")) {
      return join(physicalVerifiedRoot, ...value.slice(verifiedRoot.length + 1).split("/"));
    }
    if (value.startsWith(authorizedRoot + "/")) {
      return join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, ...value.slice(authorizedRoot.length + 1).split("/"));
    }
    throw new Error("publisher_harness_path_invalid");
  };
  const boundedFs = Object.freeze({
    realpathSync(value) {
      const physical = mapPath(value);
      if (realFs.realpathSync(physical) !== physical) throw new Error("publisher_harness_path_invalid");
      return value;
    },
    lstatSync(value) { return realFs.lstatSync(mapPath(value)); },
    readFileSync(value) { return realFs.readFileSync(mapPath(value)); },
    readdirSync(value) { return realFs.readdirSync(mapPath(value)); },
    mkdirSync(value, options) { fsWrites.push(value); return realFs.mkdirSync(mapPath(value), options); },
    writeFileSync(value, bytes, options) { fsWrites.push(value); return realFs.writeFileSync(mapPath(value), bytes, options); }
  });
  return Object.freeze({
    base, operation, githubWrites, fsWrites, fs: boundedFs,
    github: Object.freeze({ request }), core: Object.freeze({ setOutput() {} }),
    context: Object.freeze({ sha: source, ref: "refs/heads/master", runAttempt: 1,
      runId: 9001, actor: "release-actor" }),
    process: Object.freeze({ env: Object.freeze({
      VERIFIED_PUBLICATION: verifiedRoot, AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION: authorizedRoot,
      EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: source, GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR: "release-trigger"
    }) }),
    outputExists(name) { return realFs.existsSync(join(physicalAuthorizedRoot, name)); },
    cleanup() { realFs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
  });
}

async function executeLiteralPublisherScript(scriptBytes, fixture) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(scriptBytes)
    || Object.keys(fixture.process.env).join("\n") !== PUBLISHER_PROCESS_ENV_FIELDS.join("\n")) {
    throw new Error("publisher_harness_environment_invalid");
  }
  const required = [];
  const exactRequire = (specifier) => {
    required.push(specifier);
    if (specifier === "node:fs") return fixture.fs;
    if (specifier === "node:crypto") return testRequire("node:crypto");
    throw new Error("publisher_harness_unlisted_require");
  };
  const sandbox = createContext({
    Buffer, require: exactRequire, github: fixture.github, context: fixture.context,
    core: fixture.core, process: fixture.process
  }, { codeGeneration: { strings: false, wasm: false } });
  const result = await new Script(`(async () => {\n${scriptBytes.toString("utf8")}\n})()`, {
    filename: "workflow-owned-publisher-control.cjs"
  }).runInContext(sandbox, { timeout: 2_000 });
  assert.deepEqual(required, ["node:fs", "node:crypto"]);
  return result;
}

function assertExactPermissionTopology(workflow, expectedJobs) {
  if (workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const permissionSpellings = lines
    .map((line) => /^\s*([^:#]+):/.exec(line)?.[1]?.trim())
    .filter((name) => name?.toLowerCase() === "permissions");
  if (permissionSpellings.some((name) => name !== "permissions")) {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const root = lines.filter((line) => /^permissions(?:\s*:|:)/.test(line));
  if (root.length !== 1 || root[0] !== "permissions: {}") {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const jobsOffset = lines.indexOf("jobs:");
  if (jobsOffset < 0) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const headers = [];
  for (let index = jobsOffset + 1; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const match = /^  ([a-z0-9-]+):$/.exec(lines[index]);
    if (match) headers.push(Object.freeze({ name: match[1], index }));
  }
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(headers.map(({ name }) => name), Object.keys(expectedJobs));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const observed = {};
  for (let headerIndex = 0; headerIndex < headers.length; headerIndex += 1) {
    const { name, index: start } = headers[headerIndex];
    const end = headers[headerIndex + 1]?.index ?? lines.length;
    const block = lines.slice(start + 1, end);
    const declarations = block
      .map((line, offset) => Object.freeze({ line, offset }))
      .filter(({ line }) => /^    permissions(?::|\s*:)/.test(line));
    if (declarations.length !== 1) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
    const declaration = declarations[0];
    if (declaration.line === "    permissions: {}") {
      observed[name] = Object.freeze({});
      continue;
    }
    if (declaration.line !== "    permissions:") throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
    const entries = Object.create(null);
    for (let offset = declaration.offset + 1; offset < block.length; offset += 1) {
      if (block[offset].trim() === "") continue;
      if (!block[offset].startsWith("      ")) break;
      const match = /^      ([a-z][a-z-]*): (read|write)$/.exec(block[offset]);
      if (!match || Object.hasOwn(entries, match[1])) {
        throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
      }
      entries[match[1]] = match[2];
    }
    observed[name] = Object.freeze({ ...entries });
  }
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(observed, expectedJobs);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
}

function assertExactWorkflowRootShape(workflow, expectedKeys) {
  if (workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_root_invalid");
  }
  const keys = workflow.split("\n")
    .map((line) => /^([a-z][a-z0-9-]*):(?:\s|$)/.exec(line)?.[1] ?? null)
    .filter((value) => value !== null);
  if (JSON.stringify(keys) !== JSON.stringify(expectedKeys)
    || keys.includes("defaults") || keys.includes("env")
    || new Set(keys).size !== keys.length) {
    throw new Error("workflow_root_invalid");
  }
}

function exactJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId) {
  const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  if (/^    (?:container|services|env):/m.test(block)
    || /ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_(?:REQUEST_TOKEN|REQUEST_URL)/.test(block)
    || /^\s+uses:\s*(?:\.\/|docker:\/\/)/m.test(block)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_topology_invalid");
  }
  const lines = block.split("\n");
  const rows = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    if (!/^      - /.test(lines[index])) continue;
    let end = index + 1;
    while (end < lines.length && !/^      - /.test(lines[end])) end += 1;
    const bytes = Buffer.from(lines.slice(index, end).join("\n") + "\n", "utf8");
    const text = bytes.toString("utf8");
    const name = /^      - name: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1] ?? null;
    const action = /^        uses: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1]
      ?? /^      - uses: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1] ?? null;
    const hasRun = /^        run:(?:\s|$)/m.test(text);
    if ((action === null) === !hasRun) throw new Error("workflow_job_topology_invalid");
    rows.push(Object.freeze({
      name,
      kind: action === null ? "run" : "uses",
      action,
      sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex")
    }));
    index = end - 1;
  }
  return Object.freeze(rows);
}

function assertExactJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId, expected) {
  assert.deepEqual(exactJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId), expected);
}

function withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, jobId, mutate) {
  const original = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  const changed = mutate(original);
  if (changed === original) throw new Error("workflow_permission_fixture_invalid");
  return workflow.replace(original, changed);
}

function assertExactTokenPlacements(workflow, expected) {
  for (const [jobId, counts] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
    const envCount = (block.match(/^\s+GITHUB_TOKEN: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\s*$/gm) ?? []).length;
    const inputCount = (block.match(/^\s+github-token: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\s*$/gm) ?? []).length;
    const allExpressions = (block.match(/\$\{\{\s*(?:github\.token|secrets\.GITHUB_TOKEN)\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).length;
    assert.deepEqual({ env: envCount, actionInput: inputCount }, counts);
    assert.equal(allExpressions, counts.env + counts.actionInput);
    assert.doesNotMatch(block, /secrets\.GITHUB_TOKEN|github\.Token/);
  }
}

function workflowExpressionRows(text) {
  const rows = [...text.matchAll(/\$\{\{([\s\S]*?)\}\}/g)]
    .map((match) => Object.freeze({ body: match[1].trim(), index: match.index }));
  assert.equal((text.match(/\$\{\{/g) ?? []).length, rows.length);
  return rows;
}

function assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(text, expectedCounts) {
  const observed = new Map();
  for (const { body } of workflowExpressionRows(text)) {
    observed.set(body, (observed.get(body) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...observed.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")),
    Object.entries(expectedCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))
  );
}

function assertClosedCredentialContextExpressions(workflow, expectedCounts) {
  const observed = new Map();
  for (const { body } of workflowExpressionRows(workflow)) {
    if (!/\b(?:github|secrets)\b/i.test(body)) continue;
    observed.set(body, (observed.get(body) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...observed.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")),
    Object.entries(expectedCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))
  );
}

function injectJobExpression(workflow, jobId, expression) {
  const marker = `  ${jobId}:\n`;
  const replacement = `${marker}    env:\n      FORGED_CONTEXT: \${{ ${expression} }}\n`;
  const changed = workflow.replace(marker, replacement);
  if (changed === workflow) throw new Error("workflow_expression_fixture_invalid");
  return changed;
}

test("normal Artifact Gate is manual-only with two exact inputs", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  assert.match(workflow, /^name: Control Plane Artifact Gate$/m);
  assert.match(workflow, /^on:\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      inventory_gate_id:/m);
  assert.match(workflow, /      confirmation:\n/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /^  (?:push|pull_request|pull_request_target|schedule|workflow_call|repository_dispatch):/m);
  assert.equal((workflow.match(/^      [a-z_]+:\n        description:/gm) ?? []).length, 2);
});

    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest release-declaration.json", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "a31b7bf0cbb84746824139a9f4821a9435fa3b46d05eff45de9b5e6136874af2" }),

    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest dependency-build-receipt.json", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "16be35ab652bb33adcbb50a6e62d456cab8472568a19bac5be45e250afbb5163" })
  ]));
  assertExactJobStepTopology(workflow, "publish-gate-last", Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ name: "Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable", kind: "uses", action: githubScript, sha256: "dd9ede214cfcad8f031910aaad62cc4c11d69b7b6a3c0f80a75ee795a14f1c35" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: null, kind: "uses", action: download, sha256: "a6b516cef2ce6e6e71477ded7c80847238c26c4249b647a9f7a3d30ba218ab17" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Publish Production Gate asset last with fixed control", kind: "uses", action: githubScript, sha256: "7d5c15e818de41c9e4f7ed238d920adade61b8132c9d3a8f3b693231b4a37e4d" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest Production Gate last", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "0d753f5620623e77cd8d9ca5d5cb650c741c39f34cc5557a29e61147ff211e86" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Verify complete immutable pair inventory with fixed control", kind: "uses", action: githubScript, sha256: "d8e365b58880e1a509625899fa22ade13863d81edcbe8ab0a0259874ba067d13" })
  ]));
  for (const fault of [
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "defaults: {}\njobs:\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "env: {}\njobs:\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "unlisted: true\njobs:\n"),
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}\n", "permissions: {}\npermissions: {}\n"),
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}\n", "Permissions: {}\n")
  ]) assert.throws(() => assertExactWorkflowRootShape(fault, ["name", "on", "permissions", "jobs"]));
  for (const mutation of [
    "    container: ubuntu:latest\n", "    services: {}\n", "    env:\n      ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN: forged\n",
    "    steps:\n      - run: docker run unreviewed\n"
  ]) {
    const fault = workflow.replace("  publish:\n", `  publish:\n${mutation}`);
    assert.throws(() => assertExactJobStepTopology(fault, "publish", Object.freeze([])));
  }
});

test("verify and protected publisher use exact trusted checkouts and never execute artifact code", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const publisher = jobBlock(workflow, "publish");
  const toolchainPrepare = jobBlock(workflow, "toolchain-prepare");
  const tokenlessBuilder = jobBlock(workflow, "tokenless-builder");
  const verify = jobBlock(workflow, "verify");
  const nonGateVerify = jobBlock(workflow, "publication-non-gate-verify");
  const gatePublisher = jobBlock(workflow, "publish-gate-last");
  const publicationVerify = jobBlock(workflow, "publication-verify");
  const publishSteps = publisher.slice(publisher.indexOf("    steps:\n") + "    steps:\n".length);
  assert.match(publishSteps, /^      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable\n        uses: actions\/github-script@[0-9a-f]{40}\n/);
  const publishStepZero = publishSteps.split("\n      - ", 1)[0];
  assert.doesNotMatch(publishStepZero, /actions\/(?:checkout|download-artifact|setup-node)|\$\{\{\s*(?:secrets|vars)\.|id-token|oidc/i);
  assert.ok(publisher.indexOf("Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable")
    < publisher.indexOf("actions/download-artifact"));
  const expectedPermissions = Object.freeze({
    "source-prepare": Object.freeze({ contents: "read" }),
    "toolchain-prepare": Object.freeze({ contents: "read", attestations: "read" }),
    "tokenless-builder": Object.freeze({}),
    verify: Object.freeze({ attestations: "read", contents: "read", "pull-requests": "read" }),
    publish: Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "write", "pull-requests": "read", "id-token": "write", attestations: "write" }),
    "publication-non-gate-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" }),
    "publish-gate-last": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "write", "pull-requests": "read", "id-token": "write", attestations: "write" }),
    "publication-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" })
  });
  assertExactPermissionTopology(workflow, expectedPermissions);
  assertExactTokenPlacements(workflow, Object.freeze({
    "source-prepare": Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 0 }),
    "toolchain-prepare": Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 }),
    "tokenless-builder": Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 0 }),
    verify: Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 }),
    publish: Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 9 }),
    "publication-non-gate-verify": Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 }),
    "publish-gate-last": Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 4 }),
    "publication-verify": Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 })
  }));
  assertClosedCredentialContextExpressions(workflow, Object.freeze({
    "github.sha": 2,
    "github.token": 17
  }));
  assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(tokenlessBuilder, Object.freeze({
    "runner.temp": 3,
    "needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_archive_sha256": 1,
    "needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit": 1,
    "needs.toolchain-prepare.outputs.lock_sha256": 1,
    "needs.toolchain-prepare.outputs.evidence_sha256": 1
  }));
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare"), /permissions:\n      contents: read/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare"), /ref: \$\{\{ github\.sha \}\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare"), /ref: refs\/heads\/master/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /permissions:\n      contents: read\n      attestations: read/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /ref: \$\{\{ github\.sha \}\}/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /node-version: '22\.23\.1'/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /export-builder-input/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(toolchainPrepare, /inputs\.|--(?:repository|release|tag|asset|digest|platform)/);
  assert.equal((toolchainPrepare.match(/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2\.json/g) ?? []).length >= 2, true);
  assert.equal((toolchainPrepare.match(/immutable-publication-evidence\.json/g) ?? []).length >= 2, true);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /needs: \[source-prepare, toolchain-prepare\]/);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /permissions: \{\}/);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|GITHUB_TOKEN|github\.token/);
  for (const staleName of [
    "verifyFixedFoundationToolchain" + "Transfer",
    "verifyFixedSource" + "Transfer",
    "verifyExtracted" + "Tree"
  ]) assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, new RegExp(staleName));
  assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, /^    container:/m);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/docker run --rm --platform linux\/amd64/g) ?? []).length, 5);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/--network none/g) ?? []).length, 4);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/--cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges/g) ?? []).length, 5);
  const sourcePrepare = jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare");
  assert.equal((sourcePrepare.match(/actions\/upload-artifact@/g) ?? []).length, 1);
  assert.doesNotMatch(sourcePrepare, /transfer[_-]verifier|\.(?:mjs|js|cjs|sh|ps1|node)\b/);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/actions\/download-artifact@/g) ?? []).length, 2);
  assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, /name:\s+[^\n]*verifier|transfer_verifier_sha256/);
  const inlineVerifierBytes = extractInlineTransferVerifierBytes(tokenlessBuilder);
  await assertReviewedInlineTransferVerifier(inlineVerifierBytes, "normal");
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /control-plane-inline-transfer-verifier\.mjs/);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /verify-before-extract/);
  assert.ok(tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("verify-before-extract") < tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("--extract --file"));
  assert.ok(tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("verify-extracted") < tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("control-plane-artifact-builder.mjs fetch"));
  assert.match(publisher, /environment: artifact-publication/);
  assert.match(publisher, /contents: write/);
  assert.match(publisher, /pull-requests: read/);
  assert.match(publisher, /attestations: write/);
  assert.match(publisher, /id-token: write/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(publisher, /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|git\s|node scripts\/|npm (?:ci|install)|unzip|tar\s|require\([^)]*(?:verified-publication|workspace|scripts)|import\([^)]*(?:verified-publication|workspace|scripts)|child_process|eval\(/);
  assert.match(publisher, /actions\/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea/);
  assert.match(publisher, /Re-hash opaque publication and recheck approval/);
  assert.match(verify, /needs: \[source-prepare, toolchain-prepare, tokenless-builder\]/);
  assert.match(verify, /actions\/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10/);
  assert.match(verify, /name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data/);
  assert.match(verify, /GITHUB_TOKEN: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}/);
  assert.equal(
    /^    permissions:\n(?:      [^\n]+\n)+/m.exec(verify)[0],
    "    permissions:\n      attestations: read\n      contents: read\n      pull-requests: read\n"
  );
  assert.match(nonGateVerify, /needs: \[source-prepare, verify, publish\]/);
  assert.match(nonGateVerify, /--publication-stage non_gate/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(nonGateVerify, /contents: write|attestations: write|id-token: write|actions\/attest|actions\/github-script/);
  const gateSteps = gatePublisher.slice(gatePublisher.indexOf("    steps:\n") + "    steps:\n".length);
  assert.match(gateSteps, /^      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable\n        uses: actions\/github-script@[0-9a-f]{40}\n/);
  assert.ok(gatePublisher.indexOf("publication-non-gate-verify") < gatePublisher.indexOf("Publish Production Gate asset last"));
  assert.doesNotMatch(gatePublisher, /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|node scripts\/|child_process|eval\(/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /needs: \[source-prepare, verify, publish-gate-last\]/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /permissions:\n      actions: read\n      contents: read\n      attestations: read/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /ref: \$\{\{ needs\.source-prepare\.outputs\.source_commit \}\}/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /verify-artifact-publication/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /GITHUB_TOKEN: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(publicationVerify, /contents: write|attestations: write|id-token: write|actions\/attest|actions\/github-script/);
  assert.equal((workflow.match(/contents: write/g) ?? []).length, 2);
});

test("normal workflow freezes every complete job value before external-write eligibility", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const expected = Object.freeze({
    "source-prepare": normalJobExpectation(["runs-on", "permissions", "outputs", "steps"], { "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "<block>", outputs: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "7aaefc3e2206ff1fa646ab005e309086a92886b9b2f5e8b1b0904576afb437e2"),
    "toolchain-prepare": normalJobExpectation(["runs-on", "permissions", "outputs", "steps"], { "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "<block>", outputs: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "f642dffa2136e40d17fc23f08e414e820ac007d0ab828073242667750ab70af9"),
    "tokenless-builder": normalJobExpectation(["needs", "runs-on", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[source-prepare, toolchain-prepare]", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "{}", steps: "<block>" }, "45e7cb2dabc1f4396f67f7d140dc9f886536f7d21cfce5609474f887a86a28fe"),
    verify: normalJobExpectation(["needs", "runs-on", "outputs", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[source-prepare, toolchain-prepare, tokenless-builder]", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", outputs: "<block>", permissions: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "49a38ee38301464f0fd2dec3ea36f9e65733c45082b13de84881953a909a7aa5"),
    publish: normalJobExpectation(["needs", "runs-on", "environment", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[source-prepare, verify]", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", environment: "artifact-publication", permissions: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "9cfcc48ea8184722857d4180dbf310d635c03fc87c659e8b8b36e08a5cc76421"),
    "publication-non-gate-verify": normalJobExpectation(["needs", "runs-on", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[source-prepare, verify, publish]", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "01861cc02b8eb3f38e0cf06f0fbd7b62b7f8a26be4e55b00248a4464b64582db"),
    "publish-gate-last": normalJobExpectation(["needs", "runs-on", "environment", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[source-prepare, verify, publication-non-gate-verify]", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", environment: "artifact-publication", permissions: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "ec93b4601662b2657d38f2a69e0ab8271119d9870dd70d362c0fabc07d4d3f33"),
    "publication-verify": normalJobExpectation(["needs", "runs-on", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[source-prepare, verify, publish-gate-last]", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "20049d02d84c819d75d5a259e1d9f3d9b8b08108d4aaf6b2e22fc755a9aaebcc")
  });
  let externalWriteEligible = 0;
  assertExactNormalJobSkeletons(workflow, expected, () => { externalWriteEligible += 1; });
  assert.equal(externalWriteEligible, 1);
  externalWriteEligible = 0;
  const faults = [
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "\"jobs\":\n"),
    workflow.replace("on:\n", "'on':\n"),
    workflow.replace("  workflow_dispatch:\n", "  \"push\":\n  workflow_dispatch:\n"),
    workflow.replace("  workflow_dispatch:\n", "  'pull_request_target':\n  workflow_dispatch:\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "jobs:\n  _unlisted:\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "jobs:\n  \"unlisted\":\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "jobs:\n  Unlisted:\n"),
    workflow.replace("  source-prepare:\n", "  \"source-prepare\":\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    Runs-on: ubuntu-24.04"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: &runner ubuntu-24.04"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: *runner"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    <<: *shared\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    defaults: {}\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    container: ubuntu:24.04\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    services: {}\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: self-hosted"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: ubuntu-latest"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    unlisted: true\n"),
    workflow.replace("    needs: [source-prepare, verify]\n", "    needs: [source-prepare]\n"),
    workflow.replace("  publish:\n", "  publish:\n    if: ${{ always() }}\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    continue-on-error: true\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 999\n"),
    workflow.replace("    environment: artifact-publication", "    environment: unreviewed"),
    workflow.replace("    outputs:\n", "    outputs:\n      unlisted: forged\n"),
    workflow.replace("    permissions:\n", "    permissions:\n      issues: write\n"),
    workflow.replace("    steps:\n", "    steps:\n      - run: echo unreviewed\n")
  ];
  for (const fault of faults) {
    assert.throws(
      () => assertExactNormalJobSkeletons(fault, expected, () => { externalWriteEligible += 1; }),
      /workflow_job_skeleton_invalid/
    );
  }
  assert.equal(externalWriteEligible, 0);
});

test("normal Artifact Gate rejects raw permission duplicates, aliases, case drift, and unlisted scope", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const expected = Object.freeze({
    "source-prepare": Object.freeze({ contents: "read" }),
    "toolchain-prepare": Object.freeze({ contents: "read", attestations: "read" }),
    "tokenless-builder": Object.freeze({}),
    verify: Object.freeze({ attestations: "read", contents: "read", "pull-requests": "read" }),
    publish: Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "write", "pull-requests": "read", "id-token": "write", attestations: "write" }),
    "publication-non-gate-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" }),
    "publish-gate-last": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "write", "pull-requests": "read", "id-token": "write", attestations: "write" }),
    "publication-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" })
  });
  const faults = [
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "permissions: {}\npermissions: {}"),
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "permissions: &shared {}"),
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "Permissions: {}"),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish", (block) => block.replace("      contents: write", "      contents: write\n      contents: write")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish", (block) => block.replace("    permissions:\n", "    permissions: *shared\n")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish", (block) => block.replace("      contents: write", "      Contents: write")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish", (block) => block.replace("      contents: write", "      contents: write\n      issues: write")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish", (block) => block.replace("    permissions:\n", "    permissions: {}\n    permissions:\n")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publication-non-gate-verify", (block) => block.replace("      contents: read", "      contents: read\n      deployments: read")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish-gate-last", (block) => block.replace("      contents: write", "      contents: read"))
  ];
  for (const fault of faults) {
    assert.throws(() => assertExactPermissionTopology(fault, expected), /workflow_permissions_invalid|AssertionError/);
  }
});

test("normal workflow source-transfer bytes equal owner canonical bytes with no trailing byte", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const owner = await assertReviewedInlineTransferVerifier(
    extractInlineTransferVerifierBytes(jobBlock(workflow, "tokenless-builder")),
    "normal-canonical-bytes"
  );
  const value = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_source_transfer_v1",
    sourceCommit: "a".repeat(40),
    sourceArchiveSha256: "b".repeat(64),
    sourceArchiveSize: 101,
    gitTreeManifestSha256: "c".repeat(64),
    gitTreeManifestSize: 202,
    inventoryGateId: `ig1.${"a".repeat(40)}.node22-linux-x64-glibc.${"d".repeat(64)}`,
    hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: null
  });
  const workflowBytes = owner.serializeFixedSourceTransfer(value);
  assert.equal(workflowBytes.at(-1), "}".charCodeAt(0));
  for (const suffix of ["\n", " "]) {
    assert.throws(
      () => owner.verifyFixedSourceTransferBytes(Buffer.concat([workflowBytes, Buffer.from(suffix)])),
      /source_transfer_invalid/
    );
  }
});

});
