- [ ] **Step 3: Add the assembly dispatcher and pure fixed-publisher reference validator**

The adapter owner is a separate closed ESM. It has no dependency-injection export and no caller-selected operation surface:

```js
import { constants } from "node:fs";
import {
  lstat,
  mkdir,
  open,
  readdir,
  realpath,
  rename,
  rm
} from "node:fs/promises";
import {
  basename,
  dirname,
  isAbsolute,
  relative,
  resolve
} from "node:path";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "./canonical-json.mjs";
import {
  MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH,
  resolveMainSourceIdentity
} from "./control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";
import { resolveInventoryReceipt } from "./control-plane-inventory-receipt.mjs";
import {
  resolveCompatibilityInventoryReceipt
} from "./control-plane-compatibility-inventory-receipt.mjs";
import {
  assertVerifiedFoundationToolchain,
  resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain
} from "../../../scripts/control-plane-foundation-toolchain-lock.mjs";
import {
  validateReleaseDeclarationBytes,
  validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity
} from "../../../scripts/control-plane-release-declaration.mjs";
import {
  PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER
} from "../../../scripts/control-plane-publication-envelope.mjs";

const REPOSITORY = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
const SOURCE_SHA = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SAFE_RESULT_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "schema", "repository", "publicationMode", "sourceCommit", "runtimeContractId",
  "inventoryReceiptSha256", "artifactSha256", "publicationEnvelopeSha256",
  "productionGateReceiptSha256", "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256",
  "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256"
]);
const VERIFY_INPUT_FIELDS = Object.freeze(["flags", "token", "githubOutputPath"]);
const FLAG_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "source-input", "builder-output", "trusted-checkout", "expected-source-commit",
  "foundation-toolchain-lock-file", "foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file",
  "output", "github-output"
]);
const SOURCE_INPUT_FILES = Object.freeze([
  "git-tree.manifest", "source-transfer.json", "source.tar"
]);
const SOURCE_TRANSFER_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "schema", "sourceCommit", "sourceArchiveSha256", "sourceArchiveSize",
  "gitTreeManifestSha256", "gitTreeManifestSize", "inventoryGateId",
  "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256"
]);
const MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 268_435_456;

const SOURCE_TRANSFER_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-source-transfer-v1",
  maxBytes: 65_536,
  fieldOrder: SOURCE_TRANSFER_FIELDS,
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_source_transfer_v1"
      || !SOURCE_SHA.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
      || !SHA256.test(value.sourceArchiveSha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.sourceArchiveSize) || value.sourceArchiveSize < 1
      || !SHA256.test(value.gitTreeManifestSha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.gitTreeManifestSize) || value.gitTreeManifestSize < 1) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_source_transfer_invalid");
    }
  }
});

const SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-artifact-assembly-safe-result-v1",
  maxBytes: 4_096,
  fieldOrder: SAFE_RESULT_FIELDS,
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    const normal = value.publicationMode === "normal"
      && SHA256.test(value.productionGateReceiptSha256 ?? "")
      && value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 === null
      && value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 === null;
    const compatibility = value.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
      && value.productionGateReceiptSha256 === null
      && SHA256.test(value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 ?? "")
      && SHA256.test(value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 ?? "");
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_artifact_assembly_safe_result_v1"
      || value.repository !== REPOSITORY
      || !SOURCE_SHA.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
      || typeof value.runtimeContractId !== "string"
      || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/.test(value.runtimeContractId)
      || !SHA256.test(value.inventoryReceiptSha256 ?? "")
      || !SHA256.test(value.artifactSha256 ?? "")
      || !SHA256.test(value.publicationEnvelopeSha256 ?? "")
      || (!normal && !compatibility)) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_safe_result_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function assertExactOwnDataFields(value, fields, code) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error(code);
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(value);
  if (keys.length !== fields.length || keys.some((key, index) => key !== fields[index])) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
  for (const key of keys) {
    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
    if (!descriptor?.enumerable || !Object.hasOwn(descriptor, "value")) throw new Error(code);
  }
}

function assertAbsoluteCanonicalPath(value, code) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 2 || value.length > 4_096
    || /[\u0000\r\n]/.test(value) || !isAbsolute(value) || resolve(value) !== value) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
  return value;
}

function pathsOverlap(left, right) {
  const forward = relative(left, right);
  const reverse = relative(right, left);
  const inside = (value) => value === "" || (!value.startsWith("..") && !isAbsolute(value));
  return inside(forward) || inside(reverse);
}

async function readStableRegularFile(path, maxBytes, allowEmpty = false) {
  const before = await lstat(path);
  if (!before.isFile() || before.isSymbolicLink() || before.nlink !== 1
    || before.size > maxBytes || (!allowEmpty && before.size < 1)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid");
  }
  const handle = await open(path, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
  try {
    const openedBefore = await handle.stat();
    const bytes = await handle.readFile();
    const openedAfter = await handle.stat();
    const stable = [before, openedBefore, openedAfter].every((value) => value.isFile()
      && value.nlink === 1 && value.dev === before.dev && value.ino === before.ino
      && value.size === before.size);
    if (!stable || bytes.length !== before.size) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid");
    }
    return Buffer.from(bytes);
  } finally {
    await handle.close();
  }
}

async function assertExactDirectory(path, expectedNames) {
  const before = await lstat(path);
  const canonical = await realpath(path);
  if (!before.isDirectory() || before.isSymbolicLink() || canonical !== path) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid");
  }
  const names = await readdir(path);
  names.sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"));
  const expected = [...expectedNames].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"));
  if (JSON.stringify(names) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid");
  }
  return canonical;
}

function resolvePublicationMode(transfer) {
  const normal = /^ig1\./.test(transfer.inventoryGateId)
    && transfer.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 === null;
  const compatibility = /^cig1\./.test(transfer.inventoryGateId)
    && SHA256.test(transfer.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 ?? "");
  if (normal === compatibility) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_mode_invalid");
  return normal ? "normal" : "compatibility_bootstrap";
}

async function openBoundGithubOutput(path) {
  const before = await lstat(path);
  if (!before.isFile() || before.isSymbolicLink() || before.nlink !== 1) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid");
  }
  const handle = await open(path, constants.O_WRONLY | constants.O_APPEND | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
  const opened = await handle.stat();
  if (!opened.isFile() || opened.nlink !== 1 || opened.dev !== before.dev || opened.ino !== before.ino) {
    await handle.close();
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ handle, dev: before.dev, ino: before.ino });
}

async function writePublicationDirectory({ output, publicationFiles, envelope }) {
  const parent = await realpath(dirname(output));
  if (parent !== dirname(output)) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_output_invalid");
  try {
    await lstat(output);
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_output_invalid");
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
  }
  const staging = resolve(parent, `.${basename(output)}.control-plane-staging`);
  try {
    await lstat(staging);
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_output_invalid");
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
  }
  await mkdir(staging, { mode: 0o700 });
  let published = false;
  try {
    const files = new Map(publicationFiles);
    files.set("publication-envelope.json", envelope.bytes);
    const names = [...files.keys()].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"));
    if (new Set(names.map((name) => name.normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase("en-US"))).size
      !== names.length || names.some((name) => !/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,191}$/.test(name))) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_output_invalid");
    }
    for (const name of names) {
      const bytes = files.get(name);
      if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > MAX_INPUT_BYTES) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_output_invalid");
      }
      const handle = await open(resolve(staging, name), "wx", 0o600);
      try {
        await handle.writeFile(bytes);
        await handle.sync();
      } finally {
        await handle.close();
      }
      const readBack = await readStableRegularFile(resolve(staging, name), MAX_INPUT_BYTES);
      if (!readBack.equals(bytes)) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_output_invalid");
    }
    await rename(staging, output);
    published = true;
    await assertExactDirectory(output, names);
  } catch (error) {
    await rm(published ? output : staging, { recursive: true, force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}

export function createArtifactAssemblyCliOperations() {
  const resultBindings = new WeakMap();
  const writtenResults = new WeakSet();
  return Object.freeze({
    async verify(input) {
      assertExactOwnDataFields(input, VERIFY_INPUT_FIELDS, "artifact_assembly_adapter_input_invalid");
      assertExactOwnDataFields(input.flags, FLAG_FIELDS, "artifact_assembly_adapter_input_invalid");
      if (typeof input.token !== "string" || input.token.length < 1 || /[\u0000\r\n]/.test(input.token)
        || !SOURCE_SHA.test(input.flags["expected-source-commit"] ?? "")) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_adapter_input_invalid");
      }
      const pathFields = FLAG_FIELDS.filter((name) => name !== "expected-source-commit");
      const paths = Object.fromEntries(pathFields.map((name) => [
        name,
        assertAbsoluteCanonicalPath(input.flags[name], "artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid")
      ]));
      const githubOutputPath = assertAbsoluteCanonicalPath(
        input.githubOutputPath,
        "artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid"
      );
      if (paths["github-output"] !== githubOutputPath) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid");
      }
      const sourceRoot = await assertExactDirectory(paths["source-input"], SOURCE_INPUT_FILES);
      const builderRoot = await assertExactDirectory(
        paths["builder-output"],
        PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER
      );
      const checkoutRoot = await realpath(paths["trusted-checkout"]);
      const foundationLockPath = await realpath(paths["foundation-toolchain-lock-file"]);
      const foundationEvidencePath = await realpath(
        paths["foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file"]
      );
      const canonicalGithubOutputPath = await realpath(githubOutputPath);
      const custodyPaths = Object.freeze([
        sourceRoot, builderRoot, checkoutRoot, foundationLockPath,
        foundationEvidencePath, canonicalGithubOutputPath
      ]);
      const aliases = custodyPaths.some((left, index) => custodyPaths
        .slice(index + 1).some((right) => pathsOverlap(left, right)));
      if (checkoutRoot !== paths["trusted-checkout"]
        || foundationLockPath !== paths["foundation-toolchain-lock-file"]
        || foundationEvidencePath !== paths["foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file"]
        || canonicalGithubOutputPath !== githubOutputPath
        || aliases || custodyPaths.some((path) => pathsOverlap(path, paths.output))) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid");
      }
      if (basename(paths["foundation-toolchain-lock-file"]) !== "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json"
        || basename(paths["foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file"])
          !== "immutable-publication-evidence.json") {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_path_custody_invalid");
      }
      const transferBytes = await readStableRegularFile(
        resolve(sourceRoot, "source-transfer.json"),
        65_536
      );
      const transfer = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(transferBytes, SOURCE_TRANSFER_CONTRACT);
      const sourceArchiveBytes = await readStableRegularFile(
        resolve(sourceRoot, "source.tar"),
        MAX_INPUT_BYTES
      );
      const gitTreeManifestBytes = await readStableRegularFile(
        resolve(sourceRoot, "git-tree.manifest"),
        MAX_INPUT_BYTES
      );
      if (transfer.sourceCommit !== input.flags["expected-source-commit"]
        || transfer.sourceArchiveSize !== sourceArchiveBytes.length
        || transfer.sourceArchiveSha256 !== sha256Hex(sourceArchiveBytes)
        || transfer.gitTreeManifestSize !== gitTreeManifestBytes.length
        || transfer.gitTreeManifestSha256 !== sha256Hex(gitTreeManifestBytes)) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_source_transfer_invalid");
      }
      const publicationMode = resolvePublicationMode(transfer);
      const identityBytes = await readStableRegularFile(
        resolve(checkoutRoot, MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH),
        65_536
      );
      const validatedMainSourceIdentity = await resolveMainSourceIdentity({
        bytes: identityBytes,
        expectedSourceCommit: transfer.sourceCommit,
        token: input.token,
        fetchFn: globalThis.fetch
      });
      const inventory = publicationMode === "normal"
        ? await resolveInventoryReceipt({
          repository: REPOSITORY,
          inventoryGateId: transfer.inventoryGateId,
          token: input.token,
          fetchFn: globalThis.fetch
        })
        : await resolveCompatibilityInventoryReceipt({
          repository: REPOSITORY,
          compatibilityInventoryGateId: transfer.inventoryGateId,
          token: input.token,
          fetchFn: globalThis.fetch
        });
      const foundationToolchainLockBytes = await readStableRegularFile(
        paths["foundation-toolchain-lock-file"],
        1_048_576
      );
      const foundationToolchainPublicationEvidenceBytes = await readStableRegularFile(
        paths["foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file"],
        4_194_304
      );
      const verifiedFoundationToolchain = resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain({
        lockBytes: foundationToolchainLockBytes,
        immutablePublicationEvidence: foundationToolchainPublicationEvidenceBytes
      });
      assertVerifiedFoundationToolchain(verifiedFoundationToolchain);
      const publicationFiles = new Map();
      for (const name of PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER) {
        publicationFiles.set(
          name,
          await readStableRegularFile(resolve(builderRoot, name), MAX_INPUT_BYTES)
        );
      }
      const releaseDeclarationBytes = publicationFiles.get("release-declaration.json");
      const releaseDeclaration = validateReleaseDeclarationBytes({
        bytes: releaseDeclarationBytes,
        expectedSourceCommit: transfer.sourceCommit
      });
      const releaseDeclarationValue = validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity({
        declaration: releaseDeclaration.declaration,
        validatedMainSourceIdentity
      });
      const modeReceiptBindingValid = publicationMode === "normal"
        ? releaseDeclarationValue.bootstrapReceiptSha256
            === inventory.receipt.bootstrapReceiptSha256
          && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(releaseDeclarationValue.bootstrapReceiptSha256 ?? "")
          && releaseDeclarationValue.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 === null
        : releaseDeclarationValue.bootstrapReceiptSha256 === null
          && releaseDeclarationValue.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256
            === inventory.receipt.stagedHostBundleContentReceiptSha256
          && releaseDeclarationValue.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256
            === transfer.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256;
      if (inventory.receipt.sourceCommit !== transfer.sourceCommit
        || releaseDeclarationValue.repository !== REPOSITORY
        || releaseDeclarationValue.target !== "japan-control-plane"
        || releaseDeclarationValue.releaseUnit !== "control-plane-app"
        || releaseDeclarationValue.deploymentMode !== publicationMode
        || releaseDeclarationValue.automatedDeploymentEligible !== (publicationMode === "normal")
        || releaseDeclarationValue.runtimeContractId !== inventory.receipt.runtimeContractId
        || releaseDeclarationValue.artifactFileName !== "control-plane-app.zip"
        || !modeReceiptBindingValid) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_release_declaration_binding_invalid");
      }
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_verification_owner_unavailable");
    },
    async writeExactGithubOutput(input) {
      assertExactOwnDataFields(input, Object.freeze(["result"]), "artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid");
      const binding = resultBindings.get(input.result);
      if (binding === undefined || writtenResults.has(input.result)) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid");
      }
      const digest = binding.publicationMode === "normal"
        ? input.result.productionGateReceiptSha256
        : input.result.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256;
      const name = binding.publicationMode === "normal"
        ? "production_gate_receipt_sha256"
        : "compatibility_publication_receipt_sha256";
      if (!SHA256.test(digest ?? "")) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_github_output_invalid");
      try {
        await binding.githubOutput.handle.writeFile(`${name}=${digest}\n`, "utf8");
        await binding.githubOutput.handle.sync();
        writtenResults.add(input.result);
      } finally {
        await binding.githubOutput.handle.close();
      }
    },
    serializeSafeResult(result) {
      if (!resultBindings.has(result)) throw new Error("artifact_assembly_safe_result_invalid");
      const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(result, SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT);
      if (bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT.maxBytes
        || bytes.includes(0x0a) || bytes.includes(0x0d)) {
        throw new Error("artifact_assembly_safe_result_invalid");
      }
      return Buffer.from(bytes);
    }
  });
}
```

The dedicated adapter test imports and executes the real zero-argument factory. For deterministic owner boundaries it loads the same adapter ESM through `vm.SourceTextModule` with fixed synthetic owner modules; Node built-ins and filesystem custody remain real. Both modes re-hash the actual source-transfer payloads, traverse only the approved identity/inventory/Foundation/declaration owners, and then hit the exact assembly-verification-owner STOP. A separate real-module VM test invokes `assembleVerifiedArtifactPublication` with an observation proxy and requires the same STOP before any input trap or imported publication owner is called. The deliberately non-assembly fixture can never be treated as a compatibility success: receipt/envelope constructors are not linked, the output directory remains absent, GitHub output remains byte-empty, and both output surfaces reject unbranded values.

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { constants } from "node:fs";
import { mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, symlink, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import * as fsPromises from "node:fs/promises";
import * as pathOwner from "node:path";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import test from "node:test";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { SourceTextModule, SyntheticModule } from "node:vm";
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";

const adapterUrl = new URL(
  "../services/deployment/control-plane-artifact-assembly-cli-adapter.mjs",
  import.meta.url
);
const assemblyUrl = new URL("../../scripts/control-plane-artifact-assembly.mjs", import.meta.url);
const nonReceiptFiles = Object.freeze([
  "control-plane-app.zip", "artifact.json", "writer-registry.json",
  "release-declaration.json", "release-assembly.json", "dependency-build-receipt.json"
]);
const testReleaseDeclarationFields = Object.freeze([
  "repository", "target", "releaseUnit", "sourceCommit",
  "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha",
  "mainSourceMergeCommitSha", "runtimeContractId", "deploymentMode",
  "automatedDeploymentEligible", "artifactFileName", "artifactSha256",
  "artifactSizeBytes", "bootstrapReceiptSha256", "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256"
]);
const testReleaseDeclarationContract = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "test-control-plane-release-declaration-v1",
  maxBytes: 8_192,
  fieldOrder: testReleaseDeclarationFields,
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    const modeValid = value.deploymentMode === "normal"
      ? /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.bootstrapReceiptSha256 ?? "")
        && value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 === null
      : value.deploymentMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
        && value.bootstrapReceiptSha256 === null
        && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 ?? "");
    if (value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || value.target !== "japan-control-plane" || value.releaseUnit !== "control-plane-app"
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.artifactSha256 ?? "")
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.artifactSizeBytes) || value.artifactSizeBytes < 1
      || !modeValid) {
      throw new Error("test_release_declaration_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function syntheticNamespace(namespace) {
  const names = Object.keys(namespace);
  return new SyntheticModule(names, function initialize() {
    for (const name of names) this.setExport(name, namespace[name]);
  });
}

async function loadAssemblyCoreOwner({ calls }) {
  const source = await readFile(assemblyUrl, "utf8");
  const module = new SourceTextModule(source, {
    identifier: assemblyUrl.href,
    initializeImportMeta(meta) { meta.url = assemblyUrl.href; }
  });
  const unexpected = (name) => (...args) => {
    calls.push(Object.freeze({ name, args }));
    throw new Error(`unexpected assembly core owner call: ${name}`);
  };
  await module.link(async (specifier) => {
    if (specifier === "node:fs/promises") return syntheticNamespace({ readFile: unexpected("readFile") });
    if (specifier === "node:path") return syntheticNamespace({ resolve: unexpected("resolve") });
    if (specifier === "node:url") return syntheticNamespace({ pathToFileURL });
    if (specifier === "./control-plane-github-evidence.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        canonicalizeApprovalHistory: unexpected("canonicalizeApprovalHistory"),
        readCurrentMaster: unexpected("readCurrentMaster"),
        readEnvironmentPolicy: unexpected("readEnvironmentPolicy"),
        resolveExpectedReviewerApproval: unexpected("resolveExpectedReviewerApproval"),
        readWorkflowApprovalHistory: unexpected("readWorkflowApprovalHistory")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/github-attestation-verifier.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings:
          unexpected("validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH: "ops/control-plane-deploy/main-source-identity.json",
        resolveMainSourceIdentity: unexpected("resolveMainSourceIdentity")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-artifact-publication-authorization.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        buildArtifactPublicationApprovalEvidence:
          unexpected("buildArtifactPublicationApprovalEvidence"),
        buildArtifactPublicationAuthorization: unexpected("buildArtifactPublicationAuthorization"),
        validateArtifactPublicationAuthorization:
          unexpected("validateArtifactPublicationAuthorization")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-compatibility-publication-receipt.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        createCompatibilityPublicationReceipt: unexpected("createCompatibilityPublicationReceipt"),
        validateCompatibilityPublicationReceipt:
          unexpected("validateCompatibilityPublicationReceipt")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        parseCanonicalJsonBytes: unexpected("parseCanonicalJsonBytes"),
        serializeCanonicalJsonBytes: unexpected("serializeCanonicalJsonBytes"),
        sha256Hex: unexpected("sha256Hex")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/bounded-zip.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({ inspectBoundedZip: unexpected("inspectBoundedZip") });
    }
    if (specifier === "../server/services/deployment/writer-registry.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        WRITER_REGISTRY_CONTRACT: Object.freeze({ owner: "synthetic-unreachable-contract" }),
        discoverProductionWriters: unexpected("discoverProductionWriters"),
        canonicalizeWriterRegistry: unexpected("canonicalizeWriterRegistry"),
        verifyWriterRegistry: unexpected("verifyWriterRegistry")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "./artifact-git-tree-verifier.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes: unexpected("verifyArtifactGitTreeBytes")
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "./control-plane-publication-envelope.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER: nonReceiptFiles,
        createPublicationEnvelope: unexpected("createPublicationEnvelope"),
        verifyPublicationEnvelope: unexpected("verifyPublicationEnvelope")
      });
    }
    throw new Error(`unlisted assembly core import: ${specifier}`);
  });
  await module.evaluate();
  return module.namespace;
}

async function loadAdapterOwner({ calls, assembled }) {
  const source = await readFile(adapterUrl, "utf8");
  const module = new SourceTextModule(source, { identifier: adapterUrl.href });
  await module.link(async (specifier) => {
    if (specifier === "node:fs") return syntheticNamespace({ constants });
    if (specifier === "node:fs/promises") return syntheticNamespace(fsPromises);
    if (specifier === "node:path") return syntheticNamespace(pathOwner);
    if (specifier === "./canonical-json.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({ parseCanonicalJsonBytes, serializeCanonicalJsonBytes, sha256Hex });
    }
    if (specifier === "./control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH: "ops/control-plane-deploy/main-source-identity.json",
        async resolveMainSourceIdentity(input) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({ name: "resolveMainSourceIdentity", token: input.token }));
          return Object.freeze({
            sha256: "1".repeat(64),
            value: Object.freeze({
              mainSourcePrNumber: 17,
              mainSourceHeadSha: "b".repeat(40),
              mainSourceMergeCommitSha: "c".repeat(40)
            })
          });
        }
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "./control-plane-inventory-receipt.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        async resolveInventoryReceipt(input) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({ name: "resolveInventoryReceipt", token: input.token }));
          return Object.freeze({
            sha256: "7".repeat(64),
            receipt: Object.freeze({
              sourceCommit: "a".repeat(40),
              runtimeContractId: "linux-amd64-glibc-node-127",
              createdAt: "2026-08-08T10:32:00.000Z",
              bootstrapReceiptSha256: assembled.bootstrapReceipt
            })
          });
        }
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "./control-plane-compatibility-inventory-receipt.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        async resolveCompatibilityInventoryReceipt(input) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({
            name: "resolveCompatibilityInventoryReceipt",
            token: input.token
          }));
          return Object.freeze({
            sha256: "7".repeat(64),
            receipt: Object.freeze({
              sourceCommit: "a".repeat(40),
              runtimeContractId: "linux-amd64-glibc-node-127",
              createdAt: "2026-08-08T10:32:00.000Z",
              stagedHostBundleContentReceiptSha256: assembled.hostReceipt
            })
          });
        }
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../../../scripts/control-plane-foundation-toolchain-lock.mjs") {
      const verified = Object.freeze({ owner: "foundation-toolchain" });
      return syntheticNamespace({
        resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain(input) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({ name: "resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain" }));
          assert.equal(input.lockBytes.toString("utf8"), "lock");
          assert.equal(input.immutablePublicationEvidence.toString("utf8"), "evidence");
          return verified;
        },
        assertVerifiedFoundationToolchain(value) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({ name: "assertVerifiedFoundationToolchain" }));
          assert.equal(value, verified);
          return value;
        }
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../../../scripts/control-plane-release-declaration.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({
        validateReleaseDeclarationBytes({ bytes, expectedSourceCommit }) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({ name: "validateReleaseDeclarationBytes" }));
          const declaration = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, testReleaseDeclarationContract);
          assert.equal(declaration.sourceCommit, expectedSourceCommit);
          return Object.freeze({
            declaration,
            databaseContractsSha256: "4".repeat(64),
            sha256: sha256Hex(bytes)
          });
        },
        validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity({ declaration, validatedMainSourceIdentity }) {
          calls.push(Object.freeze({ name: "validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity" }));
          assert.equal(declaration.mainSourceIdentitySha256, validatedMainSourceIdentity.sha256);
          assert.equal(declaration.mainSourcePrNumber,
            validatedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber);
          assert.equal(declaration.mainSourceHeadSha,
            validatedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha);
          assert.equal(declaration.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
            validatedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha);
          return declaration;
        }
      });
    }
    if (specifier === "../../../scripts/control-plane-publication-envelope.mjs") {
      return syntheticNamespace({ PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER: nonReceiptFiles });
    }
    throw new Error(`unlisted adapter import: ${specifier}`);
  });
  await module.evaluate();
  return module.namespace;
}

    : `cig1.${sourceCommit}.linux-amd64-glibc-node-127.${"7".repeat(64)}`;
  const sourceArchiveBytes = Buffer.from("tar", "utf8");
  const gitTreeManifestBytes = Buffer.from("tree", "utf8");

    schema: "control_plane_source_transfer_v1",
    sourceCommit,
    sourceArchiveSha256: sha256Hex(sourceArchiveBytes),

  await Promise.all([
    writeFile(pathOwner.join(sourceInput, "source-transfer.json"), Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(transfer))),
    writeFile(pathOwner.join(sourceInput, "source.tar"), sourceArchiveBytes),
    writeFile(pathOwner.join(sourceInput, "git-tree.manifest"), gitTreeManifestBytes),
    writeFile(pathOwner.join(checkout, "ops/control-plane-deploy/main-source-identity.json"), "{}"),
    writeFile(pathOwner.join(foundation, "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json"), "lock"),
    writeFile(pathOwner.join(foundation, "immutable-publication-evidence.json"), "evidence"),
    writeFile(githubOutput, "")
  ]);
  const artifactBytes = Buffer.from("not-a-valid-self-referential-outer-assembly", "utf8");
  const releaseDeclaration = Object.freeze({

    mainSourcePrNumber: 17,
    mainSourceHeadSha: "b".repeat(40),
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: "c".repeat(40),
    runtimeContractId: "linux-amd64-glibc-node-127",
    deploymentMode: publicationMode,
    automatedDeploymentEligible: publicationMode === "normal",
    artifactFileName: "control-plane-app.zip",
    artifactSha256: sha256Hex(artifactBytes),
    artifactSizeBytes: artifactBytes.length,
    bootstrapReceiptSha256: bootstrapReceipt,
    hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: hostReceipt
  });
  const releaseDeclarationBytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(
    releaseDeclaration,
    testReleaseDeclarationContract
  );
  for (const name of nonReceiptFiles) {
    const bytes = name === "control-plane-app.zip" ? artifactBytes
      : name === "artifact.json"
        ? Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify({
          schemaVersion: "1",
          releaseUnit: "control-plane-app",
          sourceCommit,
          release: `${publicationMode === "normal" ? "control-plane-app" : "control-plane-compatibility"}-${sourceCommit}-linux-amd64-glibc-node-127`,
          artifact: {
            fileName: "control-plane-app.zip",
            sha256: sha256Hex(artifactBytes),
            sizeBytes: artifactBytes.length,
            createdAt: "2026-08-08T10:32:00.000Z"
          }
        }, null, 2)}\n`)
        : name === "release-declaration.json" ? releaseDeclarationBytes : Buffer.from(name);

  const owner = await loadAdapterOwner({
    calls,

      bootstrapReceipt,
      releaseDeclaration

    root, sourceInput, builderOutput, checkout, foundation, output, githubOutput,

      "builder-output": builderOutput,

        pathOwner.join(foundation, "immutable-publication-evidence.json"),
      "output": output,
      "github-output": githubOutput
    })
  });
}

test("both modes stop before any receipt, envelope, or output", async (t) => {
  for (const publicationMode of ["normal", "compatibility_bootstrap"]) {
    const fixture = await adapterFixture(t, publicationMode);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(fixture.owner), ["createArtifactAssemblyCliOperations"]);
    assert.equal(fixture.owner.createArtifactAssemblyCliOperations.length, 0);
    const operations = fixture.owner.createArtifactAssemblyCliOperations();
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(operations), ["verify", "writeExactGithubOutput", "serializeSafeResult"]);
    assert.equal(Object.isFrozen(operations), true);
    await assert.rejects(() => operations.verify(Object.freeze({
      flags: fixture.flags,
      token: "synthetic-owner-token",
      githubOutputPath: fixture.githubOutput
    })), /artifact_assembly_verification_owner_unavailable/);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.calls.map(({ name }) => name), [
      "resolveMainSourceIdentity",
      publicationMode === "normal" ? "resolveInventoryReceipt" : "resolveCompatibilityInventoryReceipt",
      "resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain", "assertVerifiedFoundationToolchain",
      "validateReleaseDeclarationBytes", "validateReleaseDeclarationMainSourceIdentity"
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.calls.slice(0, 2).map(({ token }) => token), [
      "synthetic-owner-token", "synthetic-owner-token"
    ]);
    await assert.rejects(() => operations.writeExactGithubOutput({ result: Object.freeze({}) }),
      /github_output_invalid/);
    assert.throws(() => operations.serializeSafeResult(Object.freeze({})), /safe_result_invalid/);
    assert.equal(await readFile(fixture.githubOutput, "utf8"), "");
    await assert.rejects(() => fsPromises.lstat(fixture.output), /ENOENT/);
  }
});

test("assembly core stops before inspecting input or calling any publication owner", async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const owner = await loadAssemblyCoreOwner({ calls });
  const observations = [];
  const input = new Proxy(Object.create(null), {
    get(_target, key) { observations.push(`get:${String(key)}`); return undefined; },
    getOwnPropertyDescriptor(_target, key) {
      observations.push(`descriptor:${String(key)}`);
      return undefined;
    },
    ownKeys() { observations.push("ownKeys"); return []; }
  });
  assert.throws(
    () => owner.assembleVerifiedArtifactPublication(input),
    /^Error: artifact_assembly_verification_owner_unavailable$/
  );
  assert.deepEqual(observations, []);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, []);
});

});
```

```js
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import {
  canonicalizeApprovalHistory,
  readCurrentMaster,
  readEnvironmentPolicy,
  resolveExpectedReviewerApproval,
  readWorkflowApprovalHistory
} from "./control-plane-github-evidence.mjs";
import { validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings } from "../server/services/deployment/github-attestation-verifier.mjs";
import {
  MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH,
  resolveMainSourceIdentity
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";
import {
  buildArtifactPublicationApprovalEvidence,
  buildArtifactPublicationAuthorization,
  validateArtifactPublicationAuthorization
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-artifact-publication-authorization.mjs";
import {
  createCompatibilityPublicationReceipt,
  validateCompatibilityPublicationReceipt
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-compatibility-publication-receipt.mjs";
import { sha256Hex } from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import {
  PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER,
  createPublicationEnvelope,
  verifyPublicationEnvelope
} from "./control-plane-publication-envelope.mjs";

const ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_ASSEMBLY_INPUT_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "publicationMode", "sourceCommit", "runtimeContractId", "validatedMainSourceIdentity",
  "inventory", "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256", "releaseDeclaration", "artifactSha256",
  "publicationFiles"
]);

function assertExactArtifactPublicationAssemblyInput(input) {
  if (input === null || typeof input !== "object" || Array.isArray(input)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_input_invalid");
  }
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(input);
  if (keys.length !== ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_ASSEMBLY_INPUT_FIELDS.length
    || keys.some((key, index) => key !== ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_ASSEMBLY_INPUT_FIELDS[index])
    || !["normal", "compatibility_bootstrap"].includes(input.publicationMode)
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(input.sourceCommit ?? "")
    || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/.test(input.runtimeContractId ?? "")
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.inventory?.sha256 ?? "")
    || input.inventory.receipt?.sourceCommit !== input.sourceCommit
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.releaseDeclaration?.sha256 ?? "")
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.releaseDeclaration?.bytes)
    || sha256Hex(input.releaseDeclaration.bytes) !== input.releaseDeclaration.sha256
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.artifactSha256 ?? "")
    || !(input.publicationFiles instanceof Map)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_input_invalid");
  }
}

export function assembleVerifiedArtifactPublication(input) {
  // Current executable boundary: Task 3/4 still require a separately approved
  // non-self-referential subject contract. Preserve the proposed body below only
  // as dormant review text; no caller can reach a receipt or envelope today.
  throw new Error("artifact_assembly_verification_owner_unavailable");
  assertExactArtifactPublicationAssemblyInput(input);
  const publicationFiles = new Map();
  for (const name of PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER) {
    const bytes = input.publicationFiles.get(name);
    if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1) {
      throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_input_invalid");
    }
    publicationFiles.set(name, Buffer.from(bytes));
  }
  if (input.publicationFiles.size !== PUBLICATION_NON_RECEIPT_FILE_ORDER.length
    || !publicationFiles.get("release-declaration.json").equals(input.releaseDeclaration.bytes)
    || sha256Hex(publicationFiles.get("control-plane-app.zip")) !== input.artifactSha256) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_input_invalid");
  }
  const mainSourceIdentity = input.validatedMainSourceIdentity;
  if (mainSourceIdentity === null || typeof mainSourceIdentity !== "object"
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(mainSourceIdentity.sha256 ?? "")
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(mainSourceIdentity.value?.mainSourcePrNumber)
    || mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha ?? "")
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha ?? "")) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_identity_invalid");
  }

  let productionGateReceiptSha256 = null;
  let compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 = null;
  let compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 = null;
  let lastAssetName;
  let lastAssetBytes;
  if (input.publicationMode === "normal") {
    // A legal normal Gate also needs an owner-produced deployment-plan stable body/template digest.
    // No such declaration+inventory projection owner is approved in this revision.
    throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
  } else {
    if (input.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256
        !== input.inventory.receipt.stagedHostBundleContentReceiptSha256
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 ?? "")) {
      throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_mode_invalid");
    }
    const created = createCompatibilityPublicationReceipt({
      sourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
      runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
      compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventory.sha256,
      hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: input.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256,
      releaseDeclarationSha256: input.releaseDeclaration.sha256,
      artifactSha256: input.artifactSha256,
      createdAt: input.inventory.receipt.createdAt
    });
    const validated = validateCompatibilityPublicationReceipt({
      bytes: created.bytes,
      expected: Object.freeze({
        sourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
        runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
        compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventory.sha256,
        hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: input.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256,
        releaseDeclarationSha256: input.releaseDeclaration.sha256,
        artifactSha256: input.artifactSha256
      })
    });
    if (validated.createdAt !== input.inventory.receipt.createdAt
      || sha256Hex(created.bytes) !== created.sha256
      || created.assetName !== `compatibility-publication-${created.sha256}.json`) {
      throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_compatibility_receipt_invalid");
    }
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 = input.inventory.sha256;
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 = created.sha256;
    lastAssetName = created.assetName;
    lastAssetBytes = created.bytes;
  }
  publicationFiles.set(lastAssetName, Buffer.from(lastAssetBytes));
  const envelope = createPublicationEnvelope({
    publicationMode: input.publicationMode,
    tag: `${input.publicationMode === "normal" ? "control-plane-app" : "control-plane-compatibility"}-${input.sourceCommit}-${input.runtimeContractId}`,
    targetCommit: input.sourceCommit,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: mainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventory.sha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
    files: publicationFiles
  });
  const verifiedEnvelope = verifyPublicationEnvelope({
    bytes: envelope.bytes,
    files: publicationFiles,
    publicationMode: input.publicationMode
  });
  if (verifiedEnvelope.assetOrder.at(-1) !== lastAssetName
    || verifiedEnvelope.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== productionGateReceiptSha256
    || verifiedEnvelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
      !== compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_assembly_envelope_invalid");
  }
  const safeResult = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_artifact_assembly_safe_result_v1",
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    publicationMode: input.publicationMode,
    sourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
    runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventory.sha256,
    artifactSha256: input.artifactSha256,
    publicationEnvelopeSha256: envelope.sha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
  });
  return Object.freeze({ publicationFiles, envelope, safeResult });
}

function parseArtifactAssemblyFlags(tokens) {
  const expected = Object.freeze([
    "source-input", "builder-output", "trusted-checkout", "expected-source-commit",
    "foundation-toolchain-lock-file", "foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file",
    "output", "github-output"
  ]);
  if (!Array.isArray(tokens) || tokens.length !== expected.length * 2) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_flags_invalid");
  }
  const flags = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const flag = tokens[index];
    const value = tokens[index + 1];
    const expectedName = expected[index / 2];
    if (flag !== `--${expectedName}` || Object.hasOwn(flags, expectedName)
      || typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.startsWith("--")) {
      throw new Error("artifact_assembly_flags_invalid");
    }
    flags[expectedName] = value;
  }
  if (expected.some((name) => !Object.hasOwn(flags, name))) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_flags_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(flags);
}

export async function runArtifactAssemblyCli({ argv, env, stdout }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation !== "verify") throw new Error("artifact_assembly_operation_invalid");
  const flags = parseArtifactAssemblyFlags(tokens);
  if (typeof env.GITHUB_TOKEN !== "string" || env.GITHUB_TOKEN.length < 1
    || typeof env.GITHUB_OUTPUT !== "string" || env.GITHUB_OUTPUT.length < 1) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_github_token_missing");
  }
  const { createArtifactAssemblyCliOperations } = await import(
    "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-artifact-assembly-cli-adapter.mjs"
  );
  const operations = createArtifactAssemblyCliOperations();
  const result = await operations.verify(Object.freeze({
    flags,
    token: env.GITHUB_TOKEN,
    githubOutputPath: env.GITHUB_OUTPUT
  }));
  await operations.writeExactGithubOutput({ result });
  const safeBytes = operations.serializeSafeResult(result);
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(safeBytes) || safeBytes.length < 1 || safeBytes.length > 4_096
    || safeBytes.includes(0x0a) || safeBytes.includes(0x0d)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_assembly_safe_result_invalid");
  }
  stdout.write(`${safeBytes.toString("utf8")}\n`);
  return 0;
}

export async function main({
  argv = process.argv.slice(2),
  env = process.env,
  stdout = process.stdout,
  stderr = process.stderr
} = {}) {
  try {
    process.exitCode = await runArtifactAssemblyCli({
      argv,
      env,
      stdout
    });
  } catch {
    stderr.write("artifact_assembly_failed\n");
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  await main();
}

export function validateFixedPublisherInput({ verifiedPublication, expected }) {
  const envelope = verifyPublicationEnvelope({
    bytes: verifiedPublication.envelopeBytes,
    files: verifiedPublication.files,
    publicationMode: expected.publicationMode
  });
  const approval = validateArtifactPublicationAuthorization({
    bytes: verifiedPublication.authorizationBytes,
    approvalEvidenceBytes: verifiedPublication.approvalEvidenceBytes,
    envelopeBytes: verifiedPublication.envelopeBytes,
    files: verifiedPublication.files,
    expected: Object.freeze({
      repository: expected.repository,
      environment: expected.environment,
      publicationMode: expected.publicationMode,
      sourceSha: expected.sourceSha,
      runId: expected.runId,
      runAttempt: expected.runAttempt,
      mainSourceIdentitySha256: expected.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
      mainSourcePrNumber: expected.mainSourcePrNumber,
      mainSourceHeadSha: expected.mainSourceHeadSha,
      mainSourceMergeCommitSha: expected.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
      actorIdentitySha256: expected.actorIdentitySha256,
      triggeringActorIdentitySha256: expected.triggeringActorIdentitySha256,
      reviewerIdentitySha256: expected.reviewerIdentitySha256,
      environmentPolicySha256: expected.environmentPolicySha256,
      approvalHistorySha256: expected.approvalHistorySha256
    }),
    now: expected.now
  });
  const predicate = validateExactPublicationPredicateBindings({
    predicateType: "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1",
    predicateBindings: Object.freeze({
      schema: "control_plane_publication_attestation_v1",
      repository: approval.value.repository,
      sourceSha: approval.value.sourceSha,
      workflowPath: expected.workflowPath,
      workflowRef: expected.workflowRef,
      workflowSha: approval.value.sourceSha,
      publicationMode: approval.value.publicationMode,
      publicationEnvelopeSha256: approval.value.publicationEnvelopeSha256,
      inventoryReceiptSha256: approval.value.inventoryReceiptSha256,
      productionGateReceiptSha256: approval.value.productionGateReceiptSha256,
      compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: approval.value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
      compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256:
        approval.value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
    })
  });
  if (!predicate.bytes.equals(verifiedPublication.predicateBytes)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_predicate_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ envelope, approval, predicate });
}

export async function runArtifactPublicationApprovalCheck(input) {
  if (input.environment !== "artifact-publication" || input.runIdentity.runAttempt !== 1) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_approval_identity_invalid");
  }
  const identityBytes = await readFile(resolve(input.trustedCheckout, MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH));
  const mainSourceIdentity = await resolveMainSourceIdentity({
    bytes: identityBytes,
    expectedSourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn
  });
  const [master, policy, approvals] = await Promise.all([
    readCurrentMaster(input),
    readEnvironmentPolicy(input),
    readWorkflowApprovalHistory(input)
  ]);
  const approvalHistory = canonicalizeApprovalHistory(approvals);
  const approvers = approvalHistory.value.approvals.filter((row) => row.environments.length === 1
    && row.environments[0] === "artifact-publication")
    .map(({ login, id }) => Object.freeze({ login, id }));
  if (master.sourceCommit !== input.sourceCommit
    || policy.value.preventSelfReview !== true
    || policy.value.protectedBranches !== true
    || policy.value.customBranchPolicies !== false
    || policy.value.adminBypassAllowed !== false
    || policy.value.reviewers.length < 1
    || approvers.length !== 1
    || approvers[0].login === input.runIdentity.actor.toLowerCase()
    || approvers[0].login === input.runIdentity.triggeringActor.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_approval_invalid");
  }
  const resolvedReviewer = await resolveExpectedReviewerApproval({
    ...input,
    policy: policy.value,
    approver: approvers[0].login,
    approverId: approvers[0].id
  });
  const [confirmedPolicy, confirmedMaster, confirmedIdentityBytes] = await Promise.all([
    readEnvironmentPolicy(input),
    readCurrentMaster(input),
    readFile(resolve(input.trustedCheckout, MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH))
  ]);
  if (!confirmedPolicy.bytes.equals(policy.bytes)
    || confirmedMaster.sourceCommit !== input.sourceCommit) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_approval_policy_drift");
  }
  const confirmedMainSourceIdentity = await resolveMainSourceIdentity({
    bytes: confirmedIdentityBytes,
    expectedSourceCommit: confirmedMaster.sourceCommit,
    token: input.token,
    fetchFn: input.fetchFn
  });
  if (confirmedMainSourceIdentity.sha256 !== mainSourceIdentity.sha256) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_approval_main_source_identity_drift");
  }
  const confirmedReviewer = await resolveExpectedReviewerApproval({
    ...input,
    policy: confirmedPolicy.value,
    approver: approvers[0].login,
    approverId: approvers[0].id
  });
  if (confirmedReviewer.identitySha256 !== resolvedReviewer.identitySha256) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_approval_policy_drift");
  }
  const actorIdentitySha256 = sha256Hex(Buffer.from(input.runIdentity.actor, "utf8"));
  const triggeringActorIdentitySha256 = sha256Hex(
    Buffer.from(input.runIdentity.triggeringActor, "utf8")
  );
  const approvalEvidence = buildArtifactPublicationApprovalEvidence({
    sourceSha: input.sourceCommit,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runId: String(input.runIdentity.runId),
    actorIdentitySha256,
    triggeringActorIdentitySha256,
    environmentPolicySha256: confirmedPolicy.sha256,
    approvalHistorySha256: approvalHistory.sha256,
    reviewerIdentitySha256: confirmedReviewer.identitySha256,
    createdAt: input.now
  });
  const finalized = input.operations.finalizeVerifiedPublicationLocally({
    inputDirectory: input.inputDirectory,
    approvalEvidenceBytes: approvalEvidence.bytes,
    artifactPublicationApprovalSha256: approvalEvidence.sha256,
    validatedMainSourceIdentity: confirmedMainSourceIdentity
  });
  const authorization = buildArtifactPublicationAuthorization({
    approvalEvidenceBytes: approvalEvidence.bytes,
    publicationEnvelopeSha256: finalized.envelopeSha256,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: finalized.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: finalized.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: finalized.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256:
      finalized.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
    publicationMode: finalized.publicationMode,
    sourceSha: input.sourceCommit,
    runId: String(input.runIdentity.runId),
    runAttempt: 1,
    createdAt: input.now,
    expiresAt: finalized.expiresAt
  });
  validateArtifactPublicationAuthorization({
    bytes: authorization.bytes,
    approvalEvidenceBytes: approvalEvidence.bytes,
    envelopeBytes: finalized.envelopeBytes,
    files: finalized.files,
    expected: Object.freeze({
      repository: input.repository,
      environment: input.environment,
      publicationMode: finalized.publicationMode,
      sourceSha: input.sourceCommit,
      runId: String(input.runIdentity.runId),
      runAttempt: 1,
      mainSourceIdentitySha256: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.sha256,
      mainSourcePrNumber: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
      mainSourceHeadSha: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
      mainSourceMergeCommitSha: confirmedMainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
      actorIdentitySha256,
      triggeringActorIdentitySha256,
      reviewerIdentitySha256: confirmedReviewer.identitySha256,
      environmentPolicySha256: confirmedPolicy.sha256,
      approvalHistorySha256: approvalHistory.sha256
    }),
    now: input.now
  });
  input.operations.writeAuthorizedPublicationLocally({ finalized, approvalEvidence, authorization });
  return Object.freeze({
    approvalEvidenceSha256: approvalEvidence.sha256,
    publicationAuthorizationSha256: authorization.sha256,
    publicationEnvelopeSha256: finalized.envelopeSha256,
    outputDirectory: input.outputDirectory
  });
}
```

```js
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "./canonical-json.mjs";
import { verifyPublicationEnvelope } from "../../../scripts/control-plane-publication-envelope.mjs";

const PUBLICATION_SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const PUBLICATION_SOURCE_SHA = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const PUBLICATION_RUN_ID = /^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/;
const PUBLICATION_CANONICAL_UTC = /^[0-9]{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])T(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]\.[0-9]{3}Z$/;
const APPROVAL_LIFETIME_MS = 300_000;
const ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION_EXPECTED_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "repository", "environment", "publicationMode", "sourceSha", "runId", "runAttempt",
  "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha",
  "mainSourceMergeCommitSha", "actorIdentitySha256", "triggeringActorIdentitySha256",
  "reviewerIdentitySha256", "environmentPolicySha256", "approvalHistorySha256"
]);
const EXPECTED_SHA256_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "actorIdentitySha256", "triggeringActorIdentitySha256",
  "reviewerIdentitySha256", "environmentPolicySha256", "approvalHistorySha256"
]);

function isSha256(value) {
  return typeof value === "string" && PUBLICATION_SHA256.test(value);
}

function isSourceSha(value) {
  return typeof value === "string" && PUBLICATION_SOURCE_SHA.test(value);
}

function isRunId(value) {
  return typeof value === "string" && PUBLICATION_RUN_ID.test(value);
}

function parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(value, errorCode) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !PUBLICATION_CANONICAL_UTC.test(value)) {
    throw new Error(errorCode);
  }
  const milliseconds = Date.parse(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(milliseconds) || new Date(milliseconds).toISOString() !== value) {
    throw new Error(errorCode);
  }
  return milliseconds;
}

function formatCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(milliseconds, errorCode) {
  let value;
  try {
    value = new Date(milliseconds).toISOString();
  } catch {
    throw new Error(errorCode);
  }
  if (!PUBLICATION_CANONICAL_UTC.test(value) || Date.parse(value) !== milliseconds) {
    throw new Error(errorCode);
  }
  return value;
}

function assertExactAuthorizationExpected(expected) {
  if (expected === null || typeof expected !== "object" || Array.isArray(expected)) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_authorization_expected_invalid");
  }
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(expected);
  if (keys.length !== ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION_EXPECTED_FIELDS.length
    || keys.some((key, index) => key !== ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION_EXPECTED_FIELDS[index])
    || expected.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
    || expected.environment !== "artifact-publication"
    || !["normal", "compatibility_bootstrap"].includes(expected.publicationMode)
    || !isSourceSha(expected.sourceSha)
    || !isRunId(expected.runId) || expected.runAttempt !== 1
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(expected.mainSourcePrNumber) || expected.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
    || !isSourceSha(expected.mainSourceHeadSha)
    || !isSourceSha(expected.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
    || EXPECTED_SHA256_FIELDS.some((key) => !isSha256(expected[key]))) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_authorization_expected_invalid");
  }
  return expected;
}

export const ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-artifact-publication-approval-evidence-v1",
  maxBytes: 16_384,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schema", "repository", "environment", "sourceSha", "mainSourceIdentitySha256",
    "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha", "mainSourceMergeCommitSha", "runId", "runAttempt",
    "actorIdentitySha256", "triggeringActorIdentitySha256", "reviewerIdentitySha256",
    "environmentPolicySha256", "approvalHistorySha256", "createdAt", "expiresAt"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    const createdAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
      value.createdAt,
      "artifact_publication_approval_evidence_invalid"
    );
    const expiresAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
      value.expiresAt,
      "artifact_publication_approval_evidence_invalid"
    );
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_artifact_publication_approval_evidence_v1"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || value.environment !== "artifact-publication"
      || !isSourceSha(value.sourceSha)
      || !isSha256(value.mainSourceIdentitySha256)
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.mainSourcePrNumber) || value.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
      || !isSourceSha(value.mainSourceHeadSha)
      || !isSourceSha(value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
      || !isRunId(value.runId) || value.runAttempt !== 1
      || !isSha256(value.actorIdentitySha256)
      || !isSha256(value.triggeringActorIdentitySha256)
      || !isSha256(value.reviewerIdentitySha256)
      || !isSha256(value.environmentPolicySha256)
      || !isSha256(value.approvalHistorySha256)
      || expiresAtMilliseconds - createdAtMilliseconds !== APPROVAL_LIFETIME_MS) {
      throw new Error("artifact_publication_approval_evidence_invalid");
    }
  }
});

export function buildArtifactPublicationApprovalEvidence(input) {
  const createdAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    input.createdAt,
    "artifact_publication_approval_evidence_invalid"
  );
  const expiresAt = formatCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    createdAtMilliseconds + APPROVAL_LIFETIME_MS,
    "artifact_publication_approval_evidence_invalid"
  );
  const value = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_artifact_publication_approval_evidence_v1",
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    environment: "artifact-publication",
    sourceSha: input.sourceSha,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: input.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: input.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: input.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: input.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    runId: input.runId,
    runAttempt: 1,
    actorIdentitySha256: input.actorIdentitySha256,
    triggeringActorIdentitySha256: input.triggeringActorIdentitySha256,
    reviewerIdentitySha256: input.reviewerIdentitySha256,
    environmentPolicySha256: input.environmentPolicySha256,
    approvalHistorySha256: input.approvalHistorySha256,
    createdAt: input.createdAt,
    expiresAt
  });
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT);
  return Object.freeze({ value, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) });
}

export const ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-artifact-publication-authorization-v1",
  maxBytes: 16_384,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schema", "approvalEvidenceSha256", "publicationEnvelopeSha256",
    "inventoryReceiptSha256", "productionGateReceiptSha256",
    "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256", "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256",
    "publicationMode", "repository",
    "sourceSha", "runId", "runAttempt", "createdAt", "expiresAt"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    const normal = value.publicationMode === "normal"
      && isSha256(value.productionGateReceiptSha256)
      && value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 === null
      && value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 === null;
    const compatibility = value.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap"
      && value.productionGateReceiptSha256 === null
      && isSha256(value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256)
      && isSha256(value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256);
    const createdAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
      value.createdAt,
      "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
    );
    const expiresAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
      value.expiresAt,
      "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
    );
    if (value.schema !== "control_plane_artifact_publication_authorization_v1"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || !isSha256(value.approvalEvidenceSha256)
      || !isSha256(value.publicationEnvelopeSha256)
      || !isSha256(value.inventoryReceiptSha256)
      || !isSourceSha(value.sourceSha)
      || !isRunId(value.runId) || value.runAttempt !== 1
      || expiresAtMilliseconds <= createdAtMilliseconds
      || (!normal && !compatibility)) {
      throw new Error("artifact_publication_authorization_invalid");
    }
  }
});

export function buildArtifactPublicationAuthorization(input) {
  const approvalEvidence = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(
    input.approvalEvidenceBytes,
    ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT
  );
  const createdAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    input.createdAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const requestedExpiresAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    input.expiresAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const approvalCreatedAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    approvalEvidence.createdAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const approvalExpiresAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    approvalEvidence.expiresAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  if (approvalEvidence.sourceSha !== input.sourceSha
    || approvalEvidence.runId !== input.runId
    || approvalEvidence.runAttempt !== input.runAttempt
    || input.runAttempt !== 1
    || createdAtMilliseconds < approvalCreatedAtMilliseconds) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_authorization_invalid");
  }
  const expiresAtMilliseconds = Math.min(
    requestedExpiresAtMilliseconds,
    approvalExpiresAtMilliseconds
  );
  if (expiresAtMilliseconds <= createdAtMilliseconds) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_authorization_invalid");
  }
  const value = Object.freeze({
    schema: "control_plane_artifact_publication_authorization_v1",
    approvalEvidenceSha256: sha256Hex(input.approvalEvidenceBytes),
    publicationEnvelopeSha256: input.publicationEnvelopeSha256,
    inventoryReceiptSha256: input.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: input.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: input.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256:
      input.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
    publicationMode: input.publicationMode,
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    sourceSha: input.sourceSha,
    runId: input.runId,
    runAttempt: input.runAttempt,
    createdAt: input.createdAt,
    expiresAt: formatCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
      expiresAtMilliseconds,
      "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
    )
  });
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT);
  return Object.freeze({ value, bytes, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes) });
}

export function validateArtifactPublicationAuthorization({
  bytes,
  approvalEvidenceBytes,
  envelopeBytes,
  files,
  expected,
  now
}) {
  const exactExpected = assertExactAuthorizationExpected(expected);
  const value = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT);
  const approvalEvidence = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(
    approvalEvidenceBytes,
    ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT
  );
  const envelope = verifyPublicationEnvelope({
    bytes: envelopeBytes,
    files,
    publicationMode: exactExpected.publicationMode
  });
  const nowMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    now,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const approvalCreatedAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    approvalEvidence.createdAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const approvalExpiresAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    approvalEvidence.expiresAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const authorizationCreatedAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    value.createdAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  const authorizationExpiresAtMilliseconds = parseCanonicalUtcMilliseconds(
    value.expiresAt,
    "artifact_publication_authorization_invalid"
  );
  if (sha256Hex(approvalEvidenceBytes) !== value.approvalEvidenceSha256
    || sha256Hex(envelopeBytes) !== value.publicationEnvelopeSha256
    || envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256 !== value.inventoryReceiptSha256
    || envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== value.productionGateReceiptSha256
    || envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 !== value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256
    || envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
      !== value.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
    || envelope.publicationMode !== value.publicationMode
    || value.publicationMode !== exactExpected.publicationMode
    || envelope.repository !== value.repository
    || value.repository !== approvalEvidence.repository
    || approvalEvidence.repository !== exactExpected.repository
    || envelope.targetCommit !== value.sourceSha
    || value.sourceSha !== approvalEvidence.sourceSha
    || approvalEvidence.sourceSha !== exactExpected.sourceSha
    || approvalEvidence.environment !== exactExpected.environment
    || value.runId !== approvalEvidence.runId
    || approvalEvidence.runId !== exactExpected.runId
    || value.runAttempt !== approvalEvidence.runAttempt
    || approvalEvidence.runAttempt !== exactExpected.runAttempt
    || approvalEvidence.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
    || envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== exactExpected.mainSourceIdentitySha256
    || approvalEvidence.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
    || envelope.mainSourcePrNumber !== exactExpected.mainSourcePrNumber
    || approvalEvidence.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
    || envelope.mainSourceHeadSha !== exactExpected.mainSourceHeadSha
    || approvalEvidence.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
    || envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== exactExpected.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
    || approvalEvidence.actorIdentitySha256 !== exactExpected.actorIdentitySha256
    || approvalEvidence.triggeringActorIdentitySha256 !== exactExpected.triggeringActorIdentitySha256
    || approvalEvidence.reviewerIdentitySha256 !== exactExpected.reviewerIdentitySha256
    || approvalEvidence.environmentPolicySha256 !== exactExpected.environmentPolicySha256
    || approvalEvidence.approvalHistorySha256 !== exactExpected.approvalHistorySha256
    || approvalCreatedAtMilliseconds > authorizationCreatedAtMilliseconds
    || authorizationCreatedAtMilliseconds > nowMilliseconds
    || nowMilliseconds >= authorizationExpiresAtMilliseconds
    || authorizationExpiresAtMilliseconds > approvalExpiresAtMilliseconds) {
    throw new Error("artifact_publication_authorization_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ value, sha256: sha256Hex(bytes), envelope });
}
```
