```yaml
                  mainSourceMergeCommitSha: envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
                  runId: String(input.context.runId), runAttempt: 1,
                  actorIdentitySha256: sha256(Buffer.from(String(input.context.actor).toLowerCase())),
                  triggeringActorIdentitySha256: sha256(Buffer.from(String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase())),
                  reviewerIdentitySha256: sha256(Buffer.from(String(approved[0].user.id) + ":" + approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase())),
                  environmentPolicySha256: sha256(canonical(environment.data)),
                  approvalHistorySha256: sha256(canonical(approvals.data)), createdAt, expiresAt
                });
                const approvalBytes = canonical(approval);
                const authorization = Object.freeze({
                  schema: "control_plane_artifact_publication_authorization_v1",
                  approvalEvidenceSha256: sha256(approvalBytes), publicationEnvelopeSha256: sha256(envelopeBytes),
                  inventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256,
                  productionGateReceiptSha256: envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256,
                  compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
                  compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
                  publicationMode: envelope.publicationMode, repository, sourceSha: envelope.targetCommit,
                  runId: String(input.context.runId), runAttempt: 1, createdAt, expiresAt
                });
                write("approval-evidence.json", approvalBytes);
                write("publication-authorization.json", canonical(authorization));
                return;
              };
              if (/^authorize/.test(input.operation)) {
                const normalAuthorization = input.operation === "authorize"
                  || input.operation === "authorize_and_publish_gate_last";
                if (normalAuthorization !== normal) fail();
                await authorize();
                if (input.operation === "authorize_and_publish_gate_last"
                  || input.operation === "authorize_and_publish_compatibility_receipt_last") {
                  return runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl({
                    operation: normal
                      ? "publish_gate_last"
                      : "publish_compatibility_receipt_last",
                    fs: input.fs,
                    crypto: input.crypto,
                    github: input.github,
                    context: input.context,
                    core: input.core,
                    inputRoot: input.outputRoot
                  });
                }
                return;
              }
              const approvalBytes = read(root, "approval-evidence.json", 16_384);
              const approval = parse(approvalBytes);
              exactKeys(approval, [
                "schema", "repository", "environment", "sourceSha", "mainSourceIdentitySha256",
                "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha", "mainSourceMergeCommitSha",
                "runId", "runAttempt", "actorIdentitySha256", "triggeringActorIdentitySha256",
                "reviewerIdentitySha256", "environmentPolicySha256", "approvalHistorySha256",
                "createdAt", "expiresAt"
              ]);
              const authorization = parse(read(root, "publication-authorization.json", 16_384));
              exactKeys(authorization, [
                "schema", "approvalEvidenceSha256", "publicationEnvelopeSha256", "inventoryReceiptSha256",
                "productionGateReceiptSha256", "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256",
                "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256", "publicationMode", "repository", "sourceSha",
                "runId", "runAttempt", "createdAt", "expiresAt"
              ]);
              if (authorization.schema !== "control_plane_artifact_publication_authorization_v1"
                || authorization.approvalEvidenceSha256 !== sha256(approvalBytes)
                || authorization.publicationEnvelopeSha256 !== sha256(envelopeBytes)
                || authorization.inventoryReceiptSha256 !== envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256
                || authorization.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256
                || authorization.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 !== envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256
                || authorization.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 !== envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
                || authorization.publicationMode !== envelope.publicationMode
                || authorization.repository !== repository || authorization.sourceSha !== envelope.targetCommit
                || authorization.runId !== String(input.context.runId) || authorization.runAttempt !== 1
                || Date.now() >= Date.parse(authorization.expiresAt)) fail();
              if (approval.schema !== "control_plane_artifact_publication_approval_evidence_v1"
                || approval.repository !== repository || approval.environment !== "artifact-publication"
                || approval.sourceSha !== envelope.targetCommit
                || approval.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
                || approval.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
                || approval.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                || approval.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
                || approval.runId !== String(input.context.runId) || approval.runAttempt !== 1
                || approval.actorIdentitySha256 !== sha256(Buffer.from(String(input.context.actor).toLowerCase()))
                || approval.triggeringActorIdentitySha256 !== sha256(Buffer.from(String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()))
                || Date.now() >= Date.parse(approval.expiresAt)) fail();
              const [currentBranch, currentEnvironment, currentApprovals] = await Promise.all([
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: input.context.runId })
              ]);
              if (currentBranch.data?.commit?.sha !== envelope.targetCommit
                || currentEnvironment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
                || currentEnvironment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
                || currentEnvironment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false
                || sha256(canonical(currentEnvironment.data)) !== approval.environmentPolicySha256
                || !Array.isArray(currentApprovals.data)
                || sha256(canonical(currentApprovals.data)) !== approval.approvalHistorySha256) fail();
              const currentRequired = currentEnvironment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
              const currentApproved = currentApprovals.data.filter((row) => row.state === "approved"
                && row.environments?.length === 1 && row.environments[0]?.name === "artifact-publication");
              if (!Array.isArray(currentRequired) || currentRequired.length !== 1
                || currentRequired[0].prevent_self_review !== true
                || !Array.isArray(currentRequired[0].reviewers) || currentRequired[0].reviewers.length < 1
                || currentRequired[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"
                  || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id) || row.reviewer.id < 1
                  || typeof row.reviewer?.login !== "string"
                  || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer.login))
                || currentApproved.length !== 1 || !currentApproved[0].user?.login || !currentApproved[0].user?.id
                || currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(input.context.actor).toLowerCase()
                || currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
              const currentUser = (await api("GET /users/{username}", {
                username: currentApproved[0].user.login
              })).data;
              if (String(currentUser?.id) !== String(currentApproved[0].user.id)
                || String(currentUser?.login).toLowerCase() !== currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()
                || currentRequired[0].reviewers.filter((row) => String(row.reviewer.id) === String(currentApproved[0].user.id)
                  && row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase() === currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()).length !== 1
                || sha256(Buffer.from(String(currentApproved[0].user.id) + ":" + currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()))
                  !== approval.reviewerIdentitySha256) fail();
              const currentDeclaration = parse(rows.get("release-declaration.json").bytes);
              if (currentDeclaration.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
                || currentDeclaration.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
                || currentDeclaration.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                || currentDeclaration.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) fail();
              if (normal) {
                const currentGate = parse(rows.get(lastName).bytes);
                if (currentGate.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
                  || currentGate.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
                  || currentGate.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                  || currentGate.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) fail();
              }
              const [currentPull, currentAncestry] = await Promise.all([
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}", { pull_number: envelope.mainSourcePrNumber }),
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{basehead}", {
                  basehead: envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha + "..." + envelope.targetCommit
                })
              ]);
              if (currentPull.data?.merged !== true || currentPull.data?.base?.ref !== "master"
                || currentPull.data?.base?.repo?.full_name !== repository
                || currentPull.data?.head?.repo?.full_name !== repository
                || currentPull.data?.head?.sha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                || currentPull.data?.merge_commit_sha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
                || !["ahead", "identical"].includes(currentAncestry.data?.status)) fail();
              const readRelease = async (create) => {
                let release;
                try {
                  release = (await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}", { tag: envelope.tag })).data;
                } catch (error) {
                  if (!create || error.status !== 404) fail();
                  release = (await api("POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases", {
                    tag_name: envelope.tag, target_commitish: envelope.targetCommit,
                    name: envelope.tag, draft: false, prerelease: false
                  })).data;
                }
                const tagRef = (await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/tags/{tag}", { tag: envelope.tag })).data;
                if (!Number.isSafeInteger(release?.id) || release.target_commitish !== envelope.targetCommit
                  || tagRef?.object?.type !== "commit" || tagRef.object.sha !== envelope.targetCommit) fail();
                const assets = (await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}/assets", {
                  release_id: release.id, per_page: 100
                })).data;
                if (!Array.isArray(assets) || assets.length > fileOrder.length
                  || assets.some((asset) => !fileOrder.includes(asset.name))
                  || new Set(assets.map((asset) => asset.name)).size !== assets.length) fail();
                return Object.freeze({ release, assets });
              };
              const hasAttestation = async (row) => {
                const response = await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/attestations/{subject_digest}", {
                  subject_digest: "sha256:" + row.sha256, per_page: 100
                });
                const attestations = response.data?.attestations;
                if (!Array.isArray(attestations)) fail();
                return attestations.some(({ bundle }) => {
                  try {
                    const statement = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(bundle.dsseEnvelope.payload, "base64").toString("utf8"));
                    if (!Array.isArray(statement.subject) || statement.subject.length !== 1) return false;
                    return statement.predicateType === "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1"
                      && statement.subject[0].name === row.name
                      && statement.subject[0].digest?.sha256 === row.sha256
                      && canonical(statement.predicate).equals(predicateBytes);
                  } catch { return false; }
                });
              };
              const inspectPair = async (name, createAsset, outputName) => {
                const row = rows.get(name);
                let state = await readRelease(createAsset);
                let asset = state.assets.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
                if (asset && (asset.size !== row.size || asset.digest !== "sha256:" + row.sha256)) fail();
                if (!asset && createAsset) {
                  await api("POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}/assets", {
                    release_id: state.release.id, name, data: row.bytes,
                    headers: { "content-type": "application/octet-stream", "content-length": row.size }
                  });
                  state = await readRelease(false);
                  asset = state.assets.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
                  if (!asset || asset.size !== row.size || asset.digest !== "sha256:" + row.sha256) fail();
                }
                const attested = asset ? await hasAttestation(row) : false;
                if (outputName) input.core.setOutput(outputName, attested ? "false" : "true");
                return asset && attested;
              };
              const requireNonGate = async () => {
                if (!await inspectPair("control-plane-app.zip", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("artifact.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("writer-registry.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("release-declaration.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("release-assembly.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("dependency-build-receipt.json", false)) fail();
              };
              if (input.operation === "publish_non_gate") {
                await inspectPair("control-plane-app.zip", true, "attest_control_plane_app");
                await inspectPair("artifact.json", true, "attest_artifact");
                await inspectPair("writer-registry.json", true, "attest_writer_registry");
                await inspectPair("release-declaration.json", true, "attest_release_declaration");
                await inspectPair("release-assembly.json", true, "attest_release_assembly");
                await inspectPair("dependency-build-receipt.json", true, "attest_dependency_build_receipt");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "publish_gate_last") {
                if (!normal) fail();
                await requireNonGate();
                await inspectPair(lastName, true, "attest_production_gate");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "publish_compatibility_receipt_last") {
                if (!compatibility) fail();
                await requireNonGate();
                await inspectPair(lastName, true, "attest_compatibility_publication_receipt");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "verify_complete") {
                await requireNonGate();
                if (!await inspectPair(lastName, false)) fail();
                return;
              }
              fail();
            }
            // Literal closed implementation is repeated byte-for-byte from the authorize
            // step. Six literal calls, not a loop, inspect one exact pair each; they upload
            // only a missing exact asset and set one fixed attest_* boolean only when that
            // pair's attestation half is missing.
            await runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl({ operation: "publish_non_gate", fs, crypto, github, context, core, inputRoot: process.env.AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION });
      - name: Attest control-plane-app.zip
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_control_plane_app == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/control-plane-app.zip
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest artifact.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_artifact == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/artifact.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest writer-registry.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_writer_registry == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/writer-registry.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest release-declaration.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_release_declaration == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/release-declaration.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest release-assembly.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_release_assembly == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/release-assembly.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest dependency-build-receipt.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_dependency_build_receipt == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/dependency-build-receipt.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json

  publication-non-gate-verify:
    needs: [source-prepare, verify, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
      - name: Require the unavailable full-Sigstore owner before any Gate authority
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          node scripts/control-plane-github-evidence.mjs verify-artifact-publication \
            --verified-publication "${RUNNER_TEMP}/verified-publication" \
            --expected-source-commit "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
            --publication-mode normal \
            --publication-stage non_gate

  publish-gate-last:
    needs: [source-prepare, verify, publication-non-gate-verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: artifact-publication
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fail = () => { throw new Error("artifact_publication_step0_recheck_invalid"); };
            const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
            const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
            if (context.ref !== "refs/heads/master" || context.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || Number(context.runAttempt) !== 1) fail();
            const api = (route, parameters = {}) => github.request(route, { owner, repo, ...parameters });
            const [branch, environment, approvals] = await Promise.all([
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: context.runId })
            ]);
            const required = environment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
            const approved = (Array.isArray(approvals.data) ? approvals.data : []).filter((row) =>
              row.state === "approved" && row.environments?.length === 1
              && row.environments[0]?.name === "artifact-publication");
            if (branch.data?.commit?.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
              || environment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false
              || !Array.isArray(required) || required.length !== 1 || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true
              || !Array.isArray(required[0].reviewers) || required[0].reviewers.length < 1
              || required[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"
                || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id) || row.reviewer.id < 1
                || typeof row.reviewer?.login !== "string"
                || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer.login))
              || approved.length !== 1 || !approved[0].user?.login || !approved[0].user?.id
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(context.actor).toLowerCase()
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
            const user = (await api("GET /users/{username}", { username: approved[0].user.login })).data;
            if (String(user?.id) !== String(approved[0].user.id)
              || String(user?.login).toLowerCase() !== approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()
              || required[0].reviewers.filter((row) => String(row.reviewer.id) === String(approved[0].user.id)
                && row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase() === approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()).length !== 1) fail();
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
      - name: Publish Production Gate asset last with fixed control
        id: gate_pair
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          VERIFIED_PUBLICATION: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
          AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-gate-publication
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fs = require("node:fs");
            const crypto = require("node:crypto"); // fixed-publisher-control-3
            async function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl(input) {
              throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
              const fail = () => { throw new Error("artifact_publisher_control_invalid"); };
              const keySets = Object.freeze({
                authorize: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_compatibility: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                publish_non_gate: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                verify_complete: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"]
              });
              const expectedKeys = keySets[input?.operation];
              if (!expectedKeys || Reflect.ownKeys(input).join("\n") !== expectedKeys.join("\n")) fail();
              const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
              const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
              const sha256 = (bytes) => input.crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
              const isPlain = (value) => value !== null && typeof value === "object"
                && !Array.isArray(value) && Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
              const exactKeys = (value, keys) => {
                if (!isPlain(value) || Reflect.ownKeys(value).join("\n") !== keys.join("\n")) fail();
              };
              const canonical = (value) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8");
              const resolveRoot = (root) => {
                if (typeof root !== "string" || !root.startsWith("/") || input.fs.realpathSync(root) !== root) fail();
                const stat = input.fs.lstatSync(root);
                if (!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink()) fail();
                return root;

              fs, crypto, github, context, core,
              inputRoot: process.env.VERIFIED_PUBLICATION,
              outputRoot: process.env.AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION,
              expectedSourceCommit: process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT

      - name: Attest Production Gate last
        if: ${{ steps.gate_pair.outputs.attest_production_gate == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-gate-publication/attestation-subjects/gate/production-gate-${{ needs.verify.outputs.production_gate_receipt_sha256 }}.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-gate-publication/predicates/gate.json
      - name: Verify complete immutable pair inventory with fixed control

        env:

        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fs = require("node:fs");

                authorize_and_publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                publish_non_gate: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                verify_complete: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"]
              });

              const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
              const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
              const sha256 = (bytes) => input.crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");

                const stat = input.fs.lstatSync(root);
                if (!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink()) fail();

              };

                "mainSourceMergeCommitSha",
                "runtimeContractId", "inventoryReceiptSha256", "productionGateReceiptSha256",
                "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256", "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256",
                "assetOrder", "assets"

              const normal = envelope.publicationMode === "normal";
              const compatibility = envelope.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap";

                inventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256,

                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: input.context.runId })

                  || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
                  || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
                  || environment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false) fail();
                const required = environment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
                if (!Array.isArray(required) || required.length !== 1 || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true

                const approved = (Array.isArray(approvals.data) ? approvals.data : []).filter((row) =>
                  row.state === "approved" && row.environments?.length === 1

                  || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();

                  mainSourceHeadSha: envelope.mainSourceHeadSha,
                  mainSourceMergeCommitSha: envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,

                  reviewerIdentitySha256: sha256(Buffer.from(String(approved[0].user.id) + ":" + approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase())),
                  environmentPolicySha256: sha256(canonical(environment.data)),

                });

                  schema: "control_plane_artifact_publication_authorization_v1",

                  inventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256,
                  productionGateReceiptSha256: envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256,
                  compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
                  compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256,
                  publicationMode: envelope.publicationMode, repository, sourceSha: envelope.targetCommit,
                  runId: String(input.context.runId), runAttempt: 1, createdAt, expiresAt
                });

                write("publication-authorization.json", canonical(authorization));
                return;
              };

                "productionGateReceiptSha256", "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256",

                "runId", "runAttempt", "createdAt", "expiresAt"

                || authorization.publicationEnvelopeSha256 !== sha256(envelopeBytes)
                || authorization.inventoryReceiptSha256 !== envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256
                || authorization.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256
                || authorization.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 !== envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256
                || authorization.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 !== envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
                || authorization.publicationMode !== envelope.publicationMode
                || authorization.repository !== repository || authorization.sourceSha !== envelope.targetCommit
                || authorization.runId !== String(input.context.runId) || authorization.runAttempt !== 1

                || approval.sourceSha !== envelope.targetCommit
                || approval.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
                || approval.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
                || approval.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                || approval.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
                || approval.runId !== String(input.context.runId) || approval.runAttempt !== 1
                || approval.actorIdentitySha256 !== sha256(Buffer.from(String(input.context.actor).toLowerCase()))
                || approval.triggeringActorIdentitySha256 !== sha256(Buffer.from(String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()))
                || Date.now() >= Date.parse(approval.expiresAt)) fail();

                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
                api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: input.context.runId })

                || sha256(canonical(currentEnvironment.data)) !== approval.environmentPolicySha256

              const currentApproved = currentApprovals.data.filter((row) => row.state === "approved"

                || currentRequired[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"

                || currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(input.context.actor).toLowerCase()
                || currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
              const currentUser = (await api("GET /users/{username}", {
                username: currentApproved[0].user.login

                || String(currentUser?.login).toLowerCase() !== currentApproved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()
                || currentRequired[0].reviewers.filter((row) => String(row.reviewer.id) === String(currentApproved[0].user.id)

                } catch (error) {
                  if (!create || error.status !== 404) fail();

                    name: envelope.tag, draft: false, prerelease: false

                if (!Number.isSafeInteger(release?.id) || release.target_commitish !== envelope.targetCommit
                  || tagRef?.object?.type !== "commit" || tagRef.object.sha !== envelope.targetCommit) fail();

                return Object.freeze({ release, assets });
              };
              const hasAttestation = async (row) => {
                const response = await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/attestations/{subject_digest}", {
                  subject_digest: "sha256:" + row.sha256, per_page: 100
                });
                const attestations = response.data?.attestations;
                if (!Array.isArray(attestations)) fail();
                return attestations.some(({ bundle }) => {
                  try {
                    const statement = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(bundle.dsseEnvelope.payload, "base64").toString("utf8"));
                    if (!Array.isArray(statement.subject) || statement.subject.length !== 1) return false;
                    return statement.predicateType === "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1"
                      && statement.subject[0].name === row.name
                      && statement.subject[0].digest?.sha256 === row.sha256
                      && canonical(statement.predicate).equals(predicateBytes);
                  } catch { return false; }
                });
              };
              const inspectPair = async (name, createAsset, outputName) => {
                const row = rows.get(name);
                let state = await readRelease(createAsset);
                let asset = state.assets.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
                if (asset && (asset.size !== row.size || asset.digest !== "sha256:" + row.sha256)) fail();
                if (!asset && createAsset) {
                  await api("POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}/assets", {
                    release_id: state.release.id, name, data: row.bytes,
                    headers: { "content-type": "application/octet-stream", "content-length": row.size }
                  });
                  state = await readRelease(false);
                  asset = state.assets.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
                  if (!asset || asset.size !== row.size || asset.digest !== "sha256:" + row.sha256) fail();
                }
                const attested = asset ? await hasAttestation(row) : false;
                if (outputName) input.core.setOutput(outputName, attested ? "false" : "true");
                return asset && attested;
              };
              const requireNonGate = async () => {
                if (!await inspectPair("control-plane-app.zip", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("artifact.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("writer-registry.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("release-declaration.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("release-assembly.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("dependency-build-receipt.json", false)) fail();
              };
              if (input.operation === "publish_non_gate") {
                await inspectPair("control-plane-app.zip", true, "attest_control_plane_app");
                await inspectPair("artifact.json", true, "attest_artifact");
                await inspectPair("writer-registry.json", true, "attest_writer_registry");
                await inspectPair("release-declaration.json", true, "attest_release_declaration");
                await inspectPair("release-assembly.json", true, "attest_release_assembly");
                await inspectPair("dependency-build-receipt.json", true, "attest_dependency_build_receipt");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "publish_gate_last") {
                if (!normal) fail();
                await requireNonGate();
                await inspectPair(lastName, true, "attest_production_gate");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "publish_compatibility_receipt_last") {
                if (!compatibility) fail();
                await requireNonGate();
                await inspectPair(lastName, true, "attest_compatibility_publication_receipt");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "verify_complete") {
                await requireNonGate();
                if (!await inspectPair(lastName, false)) fail();
                return;
              }
              fail();
            }
            await runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl({ operation: "verify_complete", fs, crypto, github, context, core, inputRoot: process.env.AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION });

  publication-verify:
    needs: [source-prepare, verify, publish-gate-last]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
      - name: Require the unavailable full-Sigstore owner for complete publication
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          node scripts/control-plane-github-evidence.mjs verify-artifact-publication \
            --verified-publication "${RUNNER_TEMP}/verified-publication" \
            --expected-source-commit "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
            --publication-mode normal \
            --publication-stage complete
```

Every publisher `script:` body below includes the complete reviewed `runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl` declaration before its single fixed call. The four declarations are byte-identical and have no runtime generator, artifact-carried control, local action, `require` outside the allowlisted Node built-ins, dynamic import, or unresolved identifier. Static tests extract all four declarations, require byte equality and the reviewed SHA-256, execute them in a `vm` harness with only `{ fs, crypto, github, context, core }`, and reject any filesystem read outside the fixed input/output roots or any unlisted GitHub method.

The workflow-owned reviewed inline verifier is the sole proposed pre-extraction verifier implementation. Each dormant tokenless job writes those fixed heredoc bytes into its fresh private root, checks the frozen SHA-256, and mounts only that local file into the first digest-pinned container; no executable crosses a job boundary. Its real main performs the pre-extraction and post-extraction operations shown above only after Foundation eligibility is separately restored. Future static tests reject lock/evidence/verifier/extra-file/runtime-node drift with zero extraction or candidate calls and require `verify-before-extract` → fixed containerized `/bin/tar` → `verify-extracted` → candidate fetch ordering before Tasks 9 or 10 may pass separately authorized source review; the missing full-Sigstore owner, lock postverification, and offline npm closure prevent current implementation.

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import test from "node:test";

const path = new URL("../../.github/workflows/control-plane-compatibility-artifact-gate.yml", import.meta.url);
const normalPath = new URL("../../.github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml", import.meta.url);

function shellRunBlocks(workflow) {
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const blocks = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const match = /^(\s*)run:\s*\|\s*$/.exec(lines[index]);
    if (!match) continue;
    const indent = match[1].length;
    const body = [];
    while (++index < lines.length && (lines[index].trim() === "" || lines[index].search(/\S/) > indent)) body.push(lines[index]);
    blocks.push(body.join("\n"));
    index -= 1;
  }
  return blocks;
}

function jobBlock(workflow, jobId) {
  const start = workflow.indexOf(`  ${jobId}:\n`);
  if (start < 0) throw new Error(`missing job ${jobId}`);
  const tail = workflow.slice(start + 2);
  const next = tail.search(/^  [a-z0-9-]+:\n/m);
  return next < 0 ? workflow.slice(start) : workflow.slice(start, start + 2 + next);
}

function assertClosedRawCompatibilityWorkflowMappings(workflow, expectedJobNames) {
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const scanDirect = (start, end, indent, exactName = null) => {
    const rows = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const prefix = " ".repeat(indent);
    const pattern = new RegExp(`^${prefix}(${exactName ?? "[a-z][a-z0-9-]*"}):(.*)$`);
    for (let index = start; index < end; index += 1) {
      const line = lines[index];
      if (line.trim() === "" || line.trimStart().startsWith("#")) continue;
      if (line.search(/\S/) !== indent) continue;
      const match = pattern.exec(line);
      if (!match || seen.has(match[1])) throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
      seen.add(match[1]);
      rows.push(Object.freeze({ name: match[1], index }));
    }
    return rows;
  };
  const roots = scanDirect(0, lines.length, 0);
  if (JSON.stringify(roots.map(({ name }) => name))
      !== JSON.stringify(["name", "on", "permissions", "jobs"])) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  const on = roots.find(({ name }) => name === "on");
  const jobs = roots.find(({ name }) => name === "jobs");
  const onEnd = roots.find(({ index }) => index > on.index)?.index ?? lines.length;
  const jobsEnd = roots.find(({ index }) => index > jobs.index)?.index ?? lines.length;
  const triggers = scanDirect(on.index + 1, onEnd, 2, "workflow_dispatch").map(({ name }) => name);
  const jobNames = scanDirect(jobs.index + 1, jobsEnd, 2).map(({ name }) => name);
  if (JSON.stringify(triggers) !== JSON.stringify(["workflow_dispatch"])
    || JSON.stringify(jobNames) !== JSON.stringify(expectedJobNames)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
}

function compatibilityJobExpectation(keys, direct, sha256) {
  return Object.freeze({ keys: Object.freeze(keys), direct: Object.freeze(direct), sha256 });
}

function observeCompatibilityJobSkeleton(workflow, jobId) {
  const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  const direct = Object.create(null);
  const keys = [];
  for (const line of block.split("\n").slice(1)) {
    const match = /^    ([^\s:#][^:]*):(.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (!match) continue;
    const key = match[1];
    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/.test(key) || Object.hasOwn(direct, key)) {
      throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
    }
    keys.push(key);
    direct[key] = match[2].trim() || "<block>";
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    keys: Object.freeze(keys),
    direct: Object.freeze({ ...direct }),
    sha256: createHash("sha256").update(Buffer.from(block, "utf8")).digest("hex")
  });
}

function assertExactCompatibilityJobSkeletons(workflow, expectedJobs, onExternalWriteEligible) {
  if (typeof onExternalWriteEligible !== "function" || workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  assertClosedRawCompatibilityWorkflowMappings(workflow, Object.keys(expectedJobs));
  const jobsOffset = workflow.indexOf("\njobs:\n");
  if (jobsOffset < 0) throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  const observedNames = [...workflow.slice(jobsOffset + 7).matchAll(/^  ([a-z0-9-]+):\n/gm)]
    .map((match) => match[1]);
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(observedNames, Object.keys(expectedJobs));
    for (const [jobId, expected] of Object.entries(expectedJobs)) {
      assert.deepEqual(observeCompatibilityJobSkeleton(workflow, jobId), expected);
      assert.equal(expected.direct["runs-on"], "ubuntu-24.04");
    }
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  onExternalWriteEligible();
}

function sha256Hex(bytes) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function extractInlineTransferVerifierBytes(tokenlessBuilder) {
  const lines = tokenlessBuilder.split("\n");
  const open = lines.findIndex((line) => line.endsWith("<<'CONTROL_PLANE_INLINE_TRANSFER_VERIFIER'"));
  if (open < 0) throw new Error("inline_transfer_verifier_missing");
  const indent = /^\s*/.exec(lines[open])[0];
  const close = lines.indexOf(`${indent}CONTROL_PLANE_INLINE_TRANSFER_VERIFIER`, open + 1);
  if (close < 0) throw new Error("inline_transfer_verifier_missing");
  return Buffer.from(lines.slice(open + 1, close)
    .map((line) => line.slice(indent.length)).join("\n") + "\n", "utf8");
}

function completePublisherControlText(workflow) {
  return `${jobBlock(workflow, "publish")}\n${jobBlock(workflow, "publish-receipt-last")}`;
}

function extractLiteralPublisherControlBodies(publisher) {
  return [...publisher.matchAll(
    /^(            async function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl\(input\) \{[\s\S]*?^            \})$/gm
  )].map((match) => Buffer.from(
    match[1].split("\n").map((line) => line.slice(12)).join("\n"), "utf8"
  ));
}

function assertExactPermissionTopology(workflow, expectedJobs) {
  if (workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const permissionSpellings = lines
    .map((line) => /^\s*([^:#]+):/.exec(line)?.[1]?.trim())
    .filter((name) => name?.toLowerCase() === "permissions");
  if (permissionSpellings.some((name) => name !== "permissions")) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const root = lines.filter((line) => /^permissions(?:\s*:|:)/.test(line));
  if (root.length !== 1 || root[0] !== "permissions: {}") throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const jobsOffset = lines.indexOf("jobs:");
  if (jobsOffset < 0) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const headers = [];
  for (let index = jobsOffset + 1; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const match = /^  ([a-z0-9-]+):$/.exec(lines[index]);
    if (match) headers.push(Object.freeze({ name: match[1], index }));
  }
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(headers.map(({ name }) => name), Object.keys(expectedJobs));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const observed = {};
  for (let headerIndex = 0; headerIndex < headers.length; headerIndex += 1) {
    const { name, index: start } = headers[headerIndex];
    const end = headers[headerIndex + 1]?.index ?? lines.length;
    const block = lines.slice(start + 1, end);
    const declarations = block.map((line, offset) => ({ line, offset }))
      .filter(({ line }) => /^    permissions(?::|\s*:)/.test(line));
    if (declarations.length !== 1) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
    const declaration = declarations[0];
    if (declaration.line === "    permissions: {}") {
      observed[name] = Object.freeze({});
      continue;
    }
    if (declaration.line !== "    permissions:") throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
    const entries = Object.create(null);
    for (let offset = declaration.offset + 1; offset < block.length; offset += 1) {
      if (block[offset].trim() === "") continue;
      if (!block[offset].startsWith("      ")) break;
      const match = /^      ([a-z][a-z-]*): (read|write)$/.exec(block[offset]);
      if (!match || Object.hasOwn(entries, match[1])) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
      entries[match[1]] = match[2];
    }
    observed[name] = Object.freeze({ ...entries });
  }
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(observed, expectedJobs);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
}

function withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, jobId, mutate) {
  const original = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  const changed = mutate(original);
  if (changed === original) throw new Error("workflow_permission_fixture_invalid");
  return workflow.replace(original, changed);
}

function assertExactTokenPlacements(workflow, expected) {
  for (const [jobId, counts] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
    const envCount = (block.match(/^\s+GITHUB_TOKEN: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\s*$/gm) ?? []).length;
    const inputCount = (block.match(/^\s+github-token: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\s*$/gm) ?? []).length;
    const allExpressions = (block.match(/\$\{\{\s*(?:github\.token|secrets\.GITHUB_TOKEN)\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).length;
    assert.deepEqual({ env: envCount, actionInput: inputCount }, counts);
    assert.equal(allExpressions, counts.env + counts.actionInput);
    assert.doesNotMatch(block, /secrets\.GITHUB_TOKEN|github\.Token/);
  }
}

function workflowExpressionRows(text) {
  const rows = [...text.matchAll(/\$\{\{([\s\S]*?)\}\}/g)]
    .map((match) => Object.freeze({ body: match[1].trim(), index: match.index }));
  assert.equal((text.match(/\$\{\{/g) ?? []).length, rows.length);
  return rows;
}

function assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(text, expectedCounts) {
  const observed = new Map();
  for (const { body } of workflowExpressionRows(text)) {
    observed.set(body, (observed.get(body) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...observed.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")),
    Object.entries(expectedCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))
  );
}

function assertClosedCredentialContextExpressions(workflow, expectedCounts) {
  const observed = new Map();
  for (const { body } of workflowExpressionRows(workflow)) {
    if (!/\b(?:github|secrets)\b/i.test(body)) continue;
    observed.set(body, (observed.get(body) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...observed.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")),
    Object.entries(expectedCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))
  );
}

function injectJobExpression(workflow, jobId, expression) {
  const marker = `  ${jobId}:\n`;
  const replacement = `${marker}    env:\n      FORGED_CONTEXT: \${{ ${expression} }}\n`;
  const changed = workflow.replace(marker, replacement);
  if (changed === workflow) throw new Error("workflow_expression_fixture_invalid");
  return changed;
}

function assertExactCompatibilityWorkflowRootShape(workflow, expectedKeys) {
  if (workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_root_invalid");
  }
  const keys = workflow.split("\n")
    .map((line) => /^([a-z][a-z0-9-]*):(?:\s|$)/.exec(line)?.[1] ?? null)
    .filter((value) => value !== null);
  if (JSON.stringify(keys) !== JSON.stringify(expectedKeys)
    || keys.includes("defaults") || keys.includes("env") || new Set(keys).size !== keys.length) {
    throw new Error("workflow_root_invalid");
  }
}

function exactCompatibilityJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId) {
  const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  if (/^    (?:container|services|env):/m.test(block)
    || /ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_(?:REQUEST_TOKEN|REQUEST_URL)/.test(block)
    || /^\s+uses:\s*(?:\.\/|docker:\/\/)/m.test(block)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_topology_invalid");
  }
  const lines = block.split("\n");
  const rows = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    if (!/^      - /.test(lines[index])) continue;
    let end = index + 1;
    while (end < lines.length && !/^      - /.test(lines[end])) end += 1;
    const bytes = Buffer.from(lines.slice(index, end).join("\n") + "\n", "utf8");
    const text = bytes.toString("utf8");
    const name = /^      - name: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1] ?? null;
    const action = /^        uses: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1]
      ?? /^      - uses: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1] ?? null;
    const hasRun = /^        run:(?:\s|$)/m.test(text);
    if ((action === null) === !hasRun) throw new Error("workflow_job_topology_invalid");
    rows.push(Object.freeze({
      name,
      kind: action === null ? "run" : "uses",
      action,
      sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex")
    }));
    index = end - 1;
  }
  return Object.freeze(rows);
}

function assertExactCompatibilityJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId, expected) {
  assert.deepEqual(exactCompatibilityJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId), expected);
}

test("compatibility Gate is manual-only and binds the staged host-content receipt", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const publisher = jobBlock(workflow, "publish");
  const toolchainPrepare = jobBlock(workflow, "toolchain-prepare");
  const tokenlessBuilder = jobBlock(workflow, "tokenless-builder");
  const verify = jobBlock(workflow, "verify");
  const nonGateVerify = jobBlock(workflow, "publication-non-gate-verify");
  const receiptPublisher = jobBlock(workflow, "publish-receipt-last");
  const publicationVerify = jobBlock(workflow, "publication-verify");
  const publishSteps = publisher.slice(publisher.indexOf("    steps:\n") + "    steps:\n".length);
  assert.match(publishSteps, /^      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable\n        uses: actions\/github-script@[0-9a-f]{40}\n/);
  const publishStepZero = publishSteps.split("\n      - ", 1)[0];
  assert.doesNotMatch(publishStepZero, /actions\/(?:checkout|download-artifact|setup-node)|\$\{\{\s*(?:secrets|vars)\.|id-token|oidc/i);
  assert.ok(publisher.indexOf("Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable")
    < publisher.indexOf("actions/download-artifact"));
  const expectedPermissions = Object.freeze({
    "source-prepare": Object.freeze({ contents: "read" }),
    "toolchain-prepare": Object.freeze({ contents: "read", attestations: "read" }),
    "tokenless-builder": Object.freeze({}),
    verify: Object.freeze({ attestations: "read", contents: "read", "pull-requests": "read" }),
    publish: Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "write", "pull-requests": "read", "id-token": "write", attestations: "write" }),
    "publication-non-gate-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" }),
    "publish-receipt-last": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "write", "pull-requests": "read", "id-token": "write", attestations: "write" }),
    "publication-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" })
  });
  assertExactPermissionTopology(workflow, expectedPermissions);
  assertExactTokenPlacements(workflow, Object.freeze({
    "source-prepare": Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 0 }),
    "toolchain-prepare": Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 }),
    "tokenless-builder": Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 0 }),
    verify: Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 }),
    publish: Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 9 }),
    "publication-non-gate-verify": Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 }),
    "publish-receipt-last": Object.freeze({ env: 0, actionInput: 4 }),
    "publication-verify": Object.freeze({ env: 1, actionInput: 0 })
  }));
  assertClosedCredentialContextExpressions(workflow, Object.freeze({
    "github.sha": 2,
    "github.token": 17
  }));
  assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(tokenlessBuilder, Object.freeze({
    "runner.temp": 3,
    "needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_archive_sha256": 1,
    "needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit": 1,
    "needs.toolchain-prepare.outputs.lock_sha256": 1,
    "needs.toolchain-prepare.outputs.evidence_sha256": 1
  }));
  assert.match(workflow, /^name: Control Plane Compatibility Artifact Gate$/m);
  assert.match(workflow, /inventory_gate_id:/);
  assert.match(workflow, /host_bundle_content_receipt_sha256:/);
  assert.match(workflow, /publish japan control-plane compatibility artifact/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /^  (?:push|pull_request|pull_request_target|schedule|workflow_call|repository_dispatch):/m);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /control-plane-artifact-assembly\.mjs prepare(?:-compatibility)?/);
  assert.match(workflow, /control_plane_source_transfer_v1/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /--deployment-mode|--automated-deployment-eligible/);
  for (const run of shellRunBlocks(workflow)) assert.doesNotMatch(run, /\$\{\{\s*inputs\./);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /source-input\/control\/scripts|publisher-control\.sha256|\/workspace\/input\/source/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /permissions:\n      contents: read\n      attestations: read/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /ref: \$\{\{ github\.sha \}\}/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /node-version: '22\.23\.1'/);
  assert.match(toolchainPrepare, /export-builder-input/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(toolchainPrepare, /inputs\.|--(?:repository|release|tag|asset|digest|platform)/);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /needs: \[source-prepare, toolchain-prepare\]/);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /permissions: \{\}/);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|GITHUB_TOKEN|github\.token/);
  assert.match(verify, /needs: \[source-prepare, toolchain-prepare, tokenless-builder\]/);
  assert.match(verify, /name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data/);
  assert.match(verify, /GITHUB_TOKEN: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}/);
  assert.equal(
    /^    permissions:\n(?:      [^\n]+\n)+/m.exec(verify)[0],
    "    permissions:\n      attestations: read\n      contents: read\n      pull-requests: read\n"
  );
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /permissions:\n      actions: read\n      contents: read\n      attestations: read/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /verify-artifact-publication/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /--publication-mode compatibility_bootstrap/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /--publication-stage complete/);
  assert.match(nonGateVerify, /needs: \[source-prepare, verify, publish\]/);
  assert.match(nonGateVerify, /--publication-stage non_gate/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(nonGateVerify, /contents: write|attestations: write|id-token: write|actions\/attest|actions\/github-script/);
  const receiptSteps = receiptPublisher.slice(receiptPublisher.indexOf("    steps:\n") + "    steps:\n".length);
  assert.match(receiptSteps, /^      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable\n        uses: actions\/github-script@[0-9a-f]{40}\n/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(receiptPublisher, /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|node scripts\/|child_process|eval\(/);
  assert.match(publicationVerify, /needs: \[source-prepare, verify, publish-receipt-last\]/);
  for (const staleName of [
    "verifyFixedFoundationToolchain" + "Transfer",
    "verifyFixedSource" + "Transfer",
    "verifyExtracted" + "Tree"
  ]) assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, new RegExp(staleName));
  assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, /^    container:/m);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/docker run --rm --platform linux\/amd64/g) ?? []).length, 5);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/--network none/g) ?? []).length, 4);
  const sourcePrepare = jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare");
  assert.equal((sourcePrepare.match(/actions\/upload-artifact@/g) ?? []).length, 1);
  assert.doesNotMatch(sourcePrepare, /transfer[_-]verifier|\.(?:mjs|js|cjs|sh|ps1|node)\b/);
  assert.equal((tokenlessBuilder.match(/actions\/download-artifact@/g) ?? []).length, 2);
  assert.doesNotMatch(tokenlessBuilder, /name:\s+[^\n]*verifier|transfer_verifier_sha256/);
  const compatibilityVerifier = extractInlineTransferVerifierBytes(tokenlessBuilder);
  const normalVerifier = extractInlineTransferVerifierBytes(jobBlock(await readFile(normalPath, "utf8"), "tokenless-builder"));
  assert.equal(sha256Hex(compatibilityVerifier), "aafaa1c21acb39e5d69cf5b3a8d6ccaee2a234c37b73825cac00eb1c89488b2e");
  const compatibilityVerifierSource = compatibilityVerifier.toString("utf8");
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...compatibilityVerifierSource.matchAll(/from\s+["']([^"']+)["']/g)]
      .map((match) => match[1]),
    ["node:crypto", "node:fs/promises", "node:path", "node:url"]
  );
  assert.doesNotMatch(compatibilityVerifierSource, /\brequire\s*\(|\bimport\s*\(|from\s+["'](?:\.|\/)|node_modules/);
  assert.deepEqual(compatibilityVerifier, normalVerifier);
  assert.match(tokenlessBuilder, /control-plane-inline-transfer-verifier\.mjs/);
  assert.ok(tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("verify-before-extract") < tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("--extract --file"));
  assert.ok(tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("verify-extracted") < tokenlessBuilder.indexOf("control-plane-artifact-builder.mjs fetch"));
  assert.doesNotMatch(publicationVerify, /contents: write|attestations: write|id-token: write|actions\/attest|actions\/github-script/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(jobBlock(workflow, "publish"), /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|node scripts\/|child_process|eval\(/);
});

test("compatibility workflow root and both protected publisher job bodies are exact", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const rootKeys = ["name", "on", "permissions", "jobs"];
  assertExactCompatibilityWorkflowRootShape(workflow, rootKeys);

    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest compatibility writer-registry.json", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "38b6d3835b6244c84996a41066eae50c173d083bfb8010119f2bc9162b931e3e" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest compatibility release-declaration.json", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "916e04bd9681b66fc1b32c95d0965e7d7275cde805b7609a94fe8d4f2000c520" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest compatibility release-assembly.json", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "ba651a4da26770cbbbb9a1504ab79b2c96f3bb9cec59fa6585e932ee38f41bde" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest compatibility dependency-build-receipt.json", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "d706db813d397453026f50a5778a165148d89ffe9034fe746526141c1b43ad93" })
  ]));
  assertExactCompatibilityJobStepTopology(workflow, "publish-receipt-last", Object.freeze([

    Object.freeze({ name: null, kind: "uses", action: download, sha256: "9eca50ad523ec2591de97176e6908afd9007d68b42e6fa09f5f984678e632bba" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Publish typed compatibility receipt last with fixed control", kind: "uses", action: githubScript, sha256: "1a6c7996c1f6eb2cc3e0cee4369eb24d887ba53c727437d5ffd92ad5c63ffb92" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Attest typed compatibility receipt last", kind: "uses", action: attest, sha256: "f08267c99dbd3b12807068abedaf8fc1a10fa4dc4e49e2b7ca21c310fb964802" }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "Verify compatibility pair inventory with fixed control", kind: "uses", action: githubScript, sha256: "87bd9fbf7b5c515cb1328e24d64f18b97dcbeb74305ab3bc31a0961a095b13fe" })

test("compatibility workflow freezes every complete job value before external-write eligibility", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const expected = Object.freeze({

    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    unlisted: true\n"),
    workflow.replace("    needs: [source-prepare, verify]\n", "    needs: [source-prepare]\n"),
    workflow.replace("  publish:\n", "  publish:\n    if: ${{ always() }}\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    continue-on-error: true\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 999\n"),

test("compatibility Artifact Gate rejects raw permission duplicates, aliases, case drift, and unlisted scope", async () => {

    "publication-verify": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", attestations: "read" })
  });

    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "permissions: &shared {}"),

    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "publish-receipt-last", (block) => block.replace("      contents: write", "      contents: read"))
  ];
  for (const fault of faults) {

});
```

```js
function receiptFaultFixture(created, input, fault) {
```
