- [ ] **Step 3: Create the compatibility workflow from the same isolated job topology**

`control-plane-compatibility-publication-receipt.mjs` is the sole row-7 body producer and validator:

```js
import {
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes,
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "./canonical-json.mjs";

const SHA256_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SOURCE_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const RUNTIME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?$/;

export const COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_RECEIPT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-compatibility-publication-receipt-v1",
  maxBytes: 16_384,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "schemaVersion", "receiptType", "repository", "sourceCommit",
    "runtimeContractId", "releaseTag", "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256",
    "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256", "releaseDeclarationSha256",
    "artifactSha256", "automatedDeploymentEligible", "createdAt"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    const expectedTag = `control-plane-compatibility-${value.sourceCommit}-${value.runtimeContractId}`;
    const timestamp = new Date(value.createdAt);
    if (value.schemaVersion !== "1"
      || value.receiptType !== "control_plane_compatibility_publication"
      || value.repository !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
      || !SOURCE_PATTERN.test(value.sourceCommit)
      || !RUNTIME_PATTERN.test(value.runtimeContractId)
      || value.releaseTag !== expectedTag
      || ![
        value.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
        value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256,
        value.releaseDeclarationSha256,
        value.artifactSha256
      ].every((digest) => SHA256_PATTERN.test(digest))
      || value.automatedDeploymentEligible !== false
      || Number.isNaN(timestamp.getTime())
      || timestamp.toISOString() !== value.createdAt) {
      throw new Error("compatibility_publication_receipt_invalid");
    }
  }
});

export function createCompatibilityPublicationReceipt(input) {
  const value = Object.freeze({
    schemaVersion: "1",
    receiptType: "control_plane_compatibility_publication",
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    sourceCommit: input.sourceCommit,
    runtimeContractId: input.runtimeContractId,
    releaseTag: `control-plane-compatibility-${input.sourceCommit}-${input.runtimeContractId}`,
    compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: input.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
    hostBundleContentReceiptSha256: input.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256,
    releaseDeclarationSha256: input.releaseDeclarationSha256,
    artifactSha256: input.artifactSha256,
    automatedDeploymentEligible: false,
    createdAt: input.createdAt
  });
  const bytes = serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(value, COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_RECEIPT_CONTRACT);
  const sha256 = sha256Hex(bytes);
  return Object.freeze({
    value,
    bytes,
    sha256,
    releaseTag: value.releaseTag,
    assetName: `compatibility-publication-${sha256}.json`
  });
}

export function validateCompatibilityPublicationReceipt({ bytes, expected }) {
  const value = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, COMPATIBILITY_PUBLICATION_RECEIPT_CONTRACT);
  const expectedFields = Object.freeze([
    "sourceCommit", "runtimeContractId", "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256",
    "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256", "releaseDeclarationSha256", "artifactSha256"
  ]);
  if (expected === null || typeof expected !== "object" || Array.isArray(expected)
    || Object.keys(expected).length !== expectedFields.length
    || Object.keys(expected).some((name, index) => name !== expectedFields[index])
    || expectedFields.some((name) => value[name] !== expected[name])) {
    throw new Error("compatibility_publication_receipt_binding_invalid");
  }
  return value;
}
```

The receipt owner APIs and the proposed mode-closed call sequence remain future contract detail. In this revision both `assembleVerifiedArtifactPublication` and its fixed CLI adapter raise `artifact_assembly_verification_owner_unavailable` before calling either API, because the Task 3/4 subject is still self-referential and Task 5's Foundation-bound receipt validator is still a future addendum. After that addendum is separately reviewed, the same assembly owner may call `createCompatibilityPublicationReceipt` once, immediately call `validateCompatibilityPublicationReceipt` over the returned bytes and exact six-field expected binding, insert only those unchanged bytes under the returned `assetName`, and set envelope `productionGateReceiptSha256: null` plus `compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: sha256`. Future tests must use a real owner-verified non-self-referential outer subject and reject clone, omitted validation, regenerated/self-hashed bytes, a normal receipt, caller filename/digest, cross-mode parsing, source/tree drift, outer/companion extra/missing/drift, dependency-receipt/Foundation substitution, and byte drift. Current tests instead require the exact STOP with zero constructor, envelope, directory, GitHub-output, or safe-result effect. No workflow or publisher hashes an invented compatibility body or maps it through the normal Production Gate builder.

```yaml
name: Control Plane Compatibility Artifact Gate

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      inventory_gate_id:
        description: Fresh content-addressed inventory Gate ID
        required: true
        type: string
      host_bundle_content_receipt_sha256:
        description: Read-back staged host bundle content receipt SHA-256
        required: true
        type: string
      confirmation:
        description: Type publish japan control-plane compatibility artifact
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  source-prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      source_commit: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.source_commit }}
      source_archive_sha256: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.source_archive_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: identity
        name: Bind protected master
        shell: bash
        env:
          CONFIRMATION: ${{ inputs.confirmation }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = "refs/heads/master"
          test "${CONFIRMATION}" = "publish japan control-plane compatibility artifact"
          test "${GITHUB_SHA}" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-transfer"
          git archive --format=tar --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-transfer/source.tar" "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git ls-tree -r --full-tree "${GITHUB_SHA}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-transfer/git-tree.manifest"
          SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256="$(sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-transfer/source.tar" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          printf 'source_commit=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'source_archive_sha256=%s\n' "${SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Write canonical compatibility source transfer
        shell: bash
        env:
          INVENTORY_GATE_ID: ${{ inputs.inventory_gate_id }}
          HOST_BUNDLE_CONTENT_RECEIPT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.host_bundle_content_receipt_sha256 }}
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.source_archive_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "${INVENTORY_GATE_ID}" =~ ^cig1\.[0-9a-f]{40}\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,62}[a-z0-9])?\.[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          [[ "${HOST_BUNDLE_CONTENT_RECEIPT_SHA256}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input"
          cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-transfer/source.tar" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/source.tar"
          cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-transfer/git-tree.manifest" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/git-tree.manifest"
          SOURCE_SIZE="$(stat -c '%s' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/source.tar")"
          TREE_SHA256="$(sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/git-tree.manifest" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          TREE_SIZE="$(stat -c '%s' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/git-tree.manifest")"
          SOURCE_TRANSFER_JSON="$(printf '{"schema":"control_plane_source_transfer_v1","sourceCommit":"%s","sourceArchiveSha256":"%s","sourceArchiveSize":%s,"gitTreeManifestSha256":"%s","gitTreeManifestSize":%s,"inventoryGateId":"%s","hostBundleContentReceiptSha256":"%s"}' \
            "${GITHUB_SHA}" "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256}" "${SOURCE_SIZE}" "${TREE_SHA256}" "${TREE_SIZE}" "${INVENTORY_GATE_ID}" "${HOST_BUNDLE_CONTENT_RECEIPT_SHA256}")"
          printf '%s' "${SOURCE_TRANSFER_JSON}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/source-transfer.json"
          test "$(tail -c 1 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input/source-transfer.json")" = "}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-source-input
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-input
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
  toolchain-prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    outputs:
      lock_sha256: ${{ steps.export.outputs.lock_sha256 }}
      evidence_sha256: ${{ steps.export.outputs.evidence_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - name: Export the fixed verified Foundation builder input
        id: export
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/control-plane-foundation-toolchain-lock.mjs export-builder-input \
            --output-directory "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data"
          test -f "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json"
          test -f "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data/immutable-publication-evidence.json"
          test "$(find "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = \
            "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json immutable-publication-evidence.json "
          printf 'lock_sha256=%s\n' "$(sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'evidence_sha256=%s\n' "$(sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data/immutable-publication-evidence.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/foundation-toolchain-data/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/foundation-toolchain-data/immutable-publication-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  tokenless-builder:
    needs: [source-prepare, toolchain-prepare]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-source-input
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/control-plane-tokenless/input
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/control-plane-tokenless/toolchain
      - name: Verify, extract, fetch, and build through fixed containers
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_archive_sha256 }}
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          EXPECTED_TOOLCHAIN_LOCK_SHA256: ${{ needs.toolchain-prepare.outputs.lock_sha256 }}
          EXPECTED_TOOLCHAIN_EVIDENCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.toolchain-prepare.outputs.evidence_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ROOT="${RUNNER_TEMP}/control-plane-tokenless"
          IMAGE='docker.io/library/node:22.23.1-bookworm@sha256:175215a1f306ed5df592434b99cc2019f70624373fe49cb659240a618a846aed'
          mkdir -p "${ROOT}/verifier" "${ROOT}/source" "${ROOT}/cache" "${ROOT}/output"
          VERIFIER="${ROOT}/verifier/control-plane-inline-transfer-verifier.mjs"
          cat > "${VERIFIER}" <<'CONTROL_PLANE_INLINE_TRANSFER_VERIFIER'
          import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
          import { lstat, mkdir, open, readdir, readFile, realpath, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
          import { dirname, join, posix, resolve } from "node:path";
          import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

          const INPUT_ROOT = "/workspace/input";
          const TOOLCHAIN_ROOT = "/workspace/toolchain";
          const SOURCE_ROOT = "/workspace/source";
          const IMAGE = "docker.io/library/node:22.23.1-bookworm@sha256:175215a1f306ed5df592434b99cc2019f70624373fe49cb659240a618a846aed";
          const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
          const SOURCE = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
          const MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 67_108_864;
          const MAX_TREE_BYTES = 16_777_216;
          const TRANSFER_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
            "schema", "sourceCommit", "sourceArchiveSha256", "sourceArchiveSize",
            "gitTreeManifestSha256", "gitTreeManifestSize", "inventoryGateId",
            "hostBundleContentReceiptSha256"
          ]);

          function sha256(bytes) {
            return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
          }

          function fail() {
            throw new Error("artifact_transfer_invalid");
          }

          function assertExactObject(value, fields) {
            if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
              || Reflect.ownKeys(value).some((name, index) => name !== fields[index])
              || Reflect.ownKeys(value).length !== fields.length) fail();
          }

          export function serializeFixedSourceTransfer(value) {
            assertExactObject(value, TRANSFER_FIELDS);
            const compatibility = /^cig1\./.test(value.inventoryGateId ?? "");
            if (value.schema !== "control_plane_source_transfer_v1"
              || !SOURCE.test(value.sourceCommit ?? "")
              || !SHA256.test(value.sourceArchiveSha256 ?? "")
              || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.sourceArchiveSize) || value.sourceArchiveSize < 1
              || value.sourceArchiveSize > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES
              || !SHA256.test(value.gitTreeManifestSha256 ?? "")
              || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.gitTreeManifestSize) || value.gitTreeManifestSize < 1
              || value.gitTreeManifestSize > MAX_TREE_BYTES
              || (!/^ig1\./.test(value.inventoryGateId ?? "") && !compatibility)
              || (compatibility
                ? !SHA256.test(value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 ?? "")
                : value.hostBundleContentReceiptSha256 !== null)) fail();
            return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(
              TRANSFER_FIELDS.map((name) => [name, value[name]])
            )), "utf8");
          }

          export function verifyFixedSourceTransferBytes(bytes) {
            if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.at(-1) !== 0x7d) fail();
            let value;
            try { value = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8")); } catch { fail(); }
            const canonical = serializeFixedSourceTransfer(value);
            if (!canonical.equals(bytes)) fail();
            return Object.freeze({ value: Object.freeze(value), bytes: Buffer.from(bytes), sha256: sha256(bytes) });
          }

          function parseOctal(bytes) {
            const text = bytes.toString("ascii").replace(/\0.*$/s, "").trim();
            if (!/^[0-7]+$/.test(text)) fail();
            const value = Number.parseInt(text, 8);
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) fail();
            return value;
          }

          function parseBoundedTar(bytes) {
            if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) fail();
            const entries = [];
            const names = new Set();
            let offset = 0;
            while (offset + 512 <= bytes.length) {
              const header = bytes.subarray(offset, offset + 512);
              if (header.every((byte) => byte === 0)) break;
              const storedChecksum = parseOctal(header.subarray(148, 156));
              const checksum = header.reduce((sum, byte, index) => sum + (index >= 148 && index < 156 ? 0x20 : byte), 0);
              if (checksum !== storedChecksum) fail();
              const name = header.subarray(0, 100).toString("utf8").replace(/\0.*$/s, "");
              const prefix = header.subarray(345, 500).toString("utf8").replace(/\0.*$/s, "");
              const path = prefix ? `${prefix}/${name}` : name;
              const type = String.fromCharCode(header[156] || 0x30);
              const size = parseOctal(header.subarray(124, 136));
              const mode = parseOctal(header.subarray(100, 108)) & 0o777;
              const normalized = posix.normalize(path);
              if (!path || path !== normalized || path.startsWith("/") || path.includes("\\")
                || path.split("/").includes("..") || names.has(path)
                || !["0", "\0", "5", "g"].includes(type) || size > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) fail();
              names.add(path);
              const dataOffset = offset + 512;
              const next = dataOffset + Math.ceil(size / 512) * 512;
              if (next > bytes.length) fail();
              if (type === "0" || type === "\0") entries.push(Object.freeze({ path, mode, data: Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(dataOffset, dataOffset + size)) }));
              if (type === "g" && !bytes.subarray(dataOffset, dataOffset + size).toString("utf8").startsWith("52 comment=")) fail();
              offset = next;
            }
            if (entries.length < 1 || bytes.subarray(offset).some((byte) => byte !== 0)) fail();
            return entries;
          }

          function parseGitTree(bytes) {
            if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1 || bytes.length > MAX_TREE_BYTES || bytes.at(-1) !== 0x0a) fail();
            const rows = bytes.toString("utf8").trimEnd().split("\n").map((line) => {
              const match = /^(100644|100755) blob ([0-9a-f]{40})\t([^\u0000-\u001f\\]+)$/.exec(line);
              if (!match || posix.normalize(match[3]) !== match[3] || match[3].split("/").includes("..")) fail();
              return Object.freeze({ mode: match[1], oid: match[2], path: match[3] });
            });
            if (rows.some((row, index) => index > 0 && rows[index - 1].path.localeCompare(row.path, "en") >= 0)) fail();
            return rows;
          }

          function gitBlobOid(bytes) {
            return createHash("sha1").update(`blob ${bytes.length}\0`, "utf8").update(bytes).digest("hex");
          }

          function compareTarToTree(entries, rows) {
            const files = entries.map(({ path, mode, data }) => Object.freeze({
              path,
              mode: mode & 0o111 ? "100755" : "100644",
              oid: gitBlobOid(data)
            })).sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path, "en"));
            if (JSON.stringify(files) !== JSON.stringify(rows)) fail();
          }

          async function readExactRegular(path, maxBytes) {
            const before = await lstat(path);
            if (!before.isFile() || before.isSymbolicLink() || before.nlink !== 1 || before.size < 1 || before.size > maxBytes) fail();
            const bytes = await readFile(path);
            const after = await lstat(path);
            if (before.dev !== after.dev || before.ino !== after.ino || before.size !== after.size) fail();
            return bytes;
          }

          async function assertExactDirectory(root, names) {
            const actual = (await readdir(root)).sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"));
            if (JSON.stringify(actual) !== JSON.stringify([...names].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")))) fail();
          }

          async function verifyBeforeExtract(expected) {
            if (process.platform !== "linux" || process.arch !== "x64" || process.version !== "v22.23.1"
              || process.env.CONTROL_PLANE_FOUNDATION_IMAGE !== IMAGE) fail();
            await assertExactDirectory(TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, [
              "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json", "immutable-publication-evidence.json"
            ]);
            const lock = await readExactRegular(join(TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, "foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json"), 1_048_576);
            const evidence = await readExactRegular(join(TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, "immutable-publication-evidence.json"), 4_194_304);
            if (sha256(lock) !== expected.lockSha256 || sha256(evidence) !== expected.evidenceSha256) fail();
            await assertExactDirectory(INPUT_ROOT, ["git-tree.manifest", "source-transfer.json", "source.tar"]);
            const transfer = verifyFixedSourceTransferBytes(await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "source-transfer.json"), 65_536));
            const archive = await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "source.tar"), MAX_SOURCE_BYTES);
            const tree = await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "git-tree.manifest"), MAX_TREE_BYTES);
            if (transfer.value.sourceCommit !== expected.sourceCommit
              || transfer.value.sourceArchiveSha256 !== expected.sourceArchiveSha256
              || transfer.value.sourceArchiveSize !== archive.length || sha256(archive) !== expected.sourceArchiveSha256
              || transfer.value.gitTreeManifestSha256 !== sha256(tree)
              || transfer.value.gitTreeManifestSize !== tree.length) fail();
            compareTarToTree(parseBoundedTar(archive), parseGitTree(tree));
          }

          async function walkExtracted(root, prefix = "") {
            const output = [];
            for (const name of (await readdir(join(root, prefix))).sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))) {
              const relative = prefix ? `${prefix}/${name}` : name;
              const path = join(root, relative);
              const info = await lstat(path);
              if (info.isSymbolicLink() || (!info.isDirectory() && !info.isFile())) fail();
              if (info.isDirectory()) output.push(...await walkExtracted(root, relative));
              else output.push(Object.freeze({
                path: relative.replaceAll("\\", "/"),
                mode: info.mode & 0o111 ? "100755" : "100644",
                oid: gitBlobOid(await readFile(path))
              }));
            }
            return output;
          }

          async function verifyExtracted() {
            if (await realpath(SOURCE_ROOT) !== SOURCE_ROOT) fail();
            const rows = parseGitTree(await readExactRegular(join(INPUT_ROOT, "git-tree.manifest"), MAX_TREE_BYTES));
            const observed = await walkExtracted(SOURCE_ROOT);
            if (JSON.stringify(observed) !== JSON.stringify(rows)) fail();
          }

          function parseFlags(tokens) {
            const names = [
              "expected-source-commit", "expected-source-archive-sha256",
              "expected-toolchain-lock-sha256", "expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256"
            ];
            if (tokens.length !== names.length * 2) fail();
            const values = Object.create(null);
            for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
              const name = tokens[index]?.replace(/^--/, "");
              if (!names.includes(name) || Object.hasOwn(values, name) || !tokens[index + 1]) fail();
              values[name] = tokens[index + 1];
            }
            if (!SOURCE.test(values["expected-source-commit"] ?? "")
              || !SHA256.test(values["expected-source-archive-sha256"] ?? "")
              || !SHA256.test(values["expected-toolchain-lock-sha256"] ?? "")
              || !SHA256.test(values["expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256"] ?? "")) fail();
            return Object.freeze({
              sourceCommit: values["expected-source-commit"],
              sourceArchiveSha256: values["expected-source-archive-sha256"],
              lockSha256: values["expected-toolchain-lock-sha256"],
              evidenceSha256: values["expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256"]
            });
          }

          export async function runArtifactTransferVerifierCli({ argv }) {
            const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
            if (operation === "verify-before-extract") await verifyBeforeExtract(parseFlags(tokens));
            else if (operation === "verify-extracted" && tokens.length === 0) await verifyExtracted();
            else fail();
            return 0;
          }

          export async function main({ argv = process.argv.slice(2), stderr = process.stderr } = {}) {
            try { process.exitCode = await runArtifactTransferVerifierCli({ argv }); }
            catch { stderr.write("artifact_transfer_verifier_failed\n"); process.exitCode = 2; }
          }

          if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await main();
          CONTROL_PLANE_INLINE_TRANSFER_VERIFIER
          chmod 0400 "${VERIFIER}"
          test -f "${VERIFIER}"
          test ! -L "${VERIFIER}"
          test "$(find "${ROOT}/verifier" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f %y\n')" = 'control-plane-inline-transfer-verifier.mjs f'
          test "$(sha256sum "${VERIFIER}" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "aafaa1c21acb39e5d69cf5b3a8d6ccaee2a234c37b73825cac00eb1c89488b2e"
          docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none --read-only \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 \
            --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m \
            --env CONTROL_PLANE_FOUNDATION_IMAGE="${IMAGE}" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/verifier:/trusted:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/input:/workspace/input:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/toolchain:/workspace/toolchain:ro" \
            --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/node "${IMAGE}" \
            /trusted/control-plane-inline-transfer-verifier.mjs verify-before-extract \
            --expected-source-commit "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
            --expected-source-archive-sha256 "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256}" \
            --expected-toolchain-lock-sha256 "${EXPECTED_TOOLCHAIN_LOCK_SHA256}" \
            --expected-toolchain-evidence-sha256 "${EXPECTED_TOOLCHAIN_EVIDENCE_SHA256}"
          docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none --read-only \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 \
            --volume "${ROOT}/input:/workspace/input:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/source:/workspace/source:rw" \
            --entrypoint /bin/tar "${IMAGE}" \
            --extract --file /workspace/input/source.tar --directory /workspace/source \
            --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions
          docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none --read-only \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 \
            --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m \
            --volume "${ROOT}/verifier:/trusted:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/input:/workspace/input:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/source:/workspace/source:ro" \
            --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/node "${IMAGE}" \
            /trusted/control-plane-inline-transfer-verifier.mjs verify-extracted
          docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --read-only \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 128 \
            --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m \
            --env HOME=/tmp/control-plane-fetch --env LANG=C.UTF-8 --env LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 --env TZ=UTC \
            --volume "${ROOT}/source:/workspace/source:rw" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/cache:/workspace/cache:rw" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/toolchain:/workspace/toolchain:ro" \
            --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/node "${IMAGE}" \
            /workspace/source/scripts/control-plane-artifact-builder.mjs fetch \
            --source /workspace/source --cache /workspace/cache \
            --builder-contract-file /workspace/source/ops/control-plane-deploy/artifact-builder-contract.json \
            --foundation-toolchain-lock-file /workspace/toolchain/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json \
            --foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file /workspace/toolchain/immutable-publication-evidence.json
          docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network none --read-only \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 128 \
            --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m \
            --env HOME=/tmp/control-plane-build --env LANG=C.UTF-8 --env LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 --env TZ=UTC \
            --volume "${ROOT}/source:/workspace/source:rw" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/cache:/workspace/cache:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/toolchain:/workspace/toolchain:ro" \
            --volume "${ROOT}/output:/workspace/output:rw" \
            --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/node "${IMAGE}" \
            /workspace/source/scripts/control-plane-artifact-builder.mjs build \
            --source /workspace/source --cache /workspace/cache --output /workspace/output \
            --runtime-contract-file /workspace/source/ops/control-plane-deploy/runtime-contract.json \
            --builder-contract-file /workspace/source/ops/control-plane-deploy/artifact-builder-contract.json \
            --foundation-toolchain-lock-file /workspace/toolchain/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json \
            --foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file /workspace/toolchain/immutable-publication-evidence.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-builder-output
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/control-plane-tokenless/output
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  verify:
    needs: [source-prepare, toolchain-prepare, tokenless-builder]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      compatibility_publication_receipt_sha256: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.compatibility_publication_receipt_sha256 }}
    permissions:
      attestations: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-source-input
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-input
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-builder-output
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/builder-output
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-foundation-toolchain-data
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/foundation-toolchain-data
      - name: Independently verify compatibility output
        id: verify
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          node scripts/control-plane-artifact-assembly.mjs verify \
            --source-input "${RUNNER_TEMP}/source-input" \
            --builder-output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/builder-output" \
            --trusted-checkout "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" \
            --expected-source-commit "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
            --foundation-toolchain-lock-file "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data/foundation-toolchain-lock-v2.json" \
            --foundation-toolchain-publication-evidence-file "${RUNNER_TEMP}/foundation-toolchain-data/immutable-publication-evidence.json" \
            --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/verified-publication" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  publish:
    needs: [source-prepare, verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: artifact-publication
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fail = () => { throw new Error("artifact_publication_step0_recheck_invalid"); };
            const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
            const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
            if (context.ref !== "refs/heads/master" || context.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || Number(context.runAttempt) !== 1) fail();
            const api = (route, parameters = {}) => github.request(route, { owner, repo, ...parameters });
            const [branch, environment, approvals] = await Promise.all([
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: context.runId })
            ]);
            const required = environment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
            const approved = (Array.isArray(approvals.data) ? approvals.data : []).filter((row) =>
              row.state === "approved" && row.environments?.length === 1
              && row.environments[0]?.name === "artifact-publication");
            if (branch.data?.commit?.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
              || environment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false
              || !Array.isArray(required) || required.length !== 1 || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true
              || !Array.isArray(required[0].reviewers) || required[0].reviewers.length < 1
              || required[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"
                || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id) || row.reviewer.id < 1
                || typeof row.reviewer?.login !== "string"
                || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer.login))
              || approved.length !== 1 || !approved[0].user?.login || !approved[0].user?.id
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(context.actor).toLowerCase()
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
            const user = (await api("GET /users/{username}", { username: approved[0].user.login })).data;
            if (String(user?.id) !== String(approved[0].user.id)
              || String(user?.login).toLowerCase() !== approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()
              || required[0].reviewers.filter((row) => String(row.reviewer.id) === String(approved[0].user.id)
                && row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase() === approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()).length !== 1) fail();
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
      - name: Re-hash opaque compatibility publication and recheck approval
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          VERIFIED_PUBLICATION: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
          AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fs = require("node:fs");
            const crypto = require("node:crypto"); // fixed-publisher-control-5
            async function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl(input) {
              throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
              const fail = () => { throw new Error("artifact_publisher_control_invalid"); };
              const keySets = Object.freeze({
                authorize: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_compatibility: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                publish_non_gate: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],

                  })).data;
                }
                const tagRef = (await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/tags/{tag}", { tag: envelope.tag })).data;
                if (!Number.isSafeInteger(release?.id) || release.target_commitish !== envelope.targetCommit
                  || tagRef?.object?.type !== "commit" || tagRef.object.sha !== envelope.targetCommit) fail();
                const assets = (await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}/assets", {
                  release_id: release.id, per_page: 100
                })).data;
                if (!Array.isArray(assets) || assets.length > fileOrder.length
                  || assets.some((asset) => !fileOrder.includes(asset.name))
                  || new Set(assets.map((asset) => asset.name)).size !== assets.length) fail();
                return Object.freeze({ release, assets });
              };
              const hasAttestation = async (row) => {
                const response = await api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/attestations/{subject_digest}", {
                  subject_digest: "sha256:" + row.sha256, per_page: 100
                });
                const attestations = response.data?.attestations;
                if (!Array.isArray(attestations)) fail();
                return attestations.some(({ bundle }) => {
                  try {
                    const statement = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(bundle.dsseEnvelope.payload, "base64").toString("utf8"));
                    if (!Array.isArray(statement.subject) || statement.subject.length !== 1) return false;
                    return statement.predicateType === "https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1"
                      && statement.subject[0].name === row.name
                      && statement.subject[0].digest?.sha256 === row.sha256
                      && canonical(statement.predicate).equals(predicateBytes);
                  } catch { return false; }
                });
              };
              const inspectPair = async (name, createAsset, outputName) => {
                const row = rows.get(name);
                let state = await readRelease(createAsset);
                let asset = state.assets.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
                if (asset && (asset.size !== row.size || asset.digest !== "sha256:" + row.sha256)) fail();
                if (!asset && createAsset) {
                  await api("POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{release_id}/assets", {
                    release_id: state.release.id, name, data: row.bytes,
                    headers: { "content-type": "application/octet-stream", "content-length": row.size }
                  });
                  state = await readRelease(false);
                  asset = state.assets.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
                  if (!asset || asset.size !== row.size || asset.digest !== "sha256:" + row.sha256) fail();
                }
                const attested = asset ? await hasAttestation(row) : false;
                if (outputName) input.core.setOutput(outputName, attested ? "false" : "true");
                return asset && attested;
              };
              const requireNonGate = async () => {
                if (!await inspectPair("control-plane-app.zip", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("artifact.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("writer-registry.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("release-declaration.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("release-assembly.json", false)) fail();
                if (!await inspectPair("dependency-build-receipt.json", false)) fail();
              };
              if (input.operation === "publish_non_gate") {
                await inspectPair("control-plane-app.zip", true, "attest_control_plane_app");
                await inspectPair("artifact.json", true, "attest_artifact");
                await inspectPair("writer-registry.json", true, "attest_writer_registry");
                await inspectPair("release-declaration.json", true, "attest_release_declaration");
                await inspectPair("release-assembly.json", true, "attest_release_assembly");
                await inspectPair("dependency-build-receipt.json", true, "attest_dependency_build_receipt");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "publish_gate_last") {
                if (!normal) fail();
                await requireNonGate();
                await inspectPair(lastName, true, "attest_production_gate");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "publish_compatibility_receipt_last") {
                if (!compatibility) fail();
                await requireNonGate();
                await inspectPair(lastName, true, "attest_compatibility_publication_receipt");
                return;
              }
              if (input.operation === "verify_complete") {
                await requireNonGate();
                if (!await inspectPair(lastName, false)) fail();
                return;
              }
              fail();
            }
            await runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl({ operation: "publish_non_gate", fs, crypto, github, context, core, inputRoot: process.env.AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION });
      - name: Attest compatibility control-plane-app.zip
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_control_plane_app == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/control-plane-app.zip
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest compatibility artifact.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_artifact == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/artifact.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest compatibility writer-registry.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_writer_registry == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/writer-registry.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest compatibility release-declaration.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_release_declaration == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/release-declaration.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest compatibility release-assembly.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_release_assembly == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/release-assembly.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json
      - name: Attest compatibility dependency-build-receipt.json
        if: ${{ steps.non_gate_pairs.outputs.attest_dependency_build_receipt == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/attestation-subjects/non-gate/dependency-build-receipt.json
          predicate-type: https://gccwebos.com/attestations/control-plane-publication/v1
          predicate-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-publication/predicates/non-gate.json

  publication-non-gate-verify:
    needs: [source-prepare, verify, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
      - name: Require the unavailable full-Sigstore owner before any compatibility receipt
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          node scripts/control-plane-github-evidence.mjs verify-artifact-publication \
            --verified-publication "${RUNNER_TEMP}/verified-publication" \
            --expected-source-commit "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
            --publication-mode compatibility_bootstrap \
            --publication-stage non_gate

  publish-receipt-last:
    needs: [source-prepare, verify, publication-non-gate-verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: artifact-publication
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - name: Fresh protected approval recheck before any other executable
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fail = () => { throw new Error("artifact_publication_step0_recheck_invalid"); };
            const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
            const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
            if (context.ref !== "refs/heads/master" || context.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || Number(context.runAttempt) !== 1) fail();
            const api = (route, parameters = {}) => github.request(route, { owner, repo, ...parameters });
            const [branch, environment, approvals] = await Promise.all([
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: context.runId })
            ]);
            const required = environment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
            const approved = (Array.isArray(approvals.data) ? approvals.data : []).filter((row) =>
              row.state === "approved" && row.environments?.length === 1
              && row.environments[0]?.name === "artifact-publication");
            if (branch.data?.commit?.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
              || environment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false
              || !Array.isArray(required) || required.length !== 1 || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true
              || !Array.isArray(required[0].reviewers) || required[0].reviewers.length < 1
              || required[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"
                || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id) || row.reviewer.id < 1
                || typeof row.reviewer?.login !== "string"
                || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer.login))
              || approved.length !== 1 || !approved[0].user?.login || !approved[0].user?.id
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(context.actor).toLowerCase()
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
            const user = (await api("GET /users/{username}", { username: approved[0].user.login })).data;
            if (String(user?.id) !== String(approved[0].user.id)
              || String(user?.login).toLowerCase() !== approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()
              || required[0].reviewers.filter((row) => String(row.reviewer.id) === String(approved[0].user.id)
                && row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase() === approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()).length !== 1) fail();
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-compatibility-verified-publication
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
      - name: Publish typed compatibility receipt last with fixed control
        id: compatibility_receipt_pair
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          VERIFIED_PUBLICATION: ${{ runner.temp }}/verified-publication
          AUTHORIZED_PUBLICATION: ${{ runner.temp }}/authorized-receipt-publication
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.source-prepare.outputs.source_commit }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fs = require("node:fs");
            const crypto = require("node:crypto"); // fixed-publisher-control-7
            async function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl(input) {
              throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
              const fail = () => { throw new Error("artifact_publisher_control_invalid"); };
              const keySets = Object.freeze({
                authorize: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_compatibility: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                authorize_and_publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot", "outputRoot", "expectedSourceCommit"],
                publish_non_gate: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                publish_gate_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                publish_compatibility_receipt_last: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"],
                verify_complete: ["operation", "fs", "crypto", "github", "context", "core", "inputRoot"]
              });
              const expectedKeys = keySets[input?.operation];
              if (!expectedKeys || Reflect.ownKeys(input).join("\n") !== expectedKeys.join("\n")) fail();
              const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
              const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
              const sha256 = (bytes) => input.crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
              const isPlain = (value) => value !== null && typeof value === "object"
                && !Array.isArray(value) && Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
              const exactKeys = (value, keys) => {
                if (!isPlain(value) || Reflect.ownKeys(value).join("\n") !== keys.join("\n")) fail();
              };
              const canonical = (value) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8");
              const resolveRoot = (root) => {
                if (typeof root !== "string" || !root.startsWith("/") || input.fs.realpathSync(root) !== root) fail();
                const stat = input.fs.lstatSync(root);
                if (!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink()) fail();
                return root;
              };
              const read = (root, name, max) => {
                if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/.test(name)) fail();
                const path = root + "/" + name;
                if (input.fs.realpathSync(path) !== path) fail();
                const stat = input.fs.lstatSync(path);
                if (!stat.isFile() || stat.isSymbolicLink() || stat.size < 1 || stat.size > max) fail();
                return input.fs.readFileSync(path);
              };
              const parse = (bytes) => {
                let value;
                try { value = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8")); } catch { fail(); }
                if (!canonical(value).equals(bytes)) fail();
                return value;
              };
              const root = resolveRoot(input.inputRoot);
              const envelopeBytes = read(root, "publication-envelope.json", 65_536);
              const envelope = parse(envelopeBytes);
              exactKeys(envelope, [
                "schemaVersion", "type", "repository", "publicationMode", "tag", "targetCommit",
                "mainSourceIdentitySha256", "mainSourcePrNumber", "mainSourceHeadSha",
                "mainSourceMergeCommitSha",
                "runtimeContractId", "inventoryReceiptSha256", "productionGateReceiptSha256",
                "compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256", "compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256",
                "assetOrder", "assets"
              ]);
              const normal = envelope.publicationMode === "normal";
              const compatibility = envelope.publicationMode === "compatibility_bootstrap";
              if ((!normal && !compatibility) || envelope.schemaVersion !== "1"
                || envelope.type !== "control_plane_publication_envelope"
                || envelope.repository !== repository || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(envelope.targetCommit)
                || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256)
                || !Number.isSafeInteger(envelope.mainSourcePrNumber) || envelope.mainSourcePrNumber < 1
                || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(envelope.mainSourceHeadSha)
                || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
                || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,127}$/.test(envelope.runtimeContractId)) fail();
              const nonGate = Object.freeze([
                Object.freeze(["control-plane-app.zip", "attest_control_plane_app"]),
                Object.freeze(["artifact.json", "attest_artifact"]),
                Object.freeze(["writer-registry.json", "attest_writer_registry"]),
                Object.freeze(["release-declaration.json", "attest_release_declaration"]),
                Object.freeze(["release-assembly.json", "attest_release_assembly"]),
                Object.freeze(["dependency-build-receipt.json", "attest_dependency_build_receipt"])
              ]);
              const lastName = normal
                ? "production-gate-" + envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256 + ".json"
                : "compatibility-publication-" + envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 + ".json";
              if ((normal && (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256)
                  || envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256 !== null
                  || envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256 !== null
                  || envelope.tag !== "control-plane-app-" + envelope.targetCommit + "-" + envelope.runtimeContractId))
                || (compatibility && (envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== null
                  || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256)
                  || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256)
                  || envelope.tag !== "control-plane-compatibility-" + envelope.targetCommit + "-" + envelope.runtimeContractId))) fail();
              const fileOrder = Object.freeze([...nonGate.map(([name]) => name), lastName]);
              if (!Array.isArray(envelope.assetOrder) || envelope.assetOrder.join("\n") !== fileOrder.join("\n")
                || !Array.isArray(envelope.assets) || envelope.assets.length !== fileOrder.length) fail();
              const rows = new Map();
              for (let index = 0; index < fileOrder.length; index += 1) {
                const row = envelope.assets[index];
                exactKeys(row, ["name", "sha256", "size"]);
                if (row.name !== fileOrder[index] || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(row.sha256)
                  || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.size) || row.size < 1 || row.size > 536_870_912) fail();
                const bytes = read(root, row.name, 536_870_912);
                if (bytes.length !== row.size || sha256(bytes) !== row.sha256) fail();
                rows.set(row.name, Object.freeze({ ...row, bytes }));
              }
              const expectedRootNames = ["publication-envelope.json", ...fileOrder].sort();
              if (/^authorize/.test(input.operation)) {
                if (input.fs.readdirSync(root).sort().join("\n") !== expectedRootNames.join("\n")) fail();
              } else {
                const authorizedNames = [
                  "approval-evidence.json", "attestation-subjects", "predicates",
                  "publication-authorization.json", "publication-envelope.json", ...fileOrder
                ].sort();
                if (input.fs.readdirSync(root).sort().join("\n") !== authorizedNames.join("\n")) fail();
              }
              const workflowPath = normal
                ? ".github/workflows/control-plane-artifact-gate.yml"
                : ".github/workflows/control-plane-compatibility-artifact-gate.yml";
              const predicate = Object.freeze({
                schema: "control_plane_publication_attestation_v1",
                repository,
                sourceSha: envelope.targetCommit,
                workflowPath,
                workflowRef: repository + "/" + workflowPath + "@refs/heads/master",
                workflowSha: envelope.targetCommit,
                publicationMode: envelope.publicationMode,
                publicationEnvelopeSha256: sha256(envelopeBytes),
                inventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.inventoryReceiptSha256,
                productionGateReceiptSha256: envelope.productionGateReceiptSha256,
                compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityInventoryReceiptSha256,
                compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256: envelope.compatibilityPublicationReceiptSha256
              });
              const predicateBytes = canonical(predicate);
              const api = (route, parameters = {}) => input.github.request(route, { owner, repo, ...parameters });
              const authorize = async () => {
                if (input.expectedSourceCommit !== envelope.targetCommit || input.context.sha !== envelope.targetCommit
                  || input.context.ref !== "refs/heads/master" || Number(input.context.runAttempt) !== 1) fail();
                const [branch, environment, approvals] = await Promise.all([
                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "artifact-publication" }),
                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: input.context.runId })
                ]);
                if (branch.data?.commit?.sha !== envelope.targetCommit
                  || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
                  || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
                  || environment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false) fail();
                const required = environment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
                if (!Array.isArray(required) || required.length !== 1 || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true
                  || !Array.isArray(required[0].reviewers) || required[0].reviewers.length < 1) fail();
                const approved = (Array.isArray(approvals.data) ? approvals.data : []).filter((row) =>
                  row.state === "approved" && row.environments?.length === 1
                  && row.environments[0]?.name === "artifact-publication");
                if (approved.length !== 1 || !approved[0].user?.login || !approved[0].user?.id
                  || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(input.context.actor).toLowerCase()
                  || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
                if (required[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"
                  || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id) || row.reviewer.id < 1
                  || typeof row.reviewer?.login !== "string"
                  || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer.login))) fail();
                const resolvedUser = (await api("GET /users/{username}", {
                  username: approved[0].user.login
                })).data;
                if (String(resolvedUser?.id) !== String(approved[0].user.id)
                  || String(resolvedUser?.login).toLowerCase() !== approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()) fail();
                const matches = required[0].reviewers.filter((row) =>
                  String(row.reviewer.id) === String(approved[0].user.id)
                  && row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase() === approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase());
                if (matches.length !== 1) fail();
                const declaration = parse(rows.get("release-declaration.json").bytes);
                if (!Number.isSafeInteger(declaration.mainSourcePrNumber)
                  || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(declaration.mainSourceHeadSha)
                  || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(declaration.mainSourceMergeCommitSha)
                  || declaration.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
                  || declaration.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
                  || declaration.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                  || declaration.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) fail();
                if (normal) {
                  const gate = parse(rows.get(lastName).bytes);
                  if (gate.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== envelope.mainSourceIdentitySha256
                    || gate.mainSourcePrNumber !== envelope.mainSourcePrNumber
                    || gate.mainSourceHeadSha !== envelope.mainSourceHeadSha
                    || gate.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== envelope.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) fail();
                }
                const [pull, ancestry] = await Promise.all([
                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}", { pull_number: declaration.mainSourcePrNumber }),
                  api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{basehead}", {

As in Task 9, each committed `script:` scalar contains the complete byte-identical fixed function declaration before the shown call. Compatibility changes only the closed operation name and expected `compatibility_bootstrap`/receipt bindings; it does not add a second control implementation or execute repository code.

- [ ] **Step 4: Add anti-reuse and permanent-ineligibility tests**

```js
test("compatibility publisher cannot be reached through reusable workflow authority", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const normalWorkflow = await readFile(normalPath, "utf8");
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /workflow_call:/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /^    uses: \.\/\.github\/workflows\//m);
  assert.equal((workflow.match(/contents: write/g) ?? []).length, 2);
  assert.equal((workflow.match(/environment: artifact-publication/g) ?? []).length, 2);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare"), /ref: \$\{\{ github\.sha \}\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(jobBlock(workflow, "source-prepare"), /ref: refs\/heads\/master/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "verify"), /ref: \$\{\{ needs\.source-prepare\.outputs\.source_commit \}\}/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "tokenless-builder"), /permissions: \{\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(jobBlock(workflow, "tokenless-builder"), /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|GITHUB_TOKEN|github\.token/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "publish"), /Re-hash opaque compatibility publication and recheck approval/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "verify"), /pull-requests: read/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "publish"), /pull-requests: read/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(jobBlock(workflow, "publish"), /actions\/checkout|actions\/setup-node|node scripts\/|child_process|eval\(/);
  assert.match(jobBlock(workflow, "publish"), /actions\/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea/);
  const completePublisher = completePublisherControlText(workflow);
  assert.equal((completePublisher.match(/actions\/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6/g) ?? []).length, 7);
  assert.equal((completePublisher.match(/uses: actions\/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6\n        with:\n          github-token: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\n          push-to-registry: false\n          create-storage-record: false/g) ?? []).length, 7);
  assert.match(completePublisher, /authorized-(?:receipt-)?publication\/predicates\/(?:non-gate|compatibility)\.json/);
  assert.match(workflow, /control-plane-compatibility-/);
  assert.match(workflow, /compatibility-publication-\$\{\{ needs\.verify\.outputs\.compatibility_publication_receipt_sha256 \}\}\.json/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /name: Publish Production Gate|id: gate_pair|steps\.gate_pair\.outputs\.attest_production_gate|attestation-subjects\/gate\/production-gate/);
  const subjectPaths = [...completePublisher.matchAll(/subject-path: \$\{\{ runner\.temp \}\}\/authorized-(?:receipt-)?publication\/attestation-subjects\/([^\n]+)/g)]
    .map((match) => match[1]);
  assert.deepEqual(subjectPaths, [
    "non-gate/control-plane-app.zip", "non-gate/artifact.json",
    "non-gate/writer-registry.json", "non-gate/release-declaration.json",
    "non-gate/release-assembly.json", "non-gate/dependency-build-receipt.json",
    "compatibility/compatibility-publication-${{ needs.verify.outputs.compatibility_publication_receipt_sha256 }}.json"
  ]);
  assert.equal(subjectPaths.some((subjectPath) => /[*?\[\]]/.test(subjectPath)), false);
  assert.equal((completePublisher.match(/function runLiteralBoundedPublisherControl/g) ?? []).length, 4);
  const compatibilityBodies = extractLiteralPublisherControlBodies(completePublisher);
  const normalBodies = extractLiteralPublisherControlBodies(completePublisherControlText(normalWorkflow));
  assert.equal(new Set(compatibilityBodies.map(sha256Hex)).size, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(compatibilityBodies, normalBodies);
});

After controller return and its mandatory transport close, the CLI destroys all OIDC buffers, closes the raw and replay artifact inputs, calls Artifact lifecycle `finalizeAndReadBackAbsent()`, and only then writes/announces the already Receipt-built final status.
- Receipt-owned `validateTerminal({ status, terminalBundle, plan, artifactAccepted })` consumes the exact original Bootstrap-branded ordinary immutable-terminal value, exact Bootstrap-owned `{ bytes, sha256 }` wrapper, and canonical `null` or the unchanged validated five-field acceptance acknowledgment. It returns only the Receipt-owned terminal projection including the terminal-bundle-derived `transactionInvocationSha256`; an observed acknowledgment contributes only its three selector bindings and `accepted/acceptedAt`, never the invocation. Artifact passes that terminal projection unchanged into Receipt-owned `toControllerCloseoutInput`, so immutable closeout and final status preserve the invocation without adding it to either the five-field acknowledgment or sixteen-field ordinary status. Receipt alone parses its `HOST_TERMINAL_BUNDLE_V1_CONTRACT`, verifies body, outer record, accepted-plan/accepted-artifact/invocation edges, held finalizer fence at receipt publication, initial closeout record/lease, digest, and status binding. Artifact then completes upload/ACK and performs a separate ordinary status readback which proves finalizer inactive and both leases free before final status. A nonterminal, pre-admission rejection, bare durable-rejection flag, null bytes, invocation mismatch, or invalid Receipt Task 2 proof cannot enter this validator.
- Receipt-owned closeout validation is strictly two-stage. `validateAckResponse({ transportResult, immutable, observation, uploadStartedStatus, expected })` validates the complete ACK/CAS envelope. Then `createCommittedStatusRequest({ plan, immutable, observation, ackStatus }) -> { transportRequest, expectedStatus }` produces the separate ordinary read-only request; `ackStatus` is the validated value or canonical `null` only when the ACK transport response may have been lost after durable host commit. `validateUploadCommittedObserved({ transportResult, immutable, observation, terminal, ackStatus, expectedStatus, closeoutBindings })` validates that complete independent envelope plus the unchanged exact `expectedBindings({ plan })` return, including source-origin identity, terminal-bundle identity, finalizer inactive, and both leases free; it returns the exact ordinary-status value plus its independently computed `responseSha256`. Only this last return may become `validatedFinalHostStatus`; the ACK transition is never replayed. Receipt-built final status places its owner `terminalPublishedAt` immediately after `transactionInvocationSha256`, sets it to canonical `null` for no-claim, and preserves the host terminal value for all five terminal results; Artifact never substitutes controller observation time.
- Only a validated immutable terminal host receipt may enter upload-start/upload/readback/ACK. Upload-start and ACK each request a transition-specific one-use OIDC token from the Receipt adapter using Bootstrap's sole audience grammar, `gccgw-control-plane-closeout-${transition}:${bindingSha256}`; `bindingSha256` is the digest of the complete Bootstrap-owned canonical transition tuple, not a terminal-receipt-only or artifact-observation-only shortcut. The ACK envelope is passed intact to Receipt-owned validation; afterward one separate read-only status request observes the host's independent committed state and contributes its exact `responseSha256` to final status. Receipt reserves and tests `classifyControllerCloseout({ preAdmissionDurableRejection: true, admissionAccepted: false })`, but the frozen Bootstrap ABI exposes no pre-admission rejection brand or producer; therefore this Artifact controller never calls that branch and never produces `admission_rejected_no_transaction`. A bare `admissionAccepted: false`, transport diagnostic, or arbitrary ordinary `durableRejection` fails closed. `terminal_quiescence_rejected` belongs to an already accepted critical transaction, remains transitional, and is polled within the same absolute bound. If it never becomes immutable terminal, the result is `controller_incomplete_no_production_claim`; once a later ordinary status is the branded immutable critical terminal, Artifact reads its single terminal bundle and Receipt maps it to `validated_critical_failure`. All no-claim paths perform zero upload-start requests, zero Actions closeout uploads, and zero ACK requests.
- Receipt's closed normal result algebra remains exactly `validated_deployment`, `validated_stopped_pre_switch`, `validated_schema_only_change`, `validated_rolled_back`, `validated_critical_failure`, `admission_rejected_no_transaction`, `receipt_invalid_no_production_claim`, and `controller_incomplete_no_production_claim`; with the frozen Bootstrap ABI, the Artifact controller can emit every row except reserved `admission_rejected_no_transaction`.
- The two terminal-bundle failure domains are disjoint. Any `readTerminalBundleBytes(...)` transport, framing, timeout, chunk, size, or aggregate-read failure means the controller never obtained canonical immutable Receipt input and therefore maps only to `controller_incomplete_no_production_claim`. Only after that owner reader returns its valid `{ bytes, sha256 }` wrapper may a failure from Receipt's `validateTerminal(...)` map to `receipt_invalid_no_production_claim`; neither catch can alias the other, and both branches perform zero upload/ACK.
- Host closeout dispositions `controller_closeout_pending`, `controller_closeout_acknowledged_released`, and `controller_closeout_abandoned_attached` are separate host-record facts and can never appear as `resultCode`.
