- [ ] **Step 3: Implement immutable plan/Gate admission binding**

```js
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { Transform } from "node:stream";
import { validateDeploymentPlanBytes } from "../../../scripts/control-plane-deployment-plan.mjs";
import { validateProductionGateReceipt } from "../../../scripts/control-plane-production-gate.mjs";
import {
  DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
  TRANSPORT_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES,
  validateTransportEnvelope
} from "./control-plane-transport-contract.mjs";
import {
  encodeExecuteAuthFrame,
  encodeStatusRequestFrame,
  readTerminalBundleBytes,
  validateArtifactAcceptedFrame,
  validateStatusResponseFrame
} from "./control-plane-host-protocol.mjs";
import {
  deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience,
  validateProductionAuthorizationRecord
} from "./control-plane-production-authorization.mjs";
import {
  buildControllerFinalStatus,
  buildControllerCloseout,
  classifyControllerCloseout,
  validateControllerCloseoutBytes
} from "./control-plane-controller-closeout.mjs";
import { CONTROLLER_RESULTS } from "./control-plane-receipt-contract.mjs";
import { canonicalizeDatabaseContracts } from "./database-contract.mjs";
import { sha256Hex } from "./canonical-json.mjs";

const RESULT_CODES = new Set(CONTROLLER_RESULTS);
const PENDING_CONTROLLER_RESULT_FIELDS = Object.freeze(["resultKind", "finalStatus"]);
const FINAL_STATUS_WRAPPER_FIELDS = Object.freeze(["value", "bytes", "sha256"]);
const pendingControllerResultEvidence = new WeakMap();
const consumedPendingControllerResults = new WeakSet();

function hasExactFrozenDataFields(value, fields) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
    || Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Object.prototype || !Object.isFrozen(value)) return false;
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(value);
  return keys.length === fields.length && keys.every((key, index) => key === fields[index])
    && keys.every((key) => {
      const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
      return descriptor?.enumerable === true && descriptor.configurable === false
        && Object.hasOwn(descriptor, "value") && descriptor.get === undefined
        && descriptor.set === undefined;
    });
}

function createPendingControllerResult({ resultKind, resultCode, controllerRecoveryId, closeoutSha256, finalStatus }) {
  if (!hasExactFrozenDataFields(finalStatus, FINAL_STATUS_WRAPPER_FIELDS)
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(finalStatus.bytes) || finalStatus.bytes.length < 1
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(finalStatus.sha256 ?? "")
    || sha256Hex(finalStatus.bytes) !== finalStatus.sha256
    || finalStatus.value === null || typeof finalStatus.value !== "object"
    || !Object.isFrozen(finalStatus.value)
    || !["terminal", "no_claim"].includes(resultKind)
    || finalStatus.value.resultKind !== resultKind
    || finalStatus.value.resultCode !== resultCode
    || finalStatus.value.controllerRecoveryId !== controllerRecoveryId
    || finalStatus.value.controllerCloseoutSha256 !== closeoutSha256) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_pending_result_invalid");
  }
  const pending = Object.freeze({ resultKind, finalStatus });
  pendingControllerResultEvidence.set(pending, Object.freeze({
    resultKind,
    resultCode,
    controllerRecoveryId,
    closeoutSha256,
    finalStatus,
    finalStatusValue: finalStatus.value,
    finalStatusBytes: finalStatus.bytes,
    finalStatusSha256: finalStatus.sha256
  }));
  return pending;
}

export function consumeProductionControllerPendingResult(pending) {
  const evidence = pendingControllerResultEvidence.get(pending);
  if (!hasExactFrozenDataFields(pending, PENDING_CONTROLLER_RESULT_FIELDS)
    || evidence === undefined || consumedPendingControllerResults.has(pending)
    || pending.resultKind !== evidence.resultKind
    || pending.finalStatus !== evidence.finalStatus
    || pending.finalStatus.value !== evidence.finalStatusValue
    || pending.finalStatus.bytes !== evidence.finalStatusBytes
    || pending.finalStatus.sha256 !== evidence.finalStatusSha256
    || pending.finalStatus.value.resultKind !== evidence.resultKind
    || pending.finalStatus.value.resultCode !== evidence.resultCode
    || pending.finalStatus.value.controllerRecoveryId !== evidence.controllerRecoveryId
    || pending.finalStatus.value.controllerCloseoutSha256 !== evidence.closeoutSha256
    || sha256Hex(pending.finalStatus.bytes) !== evidence.finalStatusSha256) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_pending_result_invalid");
  }
  consumedPendingControllerResults.add(pending);
  return pending;
}

const STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000;
const STATUS_POLL_LIMIT_MS = 30_000;
const STATUS_POLL_REQUEST_LIMIT = 6;

function createExactSizeHashingStream({ stream, expectedSize, expectedSha256 }) {
  if (stream === null || typeof stream?.pipe !== "function"
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedSize) || expectedSize < 1
    || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(expectedSha256)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_stream_invalid");
  }
  const hash = createHash("sha256");
  let observedSize = 0;
  const verifier = new Transform({
    transform(chunk, _encoding, callback) {
      const bytes = Buffer.isBuffer(chunk) ? chunk : Buffer.from(chunk);
      observedSize += bytes.length;
      if (observedSize > expectedSize) {
        callback(new Error("production_controller_artifact_stream_invalid"));
        return;
      }
      hash.update(bytes);
      callback(null, bytes);
    },
    flush(callback) {
      if (observedSize !== expectedSize || hash.digest("hex") !== expectedSha256) {
        callback(new Error("production_controller_artifact_stream_invalid"));
        return;
      }
      callback();
    }
  });
  return stream.pipe(verifier);
}

function validatePostApprovalEvidence({ githubEvidence, plan, authorization }) {
  const bindings = Object.freeze([
    githubEvidence.gateId === plan.gateId,
    githubEvidence.productionGateReceiptSha256 === plan.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    githubEvidence.deploymentPlanSha256 === authorization.value.deploymentPlanSha256,
    githubEvidence.inventoryReceiptSha256 === plan.inventoryReceiptSha256,
    githubEvidence.effectivePlanExpiresAt === plan.expiresAt,
    githubEvidence.transactionId === plan.transactionId,
    githubEvidence.sourceCommit === plan.sourceCommit,
    githubEvidence.mainSourceIdentitySha256 === plan.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    githubEvidence.mainSourcePrNumber === plan.mainSourcePrNumber,
    githubEvidence.mainSourceHeadSha === plan.mainSourceHeadSha,
    githubEvidence.mainSourceMergeCommitSha === plan.mainSourceMergeCommitSha,
    githubEvidence.workflowSha === plan.sourceCommit,
    String(githubEvidence.runId) === authorization.value.runId,
    githubEvidence.runAttempt === authorization.value.runAttempt,
    githubEvidence.databaseContractsSha256 === authorization.value.databaseContractsSha256,
    githubEvidence.hostExecutionContractSha256 === authorization.value.hostExecutionContractSha256,
    githubEvidence.artifactSize === plan.artifact.sizeBytes,
    githubEvidence.artifactSha256 === plan.artifact.sha256
  ]);
  return bindings.every(Boolean);
}

function isPossiblyLostCloseoutResponse(transportResult, error) {
  const envelope = validateTransportEnvelope(transportResult);
  return error instanceof Error
    && envelope.exitCode !== 0
    && envelope.responseBytes.length === 0
    && TRANSPORT_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.includes(envelope.diagnosticCode);
}

async function pollImmutableTerminalStatus({
  transport,
  plan,
  deploymentPlanSha256,
  clock,
  acceptedOrPossiblyLost
}) {
  const startedAt = clock.monotonicNow();
  if (!Number.isFinite(startedAt) || startedAt < 0) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_monotonic_clock_invalid");
  }
  const deadline = startedAt + STATUS_POLL_LIMIT_MS;
  if (!Number.isFinite(deadline)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_monotonic_clock_invalid");
  }
  let lastObserved = startedAt;
  const observeMonotonic = () => {
    const observed = clock.monotonicNow();
    if (!Number.isFinite(observed) || observed < lastObserved) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_monotonic_clock_invalid");
    }
    lastObserved = observed;
    return observed;
  };
  const waitUntil = async (scheduledAt) => {
    while (true) {
      const observed = observeMonotonic();
      if (observed >= deadline || observed >= scheduledAt) return observed;
      const sleepMs = Math.max(1, Math.min(
        STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS,
        Math.ceil(scheduledAt - observed),
        Math.ceil(deadline - observed)
      ));
      await clock.sleep(sleepMs);
    }
  };
  if (acceptedOrPossiblyLost !== null
    && !TRANSPORT_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.includes(acceptedOrPossiblyLost)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_transport_failed");
  }
  let observedCriticalTransition = false;
  for (let scheduleIndex = 0; scheduleIndex <= STATUS_POLL_REQUEST_LIMIT; scheduleIndex += 1) {
    const scheduledAt = startedAt + (scheduleIndex * STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
    const slotObserved = await waitUntil(scheduledAt);
    if (slotObserved >= deadline || scheduleIndex === STATUS_POLL_REQUEST_LIMIT) break;
    const expectedStatus = Object.freeze({
      requestId: `controller-status-${String(scheduleIndex).padStart(6, "0")}`,
      gateId: plan.gateId,
      deploymentPlanSha256,
      transactionId: plan.transactionId
    });
    const requestBytes = encodeStatusRequestFrame(expectedStatus);
    const dispatchAt = observeMonotonic();
    if (dispatchAt >= deadline) break;
    const requestRemaining = deadline - dispatchAt;
    const transportResult = await transport.request({
      credentialId: DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
      requestBytes,
      timeoutMs: Math.max(1, Math.min(STATUS_POLL_LIMIT_MS, Math.ceil(requestRemaining)))
    });
    if (observeMonotonic() >= deadline) break;
    const envelope = validateTransportEnvelope(transportResult);
    if (envelope.exitCode !== 0) {
      if (!TRANSPORT_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.includes(envelope.diagnosticCode)) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_transport_failed");
      }
      continue;
    }
    const value = validateStatusResponseFrame(envelope.responseBytes, expectedStatus);
    if (value.immutableTerminal === true) return value;
    if (value.durableRejection === true) {
      if (value.resultCode !== "terminal_quiescence_rejected") {
        throw new Error("production_controller_durable_rejection_invalid");
      }
      observedCriticalTransition = true;
    } else if (value.resultCode !== "terminal_quiescence_pending" && observedCriticalTransition) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_critical_transition_invalid");
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function buildNoClaimControllerResult({ plan, resultCode, closeoutPublisher, clock }) {
  const runnerCleanupVerified = await closeoutPublisher.cleanupAndReadBackRunnerMaterial({ plan });
  if (runnerCleanupVerified !== true) throw new Error("production_controller_cleanup_invalid");
  const noClaim = closeoutPublisher.createNoClaimEvidence({
    plan,
    resultCode,
    runnerCleanupVerified
  });
  validateControllerCloseoutBytes(noClaim.immutable.bytes, noClaim.closeoutBindings);
  const finalStatus = buildControllerFinalStatus({
    controllerCloseoutBytes: noClaim.immutable.bytes,
    closeoutBindings: noClaim.closeoutBindings,
    actionsArtifactObservation: null,
    validatedFinalHostStatus: null,
    artifactReleaseTag: null,
    backupResult: null,
    observedAt: clock.now().toISOString()
  });
  return createPendingControllerResult({
    resultKind: "no_claim",
    resultCode,
    controllerRecoveryId: plan.controllerRecoveryId,
    closeoutSha256: noClaim.immutable.sha256,
    finalStatus
  });
}

export async function runProductionController({
  planBytes,
  gateReceiptBytes,
  artifactStream,
  oidcToken,
  transport,
  githubEvidence,
  closeoutPublisher,
  clock
}) {
  let controllerPrimaryError = null;
  try {
  const now = clock.now().toISOString();
  const runContext = Object.freeze({
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    runId: String(githubEvidence.runId),
    runAttempt: githubEvidence.runAttempt,
    ref: "refs/heads/master",
    sourceCommit: githubEvidence.sourceCommit
  });
  const validated = validateDeploymentPlanBytes({ bytes: planBytes, now, runContext });
  const plan = validated.plan;
  const planDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(plan.databaseContracts);
  const deploymentPlanSha256 = sha256Hex(planBytes);
  const authorization = validateProductionAuthorizationRecord({
    bytes: githubEvidence.authorizationRecordBytes,
    expected: Object.freeze({
      deploymentPlanSha256,
      productionGateReceiptSha256: sha256Hex(gateReceiptBytes),
      databaseContractsSha256: planDatabase.sha256,
      transactionId: plan.transactionId,
      sourceSha: plan.sourceCommit,
      runId: String(githubEvidence.runId),
      runAttempt: githubEvidence.runAttempt
    }),
    now
  });
  const gate = validateProductionGateReceipt({
    productionGateId: plan.gateId,
    bytes: gateReceiptBytes,
    now,
    expectedRepository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    expectedSourceCommit: plan.sourceCommit
  });
  if (sha256Hex(gateReceiptBytes) !== plan.productionGateReceiptSha256
    || gate.receipt.artifactSha256 !== plan.artifact.sha256
    || authorization.value.sourceSha !== plan.sourceCommit
    || githubEvidence.databaseContractsSha256 !== planDatabase.sha256
    || validatePostApprovalEvidence({ githubEvidence, plan, authorization }) !== true) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_binding_invalid");
  }
  const expectedAudience = deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience(authorization.sha256);
  if (githubEvidence.oidcAudience !== expectedAudience) throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_audience_invalid");
  const authFrameBytes = encodeExecuteAuthFrame({
    deploymentPlanBytes: planBytes,
    productionGateReceiptBytes: gateReceiptBytes,
    authorizationRecordBytes: githubEvidence.authorizationRecordBytes,
    oidcTokenBytes: oidcToken
  });
  const expectedReady = Object.freeze({
    transactionId: plan.transactionId,
    productionGateReceiptSha256: plan.productionGateReceiptSha256,
    deploymentPlanSha256,
    authorizationRecordSha256: authorization.sha256,
    artifactSize: plan.artifact.sizeBytes,
    artifactSha256: plan.artifact.sha256
  });
  let executeDiagnostic = null;
  let artifactAccepted = null;
  const executeEnvelope = validateTransportEnvelope(await transport.execute({
    credentialId: DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
    authFrameBytes,
    expectedReady,
    artifactCapability: createExactSizeHashingStream({
      stream: artifactStream,
      expectedSize: plan.artifact.sizeBytes,
      expectedSha256: plan.artifact.sha256
    }),
    artifactSize: plan.artifact.sizeBytes
  }));
  if (executeEnvelope.exitCode === 0) {
    try {
      artifactAccepted = validateArtifactAcceptedFrame(executeEnvelope.responseBytes, Object.freeze({
        gateId: plan.gateId,
        deploymentPlanSha256,
        transactionId: plan.transactionId
      }));
    } catch {
      // A malformed or lost success ACK is ambiguous: poll the same transaction and never replay execute.
    }
  } else {
    executeDiagnostic = executeEnvelope.diagnosticCode;
  }

  const status = await pollImmutableTerminalStatus({
    transport,
    plan,
    deploymentPlanSha256,
    clock,
    acceptedOrPossiblyLost: executeDiagnostic
  });
  if (status === null) {
    const resultCode = classifyControllerCloseout({ controllerComplete: false });
    return await buildNoClaimControllerResult({
      plan,
      resultCode,
      closeoutPublisher,
      clock
    });
  }
  if (status.immutableTerminal !== true || status.durableRejection === true) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_terminal_status_invalid");
  }

  let terminalBundle;
  try {
    terminalBundle = await readTerminalBundleBytes({
      transport,
      validatedStatus: status,
      timeoutMs: 30_000
    });
  } catch {
    return await buildNoClaimControllerResult({
      plan,
      resultCode: classifyControllerCloseout({ controllerComplete: false }),
      closeoutPublisher,
      clock
    });
  }
  let terminal;
  try {
    terminal = closeoutPublisher.validateTerminal({ status, terminalBundle, plan, artifactAccepted });
  } catch {
    return await buildNoClaimControllerResult({
      plan,
      resultCode: classifyControllerCloseout({ receiptValid: false }),
      closeoutPublisher,
      clock
    });
  }
  const runnerCleanupVerified = await closeoutPublisher.cleanupAndReadBackRunnerMaterial({ plan });
  if (runnerCleanupVerified !== true) throw new Error("production_controller_cleanup_invalid");
  const immutable = buildControllerCloseout(
    closeoutPublisher.toControllerCloseoutInput({ plan, terminal, runnerCleanupVerified })
  );
  const closeoutBindings = closeoutPublisher.expectedBindings({ plan });
  validateControllerCloseoutBytes(immutable.bytes, closeoutBindings);

  const uploadStartedRequest = await closeoutPublisher.createUploadStartedRequest({
    plan,
    immutable
  });
  const uploadStartedResult = await transport.request(uploadStartedRequest);
  const uploadStartedStatus = closeoutPublisher.validateUploadStartedResponse({
    transportResult: uploadStartedResult,
    immutable,
    expected: closeoutBindings
  });

  let localHandle = null;
  let localPrimaryError = null;
  try {
    localHandle = await closeoutPublisher.writeImmutableLocalFile(immutable);
    const uploaded = await closeoutPublisher.uploadActionsArtifact({
      immutable,
      localHandle
    });
    const observation = await closeoutPublisher.readBackExactActionsArtifact({ uploaded, immutable, plan });

    const ackRequest = await closeoutPublisher.createAckRequest({
      plan,
      immutable,
      observation,
      uploadStartedStatus
    });
    const ackResult = await transport.request(ackRequest);
    let ackStatus = null;
    try {
      ackStatus = closeoutPublisher.validateAckResponse({
        transportResult: ackResult,
        immutable,
        observation,
        uploadStartedStatus,
        expected: closeoutBindings
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isPossiblyLostCloseoutResponse(ackResult, error)) throw error;
    }
    const committedRead = closeoutPublisher.createCommittedStatusRequest({
      plan,
      immutable,
      observation,
      ackStatus
    });
    const committedStatusResult = await transport.request(committedRead.transportRequest);
    const committedStatus = closeoutPublisher.validateUploadCommittedObserved({
      transportResult: committedStatusResult,
      immutable,
      observation,
      terminal,
      ackStatus,
      expectedStatus: committedRead.expectedStatus,
      closeoutBindings
    });

    const resultCode = immutable.value.controllerResult;
    if (!RESULT_CODES.has(resultCode)) throw new Error("production_controller_result_invalid");
    const finalStatus = buildControllerFinalStatus({
      controllerCloseoutBytes: immutable.bytes,
      closeoutBindings,
      actionsArtifactObservation: observation,
      validatedFinalHostStatus: committedStatus,
      artifactReleaseTag: plan.artifact.releaseTag,
      backupResult: terminal.backupResult,
      observedAt: clock.now().toISOString()
    });
    return createPendingControllerResult({
      resultKind: "terminal",
      resultCode,
      controllerRecoveryId: plan.controllerRecoveryId,
      closeoutSha256: immutable.sha256,
      finalStatus
    });
  } catch (error) {
    localPrimaryError = error;
    throw error;
  } finally {
    if (localHandle !== null) {
      let localCleanupFailed = false;
      try {
        localCleanupFailed = await closeoutPublisher.deleteLocalFileAndReadBackAbsent(localHandle) !== true;
      } catch {
        localCleanupFailed = true;
      }
      if (localCleanupFailed && localPrimaryError !== null) {
        throw new AggregateError(
          [localPrimaryError, new Error("production_controller_local_cleanup_failed")],
          "production_controller_primary_and_cleanup_failed"
        );
      }
      if (localCleanupFailed) throw new Error("production_controller_local_cleanup_failed");
    }
  }
  } catch (error) {
    controllerPrimaryError = error;
    throw error;
  } finally {
    let transportCloseError = null;
    try {
      await transport.close();
    } catch {
      transportCloseError = new Error("production_controller_transport_close_failed");
    }
    if (transportCloseError !== null && controllerPrimaryError !== null) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [controllerPrimaryError, transportCloseError],
        "production_controller_primary_and_transport_close_failed"
      );
    }
    if (transportCloseError !== null) throw transportCloseError;
  }
}
```

  const pending = await runProductionController(controllerFixture());

  });
  Object.freeze(accessor);
  for (const fault of [

    Object.freeze({ ...pending, extra: true }),

    accessor,
    Object.freeze({ resultKind: pending.resultKind, finalStatus: Object.freeze({ ...pending.finalStatus }) }),

    Object.freeze({ resultKind: "no_claim", finalStatus: pending.finalStatus })
  ]) {

} from "../../../scripts/control-plane-artifact-assembly.mjs";
import {
  PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT
} from "./control-plane-production-authorization.mjs";
import {
  DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
  createSecureSshTransport
} from "./control-plane-transport-contract.mjs";
import {
  CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT
} from "./control-plane-controller-closeout.mjs";
import {
  createControllerCloseoutAdapter
} from "./control-plane-controller-closeout-adapter.mjs";
import {
  consumeProductionControllerPendingResult,
  runProductionController
} from "./control-plane-production-controller.mjs";

const CONTROLLER_INPUT_FLAG_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "plan", "gate-receipt", "artifact", "postapproval-evidence", "authorization-record",
  "closeout-directory", "retention-days", "final-status-output", "github-output"
]);
const CONTROLLER_INPUT_FILE_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  plan: DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT.maxBytes,
  "gate-receipt": PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT.maxBytes,
  "postapproval-evidence": POSTAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.maxBytes,
  "authorization-record": PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT.maxBytes
});
const OIDC_REQUEST_FIELDS = Object.freeze(["audience", "requestUrl", "requestToken"]);
const TRANSITION_OIDC_FIELDS = Object.freeze(["audience", "transition", "bindingSha256"]);
const CLOSEOUT_TRANSITIONS = Object.freeze(["upload_started", "upload_committed_observed"]);
const ARTIFACT_INPUT_STATES = new WeakMap();
const SENSITIVE_OIDC_VALUES = new WeakSet();
const ACTIVE_RUNNER_ROOTS = new Set();
const PRIVATE_RUNNER_STORES = new WeakSet();
const RECEIPT_FILE_HANDLES = new WeakMap();

function assertExactOwnDataObject(value, fields, code, allowNullPrototype = false) {
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(value ?? {});
  const prototype = value === null || typeof value !== "object" ? undefined : Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
    || (prototype !== Object.prototype && !(allowNullPrototype && prototype === null))
    || keys.length !== fields.length || fields.some((field) => !keys.includes(field))
    || keys.some((key) => typeof key !== "string")
    || keys.some((key) => {
      const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
      return descriptor === undefined || !Object.hasOwn(descriptor, "value")
        || descriptor.get !== undefined || descriptor.set !== undefined
        || descriptor.enumerable !== true;
    })) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
}

function assertPrivateMode(stat, code) {
  if (!stat.isFile() && !stat.isDirectory()) throw new Error(code);
  if (process.platform !== "win32" && ((stat.mode & 0o077) !== 0
    || (typeof process.getuid === "function" && stat.uid !== process.getuid()))) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
}

function resolveExistingControllerPath(path, kind) {
  if (typeof path !== "string" || path.length < 1 || path.includes("\u0000")
    || !isAbsolute(path) || resolve(path) !== path) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  }
  const linkStat = lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
  if (linkStat === undefined || linkStat.isSymbolicLink()
    || (kind === "file" && (!linkStat.isFile() || linkStat.nlink !== 1))
    || (kind === "directory" && !linkStat.isDirectory())) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  }
  assertPrivateMode(linkStat, "production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  const canonical = realpathSync(path);
  if (canonical !== path) throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  return canonical;
}

function resolveMissingControllerLeaf(path) {
  if (typeof path !== "string" || path.length < 1 || path.includes("\u0000")
    || !isAbsolute(path) || resolve(path) !== path
    || basename(path) === "." || basename(path) === ".."
    || lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  }
  const parent = dirname(path);
  const parentStat = lstatSync(parent, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
  if (parentStat === undefined || parentStat.isSymbolicLink() || !parentStat.isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  }
  assertPrivateMode(parentStat, "production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  const canonicalParent = realpathSync(parent);
  if (canonicalParent !== parent) throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_invalid");
  return join(canonicalParent, basename(path));
}

function validateControllerPathTopology(flags) {
  const canonical = Object.freeze({
    plan: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags.plan, "file"),
    gateReceipt: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags["gate-receipt"], "file"),
    artifact: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags.artifact, "file"),
    postapprovalEvidence: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags["postapproval-evidence"], "file"),
    authorizationRecord: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags["authorization-record"], "file"),
    closeoutDirectory: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags["closeout-directory"], "directory"),
    finalStatusOutput: resolveMissingControllerLeaf(flags["final-status-output"]),
    githubOutput: resolveExistingControllerPath(flags["github-output"], "file")
  });
  const values = Object.values(canonical);
  if (new Set(values).size !== values.length) throw new Error("production_controller_input_path_alias");
  return canonical;
}

async function readBoundedPrivateFile(path, maxBytes) {
  const before = lstatSync(path);
  if (!before.isFile() || before.isSymbolicLink() || before.nlink !== 1
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(before.size) || before.size < 1 || before.size > maxBytes) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_input_file_invalid");
  }
  assertPrivateMode(before, "production_controller_input_file_invalid");
  const handle = await openFile(path, FS_CONSTANTS.O_RDONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW);
  let primaryError = null;
  try {
    const opened = await handle.stat();
    if (!opened.isFile() || opened.nlink !== 1 || opened.dev !== before.dev
      || opened.ino !== before.ino || opened.size !== before.size) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_input_file_invalid");
    }
    const bytes = await handle.readFile();
    const after = await handle.stat();
    if (bytes.length !== before.size || after.size !== before.size
      || after.dev !== before.dev || after.ino !== before.ino) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_input_file_invalid");
    }
    return Buffer.from(bytes);
  } catch (error) {
    primaryError = error;
    throw error;
  } finally {
    let closeError = null;
    try {
      await handle.close();
    } catch {
      closeError = new Error("production_controller_input_file_close_failed");
    }
    if (closeError !== null && primaryError !== null) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [primaryError, closeError],
        "production_controller_input_file_primary_and_close_failed"
      );
    }
    if (closeError !== null) throw closeError;
  }
}

function brandArtifactInput(stream, fileHandle = null, ownedBuffer = null) {
  if (stream === null || typeof stream?.destroy !== "function" || ARTIFACT_INPUT_STATES.has(stream)
    || (fileHandle !== null && typeof fileHandle?.close !== "function")
    || (ownedBuffer !== null && (!Buffer.isBuffer(ownedBuffer) || ownedBuffer.length < 1))) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_input_invalid");
  }
  ARTIFACT_INPUT_STATES.set(stream, {
    fileHandle,
    ownedBuffer,
    streamClosed: false,
    fileHandleClosed: fileHandle === null,
    ownedBufferZero: ownedBuffer === null,
    closed: false
  });
  return stream;
}

async function readAndVerifyProductionControllerInputs(argument) {
  assertExactOwnDataObject(argument, ["flags", "runnerMaterialStore"],
    "production_controller_flags_invalid");
  const { flags, runnerMaterialStore } = argument;
  if (!PRIVATE_RUNNER_STORES.has(runnerMaterialStore)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_runner_material_root_invalid");
  }
  assertExactOwnDataObject(flags, CONTROLLER_INPUT_FLAG_FIELDS,
    "production_controller_flags_invalid", true);
  if (flags["retention-days"] !== "35") throw new Error("production_controller_retention_invalid");
  const paths = validateControllerPathTopology(flags);
  const [planBytes, gateReceiptBytes, postapprovalEvidenceBytes, authorizationRecordBytes] = await Promise.all([
    readBoundedPrivateFile(paths.plan, CONTROLLER_INPUT_FILE_LIMITS.plan),
    readBoundedPrivateFile(paths.gateReceipt, CONTROLLER_INPUT_FILE_LIMITS["gate-receipt"]),
    readBoundedPrivateFile(paths.postapprovalEvidence, CONTROLLER_INPUT_FILE_LIMITS["postapproval-evidence"]),
    readBoundedPrivateFile(paths.authorizationRecord, CONTROLLER_INPUT_FILE_LIMITS["authorization-record"])
  ]);
  const plan = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(planBytes, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT);
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes(gateReceiptBytes, PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT);
  const postapprovalEvidence = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(
    postapprovalEvidenceBytes,
    POSTAPPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT
  );
  parseCanonicalJsonBytes(authorizationRecordBytes, PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT);
  const artifactBefore = lstatSync(paths.artifact);
  if (!artifactBefore.isFile() || artifactBefore.isSymbolicLink() || artifactBefore.nlink !== 1
    || artifactBefore.size !== plan.artifact.sizeBytes
    || artifactBefore.size !== postapprovalEvidence.artifactSize
    || sha256Hex(planBytes) !== postapprovalEvidence.deploymentPlanSha256
    || sha256Hex(gateReceiptBytes) !== plan.productionGateReceiptSha256
    || plan.productionGateReceiptSha256 !== postapprovalEvidence.productionGateReceiptSha256
    || plan.artifact.sha256 !== postapprovalEvidence.artifactSha256) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_input_binding_invalid");
  }
  assertPrivateMode(artifactBefore, "production_controller_input_file_invalid");
  const artifactHandle = await openFile(paths.artifact, FS_CONSTANTS.O_RDONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW);
  let artifactStream = null;
  try {
    const opened = await artifactHandle.stat();
    if (!opened.isFile() || opened.nlink !== 1 || opened.dev !== artifactBefore.dev
      || opened.ino !== artifactBefore.ino || opened.size !== artifactBefore.size) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_input_file_invalid");
    }
    artifactStream = brandArtifactInput(
      artifactHandle.createReadStream({ autoClose: false, start: 0 }),
      artifactHandle
    );
    await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.registerArtifactInput(artifactStream);
    return Object.freeze({
      planBytes,
      gateReceiptBytes,
      artifactStream,
      postapprovalEvidence,
      authorizationRecordBytes,
      plan
    });
  } catch (primary) {
    const cleanupErrors = [];
    try {
      if (artifactStream !== null) await closeArtifactInput(artifactStream);
      else await artifactHandle.close();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(error);
    }
    if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [primary, ...cleanupErrors],
        "production_controller_artifact_registration_and_cleanup_failed"
      );
    }
    throw primary;
  }
}

function createFixedSystemClock() {
  if (arguments.length !== 0) throw new Error("production_controller_clock_invalid");
  return Object.freeze({
    now: () => new Date(),
    monotonicNow: () => performance.now(),
    async sleep(milliseconds) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(milliseconds) || milliseconds < 1 || milliseconds > 30_000) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_clock_invalid");
      }
      await delay(milliseconds, undefined, { ref: false });
    }
  });
}

async function readBoundedOidcResponse(response) {
  if (response?.ok !== true || response.status !== 200
    || typeof response.body?.getReader !== "function") {
    try { await response?.body?.cancel?.(); } catch {}
    throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  }
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  let readerDone = false;
  let responseBytes = null;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const row = await reader.read();
      if (row.done) {
        readerDone = true;
        break;
      }
      if (!(row.value instanceof Uint8Array)) throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
      const owned = Buffer.from(row.value);
      chunks.push(owned);
      row.value.fill(0);
      size += owned.byteLength;
      if (size > 32_768) throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
    }
    responseBytes = Buffer.concat(chunks, size);
    const value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(responseBytes));
    assertExactOwnDataObject(value, ["value"], "production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
    if (typeof value.value !== "string" || value.value.length < 64 || value.value.length > 16_384
      || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value.value)) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.from(value.value, "utf8");
    SENSITIVE_OIDC_VALUES.add(bytes);
    return bytes;
  } catch {
    throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  } finally {
    if (!readerDone) {
      try { await reader.cancel("production_controller_oidc_request_failed"); } catch {}
    }
    try { reader.releaseLock(); } catch {}
    responseBytes?.fill(0);
    for (const chunk of chunks) chunk.fill(0);
  }
}

async function requestFixedGitHubActionsOidcToken(argument) {
  assertExactOwnDataObject(argument, OIDC_REQUEST_FIELDS, "production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  const { audience, requestUrl, requestToken } = argument;
  if (typeof audience !== "string" || audience.length < 1 || audience.length > 256
    || !/^(?:gccgw-control-plane-deploy:[0-9a-f]{64}|gccgw-control-plane-closeout-(?:upload_started|upload_committed_observed):[0-9a-f]{64})$/.test(audience)
    || typeof requestToken !== "string" || requestToken.length < 1 || requestToken.length > 16_384
    || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/u.test(requestToken)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  }
  let url;
  try {
    url = new URL(requestUrl);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  }
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.port !== "" || url.username !== "" || url.password !== ""
    || url.hash !== "" || !/^[a-z0-9-]+\.actions\.githubusercontent\.com$/.test(url.hostname)
    || url.searchParams.get("api-version") !== "2.0-preview.1"
    || url.searchParams.has("audience")) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  }
  url.searchParams.set("audience", audience);
  try {
    const response = await globalThis.fetch(url, Object.freeze({
      method: "GET",
      redirect: "error",
      headers: Object.freeze({
        accept: "application/json",
        authorization: `Bearer ${requestToken}`
      })
    }));
    return await readBoundedOidcResponse(response);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("production_controller_oidc_request_failed");
  }
}

function createFixedTransitionOidcRequester(argument) {
  assertExactOwnDataObject(argument, ["env", "authorizationRecordSha256"],
    "production_controller_transition_oidc_invalid");
  const { env, authorizationRecordSha256 } = argument;
  if (env !== process.env || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(authorizationRecordSha256)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_transition_oidc_invalid");
  }
  const used = new Set();
  return Object.freeze({
    async requestOneUse(input) {
      assertExactOwnDataObject(input, TRANSITION_OIDC_FIELDS,
        "production_controller_transition_oidc_invalid");
      if (!CLOSEOUT_TRANSITIONS.includes(input.transition)
        || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(input.bindingSha256)
        || input.audience !== `gccgw-control-plane-closeout-${input.transition}:${input.bindingSha256}`
        || used.has(`${authorizationRecordSha256}:${input.transition}`)) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_transition_oidc_invalid");
      }
      used.add(`${authorizationRecordSha256}:${input.transition}`);
      return requestFixedGitHubActionsOidcToken({
        audience: input.audience,
        requestUrl: env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL,
        requestToken: env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN
      });
    }
  });
}

const RECEIPT_RUNNER_STORE_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "writePrivateFile", "readPrivateFile", "assertPrivateUploadFile",
  "deletePrivateFileAndReadBackAbsent", "cleanupAndReadBackAbsent"
]);
const ARTIFACT_LIFECYCLE_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "registerArtifactInput", "registerSensitiveBuffer", "registerRuntimeDirectory",
  "wrapSecretMaterializer", "wrapTransport", "finalizeAndReadBackAbsent"
]);
const SENSITIVE_KINDS = Object.freeze([
  "actions_metadata_token", "deployment_oidc", "transition_oidc"
]);
const RUNTIME_ENTRY_PATHS = Object.freeze([
  "ops/control-plane-deploy/native/index.mjs",
  "ops/control-plane-deploy/native/build/Release/control_plane_native.node"
]);

function createPrivateRunnerMaterialStore(argument) {
  assertExactOwnDataObject(argument, ["root"], "production_controller_runner_material_root_invalid");
  const root = argument.root;
  if (typeof root !== "string" || !isAbsolute(root) || resolve(root) !== root
    || root.includes("\u0000") || ACTIVE_RUNNER_ROOTS.has(root)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_runner_material_root_invalid");
  }
  const rootStat = lstatSync(root, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
  if (rootStat === undefined || rootStat.isSymbolicLink() || !rootStat.isDirectory()
    || realpathSync(root) !== root || readdirSync(root).length !== 0) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_runner_material_root_invalid");
  }
  assertPrivateMode(rootStat, "production_controller_runner_material_root_invalid");
  const lifecycleRoot = join(root, "artifact-lifecycle");
  const receiptRoot = join(root, "receipt-closeout");
  let lifecycleRootCreated = false;
  let receiptRootCreated = false;
  try {
    mkdirSync(lifecycleRoot, { mode: 0o700 });
    lifecycleRootCreated = true;
    mkdirSync(receiptRoot, { mode: 0o700 });
    receiptRootCreated = true;
  } catch {
    const primary = new Error("production_controller_runner_material_root_invalid");
    const cleanupErrors = [];
    for (const [path, created] of [
      [receiptRoot, receiptRootCreated],
      [lifecycleRoot, lifecycleRootCreated]
    ]) {
      if (!created) continue;
      try {
        rmdirSync(path);
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
    }
    if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [primary, ...cleanupErrors],
        "production_controller_runner_material_root_and_cleanup_failed"
      );
    }
    throw primary;
  }
  ACTIVE_RUNNER_ROOTS.add(root);
  const records = [];
  const receiptFiles = new Set();
  let sequence = 0;
  let phase = "live";
  let inFlightLifecycleOperations = 0;

  function assertLive() {
    if (phase !== "live") throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_finalized");
  }

  async function runTrackedLifecycleOperation(operation) {
    assertLive();
    inFlightLifecycleOperations += 1;
    try {
      return await operation();
    } finally {
      inFlightLifecycleOperations -= 1;
    }
  }

  async function unwindTrackedRecord(record, primary) {
    const cleanupErrors = [];
    try {
      await record.cleanup();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(error);
    }
    try {
      if (await record.ready() !== true) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_registration_cleanup_failed");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(error);
    }
    try {
      if (record.markerCreated
        && lstatSync(record.markerPath, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
        unlinkSync(record.markerPath);
      }
      if (record.markerCreated
        && lstatSync(record.markerPath, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_registration_cleanup_failed");
      }
      record.markerCreated = false;
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(error);
    }
    if (cleanupErrors.length === 0) {
      const index = records.indexOf(record);
      if (index >= 0) records.splice(index, 1);
      record.released = true;
      throw primary;
    }
    throw new AggregateError(
      [primary, ...cleanupErrors],
      "production_controller_registration_and_cleanup_failed"
    );
  }

  async function registerRecord(kind, ready, cleanup = async () => {}) {
    assertLive();
    const markerPath = join(lifecycleRoot, `${String(sequence++).padStart(6, "0")}-${kind}`);
    const record = {
      kind,
      markerPath,
      markerCreated: false,
      openFds: new Set(),
      released: false
    };
    record.ready = async () => record.openFds.size === 0 && await ready();
    record.cleanup = async () => {
      const cleanupErrors = [];
      for (const openFd of [...record.openFds]) {
        try {
          closeSync(openFd);
          record.openFds.delete(openFd);
        } catch (error) {
          cleanupErrors.push(error);
        }
      }
      try { await cleanup(); } catch (error) { cleanupErrors.push(error); }
      if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
        throw new AggregateError(cleanupErrors, "production_controller_record_cleanup_failed");
      }
    };
    records.push(record);
    const markerBytes = Buffer.from(`control-plane-artifact-lifecycle-v1\n${kind}\n`, "utf8");
    try {
      const fd = openSync(markerPath, FS_CONSTANTS.O_CREAT | FS_CONSTANTS.O_EXCL
        | FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600);
      record.markerCreated = true;
      record.openFds.add(fd);
      writeFileSync(fd, markerBytes);
      fsyncSync(fd);
      closeSync(fd);
      record.openFds.delete(fd);
      const markerStat = lstatSync(markerPath, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
      const markerReadback = markerStat === undefined ? null : readFileSync(markerPath);
      if (markerStat === undefined || markerStat.isSymbolicLink() || !markerStat.isFile()
        || markerStat.nlink !== 1 || !markerReadback.equals(markerBytes)) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_registration_marker_invalid");
      }
      assertPrivateMode(markerStat, "production_controller_registration_marker_invalid");
      return record;
    } catch (error) {
      return unwindTrackedRecord(record, error);
    }
  }

  function requireReceiptHandle(handle) {
    const state = RECEIPT_FILE_HANDLES.get(handle);
    if (state === undefined || state.root !== root || state.deleted) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_invalid");
    }
    return state;
  }

  const receiptStore = Object.freeze({
    writePrivateFile(input) {
      assertLive();
      assertExactOwnDataObject(input, ["fileName", "bytes"],
        "production_controller_receipt_file_invalid");
      if (typeof input.fileName !== "string"
        || !/^control-plane-controller-closeout-[a-z0-9.-]+\.json$/.test(input.fileName)
        || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.bytes) || input.bytes.length < 1 || input.bytes.length > 262_144) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_invalid");
      }
      const path = join(receiptRoot, input.fileName);
      if (dirname(path) !== receiptRoot || lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_invalid");
      }
      const handle = Object.freeze(Object.create(null));
      const state = {
        root,
        path,
        bytes: Buffer.from(input.bytes),
        sha256: sha256Hex(input.bytes),
        openFds: new Set(),
        fileCreated: false,
        deleted: false
      };
      RECEIPT_FILE_HANDLES.set(handle, state);
      receiptFiles.add(handle);
      let fd = null;
      try {
        fd = openSync(path, FS_CONSTANTS.O_CREAT | FS_CONSTANTS.O_EXCL
          | FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600);
        state.fileCreated = true;
        state.openFds.add(fd);
        writeFileSync(fd, state.bytes);
        fsyncSync(fd);
        closeSync(fd);
        state.openFds.delete(fd);
        receiptStore.readPrivateFile(handle);
        return handle;
      } catch (primary) {
        const cleanupErrors = [];
        for (const openFd of [...state.openFds]) {
          try {
            closeSync(openFd);
            state.openFds.delete(openFd);
          } catch (error) {
            cleanupErrors.push(error);
          }
        }
        if (state.fileCreated) {
          let cleanupFd = null;
          try {
            const partial = lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
            if (partial !== undefined) {
              cleanupFd = openSync(path, FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW);
              state.openFds.add(cleanupFd);
              writeFileSync(cleanupFd, Buffer.alloc(partial.size));
              fsyncSync(cleanupFd);
            }
          } catch (error) {
            cleanupErrors.push(error);
          } finally {
            if (cleanupFd !== null && state.openFds.has(cleanupFd)) {
              try {
                closeSync(cleanupFd);
                state.openFds.delete(cleanupFd);
              } catch (error) {
                cleanupErrors.push(error);
              }
            }
          }
          try {
            if (lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) unlinkSync(path);
          } catch (error) {
            cleanupErrors.push(error);
          }
          try {
            if (lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
              throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_cleanup_failed");
            }
            state.fileCreated = false;
          } catch (error) {
            cleanupErrors.push(error);
          }
        }
        state.bytes.fill(0);
        if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
          throw new AggregateError(
            [primary, ...cleanupErrors],
            "production_controller_receipt_registration_and_cleanup_failed"
          );
        }
        state.deleted = true;
        receiptFiles.delete(handle);
        RECEIPT_FILE_HANDLES.delete(handle);
        throw primary;
      }
    },
    readPrivateFile(handle) {
      const state = requireReceiptHandle(handle);
      const stat = lstatSync(state.path, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
      const bytes = stat === undefined ? null : readFileSync(state.path);
      if (stat === undefined || stat.isSymbolicLink() || !stat.isFile() || stat.nlink !== 1
        || stat.size !== state.bytes.length || !bytes.equals(state.bytes)
        || sha256Hex(bytes) !== state.sha256) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_invalid");
      }
      assertPrivateMode(stat, "production_controller_receipt_file_invalid");
      return Buffer.from(bytes);
    },
    assertPrivateUploadFile(handle) {
      const state = requireReceiptHandle(handle);
      receiptStore.readPrivateFile(handle);

        filePath: state.path,
        rootDirectory: receiptRoot,
        size: state.bytes.length,
        sha256: state.sha256

    },
    deletePrivateFileAndReadBackAbsent(handle) {
      const state = requireReceiptHandle(handle);
      const cleanupErrors = [];
      for (const openFd of [...state.openFds]) {
        try {
          closeSync(openFd);
          state.openFds.delete(openFd);
        } catch (error) {
          cleanupErrors.push(error);
        }
      }
      let cleanupFd = null;
      try {
        if (state.fileCreated
          && lstatSync(state.path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
          cleanupFd = openSync(state.path, FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW);
          state.openFds.add(cleanupFd);
          writeFileSync(cleanupFd, Buffer.alloc(state.bytes.length));
          fsyncSync(cleanupFd);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      } finally {
        if (cleanupFd !== null && state.openFds.has(cleanupFd)) {
          try {
            closeSync(cleanupFd);
            state.openFds.delete(cleanupFd);
          } catch (error) {
            cleanupErrors.push(error);
          }
        }
      }
      try {
        if (state.fileCreated
          && lstatSync(state.path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
          unlinkSync(state.path);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
      if (state.fileCreated
        && lstatSync(state.path, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
        cleanupErrors.push(new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_cleanup_failed"));
      }
      if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
        throw new AggregateError(cleanupErrors, "production_controller_receipt_file_cleanup_failed");
      }
      if (state.fileCreated) state.fileCreated = false;
      state.bytes.fill(0);
      state.deleted = true;
      receiptFiles.delete(handle);
      RECEIPT_FILE_HANDLES.delete(handle);
      return true;
    },
    cleanupAndReadBackAbsent() {
      if (phase === "finalized") throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_finalized");
      const cleanupErrors = [];
      for (const handle of [...receiptFiles]) {
        try {
          receiptStore.deletePrivateFileAndReadBackAbsent(handle);
        } catch (error) {
          cleanupErrors.push(error);
        }
      }
      if (cleanupErrors.length > 0 || readdirSync(receiptRoot).length !== 0) {
        throw new AggregateError(cleanupErrors, "production_controller_receipt_file_cleanup_failed");
      }
      return true;
    }
  });
  if (Object.keys(receiptStore).some((name, index) => name !== RECEIPT_RUNNER_STORE_FIELDS[index])) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_store_invalid");
  }

  const lifecycle = Object.freeze({
    registerArtifactInput(stream) {
      return runTrackedLifecycleOperation(async () => {
        const state = ARTIFACT_INPUT_STATES.get(stream);
        if (state === undefined || records.some((record) => record.stream === stream)) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_input_invalid");
        }
        const record = await registerRecord(
          "artifact-input",
          async () => state.closed === true,
          async () => closeArtifactInput(stream)
        );
        record.stream = stream;
        return stream;
      });
    },
    registerSensitiveBuffer(input) {
      return runTrackedLifecycleOperation(async () => {
        assertExactOwnDataObject(input, ["kind", "bytes"],
          "production_controller_sensitive_material_invalid");
        if (!SENSITIVE_KINDS.includes(input.kind) || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.bytes)
          || input.bytes.length < 1 || input.bytes.length > 65_536
          || ((input.kind === "deployment_oidc" || input.kind === "transition_oidc")
            && !SENSITIVE_OIDC_VALUES.has(input.bytes))) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_sensitive_material_invalid");
        }
        const record = await registerRecord(
          input.kind,
          async () => input.bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0),
          async () => { input.bytes.fill(0); }
        );
        record.bytes = input.bytes;
        return input.bytes;
      });
    },
    registerRuntimeDirectory(input) {
      return runTrackedLifecycleOperation(async () => {
        assertExactOwnDataObject(input, ["entries"], "production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
        if (!Array.isArray(input.entries) || input.entries.length !== RUNTIME_ENTRY_PATHS.length) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
        }
        const runtimeRoot = join(lifecycleRoot, `controller-runtime-${String(sequence).padStart(6, "0")}`);
        const ownedBytes = [];
        let runtimeRootCreated = false;
        const record = await registerRecord("controller-runtime", async () => {
        const absent = lstatSync(runtimeRoot, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) === undefined;
        return absent && ownedBytes.every((bytes) => bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0));
        }, async () => {
          for (const bytes of ownedBytes) bytes.fill(0);
          if (runtimeRootCreated
            && lstatSync(runtimeRoot, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
            rmSync(runtimeRoot, { recursive: true, force: false });
          }
          if (runtimeRootCreated
            && lstatSync(runtimeRoot, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) === undefined) {
            runtimeRootCreated = false;
          }
        });
        record.runtimeRoot = runtimeRoot;
        try {
        mkdirSync(runtimeRoot, { mode: 0o700 });
        runtimeRootCreated = true;
        assertPrivateMode(lstatSync(runtimeRoot), "production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
        for (let index = 0; index < RUNTIME_ENTRY_PATHS.length; index += 1) {
          const entry = input.entries[index];
          assertExactOwnDataObject(entry, ["path", "bytes", "mode", "sha256"],
            "production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
          if (entry.path !== RUNTIME_ENTRY_PATHS[index] || entry.mode !== 0o100644
            || !Buffer.isBuffer(entry.bytes) || entry.bytes.length < 1
            || sha256Hex(entry.bytes) !== entry.sha256) {
            throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
          }
          const path = join(runtimeRoot, ...entry.path.split("/"));
          const within = relative(runtimeRoot, path);
          if (within.startsWith(`..${sep}`) || within === ".." || isAbsolute(within)) {
            throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
          }
          mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
          const bytes = Buffer.from(entry.bytes);
          ownedBytes.push(bytes);
          const fd = openSync(path, FS_CONSTANTS.O_CREAT | FS_CONSTANTS.O_EXCL
            | FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600);
          record.openFds.add(fd);
          writeFileSync(fd, bytes);
          fsyncSync(fd);
          closeSync(fd);
          record.openFds.delete(fd);
          const fileStat = lstatSync(path, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
          const readback = fileStat === undefined ? null : readFileSync(path);
          const matches = fileStat !== undefined && !fileStat.isSymbolicLink() && fileStat.isFile()
            && fileStat.nlink === 1 && readback.equals(bytes) && sha256Hex(readback) === entry.sha256;
          readback?.fill(0);
          if (!matches) throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
          assertPrivateMode(fileStat, "production_controller_runtime_directory_invalid");
        }
          return Object.freeze({
            wrapperUrl: pathToFileURL(join(runtimeRoot, ...RUNTIME_ENTRY_PATHS[0].split("/"))).href
          });
        } catch (error) {
          return unwindTrackedRecord(record, error);
        }
      });
    },
    wrapSecretMaterializer(materializer) {
      assertLive();
      if (typeof materializer?.materializeFixedCredential !== "function") {
        throw new Error("production_controller_sensitive_material_invalid");
      }
      let used = false;
      return Object.freeze({
        materializeFixedCredential(credentialId) {
          if (used) throw new Error("production_controller_sensitive_material_invalid");
          used = true;
          return runTrackedLifecycleOperation(async () => {
            const buffers = [];
            let materializationStarted = false;
            let materializationSettled = false;
            let resolveMaterializationSettled;
            const materializationSettlement = new Promise((resolve) => {
              resolveMaterializationSettled = resolve;
            });
            const record = await registerRecord(
              "ssh-material-in-flight",
              async () => (!materializationStarted || materializationSettled)
                && buffers.every((bytes) => bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0)),
              async () => {
                if (materializationStarted) await materializationSettlement;
                for (const bytes of buffers) bytes.fill(0);
              }
            );
            record.buffers = buffers;
            try {
              materializationStarted = true;
              const result = await materializer.materializeFixedCredential(credentialId);
              const candidates = [
                result?.material?.privateKeyBytes,
                result?.material?.knownHostsBytes
              ];
              for (const bytes of candidates) {
                if (Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)) buffers.push(bytes);
              }
              if (candidates.some((bytes) => !Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length < 1)) {
                throw new Error("production_controller_sensitive_material_invalid");
              }
              materializationSettled = true;
              resolveMaterializationSettled();
              return result;
            } catch (error) {
              materializationSettled = true;
              resolveMaterializationSettled();
              return unwindTrackedRecord(record, error);
            }
          });
        }
      });
    },
    wrapTransport(transport) {
      const fields = ["execute", "request", "requestStatusBundle", "requestBootstrap", "close"];
      if (transport === null || typeof transport !== "object"
        || fields.some((name) => typeof transport[name] !== "function")) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_transport_invalid");
      }
      let closed = false;
      let closePromise = null;
      const closeOwnedTransport = async () => {
        if (closed) return true;
        if (closePromise === null) {
          closePromise = (async () => {
            await transport.close();
            closed = true;

          })();

          return await closePromise;
        } finally {
          if (!closed) closePromise = null;
        }
      };

        return transport[name](input);
      };

        execute: (input) => invoke("execute", input),
        request: (input) => invoke("request", input),
        requestStatusBundle: (input) => invoke("requestStatusBundle", input),
        requestBootstrap: (input) => invoke("requestBootstrap", input),
        close: closeOwnedTransport
      });
      return runTrackedLifecycleOperation(async () => {

          const record = await registerRecord(
            "transport",
            async () => closed,
            closeOwnedTransport
          );

            await closeOwnedTransport();

              [primary, cleanup],
              "production_controller_transport_registration_and_cleanup_failed"
            );
          }
