```js
        }
      });
    },
    async finalizeAndReadBackAbsent() {
      assertLive();
      if (inFlightLifecycleOperations !== 0) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_operation_in_flight");
      }
      phase = "finalizing";
      const cleanupErrors = [];
      for (const record of records) {
        try { await record.cleanup(); } catch (error) { cleanupErrors.push(error); }
      }
      for (const record of records) {
        try {
          if (await record.ready() !== true) throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed");
          if (record.markerCreated
            && lstatSync(record.markerPath, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
            unlinkSync(record.markerPath);
          }
          if (record.markerCreated
            && lstatSync(record.markerPath, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
            throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed");
          }
          record.markerCreated = false;
          record.released = true;
        } catch (error) {
          cleanupErrors.push(error);
        }
      }
      try {
        if (receiptStore.cleanupAndReadBackAbsent() !== true) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_receipt_file_cleanup_failed");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
      for (const internalRoot of [lifecycleRoot, receiptRoot]) {
        try {
          if (lstatSync(internalRoot, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) rmdirSync(internalRoot);
          if (lstatSync(internalRoot, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
            throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed");
          }
        } catch (error) {
          cleanupErrors.push(error);
        }
      }
      try {
        if (readdirSync(root).length !== 0) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
      if (cleanupErrors.length > 0 || records.some((record) => !record.released)) {
        throw new AggregateError(
          cleanupErrors.length > 0 ? cleanupErrors : [new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed")],
          "production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed"
        );
      }
      phase = "finalized";
      ACTIVE_RUNNER_ROOTS.delete(root);
      PRIVATE_RUNNER_STORES.delete(store);
      return true;
    }
  });
  if (Object.keys(lifecycle).some((name, index) => name !== ARTIFACT_LIFECYCLE_FIELDS[index])) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_invalid");
  }
  const store = Object.freeze({ receiptStore, lifecycle });
  PRIVATE_RUNNER_STORES.add(store);
  return store;
}

function createPrivateFinalStatusSink(argument) {
  assertExactOwnDataObject(argument, ["path", "contract"],
    "production_controller_final_status_sink_invalid");
  const { path, contract } = argument;
  if (contract !== CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_sink_invalid");
  }
  const canonicalPath = resolveMissingControllerLeaf(path);
  let committed = false;
  let expectedBytes = null;
  return Object.freeze({
    async writeExact(input) {
      assertExactOwnDataObject(input, ["bytes", "sha256"],
        "production_controller_final_status_sink_invalid");
      if (committed || !Buffer.isBuffer(input.bytes) || input.bytes.length < 1
        || input.bytes.length > contract.maxBytes || sha256Hex(input.bytes) !== input.sha256) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_sink_invalid");
      }
      parseCanonicalJsonBytes(input.bytes, contract);
      const temporary = join(dirname(canonicalPath), `.${basename(canonicalPath)}.${process.pid}.tmp`);
      let temporaryCreated = false;
      try {
        const fd = openSync(temporary, FS_CONSTANTS.O_CREAT | FS_CONSTANTS.O_EXCL
          | FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600);
        temporaryCreated = true;
        try {
          writeFileSync(fd, input.bytes);
          fsyncSync(fd);
        } finally {
          closeSync(fd);
        }
        linkSync(temporary, canonicalPath);
      } finally {
        if (temporaryCreated
          && lstatSync(temporary, { throwIfNoEntry: false }) !== undefined) {
          unlinkSync(temporary);
        }
      }
      const directoryFd = openSync(dirname(canonicalPath), FS_CONSTANTS.O_RDONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_DIRECTORY);
      try { fsyncSync(directoryFd); } finally { closeSync(directoryFd); }
      expectedBytes = Buffer.from(input.bytes);
      committed = true;
    },
    async readBackExact() {
      if (!committed || expectedBytes === null) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_sink_invalid");
      }
      const stat = lstatSync(canonicalPath, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
      const bytes = stat === undefined ? null : readFileSync(canonicalPath);
      if (stat === undefined || stat.isSymbolicLink() || !stat.isFile() || stat.nlink !== 1
        || stat.size !== expectedBytes.length || !bytes.equals(expectedBytes)) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_readback_invalid");
      }
      assertPrivateMode(stat, "production_controller_final_status_readback_invalid");
      parseCanonicalJsonBytes(bytes, contract);
      return Buffer.from(bytes);
    }
  });
}

async function appendFixedControllerGitHubOutputs(path, values) {
  assertExactOwnDataObject(values, ["final_status_available", "deploy_note_eligible"],
    "production_controller_github_output_invalid");
  if (!Object.values(values).every((value) => value === "true" || value === "false")) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_github_output_invalid");
  }
  const canonicalPath = resolveExistingControllerPath(path, "file");
  const bytes = Buffer.from(
    `final_status_available=${values.final_status_available}\ndeploy_note_eligible=${values.deploy_note_eligible}\n`,
    "utf8"
  );
  const before = statSync(canonicalPath);
  const fd = openSync(canonicalPath, FS_CONSTANTS.O_APPEND | FS_CONSTANTS.O_WRONLY | FS_CONSTANTS.O_NOFOLLOW);
  try {
    writeFileSync(fd, bytes);
    fsyncSync(fd);
  } finally {
    closeSync(fd);
  }
  const after = statSync(canonicalPath);
  const readback = readFileSync(canonicalPath);
  if (after.dev !== before.dev || after.ino !== before.ino
    || after.size !== before.size + bytes.length
    || !readback.subarray(readback.length - bytes.length).equals(bytes)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_github_output_invalid");
  }
}

function destroySensitiveValue(value) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(value) || !SENSITIVE_OIDC_VALUES.has(value)) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_sensitive_material_invalid");
  }
  value.fill(0);
  return true;
}

async function closeArtifactInput(stream) {
  const state = ARTIFACT_INPUT_STATES.get(stream);
  if (state === undefined) throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_input_invalid");
  if (state.closed) return true;
  const errors = [];
  if (!state.streamClosed) {
    try {
      if (!stream.destroyed) stream.destroy();
      await Promise.race([
        finished(stream, { cleanup: true }).catch((error) => {
          if (error?.code !== "ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE") throw error;
        }),
        delay(5_000, undefined, { ref: false }).then(() => {
          throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_input_close_timeout");
        })
      ]);
      state.streamClosed = true;
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(error);
    }
  }
  if (!state.fileHandleClosed) {
    try {
      await state.fileHandle.close();
      state.fileHandleClosed = true;
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(error);
    }
  }
  if (!state.ownedBufferZero) {
    try {
      state.ownedBuffer.fill(0);
      if (!state.ownedBuffer.every((byte) => byte === 0)) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_input_zeroize_failed");
      }
      state.ownedBufferZero = true;
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(error);
    }
  }
  state.closed = state.streamClosed && state.fileHandleClosed && state.ownedBufferZero;
  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new AggregateError(errors, "production_controller_artifact_input_close_failed");
  }
  if (!state.closed) throw new Error("production_controller_artifact_input_close_failed");
  return true;
}

const ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_UPLOAD_DIGEST = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_METADATA_DIGEST = /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const ACTIONS_METADATA_MAX_BYTES = 65_536;
const CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_LIMITS = Object.freeze({
  compressedBytes: 268_435_456,
  entries: 50_000,
  entryBytes: 67_108_864,
  expandedBytes: 805_306_368,
  compressionRatio: 100
});
async function readExactBoundedArtifact(stream, expectedSize) {
  if (stream === null || typeof stream?.[Symbol.asyncIterator] !== "function"
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedSize) || expectedSize < 1
    || expectedSize > CONTROLLER_RUNTIME_LIMITS.compressedBytes) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_invalid");
  }
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(chunk);
      chunks.push(bytes);
      size += bytes.length;
      if (size > expectedSize) throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_invalid");
    }
    if (size !== expectedSize) throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_invalid");
    return Buffer.concat(chunks, size);
  } finally {
    for (const bytes of chunks) bytes.fill(0);
  }
}

export async function loadVerifiedControllerNative({
  artifactStream,
  expectedArtifactSha256,
  expectedArtifactSize,
  runnerMaterialStore
}) {
  const bytes = await readExactBoundedArtifact(artifactStream, expectedArtifactSize);
  let projection = null;
  let replayOwnsBytes = false;
  try {
    try {
      projection = extractVerifiedControllerRuntime({
        bundleBytes: bytes,
        expectedBundleSha256: expectedArtifactSha256,
        expectedBundleSize: expectedArtifactSize
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_invalid", { cause: error });
    }
    const runtime = await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.registerRuntimeDirectory({
      entries: Object.freeze([
        Object.freeze({
          path: "ops/control-plane-deploy/native/index.mjs",
          bytes: projection.wrapperBytes,
          mode: 0o100644,
          sha256: projection.wrapperSha256
        }),
        Object.freeze({
          path: "ops/control-plane-deploy/native/build/Release/control_plane_native.node",
          bytes: projection.addonBytes,
          mode: 0o100644,
          sha256: projection.addonSha256
        })
      ])
    });
    projection.wrapperBytes.fill(0);
    projection.addonBytes.fill(0);
    const native = await import(runtime.wrapperUrl);
    const nativeNames = Object.keys(native).sort();
    if (process.versions.modules !== "127" || nativeNames.length !== FOUNDATION_NATIVE_EXPORTS.length
      || nativeNames.some((name, index) => name !== FOUNDATION_NATIVE_EXPORTS[index])) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_runtime_invalid");
    }
    const replay = brandArtifactInput(Readable.from([bytes]), null, bytes);
    await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.registerArtifactInput(replay);
    replayOwnsBytes = true;
    return Object.freeze({ native, artifactStream: replay });
  } finally {
    projection?.wrapperBytes?.fill?.(0);
    projection?.addonBytes?.fill?.(0);
    if (!replayOwnsBytes) bytes.fill(0);
  }
}

const ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_ENV_NAMES = Object.freeze([
  "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN", "ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL", "GITHUB_RUN_ID",
  "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "RUNNER_TEMP"
]);

function readActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(env) {
  const value = Object.fromEntries(ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_ENV_NAMES.map((name) => [name, env[name]]));
  let resultsUrl;
  try {
    resultsUrl = new URL(value.ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_environment_invalid");
  }
  if (typeof value.ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN !== "string" || value.ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN.length < 1
    || value.ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN.length > 16_384 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(value.ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)
    || resultsUrl.protocol !== "https:" || !resultsUrl.hostname.endsWith(".actions.githubusercontent.com")
    || !/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(value.GITHUB_RUN_ID)
    || value.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT !== "1"
    || value.GITHUB_REPOSITORY !== "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal"
    || typeof value.RUNNER_TEMP !== "string" || !value.RUNNER_TEMP.startsWith("/")) {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_environment_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(value);
}

function assertActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(expected, env = process.env) {
  const current = readActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(env);
  if (ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_ENV_NAMES.some((name) => current[name] !== expected[name])) {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_environment_drift");
  }
}

function normalizeNativeUploadDigest(value) {
  if (!ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_UPLOAD_DIGEST.test(value ?? "")) {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_upload_invalid");
  }
  return `sha256:${value}`;
}

async function readBoundedMetadataJson(response) {
  if (response?.ok !== true || typeof response.body?.getReader !== "function") {
    try { await response?.body?.cancel?.(); } catch {}
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
  }
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const row = await reader.read();
      if (row.done) break;
      if (!(row.value instanceof Uint8Array)) {
        await reader.cancel("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
        throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
      }
      size += row.value.byteLength;
      if (size > ACTIONS_METADATA_MAX_BYTES) {
        await reader.cancel("production_actions_artifact_metadata_too_large");
        throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
      }
      chunks.push(Buffer.from(row.value));
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  let text;
  try {
    text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(Buffer.concat(chunks, size));
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
  }
}

function canonicalizeGithubApiUtcTimestamp(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "string"
    || !/^\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])T(?:[01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d(?:\.\d{3})?Z$/.test(value)) {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
  }
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed.getTime())) throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
  const canonical = parsed.toISOString();
  const expectedWire = value.includes(".") ? canonical : canonical.replace(/\.000Z$/, "Z");
  if (value !== expectedWire) throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
  return canonical;
}

function createActionsArtifactClientAdapter({
  nativeClient,
  runtimeEnvironment,
  metadataTokenBytes,
  metadataFetch
}) {
  if (typeof nativeClient?.uploadArtifact !== "function"
    || typeof nativeClient?.downloadArtifact !== "function"
    || Object.keys(runtimeEnvironment ?? {}).some((name, index) => name !== ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_ENV_NAMES[index])
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(metadataTokenBytes) || metadataTokenBytes.length < 1
    || typeof metadataFetch !== "function") {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_client_invalid");
  }
  const uploaded = new Map();
  return Object.freeze({
    async uploadArtifact(name, files, rootDirectory, options) {
      if (typeof name !== "string" || !/^control-plane-controller-closeout-[a-z0-9.-]+$/.test(name)
        || !Array.isArray(files) || files.length !== 1 || typeof files[0] !== "string"
        || typeof rootDirectory !== "string" || rootDirectory.length < 1
        || options === null || Object.keys(options).length !== 1 || options.retentionDays !== 35) {
        throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_upload_invalid");
      }
      try {
        assertActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(runtimeEnvironment);
        const result = await nativeClient.uploadArtifact(name, files, rootDirectory, Object.freeze({ retentionDays: 35 }));
        assertActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(runtimeEnvironment);
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(result?.id) || result.id < 1 || uploaded.has(result.id)
          || !Number.isSafeInteger(result.size) || result.size < 1 || result.size > 262_144) {
          throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_upload_invalid");
        }
        const digest = normalizeNativeUploadDigest(result.digest);
        uploaded.set(result.id, Object.freeze({ name, size: result.size, digest }));
        return Object.freeze({ id: result.id, size: result.size, digest });
      } catch (error) {
        metadataTokenBytes.fill(0);
        throw error;
      }
    },
    async downloadArtifact(artifactId, options) {
      const upload = uploaded.get(artifactId);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(artifactId) || upload === undefined
        || options === null || Object.keys(options).length !== 1
        || typeof options.path !== "string" || options.path.length < 1) {
        throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_download_invalid");
      }
      try {
        assertActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(runtimeEnvironment);
        const route = `https://api.github.com/repos/gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal/actions/artifacts/${artifactId}`;
        const response = await metadataFetch(route, Object.freeze({
          method: "GET",
          redirect: "error",
          headers: Object.freeze({
            accept: "application/vnd.github+json",
            authorization: `Bearer ${metadataTokenBytes.toString("utf8")}`,
            "x-github-api-version": "2022-11-28"
          })
        }));
        const value = await readBoundedMetadataJson(response);
        const createdAt = canonicalizeGithubApiUtcTimestamp(value.created_at);
        const expiresAt = canonicalizeGithubApiUtcTimestamp(value.expires_at);
        if (value.id !== artifactId || value.name !== upload.name
          || value.size_in_bytes !== upload.size || value.digest !== upload.digest
          || !ACTIONS_ARTIFACT_METADATA_DIGEST.test(value.digest ?? "")
          || value.expired !== false
          || value.archive_download_url !== route + "/zip"
          || String(value.workflow_run?.id) !== runtimeEnvironment.GITHUB_RUN_ID
          || Date.parse(expiresAt) - Date.parse(createdAt) !== 35 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {
          throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_metadata_invalid");
        }
        assertActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(runtimeEnvironment);
        const result = await nativeClient.downloadArtifact(artifactId, Object.freeze({ path: options.path }));
        assertActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(runtimeEnvironment);
        if (typeof result?.downloadPath !== "string" || result.downloadPath !== options.path) {
          throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_download_invalid");
        }
        uploaded.delete(artifactId);
        return Object.freeze({
          downloadPath: result.downloadPath,
          metadata: Object.freeze({
            id: artifactId,
            name: upload.name,
            workflowRunId: runtimeEnvironment.GITHUB_RUN_ID,
            repository: runtimeEnvironment.GITHUB_REPOSITORY,
            digest: upload.digest,
            size: upload.size,
            createdAt,
            expiresAt
          })
        });
      } finally {
        metadataTokenBytes.fill(0);
      }
    }
  });
}

export async function createFixedActionsArtifactClient({ runnerMaterialStore }) {
  if (Object.keys(arguments[0] ?? {}).join("\n") !== "runnerMaterialStore") {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_client_invalid");
  }
  if (!PRIVATE_RUNNER_STORES.has(runnerMaterialStore)) {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_client_invalid");
  }
  const runtimeEnvironment = readActionsArtifactServiceEnvironment(process.env);
  const token = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
  if (typeof token !== "string" || token.length < 1 || token.length > 4_096
    || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/u.test(token)) {
    throw new Error("production_actions_artifact_environment_invalid");
  }
  const ownedMetadataTokenBytes = Buffer.from(token, "utf8");
  delete process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
  try {
    const metadataTokenBytes = await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({
      kind: "actions_metadata_token",
      bytes: ownedMetadataTokenBytes
    });
    return createActionsArtifactClientAdapter({
      nativeClient: new DefaultArtifactClient(),
      runtimeEnvironment,
      metadataTokenBytes,
      metadataFetch: globalThis.fetch
    });
  } catch (error) {
    ownedMetadataTokenBytes.fill(0);
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function createProductionIntegrationAdapters({
  native,
  clock,
  secretMaterializer,
  transitionOidc,
  runnerMaterialStore,
  actionsArtifactClient
}) {
  if (typeof secretMaterializer?.materializeFixedCredential !== "function") {
    throw new Error("production_integration_materializer_invalid");
  }
  const trackedSecretMaterializer = runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.wrapSecretMaterializer(secretMaterializer);
  const rawTransport = createSecureSshTransport({ native, clock, secretMaterializer: trackedSecretMaterializer });
  let transport = null;
  let lifecycleOwnsTransport = false;
  try {
    lifecycleOwnsTransport = true;
    transport = await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.wrapTransport(rawTransport);
    const closeoutPublisher = createControllerCloseoutAdapter({
        runnerMaterialStore: runnerMaterialStore.receiptStore,
        actionsArtifactClient,
        requestOidcToken: async (binding) => runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({
          kind: "transition_oidc",
          bytes: await transitionOidc.requestOneUse(binding)
        }),
        clock
      });
    return Object.freeze({
      credentialId: DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
      transport,
      closeoutPublisher
    });
  } catch (primary) {
    const cleanupErrors = [];
    try {
      if (transport !== null) await transport.close();
      else if (!lifecycleOwnsTransport) await rawTransport.close();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(error);
    }
    if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [primary, ...cleanupErrors],
        "production_integration_registration_and_cleanup_failed"
      );
    }
    throw primary;
  }
}

function deriveExpectedControllerFinalStatus(argument) {
  const fields = ["pendingResult", "inputs", "authorization"];
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(argument ?? {});
  if (argument === null || typeof argument !== "object" || Array.isArray(argument)
    || Object.getPrototypeOf(argument) !== Object.prototype
    || keys.length !== fields.length || keys.some((name, index) => name !== fields[index])
    || keys.some((name) => {
      const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(argument, name);
      return !descriptor || !Object.hasOwn(descriptor, "value") || descriptor.get || descriptor.set;
    })) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_binding_invalid");
  }
  const { pendingResult, inputs, authorization } = argument;
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(pendingResult?.finalStatus?.sha256 ?? "")
    || !/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(inputs?.postapprovalEvidence?.runId ?? "")
    || inputs.postapprovalEvidence.runId !== authorization?.value?.runId
    || inputs?.postapprovalEvidence?.runAttempt !== authorization?.value?.runAttempt
    || inputs?.plan?.mainSourceIdentitySha256 !== inputs?.postapprovalEvidence?.mainSourceIdentitySha256
    || inputs?.plan?.mainSourcePrNumber !== inputs?.postapprovalEvidence?.mainSourcePrNumber
    || inputs?.plan?.mainSourceHeadSha !== inputs?.postapprovalEvidence?.mainSourceHeadSha
    || inputs?.plan?.mainSourceMergeCommitSha !== inputs?.postapprovalEvidence?.mainSourceMergeCommitSha) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_binding_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    runId: inputs.postapprovalEvidence.runId,
    runAttempt: inputs.postapprovalEvidence.runAttempt,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: inputs.plan.mainSourceIdentitySha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: inputs.plan.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: inputs.plan.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: inputs.plan.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  });
}

const PRODUCTION_CONTROLLER_CLI_OPERATION_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  "readAndVerifyInputs", "clock", "requestOidcToken", "createRunnerMaterialStore",
  "loadVerifiedControllerNative", "createProductionIntegrationAdapters", "createTransitionOidcRequester",
  "createActionsArtifactClient", "createFinalStatusSink", "expectedControllerFinalStatus",
  "runController", "consumePendingControllerResult", "appendGitHubOutputs",
  "destroySensitiveValue", "closeArtifactInput"
]);

export function createProductionControllerCliOperations() {
  const clock = createFixedSystemClock();
  const operations = Object.freeze({
    readAndVerifyInputs: readAndVerifyProductionControllerInputs,
    clock,
    requestOidcToken: requestFixedGitHubActionsOidcToken,
    createRunnerMaterialStore: createPrivateRunnerMaterialStore,
    loadVerifiedControllerNative,
    createProductionIntegrationAdapters,
    createTransitionOidcRequester: createFixedTransitionOidcRequester,
    createActionsArtifactClient: createFixedActionsArtifactClient,
    createFinalStatusSink: createPrivateFinalStatusSink,
    expectedControllerFinalStatus: deriveExpectedControllerFinalStatus,
    runController: runProductionController,
    consumePendingControllerResult: consumeProductionControllerPendingResult,
    appendGitHubOutputs: appendFixedControllerGitHubOutputs,
    destroySensitiveValue,
    closeArtifactInput
  });
  if (Object.keys(operations).some((name, index) => name !== PRODUCTION_CONTROLLER_CLI_OPERATION_FIELDS[index])) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_operations_invalid");
  }
  return operations;
}
```

The same adapter file implements every module-private function referenced by `createProductionControllerCliOperations`; none is imported from candidate source or accepted as a factory argument. `readAndVerifyProductionControllerInputs` opens only the nine closed-flag paths, parses the plan and postapproval bytes with their owner contracts, opens the artifact once read-only, and returns owned bytes plus that one stream. The fixed clock exposes only `now`, `monotonicNow`, and `sleep`. The two OIDC adapters use only GitHub's fixed runner request URL/token at the instant of each request and return a mutable owned token buffer; no URL, token, `fetchFn`, clock, native object, artifact client, filesystem adapter, output writer, or operation enters through `argv`, an environment selector, or a caller argument. Their bounded reader owns and zeroes every response chunk plus its concatenated response copy on both success and failure; an unfinished reader is canceled exactly once and cancel/release failures never replace the fixed primary error. `createPrivateRunnerMaterialStore` implements the frozen two-surface store and real absence readback. `createActionsArtifactClientAdapter` is module-private; only its fixed `DefaultArtifactClient` composition is exported. The final-status sink creates one private non-symlink file, atomically writes exact Receipt bytes, and reopens/readbacks them. GitHub-output append accepts only the two fixed aggregate keys. Token destruction and artifact-stream close are idempotent and bounded. Factory construction is lazy: it performs no file, token, artifact, SSH, or network operation.

```js
test("integration adapter composes only lazy Bootstrap transport and Receipt closeout", async () => {
  const adapters = await createProductionIntegrationAdapters(integrationFixture());
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(adapters), ["credentialId", "transport", "closeoutPublisher"]);
  assert.equal(adapters.credentialId, "japan-control-plane-github-deploy-v1");
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(adapters.transport).sort(), [
    "close", "execute", "request", "requestBootstrap", "requestStatusBundle"
  ]);
  assert.equal(integrationFixture().secretMaterializerCalls.length, 0);
});

test("real CLI factory is argumentless, exact, frozen, and lazy", () => {
  assert.equal(createProductionControllerCliOperations.length, 0);
  const operations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(operations), [
    "readAndVerifyInputs", "clock", "requestOidcToken", "createRunnerMaterialStore",
    "loadVerifiedControllerNative", "createProductionIntegrationAdapters", "createTransitionOidcRequester",
    "createActionsArtifactClient", "createFinalStatusSink", "expectedControllerFinalStatus",
    "runController", "consumePendingControllerResult", "appendGitHubOutputs",
    "destroySensitiveValue", "closeArtifactInput"
  ]);
  assert.equal(Object.isFrozen(operations), true);
  const sourceIdentity = Object.freeze({
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: "a".repeat(64),
    mainSourcePrNumber: 593,
    mainSourceHeadSha: "b".repeat(40),
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: "c".repeat(40)
  });
  assert.deepEqual(operations.expectedControllerFinalStatus({
    pendingResult: Object.freeze({
      resultKind: "terminal",
      finalStatus: Object.freeze({ sha256: "d".repeat(64) })
    }),
    inputs: Object.freeze({
      postapprovalEvidence: Object.freeze({ runId: "123", runAttempt: 1, ...sourceIdentity }),
      plan: Object.freeze({ ...sourceIdentity })
    }),
    authorization: Object.freeze({ value: Object.freeze({ runId: "123", runAttempt: 1 }) })
  }), Object.freeze({ runId: "123", runAttempt: 1, ...sourceIdentity }));
});

test("real CLI factory executes every fixed I/O, OIDC, store, sink, output, and cleanup port", async (t) => {
  const fixture = await materializeRealControllerOperationsFixture(t);
  await withExactProcessEnvironment(fixture.processEnvironment, async () => {
    const operations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
    for (const name of [
      "readAndVerifyInputs", "requestOidcToken", "createRunnerMaterialStore",
      "createTransitionOidcRequester", "createFinalStatusSink", "appendGitHubOutputs",
      "destroySensitiveValue", "closeArtifactInput"
    ]) assert.equal(typeof operations[name], "function", name);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(operations.clock), ["now", "monotonicNow", "sleep"]);
    assert.ok(operations.clock.now() instanceof Date);
    assert.equal(Number.isFinite(operations.clock.monotonicNow()), true);

    const store = await operations.createRunnerMaterialStore({ root: fixture.flags["closeout-directory"] });
    const inputs = await operations.readAndVerifyInputs({
      flags: fixture.flags,
      runnerMaterialStore: store
    });
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(inputs), [
      "planBytes", "gateReceiptBytes", "artifactStream", "postapprovalEvidence",
      "authorizationRecordBytes", "plan"
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(store), ["receiptStore", "lifecycle"]);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(store.receiptStore), [
      "writePrivateFile", "readPrivateFile", "assertPrivateUploadFile",
      "deletePrivateFileAndReadBackAbsent", "cleanupAndReadBackAbsent"
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(store.lifecycle), [
      "registerArtifactInput", "registerSensitiveBuffer", "registerRuntimeDirectory",
      "wrapSecretMaterializer", "wrapTransport", "finalizeAndReadBackAbsent"
    ]);
    const deploymentToken = await withFixedOidcFetchResponse(fixture, () => operations.requestOidcToken({
      audience: fixture.deploymentAudience,
      requestUrl: fixture.processEnvironment.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL,
      requestToken: fixture.processEnvironment.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN
    }));
    await store.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({ kind: "deployment_oidc", bytes: deploymentToken });
    assert.equal(operations.destroySensitiveValue(deploymentToken), true);
    assert.equal(deploymentToken.every((byte) => byte === 0), true);

    const transitionOidc = operations.createTransitionOidcRequester({
      env: process.env,
      authorizationRecordSha256: fixture.authorizationRecordSha256
    });
    const transitionToken = await withFixedOidcFetchResponse(fixture, () => transitionOidc.requestOneUse({
      audience: `gccgw-control-plane-closeout-upload_started:${fixture.bindingSha256}`,
      transition: "upload_started",
      bindingSha256: fixture.bindingSha256
    }));
    await store.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({ kind: "transition_oidc", bytes: transitionToken });
    assert.equal(operations.destroySensitiveValue(transitionToken), true);

    await operations.closeArtifactInput(inputs.artifactStream);
    assert.equal(await store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent(), true);
    assert.deepEqual(readdirSync(fixture.flags["closeout-directory"]), []);
    await assert.rejects(
      () => store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent(),
      /production_controller_lifecycle_finalized/
    );
    const afterFinalize = Buffer.from("must-zero", "utf8");
    await assert.rejects(
      () => store.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({ kind: "deployment_oidc", bytes: afterFinalize }),
      /production_controller_lifecycle_finalized/
    );
    afterFinalize.fill(0);

    const sink = operations.createFinalStatusSink({
      path: fixture.flags["final-status-output"],
      contract: CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT
    });
    await sink.writeExact(fixture.finalStatus);
    assert.deepEqual(await sink.readBackExact(), fixture.finalStatus.bytes);
    await operations.appendGitHubOutputs(fixture.flags["github-output"], {
      final_status_available: "true",
      deploy_note_eligible: "true"
    });
    assert.equal(readFileSync(fixture.flags["github-output"], "utf8").endsWith(
      "final_status_available=true\ndeploy_note_eligible=true\n"
    ), true);
  });
  assert.equal(fixture.networkCalls.every((call) => call.host.endsWith(".actions.githubusercontent.com")), true);
  assert.equal(fixture.openArtifactHandles, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(fixture.temporaryFinalStatusFiles, []);
});

test("bounded OIDC reads zero every response copy and cancel every unfinished fault", async (t) => {
  const success = await materializeRealControllerOperationsFixture(t);
  const successOperations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
  const token = await withFixedOidcFetchResponse(success, () => successOperations.requestOidcToken({
    audience: success.deploymentAudience,
    requestUrl: success.processEnvironment.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL,
    requestToken: success.processEnvironment.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN
  }));
  assert.equal(success.oidcReaderCancelCalls, 0);
  assert.equal(success.oidcResponseChunks.every((bytes) => bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0)), true);
  assert.equal(success.oidcConcatenatedCopies.every((bytes) => bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0)), true);
  assert.equal(successOperations.destroySensitiveValue(token), true);
  assert.equal(token.every((byte) => byte === 0), true);

  const unfinishedFaults = new Set([
    "oidc_stream_error", "oidc_wrong_chunk_type", "oidc_oversize"
  ]);
  for (const fault of [
    "oidc_stream_error", "oidc_wrong_chunk_type", "oidc_oversize", "oidc_invalid_utf8",
    "oidc_invalid_json", "oidc_invalid_schema", "oidc_invalid_jwt"
  ]) {
    const fixture = await materializeRealControllerOperationsFixture(t, { fault });
    const operations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
    await assert.rejects(
      () => withFixedOidcFetchResponse(fixture, () => operations.requestOidcToken({
        audience: fixture.deploymentAudience,
        requestUrl: fixture.processEnvironment.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL,
        requestToken: fixture.processEnvironment.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN
      })),
      /production_controller_oidc_request_failed/
    );
    assert.equal(fixture.oidcReaderCancelCalls, unfinishedFaults.has(fault) ? 1 : 0, fault);
    assert.equal(fixture.oidcResponseChunks.every(
      (bytes) => bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0)
    ), true, fault);
    assert.equal(fixture.oidcConcatenatedCopies.every(
      (bytes) => bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0)
    ), true, fault);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.externalReportEvents, [], fault);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.temporaryFinalStatusFiles, [], fault);
  }
});

test("finalization rejects while SSH materialization is in flight and retains cleanup ownership", async (t) => {
  const fixture = await materializeRealControllerOperationsFixture(t);
  const operations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
  const store = await operations.createRunnerMaterialStore({ root: fixture.flags["closeout-directory"] });
  let releaseMaterialization;
  const waitForRelease = new Promise((resolve) => { releaseMaterialization = resolve; });
  const privateKeyBytes = Buffer.from("private-key", "utf8");
  const knownHostsBytes = Buffer.from("known-hosts", "utf8");
  const wrapped = store.lifecycle.wrapSecretMaterializer({
    async materializeFixedCredential() {
      await waitForRelease;
      return Object.freeze({
        material: Object.freeze({ privateKeyBytes, knownHostsBytes })
      });
    }
  });
  const materialization = wrapped.materializeFixedCredential("japan-control-plane-github-deploy-v1");
  await Promise.resolve();
  assert.deepEqual(
    readdirSync(`${fixture.flags["closeout-directory"]}/artifact-lifecycle`)
      .map((name) => name.replace(/^[0-9]{6}-/, "")),
    ["ssh-material-in-flight"]
  );
  await assert.rejects(
    () => store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent(),
    /production_controller_lifecycle_operation_in_flight/
  );
  releaseMaterialization();
  await materialization;
  assert.equal(await store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent(), true);
  assert.equal(privateKeyBytes.every((byte) => byte === 0), true);
  assert.equal(knownHostsBytes.every((byte) => byte === 0), true);
  assert.deepEqual(readdirSync(fixture.flags["closeout-directory"]), []);
});

test("same-turn finalization cannot overtake public lifecycle promise settlement", async (t) => {
  const fixture = await materializeRealControllerOperationsFixture(t);
  const operations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
  const store = await operations.createRunnerMaterialStore({ root: fixture.flags["closeout-directory"] });
  for (const name of [
    "registerArtifactInput", "registerSensitiveBuffer", "registerRuntimeDirectory", "wrapTransport"
  ]) {
    assert.notEqual(store.lifecycle[name].constructor.name, "AsyncFunction", name);
  }
  const wrapped = store.lifecycle.wrapSecretMaterializer({
    async materializeFixedCredential() { throw new Error("unused test materializer"); }
  });
  assert.notEqual(wrapped.materializeFixedCredential.constructor.name, "AsyncFunction");

  const bytes = Buffer.from("same-turn-sensitive-material", "utf8");
  let publicPromiseSettled = false;
  const registration = store.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({
    kind: "actions_metadata_token",
    bytes
  });
  registration.then(() => { publicPromiseSettled = true; });
  const checkpoint = await new Promise((resolveCheckpoint) => {
    queueMicrotask(() => queueMicrotask(() => queueMicrotask(() => {
      resolveCheckpoint(Object.freeze({
        publicPromiseSettled,
        finalization: store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent()
      }));
    })));
  });
  assert.equal(checkpoint.publicPromiseSettled, true);
  assert.equal(await registration, bytes);
  assert.equal(await checkpoint.finalization, true);
  assert.equal(bytes.every((byte) => byte === 0), true);
  assert.deepEqual(readdirSync(fixture.flags["closeout-directory"]), []);
});

test("a second finalize rejects while the first finalize is blocked in cleanup", async (t) => {
  const fixture = await materializeRealControllerOperationsFixture(t);
  const operations = createProductionControllerCliOperations();
  const store = await operations.createRunnerMaterialStore({ root: fixture.flags["closeout-directory"] });
  let signalCloseStarted;
  let releaseClose;
  const closeStarted = new Promise((resolve) => { signalCloseStarted = resolve; });
  const closeRelease = new Promise((resolve) => { releaseClose = resolve; });
  let closeAttempts = 0;
  await store.lifecycle.wrapTransport({
    execute: async () => { throw new Error("unused transport execute"); },
    request: async () => { throw new Error("unused transport request"); },
    requestStatusBundle: async () => { throw new Error("unused transport status"); },
    requestBootstrap: async () => { throw new Error("unused transport bootstrap"); },
    close: async () => {
      closeAttempts += 1;
      signalCloseStarted();
      await closeRelease;
    }
  });
  const first = store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent();
  await closeStarted;
  await assert.rejects(
    () => store.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent(),
    /production_controller_lifecycle_finalized/
  );
  assert.equal(closeAttempts, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(fixture.externalReportEvents, []);
  releaseClose();
  assert.equal(await first, true);
  assert.equal(closeAttempts, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(readdirSync(fixture.flags["closeout-directory"]), []);
  assert.deepEqual(fixture.externalReportEvents, []);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 6 (5 min): Implement the execute-only CLI and bounded aggregate output**

```js
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { canonicalizeDatabaseContracts } from "../server/services/deployment/database-contract.mjs";
import {
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";
import {
  assertKnownHostsRecordExpectation,
  createFixedCredentialExpectation,
  DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
  deriveKnownHostsBinding,
  FIXED_CREDENTIAL_EXPECTATION_CONTRACT,
  FIXED_CREDENTIAL_EXPECTATION_FIELDS,
  FIXED_CREDENTIAL_MATERIAL_FIELDS,
  validateFixedCredentialMaterial
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-transport-contract.mjs";
import {
  deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience,
  validateProductionAuthorizationRecord
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-production-authorization.mjs";
import {
  CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT,
  validateControllerFinalStatus
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-controller-closeout.mjs";
import {
  CONTROLLER_RESULTS,
  isControllerTerminalResult
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-receipt-contract.mjs";
import {
  createProductionControllerCliOperations,
  createProductionIntegrationAdapters
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-production-integration-adapter.mjs";

const RESULT_CODES = new Set(CONTROLLER_RESULTS);
const DEPLOY_NOTE_RESULTS = new Set(CONTROLLER_RESULTS.filter(isControllerTerminalResult));
if (DEPLOY_NOTE_RESULTS.size !== 5) throw new Error("production_controller_result_owner_invalid");

function parseClosedFlags(tokens, expectedNames) {
  if (!Array.isArray(tokens) || tokens.length !== expectedNames.length * 2) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_flags_invalid");
  }
  const values = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const flag = tokens[index];
    const value = tokens[index + 1];
    if (typeof flag !== "string" || !flag.startsWith("--")
      || !expectedNames.includes(flag.slice(2))
      || Object.hasOwn(values, flag.slice(2))
      || typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.startsWith("--")) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_flags_invalid");
    }
    values[flag.slice(2)] = value;
  }
  if (expectedNames.some((name) => !Object.hasOwn(values, name))) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_flags_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(values);
}

const CONTROLLER_SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-controller-safe-result-v1",
  maxBytes: 1_024,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze([
    "resultCode", "controllerRecoveryId", "closeoutSha256", "finalStatusSha256"
  ]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    if (!RESULT_CODES.has(value.resultCode)
      || !/^cr1\.[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.controllerRecoveryId)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.closeoutSha256)
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.finalStatusSha256)) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_safe_result_invalid");
    }
  }
});

function createLazyDeploySecretMaterializer({ env, authorization, clock }) {
  let used = false;
  return Object.freeze({
    async materializeFixedCredential(credentialId) {
      if (used || credentialId !== DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID) {
        throw new Error("production_controller_credential_invalid");
      }
      used = true;
      const names = [
        "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_HOST",
        "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PORT",
        "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER",
        "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY",
        "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS"
      ];
      const values = Object.fromEntries(names.map((name) => [name, env[name]]));
      for (const name of names) delete env[name];
      let privateKeyBytes = null;
      let knownHostsBytes = null;
      try {
        privateKeyBytes = Buffer.from(values.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY, "utf8");
        knownHostsBytes = Buffer.from(values.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS, "utf8");
        const host = values.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_HOST;
        const port = Number(values.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PORT);
        const binding = deriveKnownHostsBinding({ host, port, knownHostsBytes });
        const material = Object.freeze({
          credentialId: DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
          host: binding.host,
          port: binding.port,
          user: values.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER,
          authorizationGeneration: authorization.value.authorizationGeneration,
          bootstrapReceiptSha256: authorization.value.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
          knownHostsFingerprint: binding.knownHostsFingerprint,
          knownHostsTupleSha256: binding.knownHostsTupleSha256,
          expiresAt: authorization.value.expiresAt,
          privateKeyBytes,
          knownHostsBytes
        });
        if (Object.keys(material).some((key, index) => key !== FIXED_CREDENTIAL_MATERIAL_FIELDS[index])) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_credential_invalid");
        }
        const expectation = createFixedCredentialExpectation({
          credentialId: DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL_ID,
          authorizationGeneration: authorization.value.authorizationGeneration,
          bootstrapReceiptSha256: authorization.value.bootstrapReceiptSha256,
          knownHostsFingerprint: binding.knownHostsFingerprint,
          knownHostsTupleSha256: binding.knownHostsTupleSha256,
          expiresAt: authorization.value.expiresAt,
          observedAt: clock.now().toISOString()
        });
        if (Object.keys(expectation).some((key, index) => key !== FIXED_CREDENTIAL_EXPECTATION_FIELDS[index])) {
          throw new Error("production_controller_credential_expectation_invalid");
        }
        FIXED_CREDENTIAL_EXPECTATION_CONTRACT.validate(expectation);
        assertKnownHostsRecordExpectation({ binding, material });
        validateFixedCredentialMaterial(material, expectation);
        return Object.freeze({ material, expectation });
      } catch (error) {
        privateKeyBytes?.fill(0);
        knownHostsBytes?.fill(0);
        throw error;
      }
    }
  });
}

export async function runProductionControllerCli({ argv, env, stdout, stderr, operations }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation !== "execute") throw new Error("production_controller_operation_invalid");
  const flags = parseClosedFlags(tokens, [
    "plan", "gate-receipt", "artifact", "postapproval-evidence", "authorization-record", "closeout-directory", "retention-days", "final-status-output", "github-output"
  ]);
  if (flags["retention-days"] !== "35") throw new Error("production_controller_retention_invalid");
  let runnerMaterialStore = null;
  let inputs = null;
  let controllerArtifactStream = null;
  let actionsArtifactClient = null;
  let oidcToken = null;
  let authorization = null;
  let pendingResult = null;
  let lifecycleAbsenceVerified = false;
  let primaryError = null;
  try {
    runnerMaterialStore = await operations.createRunnerMaterialStore({
      root: flags["closeout-directory"]
    });
    inputs = await operations.readAndVerifyInputs({ flags, runnerMaterialStore });
    const runtime = await operations.loadVerifiedControllerNative({
      artifactStream: inputs.artifactStream,
      expectedArtifactSha256: inputs.plan.artifact.sha256,
      expectedArtifactSize: inputs.plan.artifact.sizeBytes,
      runnerMaterialStore
    });
    controllerArtifactStream = runtime.artifactStream;
    const planDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(inputs.plan.databaseContracts);
    if (planDatabase.sha256 !== inputs.postapprovalEvidence.databaseContractsSha256) {
      throw new Error("production_controller_database_contract_drift");
    }
    authorization = validateProductionAuthorizationRecord({
      bytes: inputs.authorizationRecordBytes,
      expected: Object.freeze({
        deploymentPlanSha256: sha256Hex(inputs.planBytes),
        databaseContractsSha256: planDatabase.sha256,
        sourceSha: inputs.plan.sourceCommit,
        runId: String(inputs.postapprovalEvidence.runId),
        runAttempt: inputs.postapprovalEvidence.runAttempt
      }),
      now: operations.clock.now().toISOString()
    });
    const audience = deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience(authorization.sha256);
    actionsArtifactClient = await operations.createActionsArtifactClient({ runnerMaterialStore });
    oidcToken = await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.registerSensitiveBuffer({
      kind: "deployment_oidc",
      bytes: await operations.requestOidcToken({
        audience,
        requestUrl: env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL,
        requestToken: env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN
      })
    });
    const { transport, closeoutPublisher } = await operations.createProductionIntegrationAdapters({
      native: runtime.native,
      clock: operations.clock,
      secretMaterializer: createLazyDeploySecretMaterializer({ env, authorization, clock: operations.clock }),
      transitionOidc: operations.createTransitionOidcRequester({ env, authorizationRecordSha256: authorization.sha256 }),
      runnerMaterialStore,
      actionsArtifactClient
    });
    pendingResult = await operations.runController({
      ...inputs,
      artifactStream: controllerArtifactStream,
      oidcToken,
      githubEvidence: { ...inputs.postapprovalEvidence, authorizationRecordBytes: inputs.authorizationRecordBytes, oidcAudience: audience },
      transport,
      closeoutPublisher,
      clock: operations.clock
    });
  } catch (error) {
    primaryError = error;
  } finally {
    const cleanupErrors = [];
    if (oidcToken !== null) {
      try {
        operations.destroySensitiveValue(oidcToken);
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
    }
    if (inputs !== null) {
      try {
        await operations.closeArtifactInput(inputs.artifactStream);
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
    }
    if (controllerArtifactStream !== null
      && (inputs === null || controllerArtifactStream !== inputs.artifactStream)) {
      try {
        await operations.closeArtifactInput(controllerArtifactStream);
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
    }
    if (runnerMaterialStore !== null) {
      try {
        if (await runnerMaterialStore.lifecycle.finalizeAndReadBackAbsent() !== true) {
          cleanupErrors.push(new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed"));
        } else {
          lifecycleAbsenceVerified = true;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        cleanupErrors.push(error);
      }
    }
    if (primaryError !== null && cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
      primaryError = new AggregateError(
        [primaryError, ...cleanupErrors],
        "production_controller_primary_and_lifecycle_cleanup_failed"
      );
    } else if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {
      primaryError = new Error("production_controller_lifecycle_cleanup_failed");
    }
  }
  if (primaryError !== null) throw primaryError;
  if (pendingResult === null || runnerMaterialStore === null || lifecycleAbsenceVerified !== true) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_result_invalid");
  }
  const result = operations.consumePendingControllerResult(pendingResult);
  const finalStatus = result.finalStatus;
  const expectedFinalStatus = operations.expectedControllerFinalStatus({
    pendingResult: result,
    inputs,
    authorization
  });
  validateControllerFinalStatus(finalStatus.bytes, expectedFinalStatus);
  const finalStatusSink = operations.createFinalStatusSink({
    path: flags["final-status-output"],
    contract: CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT
  });
  await finalStatusSink.writeExact({
    bytes: finalStatus.bytes,
    sha256: finalStatus.sha256
  });
  const finalStatusBytes = await finalStatusSink.readBackExact();
  if (!finalStatusBytes.equals(finalStatus.bytes)
    || sha256Hex(finalStatusBytes) !== finalStatus.sha256) {
    throw new Error("production_controller_final_status_readback_invalid");
  }
  validateControllerFinalStatus(finalStatusBytes, expectedFinalStatus);
  await operations.appendGitHubOutputs(flags["github-output"], {
    final_status_available: "true",
    deploy_note_eligible: result.resultKind === "terminal"
      && DEPLOY_NOTE_RESULTS.has(finalStatus.value.resultCode) ? "true" : "false"
  });
  const safeResult = Object.freeze({
    resultCode: finalStatus.value.resultCode,
    controllerRecoveryId: finalStatus.value.controllerRecoveryId,
    closeoutSha256: finalStatus.value.controllerCloseoutSha256,
    finalStatusSha256: finalStatus.sha256
  });
  stdout.write(`${serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(safeResult, CONTROLLER_SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT).toString("utf8")}\n`);
  return finalStatus.value.resultCode === "validated_deployment" ? 0 : 2;
}

export async function main({
  argv = process.argv.slice(2),
  env = process.env,
  stdout = process.stdout,
  stderr = process.stderr
} = {}) {
  try {
    process.exitCode = await runProductionControllerCli({
      argv,
      env,
      stdout,
      stderr,
      operations: createProductionControllerCliOperations()
    });
  } catch {
    stderr.write("production_controller_failed\n");
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  await main();
}
```

```js
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import test from "node:test";
import { runPostApprovalCli } from "../../scripts/control-plane-postapproval-check.mjs";
import { runProductionPreflightCli } from "../../scripts/control-plane-production-preflight.mjs";

const path = new URL("../../.github/workflows/japan-control-plane-production-deploy.yml", import.meta.url);

function shellRunBlocks(workflow) {
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const blocks = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const match = /^(\s*)run:\s*\|\s*$/.exec(lines[index]);
    if (!match) continue;
    const indent = match[1].length;
    const body = [];
    while (++index < lines.length && (lines[index].trim() === "" || lines[index].search(/\S/) > indent)) body.push(lines[index]);
    blocks.push(body.join("\n"));
    index -= 1;
  }
  return blocks;
}

function jobBlock(workflow, jobId) {
  const start = workflow.indexOf(`  ${jobId}:\n`);
  if (start < 0) throw new Error(`missing job ${jobId}`);
  const tail = workflow.slice(start + 2);
  const next = tail.search(/^  [a-z0-9-]+:\n/m);
  return next < 0 ? workflow.slice(start) : workflow.slice(start, start + 2 + next);
}

function assertClosedRawProductionWorkflowMappings(workflow, expectedJobNames) {
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const scanDirect = (start, end, indent, exactName = null) => {
    const rows = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const prefix = " ".repeat(indent);
    const pattern = new RegExp(`^${prefix}(${exactName ?? "[a-z][a-z0-9-]*"}):(.*)$`);
    for (let index = start; index < end; index += 1) {
      const line = lines[index];
      if (line.trim() === "" || line.trimStart().startsWith("#")) continue;
      if (line.search(/\S/) !== indent) continue;
      const match = pattern.exec(line);
      if (!match || seen.has(match[1])) throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
      seen.add(match[1]);
      rows.push(Object.freeze({ name: match[1], index }));
    }
    return rows;
  };
  const roots = scanDirect(0, lines.length, 0);
  if (JSON.stringify(roots.map(({ name }) => name))
      !== JSON.stringify(["name", "on", "permissions", "concurrency", "jobs"])) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  const on = roots.find(({ name }) => name === "on");
  const jobs = roots.find(({ name }) => name === "jobs");
  const onEnd = roots.find(({ index }) => index > on.index)?.index ?? lines.length;
  const jobsEnd = roots.find(({ index }) => index > jobs.index)?.index ?? lines.length;
  const triggers = scanDirect(on.index + 1, onEnd, 2, "workflow_dispatch").map(({ name }) => name);
  const jobNames = scanDirect(jobs.index + 1, jobsEnd, 2).map(({ name }) => name);
  if (JSON.stringify(triggers) !== JSON.stringify(["workflow_dispatch"])
    || JSON.stringify(jobNames) !== JSON.stringify(expectedJobNames)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
}

for (const pendingFault of [
  "pending_spread", "pending_reordered", "pending_extra", "pending_symbol", "pending_accessor",
  "final_status_clone", "final_status_substitute", "result_kind_substitute", "repeat_consume",
  "runner_cleanup_verified_lookalike"
]) {
  test(`pending owner rejects ${pendingFault} after cleanup and before every report sink`, async () => {
    const fixture = controllerCliFixture({ pendingFault });
    await assert.rejects(
      () => runProductionControllerCli(fixture),
      /production_controller_pending_result_invalid/
    );
    assert.equal(fixture.lifecycleFinalizeCalls, 1);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.finalStatusSinkEvents, []);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.githubOutputWrites, []);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.stdoutWrites, []);
    assert.deepEqual(fixture.deployNoteEligibilityEvents, []);
  });
}

function productionJobExpectation(keys, direct, sha256) {
  return Object.freeze({ keys: Object.freeze(keys), direct: Object.freeze(direct), sha256 });
}

function observeProductionJobSkeleton(workflow, jobId) {
  const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  const direct = Object.create(null);
  const keys = [];
  for (const line of block.split("\n").slice(1)) {
    const match = /^    ([^\s:#][^:]*):(.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (!match) continue;
    const key = match[1];
    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/.test(key) || Object.hasOwn(direct, key)) {
      throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
    }
    keys.push(key);
    direct[key] = match[2].trim() || "<block>";
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    keys: Object.freeze(keys),
    direct: Object.freeze({ ...direct }),
    sha256: createHash("sha256").update(Buffer.from(block, "utf8")).digest("hex")
  });
}

function assertExactProductionJobSkeletons(workflow, expectedJobs, onExternalWriteEligible) {
  if (typeof onExternalWriteEligible !== "function" || workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  assertClosedRawProductionWorkflowMappings(workflow, Object.keys(expectedJobs));
  const jobsOffset = workflow.indexOf("\njobs:\n");
  if (jobsOffset < 0) throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  const observedNames = [...workflow.slice(jobsOffset + 7).matchAll(/^  ([a-z0-9-]+):\n/gm)]
    .map((match) => match[1]);
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(observedNames, Object.keys(expectedJobs));
    for (const [jobId, expected] of Object.entries(expectedJobs)) {
      assert.deepEqual(observeProductionJobSkeleton(workflow, jobId), expected);
      assert.equal(expected.direct["runs-on"], "ubuntu-24.04");
    }
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_skeleton_invalid");
  }
  onExternalWriteEligible();
}

function assertExactPermissionTopology(workflow, expectedJobs) {
  if (workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const lines = workflow.split("\n");
  const permissionSpellings = lines
    .map((line) => /^\s*([^:#]+):/.exec(line)?.[1]?.trim())
    .filter((name) => name?.toLowerCase() === "permissions");
  if (permissionSpellings.some((name) => name !== "permissions")) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const root = lines.filter((line) => /^permissions(?:\s*:|:)/.test(line));
  if (root.length !== 1 || root[0] !== "permissions: {}") throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const jobsOffset = lines.indexOf("jobs:");
  if (jobsOffset < 0) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  const headers = [];
  for (let index = jobsOffset + 1; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const match = /^  ([a-z0-9-]+):$/.exec(lines[index]);
    if (match) headers.push(Object.freeze({ name: match[1], index }));
  }
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(headers.map(({ name }) => name), Object.keys(expectedJobs));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
  const observed = {};
  for (let headerIndex = 0; headerIndex < headers.length; headerIndex += 1) {
    const { name, index: start } = headers[headerIndex];
    const end = headers[headerIndex + 1]?.index ?? lines.length;
    const block = lines.slice(start + 1, end);
    const declarations = block.map((line, offset) => ({ line, offset }))
      .filter(({ line }) => /^    permissions(?::|\s*:)/.test(line));
    if (declarations.length !== 1) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
    const declaration = declarations[0];
    if (declaration.line === "    permissions: {}") {
      observed[name] = Object.freeze({});
      continue;
    }
    if (declaration.line !== "    permissions:") throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
    const entries = Object.create(null);
    for (let offset = declaration.offset + 1; offset < block.length; offset += 1) {
      if (block[offset].trim() === "") continue;
      if (!block[offset].startsWith("      ")) break;
      const match = /^      ([a-z][a-z-]*): (read|write)$/.exec(block[offset]);
      if (!match || Object.hasOwn(entries, match[1])) throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
      entries[match[1]] = match[2];
    }
    observed[name] = Object.freeze({ ...entries });
  }
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(observed, expectedJobs);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("workflow_permissions_invalid");
  }
}

function withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, jobId, mutate) {
  const original = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  const changed = mutate(original);
  if (changed === original) throw new Error("workflow_permission_fixture_invalid");
  return workflow.replace(original, changed);
}

function assertExactTokenPlacements(workflow, expected) {
  for (const [jobId, counts] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
    const envCount = (block.match(/^\s+GITHUB_TOKEN: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\s*$/gm) ?? []).length;
    const inputCount = (block.match(/^\s+github-token: \$\{\{ github\.token \}\}\s*$/gm) ?? []).length;
    const allExpressions = (block.match(/\$\{\{\s*(?:github\.token|secrets\.GITHUB_TOKEN)\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).length;
    assert.deepEqual({ env: envCount, actionInput: inputCount }, counts);
    assert.equal(allExpressions, counts.env + counts.actionInput);
    assert.doesNotMatch(block, /secrets\.GITHUB_TOKEN|github\.Token/);
  }
}

function workflowExpressionRows(text) {
  const rows = [...text.matchAll(/\$\{\{([\s\S]*?)\}\}/g)]
    .map((match) => Object.freeze({ body: match[1].trim(), index: match.index }));
  assert.equal((text.match(/\$\{\{/g) ?? []).length, rows.length);
  return rows;
}

function assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(text, expectedCounts) {
  const observed = new Map();
  for (const { body } of workflowExpressionRows(text)) {
    observed.set(body, (observed.get(body) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...observed.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")),
    Object.entries(expectedCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))
  );
}

function assertClosedCredentialContextExpressions(workflow, expectedCounts) {
  const observed = new Map();
  for (const { body } of workflowExpressionRows(workflow)) {
    if (!/\b(?:github|secrets)\b/i.test(body)) continue;
    observed.set(body, (observed.get(body) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...observed.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")),
    Object.entries(expectedCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"))
  );
}

function assertExactSecretSlots(workflow, expectedLines) {
  const observed = workflow.split("\n")
    .filter((line) => /\$\{\{[\s\S]*\bsecrets\b/i.test(line))
    .map((line) => line.trim())
    .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en"));
  assert.deepEqual(observed, [...expectedLines].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, "en")));
}

function injectJobExpression(workflow, jobId, expression) {
  const marker = `  ${jobId}:\n`;
  const replacement = `${marker}    env:\n      FORGED_CONTEXT: \${{ ${expression} }}\n`;
  const changed = workflow.replace(marker, replacement);
  if (changed === workflow) throw new Error("workflow_expression_fixture_invalid");
  return changed;
}

function inputBlock(workflow) {
  const start = workflow.indexOf("    inputs:\n");
  const end = workflow.indexOf("\npermissions:", start);
  if (start < 0 || end < 0) throw new Error("missing workflow_dispatch inputs");
  return workflow.slice(start, end);
}

function assertExactProductionWorkflowRootShape(workflow, expectedKeys) {
  if (workflow.includes("\r") || /\t/.test(workflow)
    || /(?:^|\s)[&*][a-z0-9_-]+/im.test(workflow) || /^\s*<<:/m.test(workflow)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_root_invalid");
  }
  const keys = workflow.split("\n")
    .map((line) => /^([a-z][a-z0-9-]*):(?:\s|$)/.exec(line)?.[1] ?? null)
    .filter((value) => value !== null);
  if (JSON.stringify(keys) !== JSON.stringify(expectedKeys)
    || keys.includes("defaults") || keys.includes("env") || new Set(keys).size !== keys.length) {
    throw new Error("workflow_root_invalid");
  }
}

function exactProductionJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId) {
  const block = jobBlock(workflow, jobId);
  if (/^    (?:container|services|env):/m.test(block)
    || /ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_(?:REQUEST_TOKEN|REQUEST_URL)/.test(block)
    || /^\s+uses:\s*(?:\.\/|docker:\/\/)/m.test(block)) {
    throw new Error("workflow_job_topology_invalid");
  }
  const lines = block.split("\n");
  const rows = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    if (!/^      - /.test(lines[index])) continue;
    let end = index + 1;
    while (end < lines.length && !/^      - /.test(lines[end])) end += 1;
    const bytes = Buffer.from(lines.slice(index, end).join("\n") + "\n", "utf8");
    const text = bytes.toString("utf8");
    const name = /^      - name: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1] ?? null;
    const action = /^        uses: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1]
      ?? /^      - uses: (.*)$/m.exec(text)?.[1] ?? null;
    const hasRun = /^        run:(?:\s|$)/m.test(text);
    if ((action === null) === !hasRun) throw new Error("workflow_job_topology_invalid");
    rows.push(Object.freeze({
      name,
      kind: action === null ? "run" : "uses",
      action,
      sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex")
    }));
    index = end - 1;
  }
  return Object.freeze(rows);
}

function assertExactProductionJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId, expected) {
  assert.deepEqual(exactProductionJobStepTopology(workflow, jobId), expected);
}

test("production workflow is manual-only with exact Gate and confirmation inputs", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  assert.match(workflow, /^name: Japan Control Plane Production Deploy$/m);
  assert.match(workflow, /^on:\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      production_gate_id:/m);
  assert.match(workflow, /deploy japan control-plane production/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /^  (?:push|pull_request|pull_request_target|schedule|workflow_call|repository_dispatch):/m);
  assert.match(workflow, /group: japan-control-plane-production-authority/);
  assert.match(workflow, /cancel-in-progress: false/);
});

test("current production CLIs stop after closed local flags and before every operation or output", async () => {
  let operationReads = 0;
  let stdoutWrites = 0;
  const operations = new Proxy(Object.freeze({}), {
    get() { operationReads += 1; throw new Error("operations_must_not_be_read"); }
  });
  const stdout = Object.freeze({ write() { stdoutWrites += 1; } });
  const identityFlags = [
    "--production-gate-id", "pg1_test", "--run-id", "101", "--run-attempt", "1",
    "--actor", "operator", "--triggering-actor", "operator",
    "--trusted-checkout", "C:/fixed", "--expected-source-commit", "a".repeat(40)
  ];
  await assert.rejects(() => runProductionPreflightCli({
    argv: ["preflight", ...identityFlags, "--output", "C:/packet", "--github-output", "C:/output"],
    env: Object.freeze({}), stdout, operations
  }), /github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable/);
  await assert.rejects(() => runPostApprovalCli({
    argv: ["verify", ...identityFlags, "--input", "C:/packet", "--output", "C:/postapproval"],
    env: Object.freeze({}), stdout, operations
  }), /github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable/);
  await assert.rejects(() => runPostApprovalCli({
    argv: ["authorize", "--postapproval-evidence", "C:/postapproval", "--scope-attestation", "C:/scope", "--output", "C:/authorization"],
    env: Object.freeze({}), stdout, operations
  }), /github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable/);
  assert.equal(operationReads, 0);
  assert.equal(stdoutWrites, 0);
});

test("production, OIDC, and PR-write capabilities remain isolated", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");

    deploy: Object.freeze({ actions: "read", attestations: "read", checks: "read", contents: "read", "id-token": "write", "pull-requests": "read", statuses: "read" }),
    "deploy-note": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", "pull-requests": "write" })
  });
  assertExactPermissionTopology(workflow, expectedPermissions);
  assertExactTokenPlacements(workflow, Object.freeze({

    "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER }}"
  ]));
  assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(preflight, Object.freeze({

    "github.token": 1,

    "runner.temp": 1,

  assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(deploy, Object.freeze({

    "github.run_id": 1,
    "github.token": 3,
    "inputs.production_gate_id": 1,
    "needs.preflight.outputs.controller_recovery_id": 1,
    "needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit": 3,
    "runner.temp": 2,
    "secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_HOST": 1,
    "secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS": 1,
    "secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY": 1,
    "secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PORT": 1,
    "secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY": 1,
    "secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER": 1,
    "steps.controller.outcome != 'success'": 1,
    "steps.controller.outputs.deploy_note_eligible": 1,
    "steps.controller.outputs.final_status_available": 1,
    "steps.controller.outputs.final_status_available == 'true'": 1,
    "success() && github.run_attempt == 1": 1,
    "vars.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_ID": 1,
    "vars.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_INSTALLATION_ID": 1
  }));
  assertClosedExpressionAllowlist(deployNote, Object.freeze({
    "always() && github.run_attempt == 1 && needs.deploy.outputs.deploy_note_eligible == 'true'": 1,
    "github.run_attempt": 1,
    "github.run_id": 1,
    "github.token": 1,
    "needs.preflight.outputs.controller_recovery_id": 1,
    "needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit": 2,

  }));
  assert.doesNotMatch(preflight, /environment:|id-token: write|secrets\./);

  assert.match(deploySteps, /^      - name: Fresh production approval recheck before any other executable\n        uses: actions\/github-script@[0-9a-f]{40}\n/);
  const deployStepZero = deploySteps.split("\n      - ", 1)[0];
  assert.doesNotMatch(deployStepZero, /actions\/(?:checkout|download-artifact|setup-node)|\$\{\{\s*(?:secrets|vars)\.|id-token|oidc/i);
  for (const later of ["actions/checkout", "actions/setup-node", "actions/download-artifact", "npm ci",
    "JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY", "Execute approved production controller"]) {
    assert.ok(deploy.indexOf("Fresh production approval recheck before any other executable") < deploy.indexOf(later));
  }
  assert.match(deployNote, /pull-requests: write/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(deployNote, /environment:|id-token: write|secrets\.|JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_/);
  for (const run of shellRunBlocks(workflow)) assert.doesNotMatch(run, /\$\{\{\s*inputs\./);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /preflight-packet\/control\/scripts|preflight-packet\/.*\.(?:mjs|js|sh)/);
  assert.match(deploy, /ref: \$\{\{ needs\.preflight\.outputs\.source_commit \}\}/);
  assert.equal((workflow.match(/node-version: '22\.23\.1'/g) ?? []).length, 3);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workflow, /node-version: (?:'22'|22|22\.22\.0)/);
});

test("production workflow freezes every complete job value before external-write eligibility", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const expected = Object.freeze({
    preflight: productionJobExpectation(["runs-on", "permissions", "outputs", "steps"], { "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "<block>", outputs: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "9181d5b6f5e6ce826939fd449fd9907f94c3a60ece65c7b392775187b06e3366"),
    deploy: productionJobExpectation(["needs", "if", "runs-on", "environment", "permissions", "outputs", "steps"], { needs: "preflight", if: "${{ success() && github.run_attempt == 1 }}", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", environment: "vultr-japan-production", permissions: "<block>", outputs: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "f999a9fe85046d9a63b23e542245bdeb674aba31834959cae4015bcfdc4d5e92"),
    "deploy-note": productionJobExpectation(["needs", "if", "runs-on", "permissions", "steps"], { needs: "[preflight, deploy]", if: "${{ always() && github.run_attempt == 1 && needs.deploy.outputs.deploy_note_eligible == 'true' }}", "runs-on": "ubuntu-24.04", permissions: "<block>", steps: "<block>" }, "7eb9c9f4e6363df1c1f0163b0d2b2b4484e5e7f5dee5c9d4f6ec9db0dbfaaaa6")
  });
  let externalWriteEligible = 0;
  assertExactProductionJobSkeletons(workflow, expected, () => { externalWriteEligible += 1; });
  assert.equal(externalWriteEligible, 1);
  externalWriteEligible = 0;
  const faults = [
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "\"jobs\":\n"),
    workflow.replace("on:\n", "'on':\n"),
    workflow.replace("  workflow_dispatch:\n", "  \"push\":\n  workflow_dispatch:\n"),
    workflow.replace("  workflow_dispatch:\n", "  'pull_request_target':\n  workflow_dispatch:\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "jobs:\n  _unlisted:\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "jobs:\n  \"unlisted\":\n"),
    workflow.replace("jobs:\n", "jobs:\n  Unlisted:\n"),
    workflow.replace("  preflight:\n", "  \"preflight\":\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    Runs-on: ubuntu-24.04"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: &runner ubuntu-24.04"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: *runner"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    <<: *shared\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    defaults: {}\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    container: ubuntu:24.04\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    services: {}\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: self-hosted"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04", "    runs-on: ubuntu-latest"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    unlisted: true\n"),
    workflow.replace("    needs: preflight\n", "    needs: [preflight, deploy-note]\n"),
    workflow.replace("    if: ${{ success() && github.run_attempt == 1 }}", "    if: ${{ always() }}"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    continue-on-error: true\n"),
    workflow.replace("    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n", "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 999\n"),
    workflow.replace("    environment: vultr-japan-production", "    environment: unreviewed"),
    workflow.replace("    outputs:\n", "    outputs:\n      unlisted: forged\n"),
    workflow.replace("    permissions:\n", "    permissions:\n      issues: write\n"),
    workflow.replace("    steps:\n", "    steps:\n      - run: echo unreviewed\n")
  ];
  for (const fault of faults) {
    assert.throws(
      () => assertExactProductionJobSkeletons(fault, expected, () => { externalWriteEligible += 1; }),
      /workflow_job_skeleton_invalid/
    );
  }
  assert.equal(externalWriteEligible, 0);
});

test("production workflow rejects raw permission duplicates, aliases, case drift, and unlisted scope", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const expected = Object.freeze({
    preflight: Object.freeze({ actions: "read", attestations: "read", checks: "read", contents: "read", "pull-requests": "read", statuses: "read" }),
    deploy: Object.freeze({ actions: "read", attestations: "read", checks: "read", contents: "read", "id-token": "write", "pull-requests": "read", statuses: "read" }),
    "deploy-note": Object.freeze({ actions: "read", contents: "read", "pull-requests": "write" })
  });
  const faults = [
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "permissions: {}\npermissions: {}"),
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "permissions: &shared {}"),
    workflow.replace("permissions: {}", "Permissions: {}"),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "deploy", (block) => block.replace("      contents: read", "      contents: read\n      contents: read")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "preflight", (block) => block.replace("    permissions:\n", "    permissions: *shared\n")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "deploy-note", (block) => block.replace("      contents: read", "      Contents: read")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "deploy-note", (block) => block.replace("      contents: read", "      contents: read\n      issues: write")),
    withJobPermissionMutation(workflow, "preflight", (block) => block.replace("    permissions:\n", "    permissions: {}\n    permissions:\n"))
  ];
  for (const fault of faults) {
    assert.throws(() => assertExactPermissionTopology(fault, expected), /workflow_permissions_invalid|AssertionError/);
  }
});
```
