- [ ] **Step 3: Add exact preflight and post-approval CLI adapters**

The two leaf scripts each include the following private closed flag/run-identity parser bytes verbatim; neither exports them or imports a third parser. This deliberate two-file copy has no success authority: after local syntax/identity validation, every operation immediately throws the same full-Sigstore owner STOP before any port is constructed or read. The copy is source-reviewed here; a later success supplement must either consolidate it under an approved owner or add explicit byte-drift tests before enabling any port.

```js
function parseClosedFlags(tokens, expectedNames) {
  if (!Array.isArray(tokens) || tokens.length !== expectedNames.length * 2) {
    throw new Error("production_cli_flags_invalid");
  }
  const flags = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const flag = tokens[index];
    const value = tokens[index + 1];
    if (typeof flag !== "string" || !flag.startsWith("--")
      || !expectedNames.includes(flag.slice(2)) || Object.hasOwn(flags, flag.slice(2))
      || typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.startsWith("--")) {
      throw new Error("production_cli_flags_invalid");
    }
    flags[flag.slice(2)] = value;
  }
  if (expectedNames.some((name) => !Object.hasOwn(flags, name))) {
    throw new Error("production_cli_flags_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(flags);
}

function parseRunIdentity(flags) {
  const sourceCommit = flags["expected-source-commit"];
  const actor = flags.actor?.toLowerCase();
  const triggeringActor = flags["triggering-actor"]?.toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(sourceCommit)
    || !/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(flags["run-id"])
    || flags["run-attempt"] !== "1"
    || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/.test(actor ?? "")
    || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/.test(triggeringActor ?? "")) {
    throw new Error("production_run_identity_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    repository: "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal",
    ref: "refs/heads/master",
    sourceCommit,
    workflowSha: sourceCommit,
    runId: flags["run-id"],
    runAttempt: 1,
    actor,
    triggeringActor
  });
}

export async function writePreflightPacket({ outputDirectory, result, packetStore }) {
  const artifactEvidence = result?.artifactEvidence;
  const artifactEvidenceFields = [
    "artifactBytes", "artifactSha256", "artifactSize", "releaseDeclarationBytes",
    "releaseDeclarationValue", "releaseDeclarationSha256", "deploymentPlanStableBody"
  ];
  if (artifactEvidence === null || typeof artifactEvidence !== "object"
    || !Object.isFrozen(artifactEvidence)
    || Reflect.ownKeys(artifactEvidence).some((name, index) => name !== artifactEvidenceFields[index])
    || Reflect.ownKeys(artifactEvidence).length !== artifactEvidenceFields.length
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(artifactEvidence.artifactBytes)
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationBytes)
    || !Object.isFrozen(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationValue)
    || !Object.isFrozen(artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody)
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(result.deploymentPlanBytes)
    || !Buffer.isBuffer(result.productionGateReceiptBytes)) {
    throw new Error("preflight_packet_invalid");
  }
  const artifactBytes = Buffer.from(artifactEvidence.artifactBytes);
  const plan = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(result.deploymentPlanBytes, DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_CONTRACT);
  const gate = parseCanonicalJsonBytes(
    result.productionGateReceiptBytes,
    PRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_CONTRACT
  );
  const planStableBody = Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(
    DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_STABLE_BODY_CONTRACT.fieldOrder.map((name) => [name, plan[name]])
  ));
  const inventoryDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(plan.databaseContracts);
  const releaseDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(
    artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationValue?.databaseContracts
  );
  const stableBodyDatabase = canonicalizeDatabaseContracts(
    artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody?.databaseContracts
  );
  if (artifactBytes.length !== artifactEvidence.artifactSize
    || sha256Hex(artifactBytes) !== artifactEvidence.artifactSha256
    || sha256Hex(artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationBytes)
      !== artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || artifactBytes.length !== plan.artifact.sizeBytes
    || artifactEvidence.artifactSha256 !== plan.artifact.sha256
    || artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256 !== plan.artifact.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || sha256Hex(result.productionGateReceiptBytes) !== plan.productionGateReceiptSha256
    || gate.artifactSha256 !== artifactEvidence.artifactSha256
    || gate.releaseDeclarationSha256 !== artifactEvidence.releaseDeclarationSha256
    || computeDeploymentPlanTemplateSha256(artifactEvidence.deploymentPlanStableBody)
      !== gate.deploymentPlanTemplateSha256
    || computeDeploymentPlanTemplateSha256(planStableBody) !== gate.deploymentPlanTemplateSha256
    || !inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(releaseDatabase.bytes)
    || !inventoryDatabase.bytes.equals(stableBodyDatabase.bytes)) {
    artifactBytes.fill(0);
    throw new Error("preflight_packet_artifact_evidence_invalid");
  }
  const files = Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({ name: "control-plane-app.zip", bytes: artifactBytes, executable: false }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "deployment-plan.json", bytes: result.deploymentPlanBytes, executable: false }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "preapproval-evidence.json", bytes: result.preapprovalEvidenceBytes, executable: false }),
    Object.freeze({ name: "production-gate.json", bytes: result.productionGateReceiptBytes, executable: false })
  ]);
  if (files.some(({ bytes }) => !Buffer.isBuffer(bytes))) throw new Error("preflight_packet_invalid");
  await packetStore.writeExactDirectory({ outputDirectory, files });
  const observed = await packetStore.readExactDirectory({ outputDirectory, expectedNames: files.map(({ name }) => name) });
  for (const expected of files) {
    const actual = observed.files.find(({ name }) => name === expected.name);
    if (actual === undefined || actual.executable !== false || !actual.bytes.equals(expected.bytes)) {
      throw new Error("preflight_packet_readback_invalid");
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    fileNames: Object.freeze(files.map(({ name }) => name)),
    files: observed.files,
    preapprovalEvidenceSha256: result.preapprovalEvidenceSha256
  });
}

export async function runProductionPreflightCli({ argv }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation !== "preflight") throw new Error("production_preflight_operation_invalid");
  const flags = parseClosedFlags(tokens, ["production-gate-id", "run-id", "run-attempt", "actor", "triggering-actor", "trusted-checkout", "expected-source-commit", "output", "github-output"]);
  parseRunIdentity(flags);
  throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
}

export async function runPostApprovalCli({ argv }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation === "authorize") {
    parseClosedFlags(tokens, ["postapproval-evidence", "scope-attestation", "output"]);
    throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
  }
  if (operation !== "verify") throw new Error("postapproval_operation_invalid");
  const flags = parseClosedFlags(tokens, ["production-gate-id", "run-id", "run-attempt", "actor", "triggering-actor", "trusted-checkout", "expected-source-commit", "input", "output"]);
  parseRunIdentity(flags);
  throw new Error("github_full_sigstore_owner_unavailable");
}
```

Both source files have a real direct-execution guard, but no operations factory exists in this revision because the closed parser immediately raises the full-Sigstore owner STOP before reading env, stdio, a file, clock, random source, GitHub client, or packet store. Each `main()` calls its one `run*Cli` with only `process.argv.slice(2)`, catches to a script-specific literal one-line error, and sets exit code `2`; exit `0` is intentionally unreachable. Direct execution uses `pathToFileURL(process.argv[1])`; import does not execute. Unit tests execute all three current legal selectors and prove mandatory owner-unavailable failure with zero operation/stdout access; invalid-argv and direct-main behavior remain source-reviewed rather than claimed as dynamically covered here. The dormant `writePreflightPacket` helper remains source-reviewed only and is never called.

In `control-plane-production-preflight.mjs`:

```js
export async function main({
  argv = process.argv.slice(2),
  stderr = process.stderr
} = {}) {
  try {
    await runProductionPreflightCli({ argv });
    throw new Error("production_preflight_unreachable_success");
  } catch {
    stderr.write("production_preflight_failed\n");
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  await main();
}
```

In `control-plane-postapproval-check.mjs`:

```js
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

export async function main({
  argv = process.argv.slice(2),
  stderr = process.stderr
} = {}) {
  try {
    await runPostApprovalCli({ argv });
    throw new Error("postapproval_unreachable_success");
  } catch {
    stderr.write("postapproval_failed\n");
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  await main();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the manual production workflow**

```yaml
name: Japan Control Plane Production Deploy

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      production_gate_id:
        description: Fresh immutable Production Gate ID
        required: true
        type: string
      confirmation:
        description: Type deploy japan control-plane production
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: japan-control-plane-production-authority
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  preflight:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      attestations: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      statuses: read
    outputs:
      controller_recovery_id: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.controller_recovery_id }}
      source_commit: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.source_commit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - id: plan
        name: Resolve immutable Gate and build no-secret plan
        shell: bash
        env:
          CONFIRMATION: ${{ inputs.confirmation }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PRODUCTION_GATE_ID: ${{ inputs.production_gate_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${CONFIRMATION}" = "deploy japan control-plane production"
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = "refs/heads/master"
          test "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" = "1"
          node scripts/control-plane-production-preflight.mjs preflight \
            --production-gate-id "${PRODUCTION_GATE_ID}" \
            --run-id "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --run-attempt "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            --actor "${GITHUB_ACTOR}" \
            --triggering-actor "${GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR}" \
            --trusted-checkout "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" \
            --expected-source-commit "${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: control-plane-preflight-packet
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/preflight-packet
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  deploy:
    needs: preflight
    if: ${{ success() && github.run_attempt == 1 }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: vultr-japan-production
    permissions:
      actions: read
      attestations: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: read
      statuses: read
    outputs:
      final_status_available: ${{ steps.controller.outputs.final_status_available }}
      deploy_note_eligible: ${{ steps.controller.outputs.deploy_note_eligible }}
    steps:
      - name: Fresh production approval recheck before any other executable
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c74a4aee543508d2ffcb1c3799cdea
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fail = () => { throw new Error("production_step0_recheck_invalid"); };
            const repository = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
            const [owner, repo] = repository.split("/");
            if (context.ref !== "refs/heads/master" || context.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || Number(context.runAttempt) !== 1) fail();
            const api = (route, parameters = {}) => github.request(route, { owner, repo, ...parameters });
            const [branch, environment, approvals] = await Promise.all([
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/master"),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}", { environment_name: "vultr-japan-production" }),
              api("GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approvals", { run_id: context.runId })
            ]);
            const required = environment.data?.protection_rules?.filter((row) => row.type === "required_reviewers");
            const approved = (Array.isArray(approvals.data) ? approvals.data : []).filter((row) =>
              row.state === "approved" && row.environments?.length === 1
              && row.environments[0]?.name === "vultr-japan-production");
            if (branch.data?.commit?.sha !== process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.protected_branches !== true
              || environment.data?.deployment_branch_policy?.custom_branch_policies !== false
              || environment.data?.can_admins_bypass !== false
              || !Array.isArray(required) || required.length !== 1 || required[0].prevent_self_review !== true
              || !Array.isArray(required[0].reviewers) || required[0].reviewers.length < 1
              || required[0].reviewers.some((row) => row.type !== "User"
                || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.reviewer?.id) || row.reviewer.id < 1
                || typeof row.reviewer?.login !== "string"
                || !/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38})$/i.test(row.reviewer.login))
              || approved.length !== 1 || !approved[0].user?.login || !approved[0].user?.id
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(context.actor).toLowerCase()
              || approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase() === String(process.env.GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR).toLowerCase()) fail();
            const user = (await api("GET /users/{username}", { username: approved[0].user.login })).data;
            if (String(user?.id) !== String(approved[0].user.id)
              || String(user?.login).toLowerCase() !== approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()
              || required[0].reviewers.filter((row) => String(row.reviewer.id) === String(approved[0].user.id)
                && row.reviewer.login.toLowerCase() === approved[0].user.login.toLowerCase()).length !== 1) fail();
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - name: Download exact preflight packet without secrets
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-preflight-packet
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/preflight-packet
      - name: Recheck approval and immutable evidence before secrets
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PRODUCTION_GATE_ID: ${{ inputs.production_gate_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          node scripts/control-plane-postapproval-check.mjs verify \
            --production-gate-id "${PRODUCTION_GATE_ID}" \
            --run-id "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --run-attempt "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            --actor "${GITHUB_ACTOR}" \
            --triggering-actor "${GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR}" \
            --trusted-checkout "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" \
            --expected-source-commit "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
            --input "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet" \
            --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/postapproval.json"
      - name: Require the unapproved Foundation offline npm closure owner before repository runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s\n' "full_sigstore_owner_topology_unapproved" >&2
          exit 2
      - name: Install exact controller runtime dependencies from the Foundation-owned offline closure only
        shell: bash
        env:
          npm_config_ignore_scripts: "true"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --omit=dev
      - name: Attest Environment-only authorization scopes
        shell: bash
        env:
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_ID: ${{ vars.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_ID }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_INSTALLATION_ID: ${{ vars.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_INSTALLATION_ID }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/control-plane-github-scope-attestor.mjs attest \
            --repository "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal" \
            --environment "vultr-japan-production" \
            --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/scope-attestation.json"
      - name: Finalize unique canonical authorization record
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/control-plane-postapproval-check.mjs authorize \
            --postapproval-evidence "${RUNNER_TEMP}/postapproval.json" \
            --scope-attestation "${RUNNER_TEMP}/scope-attestation.json" \
            --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-authorization.json"
      - name: Create exact empty private closeout root without secrets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CLOSEOUT_ROOT="${RUNNER_TEMP}/closeout"
          test ! -e "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}"
          umask 077
          mkdir -m 700 -- "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}"
          test -d "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}"
          test ! -L "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}"
          test "$(realpath -- "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}")" = "$(realpath -- "${RUNNER_TEMP}")/closeout"
          test "$(stat -c '%a' -- "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}")" = "700"
          test -z "$(find "${CLOSEOUT_ROOT}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)"
      - name: Execute approved production controller
        id: controller
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_HOST }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PORT: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PORT }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_USER }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS: ${{ secrets.JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/control-plane-production-controller.mjs execute \
            --plan "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet/deployment-plan.json" \
            --gate-receipt "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet/production-gate.json" \
            --artifact "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet/control-plane-app.zip" \
            --postapproval-evidence "${RUNNER_TEMP}/postapproval.json" \
            --authorization-record "${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-authorization.json" \
            --closeout-directory "${RUNNER_TEMP}/closeout" \
            --retention-days "35" \
            --final-status-output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/final-status.json" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Upload aggregate final status only
        if: ${{ steps.controller.outputs.final_status_available == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: control-plane-final-status-${{ needs.preflight.outputs.controller_recovery_id }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/final-status.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Remove and read back absent all transient deploy material
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf -- "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/closeout"
          rm -f -- "${RUNNER_TEMP}/postapproval.json" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/scope-attestation.json" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-authorization.json" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/final-status.json"
          for target in \
            "${RUNNER_TEMP}/preflight-packet" \
            "${RUNNER_TEMP}/closeout" \
            "${RUNNER_TEMP}/postapproval.json" \
            "${RUNNER_TEMP}/scope-attestation.json" \
            "${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-authorization.json" \
            "${RUNNER_TEMP}/final-status.json"; do
            test ! -e "${target}"
          done
      - name: Preserve controller conclusion
        if: ${{ steps.controller.outcome != 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: exit 1

  deploy-note:
    needs: [preflight, deploy]
    if: ${{ always() && github.run_attempt == 1 && needs.deploy.outputs.deploy_note_eligible == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: control-plane-final-status-${{ needs.preflight.outputs.controller_recovery_id }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/final-status
      - name: Append bounded Deploy Note to the exact merged PR
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.source_commit }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          node scripts/control-plane-deploy-note.mjs record \
            --repository "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal" \
            --run-id "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --run-attempt "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            --final-status "${RUNNER_TEMP}/final-status/final-status.json"
```

test("unapproved offline closure cannot be bypassed into cache, registry, secret, or controller use", async () => {
  const workflow = await readFile(path, "utf8");
  const assertClosedOfflineInstall = (candidate, onExternalEffectEligible) => {
    const deploy = jobBlock(candidate, "deploy");
    const recheck = deploy.indexOf("Recheck approval and immutable evidence before secrets");
    const stop = deploy.indexOf(
      "Require the unapproved Foundation offline npm closure owner before repository runtime"
    );
    const install = deploy.indexOf(
      "Install exact controller runtime dependencies from the Foundation-owned offline closure only"
    );
    const secret = deploy.indexOf("JAPAN_CONTROL_DEPLOY_METADATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY");
    const controller = deploy.indexOf("Execute approved production controller");
    const stopBody = deploy.slice(stop, install);
    const installBody = deploy.slice(install, secret);
    if (!(recheck >= 0 && recheck < stop && stop < install && install < secret && secret < controller)
      || !/full_sigstore_owner_topology_unapproved/.test(stopBody) || !/exit 2/.test(stopBody)
      || !/npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --omit=dev/.test(installBody)
      || /cache:\s*npm|actions\/cache@|npm_config_registry|--prefer-online|--offline=false/.test(candidate)) {
      throw new Error("production_offline_closure_boundary_invalid");
    }
    onExternalEffectEligible();
  };
  let externalEffectEligible = 0;
  assertClosedOfflineInstall(workflow, () => { externalEffectEligible += 1; });
  assert.equal(externalEffectEligible, 1);
  for (const fault of [
    workflow.replace("full_sigstore_owner_topology_unapproved", "owner_available"),
    workflow.replace("          exit 2\n", "          true\n"),
    workflow.replace("npm ci --offline", "npm ci --prefer-online"),
    workflow.replace("          npm_config_ignore_scripts: \"true\"\n", "          npm_config_ignore_scripts: \"true\"\n          npm_config_registry: https://registry.invalid\n"),
    workflow.replace("          node-version: '22.23.1'\n", "          node-version: '22.23.1'\n          cache: npm\n")
  ]) {
    externalEffectEligible = 0;
    assert.throws(
      () => assertClosedOfflineInstall(fault, () => { externalEffectEligible += 1; }),
      /production_offline_closure_boundary_invalid/
    );
    assert.equal(externalEffectEligible, 0);
  }
});

### Task 13: Isolated Deploy Note writer

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/control-plane-deploy-note.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-deploy-note.test.mjs`
- Create: `server/tests/control-plane-controller-output-deploy-note.integration.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes Receipt-owned `CONTROLLER_FINAL_STATUS_CONTRACT`, `buildControllerFinalStatus`, `inspectControllerFinalStatus`, `validateControllerFinalStatus`, and test-only `makeControllerFinalStatusFixture(...)` from `server/tests/helpers/control-plane-receipt-fixtures.mjs`; Artifact declares no competing final-status contract or parser.
- `node scripts/control-plane-deploy-note.mjs record --repository gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal --run-id <id> --run-attempt 1 --final-status <file>` derives the repository root internally and performs exactly two stages. Stage one reads only the explicitly downloaded final-status file and calls Receipt-owned `inspectControllerFinalStatus(bytes, expectedRun)`; a no-claim or nonterminal result returns before reading the identity file or making any GitHub request. Stage two, reachable only for an inspected validated terminal result, reads the fixed `MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH`, resolves exact PR/ancestry through the Integration owner, calls `validateControllerFinalStatus(bytes, expected)` with all four owner-resolved identity bindings, renders result-specific text only for that validated result, and writes at most one bounded comment to the fixed repository route and exact `mainSourcePrNumber`. It accepts no repository/identity path, PR number, merge SHA, API base URL, or identity flag; it never queries PRs associated with `status.sourceCommit`.
- The result-specific comment shape is closed. Only `validated_deployment` has seven output lines and maps Receipt-owned `finalStatus.terminalPublishedAt` to `deployed_at`; it never substitutes controller `observedAt`. `validated_stopped_pre_switch`, `validated_schema_only_change`, `validated_rolled_back`, and `validated_critical_failure` each have the exact six common lines and structurally omit `deployed_at`. Their wording cannot imply a successful deployment. Unknown/extra/missing conditional fields fail before the comment request.

- [ ] **Step 1: Implement exact main-source-PR Deploy Note validation**

```js
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import {
  inspectControllerFinalStatus,
  validateControllerFinalStatus
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-controller-closeout.mjs";
import {
  MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH,
  resolveMainSourceIdentity
} from "../server/services/deployment/control-plane-main-source-identity.mjs";
import {
  serializeCanonicalJsonBytes,
  sha256Hex
} from "../server/services/deployment/canonical-json.mjs";

const DEPLOY_NOTE_REPOSITORY = "gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal";
const DEPLOY_NOTE_REPOSITORY_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const DEPLOY_NOTE_MAX_BYTES = 2_048;
const DEPLOY_NOTE_COMMON_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
  Object.freeze(["releaseUnit", "release_unit"]),
  Object.freeze(["sourceCommit", "source_commit"]),
  Object.freeze(["artifactOrRelease", "artifact_or_release"]),
  Object.freeze(["target", "target"]),
  Object.freeze(["backup", "backup"]),
  Object.freeze(["validation", "validation"])
]);
const DEPLOY_NOTE_FIELDS_BY_RESULT = Object.freeze({
  validated_deployment: Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze(["deployedAt", "deployed_at"]),
    ...DEPLOY_NOTE_COMMON_FIELDS
  ]),
  validated_stopped_pre_switch: DEPLOY_NOTE_COMMON_FIELDS,
  validated_schema_only_change: DEPLOY_NOTE_COMMON_FIELDS,
  validated_rolled_back: DEPLOY_NOTE_COMMON_FIELDS,
  validated_critical_failure: DEPLOY_NOTE_COMMON_FIELDS
});

function assertExactKeys(value, expected, code) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)
    || Object.keys(value).length !== expected.length
    || Object.keys(value).some((name, index) => name !== expected[index])) {
    throw new Error(code);
  }
}

function assertSafeDeployNoteValue(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.length > 256
    || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(value)) {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_body_invalid");
  }
  return value;
}

export function renderBoundedDeployNote(value) {
  const fields = DEPLOY_NOTE_FIELDS_BY_RESULT[value?.resultCode];
  if (fields === undefined) throw new Error("deploy_note_body_invalid");
  const expected = ["resultCode", ...fields.map(([name]) => name)];
  assertExactKeys(value, expected, "deploy_note_body_invalid");
  const body = `${fields
    .map(([name, label]) => `${label}: ${assertSafeDeployNoteValue(value[name])}`)
    .join("\n")}\n`;
  if (Buffer.byteLength(body, "utf8") > DEPLOY_NOTE_MAX_BYTES) {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_body_invalid");
  }
  return body;
}

export async function createPullRequestComment(input) {
  assertExactKeys(
    input,
    ["repository", "pullNumber", "body", "token", "fetchFn"],
    "deploy_note_comment_input_invalid"
  );
  if (input.repository !== DEPLOY_NOTE_REPOSITORY
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.pullNumber) || input.pullNumber < 1
    || typeof input.body !== "string" || input.body.length < 1
    || Buffer.byteLength(input.body, "utf8") > DEPLOY_NOTE_MAX_BYTES
    || typeof input.token !== "string" || input.token.length < 1 || input.token.length > 4_096
    || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/u.test(input.token)
    || typeof input.fetchFn !== "function") {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_comment_input_invalid");
  }
  const response = await input.fetchFn(
    `https://api.github.com/repos/gccwebos-com/proxy-gateway-minimal/issues/${input.pullNumber}/comments`,
    Object.freeze({
      method: "POST",
      redirect: "error",
      headers: Object.freeze({
        accept: "application/vnd.github+json",
        authorization: `Bearer ${input.token}`,
        "content-type": "application/json",
        "x-github-api-version": "2022-11-28"
      }),
      body: JSON.stringify({ body: input.body })
    })
  );
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("deploy_note_comment_write_failed");
  const result = await response.json();
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(result?.id) || result.id < 1) {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_comment_response_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ commentId: result.id });
}

export async function recordDeployNote({ repositoryRoot, repository, runId, runAttempt, finalStatusBytes, token, fetchFn }) {
  if (repository !== DEPLOY_NOTE_REPOSITORY || runAttempt !== 1) throw new Error("deploy_note_identity_invalid");
  const inspected = inspectControllerFinalStatus(finalStatusBytes, Object.freeze({
    runId: String(runId),
    runAttempt: 1
  }));
  if (inspected.terminal !== true || inspected.validationState !== "validated") {
    return Object.freeze({ recorded: false, reason: "nonterminal_noop" });
  }
  const identityBytes = await readFile(resolve(repositoryRoot, MAIN_SOURCE_IDENTITY_PATH));
  const mainSourceIdentity = await resolveMainSourceIdentity({
    bytes: identityBytes,
    expectedSourceCommit: inspected.sourceCommit,
    token,
    fetchFn
  });
  const status = validateControllerFinalStatus(finalStatusBytes, Object.freeze({
    runId: String(runId),
    runAttempt: 1,
    mainSourceIdentitySha256: mainSourceIdentity.sha256,
    mainSourcePrNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    mainSourceHeadSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceHeadSha,
    mainSourceMergeCommitSha: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourceMergeCommitSha
  }));
  const wording = Object.freeze({
    validated_deployment: "deployment completed and final validation passed",
    validated_stopped_pre_switch: "deployment stopped before switch and the unchanged service was validated",
    validated_schema_only_change: "schema-only transaction completed and final validation passed",
    validated_rolled_back: "deployment rolled back and rollback validation passed",
    validated_critical_failure: "critical failure was durably recorded and the final failure state was validated"
  })[status.resultCode];
  if (!wording) throw new Error("deploy_note_result_invalid");
  const body = renderBoundedDeployNote({
    resultCode: status.resultCode,
    ...(status.resultCode === "validated_deployment"
      ? { deployedAt: status.terminalPublishedAt }
      : {}),
    releaseUnit: "control-plane-app",
    sourceCommit: status.sourceCommit,
    artifactOrRelease: status.artifactReleaseTag,
    target: "japan-control-plane",
    backup: status.backupResult,
    validation: wording
  });
  await createPullRequestComment({
    repository,
    pullNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    body,
    token,
    fetchFn
  });
  return Object.freeze({
    recorded: true,
    pullNumber: mainSourceIdentity.value.mainSourcePrNumber,
    bodySha256: sha256Hex(Buffer.from(body, "utf8"))
  });
}

const DEPLOY_NOTE_SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT = Object.freeze({
  schemaId: "control-plane-deploy-note-safe-result-v1",
  maxBytes: 512,
  fieldOrder: Object.freeze(["recorded", "reason", "pullNumber", "bodySha256"]),
  nested: Object.freeze({}),
  arrays: Object.freeze({}),
  validate(value) {
    const recorded = value.recorded === true && value.reason === null
      && Number.isSafeInteger(value.pullNumber) && value.pullNumber > 0
      && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value.bodySha256);
    const noOp = value.recorded === false && value.reason === "nonterminal_noop"
      && value.pullNumber === null && value.bodySha256 === null;
    if (!recorded && !noOp) throw new Error("deploy_note_safe_result_invalid");
  }
});

function parseDeployNoteFlags(tokens) {
  const expected = Object.freeze(["repository", "run-id", "run-attempt", "final-status"]);
  if (!Array.isArray(tokens) || tokens.length !== expected.length * 2) {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_flags_invalid");
  }
  const flags = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const flag = tokens[index];
    const value = tokens[index + 1];
    if (typeof flag !== "string" || !flag.startsWith("--")
      || !expected.includes(flag.slice(2)) || Object.hasOwn(flags, flag.slice(2))
      || typeof value !== "string" || value.length < 1 || value.startsWith("--")) {
      throw new Error("deploy_note_flags_invalid");
    }
    flags[flag.slice(2)] = value;
  }
  if (expected.some((name) => !Object.hasOwn(flags, name))) {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_flags_invalid");
  }
  return Object.freeze(flags);
}

export async function runDeployNoteCli({ argv, env, stdout, fetchFn = globalThis.fetch }) {
  const [operation, ...tokens] = argv;
  if (operation !== "record") throw new Error("deploy_note_operation_invalid");
  const flags = parseDeployNoteFlags(tokens);
  if (flags.repository !== DEPLOY_NOTE_REPOSITORY
    || !/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(flags["run-id"])
    || flags["run-attempt"] !== "1"
    || typeof env.GITHUB_TOKEN !== "string" || env.GITHUB_TOKEN.length < 1) {
    throw new Error("deploy_note_identity_invalid");
  }
  const result = await recordDeployNote({
    repositoryRoot: DEPLOY_NOTE_REPOSITORY_ROOT,
    repository: flags.repository,
    runId: flags["run-id"],
    runAttempt: 1,
    finalStatusBytes: await readFile(resolve(flags["final-status"])),
    token: env.GITHUB_TOKEN,
    fetchFn
  });
  const safeResult = Object.freeze({
    recorded: result.recorded,
    reason: result.recorded ? null : result.reason,
    pullNumber: result.recorded ? result.pullNumber : null,
    bodySha256: result.recorded ? result.bodySha256 : null
  });
  stdout.write(`${serializeCanonicalJsonBytes(safeResult, DEPLOY_NOTE_SAFE_RESULT_CONTRACT).toString("utf8")}\n`);
  return 0;
}

export async function main({
  argv = process.argv.slice(2),
  env = process.env,
  stdout = process.stdout,
  stderr = process.stderr,
  fetchFn = globalThis.fetch
} = {}) {
  try {
    process.exitCode = await runDeployNoteCli({ argv, env, stdout, fetchFn });
  } catch {
    stderr.write("deploy_note_failed\n");
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  await main();
}
```

## Independent PR Boundary

- Current authorization permits only the separate exact 11-file authority-bootstrap Draft PR owned outside Tasks 1–14. It authorizes no Artifact implementation file, serial task commit, push, main Draft PR, Task 14 validation, or rollout handoff.
- A future main source-only Draft PR is not authorized merely because the authority-bootstrap predecessor merges. Before that PR can be proposed, a separately approved Risk-A unified full-Sigstore owner and real multi-pair corpus/private brand must be GREEN on protected `master`; that same owner must successfully postverify the published immutable Foundation v2 lock; a separately approved complete content-addressed offline npm closure must be published and digest-read-back; every fixed owner-unavailable stop must be removed through review; and the operator must explicitly approve Tasks 1–14 as Risk A work.
- Only after those approvals may Tasks 1–13 become reviewable implementation boundaries and Task 14 become a no-change validation boundary. Until then `full_sigstore_owner_topology_unapproved` precedes implementation, Settings, Release publication, Ready, and merge; current documentation validation cannot authorize or silently create any predecessor or PR.
- Any future source merge still does not authorize a manual workflow dispatch. The settings/configuration Gate, compatibility bootstrap sequence, fresh read-only inventory, normal Artifact Gate, Production Gate, protected Deploy click, and any recovery invocation retain their own explicit Risk A approvals.

## Spec Coverage and Residual Risks

| Approved design area | Owning tasks in this plan | Evidence before Ready | Residual stop condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Manual trigger and immutable Production Gate | Tasks 1, 8, 9, 10, 12 | ID/TTL/outer-inner and static workflow tests | Full-Sigstore owner unavailable; no Gate may be published |
| Durable artifact, writer/declaration, bounded assembly | Tasks 3–5, 9–10 | canonical copy, tree, ZIP, lifecycle, offline-build tests | Source artifact may not enter any publisher while STOP is active |
| No-secret preflight and GitHub policy | Tasks 6, 8, 12 | exact inventory-owned tuples, policy, reviewer tests | Release evidence bridge always stops; no ready/valid output |
| Permission and credential separation | Tasks 6, 9, 10, 12 | static job/action/scope/first-step tests | Every write job remains zero-effect and undispatched |
| Human Deploy, automatic execution/rollback/verification | Tasks 11–12 plus host/DB plan | pure controller/protocol/receipt algebra tests | Operational path unreachable before OIDC/secrets/SSH |
| Durable closeout and recovery handoff | Tasks 7, 11–13 plus receipt plan | hard-stop fixture, ACK/CAS pure tests | No Release pair or recovery completion can be produced |

- The private repository's live check App IDs are intentionally absent from source constants. Fresh inventory supplies the canonical `requiredCheckContracts`; each workflow row must also join through the check's observed suite ID to one actual Actions run, and a missing or changed producer tuple is a hard stop.
- A future sole published Foundation v2 lock and its private-branded resolver return remain the only permitted builder/native tool authority, but neither exists as eligible evidence in this revision. The same future lock/candidate/offline-package closure bindings require a passing target-matched Linux receipt; Windows-only tests, ordinary hosted-runner unit tests, a tracked alternate digest, online npm fetch, or synthetic lock evidence cannot substitute for it.
- GitHub YAML cannot establish Environment protection, required reviewers, retention capability, or secret scope. Separate settings readback must prove those facts before any dispatch.
- Compatibility namespace and receipt layouts are dormant bootstrap design only; no compatibility asset is currently published or durable, and production preflight is independently stopped.
- A controller transport interruption is never converted into a production claim. Only receipt-owned validated results and the exact immutable closeout/observation/ACK sequence can close the run.

## Self-Review

- [ ] **Current plan-only authorization-boundary scan:** this is the only executable review check introduced by this supplement. It reads only this plan's bytes/text, computes its digest, and statically checks its fences, frozen symbol spellings, deferred markers, whitespace, and authorization boundary; it imports or executes no workspace source, runs no source test, and creates no source, commit, PR, or external state:

```powershell
$artifactPlanPath = 'docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-github-control-plane-artifact-and-workflow.md'
$artifactPlanBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($artifactPlanPath)
$artifactPlanUtf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
$artifactPlanText = $artifactPlanUtf8.GetString($artifactPlanBytes)
$artifactPlanRoundTripBytes = $artifactPlanUtf8.GetBytes($artifactPlanText)

function Get-ArtifactPlanSha256([byte[]]$Bytes) {
  $algorithm = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
  try {
    return ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($algorithm.ComputeHash($Bytes))).Replace('-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
  }
  finally {
    $algorithm.Dispose()
  }
}

$artifactPlanSha256 = Get-ArtifactPlanSha256 $artifactPlanBytes
$artifactPlanRoundTripSha256 = Get-ArtifactPlanSha256 $artifactPlanRoundTripBytes
if ($artifactPlanBytes.Length -ne $artifactPlanRoundTripBytes.Length -or
    $artifactPlanSha256 -ne $artifactPlanRoundTripSha256 -or
    [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($artifactPlanPath, $artifactPlanUtf8) -cne $artifactPlanText) {
  throw 'artifact_plan_utf8_roundtrip_invalid'
}
if ($artifactPlanBytes.Length -eq 0 -or $artifactPlanBytes[-1] -ne 0x0A -or
    $artifactPlanText.Contains("`r") -or
    [regex]::IsMatch($artifactPlanText, '(?m)[ \t]+$')) {
  throw 'artifact_plan_text_or_whitespace_invalid'
}
if ($artifactPlanBytes.Length -ge 3 -and
    $artifactPlanBytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and
    $artifactPlanBytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and
    $artifactPlanBytes[2] -eq 0xBF) {
  throw 'artifact_plan_utf8_bom_forbidden'
}
if ($artifactPlanSha256 -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') {
  throw 'artifact_plan_sha256_invalid'
}

@(
  'Current authorization permits only the separate exact 11-file authority-bootstrap',
  'Do not begin Task 1 in the current authorization',
  'unified full-Sigstore owner',
  'published immutable Foundation v2 lock has been successfully postverified by that same unified owner',
  'complete offline npm',
  'There is no currently authorized Artifact source-review or rollout handoff action'
) | ForEach-Object {
  if (-not $artifactPlanText.Contains($_)) { throw "artifact_current_boundary_missing: $_" }
}
if ([regex]::IsMatch($artifactPlanText, '(?m)^git\s+(?:add|commit|push)\b')) {
  throw 'artifact_current_boundary_contains_direct_git_write_command'
}
$legacyExecutionHandoff = 'Execution choices after the combined plan set is independently ' + 'reviewed:'
if ($artifactPlanText.Contains($legacyExecutionHandoff)) {
  throw 'artifact_current_boundary_contains_execution_handoff'
}

  '```yaml' = 3
}
$allFenceLines = [regex]::Matches($artifactPlanText, '(?m)^```[^\r\n]*$')
$expectedFenceLineCount = 0
foreach ($entry in $expectedFenceLines.GetEnumerator()) {
  $actual = [regex]::Matches(
    $artifactPlanText,
    ('(?m)^' + [regex]::Escape([string]$entry.Key) + '\s*$')
  ).Count
  if ($actual -ne $entry.Value) {
    throw "artifact_plan_fence_count_invalid: $($entry.Key): $actual"
  }
  $expectedFenceLineCount += $entry.Value
}
if ($allFenceLines.Count -ne $expectedFenceLineCount) {
  throw "artifact_plan_fence_spelling_invalid: $($allFenceLines.Count)"
}

$expectedSymbolOccurrences = [ordered]@{
  'resolvePublishedFoundationToolchain' = 11
  'resolveInventoryReceipt' = 13
  'resolveControlPlaneRequiredCheckContracts' = 9
  'readWorkflowRuns' = 9
  'requiredCheckContracts' = 35
  'canonicalizeDatabaseContracts' = 32
  'discoverProductionWriters' = 9
  'canonicalizeWriterRegistry' = 9
  'verifyWriterRegistry' = 9
  'deriveProductionAuthorizationOidcAudience' = 10
  'runProductionController' = 49
  'readTerminalBundleBytes' = 7
  'validateAckResponse' = 4
  'validateUploadCommittedObserved' = 4
  'buildControllerFinalStatus' = 9
  'inspectControllerFinalStatus' = 7
  'validateControllerFinalStatus' = 12
  'buildControllerCloseout' = 4
  'writeMissingImmutableAsset' = 11
  'publishImmutableAssetAttestationPair' = 8
}
foreach ($entry in $expectedSymbolOccurrences.GetEnumerator()) {
  $actual = [regex]::Matches($artifactPlanText, [regex]::Escape([string]$entry.Key)).Count
  if ($actual -ne $entry.Value) {
    throw "artifact_plan_symbol_occurrence_invalid: $($entry.Key): $actual"
  }
}

$deferredTerms = @('TO' + 'DO', 'T' + 'BD', 'FIX' + 'ME', 'implement' + ' later', 'fill' + ' in', 'similar' + ' to')
foreach ($term in $deferredTerms) {
  if ($artifactPlanText.Contains($term)) {
    throw "artifact_plan_deferred_marker_present: $term"
  }
}

$selfReviewMarker = '## Self-' + 'Review'
$futureOnlyMarker = '**FUTURE-' + 'ONLY — DO NOT RUN NOW:'
$selfReviewStart = $artifactPlanText.IndexOf($selfReviewMarker, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
$futureOnlyStart = $artifactPlanText.IndexOf($futureOnlyMarker, $selfReviewStart, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
if ($selfReviewStart -lt 0 -or $futureOnlyStart -le $selfReviewStart) {
  throw 'artifact_current_review_boundary_missing'
}
$currentReachableReview = $artifactPlanText.Substring($selfReviewStart, $futureOnlyStart - $selfReviewStart)
$currentForbiddenSourceCommands = [ordered]@{
  workspace_source_import = '(?m)^\s*(?:import\b[^\r\n]*from\s+|}\s*from\s+)["'']\./(?:scripts|server)/'
  dynamic_workspace_import = '(?m)^\s*.*\bimport\s*\(\s*["'']\./(?:scripts|server)/'
  node_stdin_source_execution = '(?m)^\s*\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*\|\s*node(?:\.exe)?\s+--input-type(?:=|\s+)module\b'
  node_source_test = '(?m)^\s*node(?:\.exe)?\s+--test\b'
}
foreach ($entry in $currentForbiddenSourceCommands.GetEnumerator()) {
  if ([regex]::IsMatch($currentReachableReview, [string]$entry.Value)) {
    throw "artifact_current_review_source_command_forbidden: $($entry.Key)"
  }
}

[pscustomobject]@{
  Path = $artifactPlanPath
  Sha256 = $artifactPlanSha256
  Bytes = $artifactPlanBytes.Length
  Lines = [regex]::Matches($artifactPlanText, "`n").Count
  FenceLines = $allFenceLines.Count
}
```
